title: 3 Types of Kofta: Baniyah Kofta, Rice Kofta, Haty Kofta
culturalNotes: Kofta can be frozen by placing it in foam trays, with a plastic bag between each layer to prevent sticking. Let it sit at room temperature before cooking.

instructions.1: Prepare Baniyah Kofta:
instructions.2: Mix ground beef with boiled rice, finely chopped onion, chopped parsley, salt, pepper, meat spices, and instant stock.
instructions.3: Knead the mixture thoroughly until well combined and firm.
instructions.4: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
instructions.5: Dip each kofta in flour, then in a mixture of egg and milk, then in a mixture of breadcrumbs, flour, and cornstarch.
instructions.6: Fry the kofta in hot oil over medium heat until golden brown.
instructions.7: Prepare Rice Kofta:
instructions.8: Mix ground beef with ground rice, finely chopped onion, garlic, mixed vegetables, salt, pepper, cumin, dried coriander, and sugar.
instructions.9: Knead the mixture well until it holds together.
instructions.10: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
instructions.11: Fry the kofta in hot oil over medium heat until golden brown.
instructions.12: Prepare Haty Kofta:
instructions.13: Mix ground beef with washed and drained bulgur, finely chopped onion, chopped parsley, salt, pepper, meat spices, and instant stock.
instructions.14: Knead the mixture for about 10 minutes until firm and cohesive.
instructions.15: Shape the kofta into balls or fingers.
instructions.16: Grill the kofta on a grill, over charcoal, or in the oven until golden brown.

title: Spicy Buffalo Chicken Wings
culturalNotes: You can reduce or omit the chili if you don't like spicy food. You can also serve the wings with a side salad or fries.

instructions.1: Wash the wings thoroughly and soak them in water and vinegar for 10 minutes, then drain.
instructions.2: Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, pepper, and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.3: Pat the wings dry with a kitchen towel, then dip them into the flour and cornstarch mixture, coating them well.
instructions.4: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, then fry the wings until golden brown (about 15–20 minutes).
instructions.5: Drain the fried wings on a kitchen towel.
instructions.6: In another bowl, melt the butter, then add tomato sauce, ketchup, black honey, soy sauce, sugar, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, black pepper, and chili (optional).
instructions.7: Stir the mixture over heat until thickened.
instructions.8: Add the fried wings to the sauce mixture and toss well until fully coated.
instructions.9: Serve hot with side sauces as desired.

title: Steak with Mushroom Sauce
culturalNotes: Beef cuts such as fillet can be used instead of tibon, and they cook faster.

instructions.1: Season the beef cutlets with salt and black pepper on all sides.
instructions.2: Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium heat, then add the beef slices and sear until browned on both sides.
instructions.3: After searing, cover the beef with aluminum foil or a lid to keep it warm.
instructions.4: In the same pan, add the diced onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.5: Add the garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the sliced mushrooms and stir until they reduce in size.
instructions.7: Season with salt and black pepper, and mix well.
instructions.8: Add the flour and stir until fully incorporated with the mushrooms.
instructions.9: Pour in the hot water and stir until the sauce thickens.
instructions.10: Add the cream and instant stock cube, and stir until the sauce is smooth and well blended.
instructions.11: Serve the steak with the mushroom sauce, and optionally accompany with grilled vegetables or white rice.

title: Stuffed Duck with Freekeh
culturalNotes: You can serve stuffed duck with freekeh alongside a green salad or basmati rice. The duck can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for up to one month.

instructions.1: Wash the duck and soak it in water mixed with vinegar and salt for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Rinse the duck and drain it well.
instructions.3: Soak the freekeh in water for 30 minutes, then rinse and drain.
instructions.4: Chop the onion, tomato, carrot, and celery into small pieces.
instructions.5: In a pot, sauté the onions with ghee, salt, pepper, and seven-spice mix.
instructions.6: Add the freekeh to the pot and stir with the onions and spices.
instructions.7: Cook the mixture over low heat for a few minutes until warmed through.
instructions.8: Let the mixture cool completely, then stuff the duck with it.
instructions.9: Close the duck’s opening with the liver and giblets.
instructions.10: Prepare the glaze by mixing ketchup with water and spices.
instructions.11: Brush the glaze over the outside of the duck.
instructions.12: Place the duck in a heatproof bag with vegetables and spices, and seal the bag tightly.
instructions.13: Make 3-4 small cuts in the bag and place it on a baking tray.
instructions.14: Put the tray in a preheated oven at high temperature for 30 minutes.
instructions.15: Lower the oven temperature and continue baking for 2-3 hours until the duck is fully cooked.
instructions.16: Serve the duck with the cooked freekeh in the duck sauce.

title: Kebab the Traditional Way
culturalNotes: You can add onion and pepper while grilling for a delicious aroma. The kebab can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Prepare the ground meat: Have the butcher grind the meat twice, using a 20% fat content.
instructions.2: Prepare the onions: Grate two large onions and drain them well.
instructions.3: Mix the ingredients: Place the ground meat in a bowl, add the grated onions, salt, pepper, sugar, spices, and baking powder. Mix thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.4: Prepare the wrapper: Cut the wrapper into large squares.
instructions.5: Shape the kebabs: Take a portion of the meat mixture and shape it into a finger-like form, then wrap the wrapper around it.
instructions.6: Prepare the skewers: Place the kebabs onto skewers and ensure each piece is securely fastened.
instructions.7: Grill: Place the skewers on the grill over charcoal, leaving enough space to avoid burning. Turn the skewers regularly until the kebabs develop a nice golden color and are fully cooked.
instructions.8: Serve: Serve the kebabs hot, accompanied by parsley, grilled vegetables, and toasted bread.

title: Turkish-style Chicken
culturalNotes: You can add fresh herbs like parsley or fresh coriander for extra flavor. The chicken can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the garlic, hot pepper, green pepper, and tomatoes, and stir for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Add the chicken broth, salt, black pepper, cinnamon, dried coriander, and mix well.
instructions.5: Add the water and bring to a boil.
instructions.6: Add the chicken and simmer gently for 40 minutes.
instructions.7: Add the raisins and green olives, and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Serve the chicken hot with rice or bread.

title: Liver and Tripe with Spices
culturalNotes: Make sure to buy fresh liver and tripe, and wash them thoroughly before cooking. You can serve the dish with parsley and baladi bread for better flavor.

instructions.1: Wash the liver and tripe, then soak them in water for 10 minutes, then drain.
instructions.2: Place the liver and tripe in a pot with boiling water, and boil until the water comes to a boil, then drain.
instructions.3: Transfer the liver and tripe to a clean pot, add boiling water, laurel leaves, mint, cumin, salt, sugar, celery, carrot, tomato, and garlic, and simmer until tender.
instructions.4: Cut the liver and tripe into slices.
instructions.5: In a frying pan, add oil and sauté the tripe for 1 minute, then add garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add onion and stir for 3 minutes until softened.
instructions.7: Add chili pepper and bell pepper, and stir with salt, dried parsley, black pepper, cumin, and spices.
instructions.8: Add the liver to the pan and stir over heat until browned, being careful of splattering oil.
instructions.9: Drain the liver and tripe and serve on a bed of fresh parsley.
instructions.10: Serve the dish with parsley, baladi bread, and sandwiches.

title: Saudi Kabsa with Dukha
culturalNotes: You can store the dukha in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. You can serve kabsa with a green salad or yogurt.

instructions.1: Heat oil in a pot over medium heat, then add chicken pieces and brown them well.
instructions.2: Add the small chopped onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add minced garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.4: Add the correct spices (salt, pepper, cumin, parsley, seven-spice mix, cloves, cassia bark, black pepper, cinnamon, and laurel leaves).
instructions.5: Add the chicken pieces and stir them with the spices, garlic, and onion.
instructions.6: Add grated tomatoes, green pepper, and grated carrots, and mix well.
instructions.7: Add water (2 1/4 cups) and bring to a boil.
instructions.8: Cover the pot and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked.
instructions.9: Add the washed and drained basmati rice and stir well.
instructions.10: Cover the pot and continue cooking on low heat until the rice is fully cooked.
instructions.11: In a separate bowl, mix chopped tomatoes, hot pepper, mint, minced garlic, parsley, chili powder, salt, black pepper, tomato sauce, vinegar, and water. Blend thoroughly.
instructions.12: Strain the dukha into a bowl and set aside.
instructions.13: Add lemon juice to the dukha and mix well.
instructions.14: Serve kabsa hot with dukha on the side.

title: Ghamraoui Kofta
culturalNotes: You can store the kofta after boiling in foam containers and freeze them for later use. You can fry or reheat them as needed.

instructions.1: Mix the ground beef with soaked and well-drained rice.
instructions.2: Add parsley, dill, coriander, chopped onion, garlic, salt, black pepper, cumin, cilantro, seven-spice mix, cinnamon, sugar, and instant stock.
instructions.3: Mix all ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.4: Take a portion of the mixture and shape it into a kofta.
instructions.5: Place the kofta in a baking tray and cover with oil.
instructions.6: Heat oil in a pot and sauté onion slices, tomatoes, and peppers.
instructions.7: Add the kofta to the pot and cover with boiling, salted broth.
instructions.8: Bring to a boil over high heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Reduce heat and let the kofta simmer for 1 to 1.5 hours.
instructions.10: After cooking, you can fry the kofta in eggs and milk, then pan-fry in oil.
instructions.11: Serve hot with fresh parsley.

title: Cold Meat
culturalNotes: Cold meat can also be served with mixed rice. Let the meat rest in the refrigerator for a full day before serving for the best flavor.

instructions.1: Prepare the meat stock using the method demonstrated by chef Fatma Abu Hati.
instructions.2: Wash the meat thoroughly and make small incisions in it using a sharp knife.
instructions.3: Insert black peppercorns, salt, whole peppercorns, ground pepper, whole pepper, tomatoes, onions, carrots, celery, thyme, and clove into the incisions.
instructions.4: Season the meat externally with salt, ground pepper, thyme, and clove.
instructions.5: Let the meat rest for 30 minutes to absorb the seasonings.
instructions.6: Heat a small amount of oil in a pan and brown the meat on all sides until it develops a golden-brown color.
instructions.7: Add the vegetables (onion, tomatoes, carrots, celery, and laurel leaf) to the pan.
instructions.8: Add two cups of boiling water, one teaspoon of sugar, and salt.
instructions.9: Cover the pan with aluminum foil and simmer on low heat for one hour.
instructions.10: After one hour, flip the meat and cover the pan again. Simmer for another hour.
instructions.11: Let the meat cool, then refrigerate it overnight.
instructions.12: The next day, slice the meat thinly.
instructions.13: To prepare the noodles: dice the onion and colored peppers into small cubes.
instructions.14: Heat a small amount of oil and ghee in a pan, add the noodles, and stir until golden brown.
instructions.15: Add the diced onion and colored peppers and stir with the noodles.
instructions.16: Add water, salt, pepper, cinnamon, and meat stock. Simmer until the noodles are cooked through.
instructions.17: To prepare the liver (optional): Heat a small amount of oil in a pan, add the liver, and stir until cooked through.
instructions.18: Add salt, pepper, and cinnamon. Stir until fully cooked.
instructions.19: Serve the cold meat with noodles and liver (if desired).

title: Braised Meat with Spiced Rice
culturalNotes: Serve the dish with nuts and sauce for a stronger flavor. The braised meat can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Trim the fat from the short ribs and tie them with cotton string.
instructions.2: Season the ribs with salt, pepper, and garlic.
instructions.3: Brown the ribs in butter and oil on all sides over medium heat.
instructions.4: Add the onion, celery, tomatoes, laurel leaf, and hot water; bring to a boil.
instructions.5: Stir the ribs after one hour and continue cooking for another hour.
instructions.6: Remove the ribs and let them cool in the refrigerator for 2 to 3 hours.
instructions.7: Strain the broth and blend part of it with the vegetables in a blender.
instructions.8: Return the blended broth to the pan and add the flour; stir until thickened.
instructions.9: Add hot water, salt, pepper, and cinnamon; bring to a boil.
instructions.10: Add the rice to the broth and stir well; bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer.
instructions.11: Add the raisins and let the rice finish cooking.
instructions.12: Sauté the chicken liver in oil until browned, then add spices.
instructions.13: Remove the ribs from the broth and cut into pieces.
instructions.14: Serve the braised meat with rice, liver, and spices.

title: Easy and Delicious Ground Meat Mix
culturalNotes: You can prepare a large batch of ground meat mix in advance before Ramadan and store it in the freezer to save time and effort.

instructions.1: In a pan on the stove, add 1 tablespoon ghee and a little oil.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the ground beef and stir well with the onion until fully cooked.
instructions.4: Add a pinch of sugar, pepper, salt, cinnamon, and thyme, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Let the mixture cook until fully done.
instructions.6: After cooking, let the meat cool completely.
instructions.7: Store the ground meat mix in freezer bags and use as needed.

title: Palestinian Mansaf
culturalNotes: Pita bread can be used instead of baladi bread if available. Nuts can be added for garnish and flavor.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken and clean it thoroughly inside and out.
instructions.2: Cut the chicken lengthwise and make incisions with a knife to help the marinade penetrate.
instructions.3: Slice the onion into wedges.
instructions.4: Mix olive oil, pomegranate molasses, sumac, black pepper, and salt with the onions and stir well.
instructions.5: Rub the chicken with the marinade and let it rest.
instructions.6: Place the chicken in a baking tray, add tomato halves, and drizzle with a little olive oil.
instructions.7: Cover the tray with parchment paper, then with aluminum foil.
instructions.8: Bake in the oven at 220°C for 2 hours.
instructions.9: After removing the chicken from the oven, arrange the baladi bread on a serving platter.
instructions.10: Pour the onion sauce made with onions, olive oil, and sumac over the bread.
instructions.11: Garnish the dish with pomegranate seeds, cilantro, lemon, and nuts as desired.
instructions.12: Serve hot.

title: Lebanese Mansaf
culturalNotes: You can store the rice in the refrigerator for up to two days. You can serve the dish with tahini salad or grilled eggplant.

instructions.1: Heat the semolina in a pot, add the mastic and meat, and stir until well browned.
instructions.2: Add the tomatoes, carrot, chopped onion, laurel leaf, and cumin powder, and stir all ingredients together.
instructions.3: Pour in boiling water until the meat is fully covered, then simmer on low heat until the meat is tender.
instructions.4: Add salt and sugar, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and let it finish cooking.
instructions.5: In another pot, heat the semolina and oil, add the chopped onion, and sauté until golden.
instructions.6: Add the ground meat, cinnamon stick, laurel leaf, and black pepper, and stir until the meat is well browned.
instructions.7: Add the minced garlic and mix thoroughly.
instructions.8: Rinse the rice and soak for 30 minutes, then drain and add to the meat mixture.
instructions.9: Pour in the boiling broth and stir until the rice absorbs the liquid.
instructions.10: Cover the pot and cook on high heat for 5 minutes, then reduce heat and let it steam until fully cooked.
instructions.11: Prepare the yogurt salad: place the yogurt in a narrow strainer to drain.
instructions.12: Chop the mint finely and mix into the yogurt with lemon juice, black pepper, and salt.
instructions.13: Add olive oil, nuts, and parsley, and stir well.
instructions.14: Serve the rice with the boiled meat, nuts, parsley, and yogurt salad.

title: Economical Meatball (Kadab Meatball)
culturalNotes: You can freeze the meatballs after shaping and browning them as needed. This dish is perfect for gatherings and is known for its delicious flavor.

instructions.1: Chop the onion finely.
instructions.2: Add chicken seasoning, salt, cumin, black pepper, and paprika. Mix well.
instructions.3: Add half a kilogram of chicken (breast or thighs) and finely chop them together with the other ingredients.
instructions.4: Transfer the mixture to a deep bowl.
instructions.5: Add one cup of ground breadcrumbs and one mashed potato. Knead the mixture thoroughly until it becomes firm and easy to shape.
instructions.6: Prepare the coating mixture: mix two cups of breadcrumbs, half a cup of cornstarch, a pinch of salt, a pinch of black pepper, a pinch of cilantro, a pinch of cumin, and a pinch of paprika.
instructions.7: Take a piece of the mixture, shape it into a ball, then press it into the coating mixture.
instructions.8: Repeat the previous step until all the mixture is used up.
instructions.9: Heat oil in a pan and fry the pieces until golden brown.
instructions.10: Serve the meatballs garnished with fresh parsley.

title: Tripe Cutlet
culturalNotes: Tripe cutlet can be served with pasta or as sandwiches. You can also add sauces such as red sauce or white sauce when serving.

instructions.1: Place water in a pot and bring to a boil.
instructions.2: Add carrot, tomato, onion, celery, garlic, cumin, cardamom, laurel leaf, and cloves to the boiling water.
instructions.3: Let the ingredients simmer for a few minutes until the aromas are released.
instructions.4: Wash the tripe thoroughly with water and vinegar, then let it dry.
instructions.5: Place the tripe into the boiling water and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Remove the tripe from the water and let it cool.
instructions.7: Cut the tripe into pieces about 1 cm thick.
instructions.8: In a bowl, beat the eggs with yogurt, salt, and black pepper.
instructions.9: In another bowl, mix flour, cornstarch, salt, black pepper, and spices to taste.
instructions.10: Dip the tripe pieces into the egg and yogurt mixture, then coat them in the flour and cornstarch mixture.
instructions.11: Fry the tripe pieces in hot oil over medium heat until golden brown and crispy.
instructions.12: Remove the fried pieces from the oil and place them on paper towels to drain excess oil.
instructions.13: Serve tripe cutlet with pasta or as sandwiches.

title: Turkey Substitute
culturalNotes: Serve the turkey substitute with rice cooked in a spice mix for a complete and delicious meal.

instructions.1: Prepare the soaking solution by mixing salt, orange, lemon, ginger, cinnamon, and red vinegar. Soak the turkey in this solution for 3–4 hours.
instructions.2: After soaking, prepare the marinade by mixing salt, saffron, cassia, seven-spice mix, cinnamon, onion powder, garlic powder, pepper, instant stock, ketchup, and red vinegar.
instructions.3: Rinse the turkey and inject the marinade into the meat by making small incisions with a knife.
instructions.4: Place carrots, onion, and tomatoes inside the turkey cavity.
instructions.5: Put the turkey in a heat-safe bag, seal it tightly, and make two small vents for steam release.
instructions.6: Place the turkey in a large baking dish and add boiling water.
instructions.7: Put the turkey in a preheated oven at high heat for 30 minutes, then reduce heat and cook for 2–3 hours until fully cooked.
instructions.8: Check for doneness before serving by pressing on the wing.

title: Beefsteak with Potatoes
culturalNotes: This dish can be served with pasta or basmati rice with green beans.

fah-018-i4.name: Potatoes
fah-018-i4.amount: 0.5 kg cut into cubes and fried

instructions.1: Pound the beefsteak slices in a plastic bag until tender and thin.
instructions.2: Mix the chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, sugar, and spices in a bowl.
instructions.3: Season the beefsteak slices on both sides with the mixture and let them marinate for 30 minutes.
instructions.4: Heat a frying pan on the stove and add the ghee and oil.
instructions.5: Add the minced garlic and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.6: Add the beefsteak slices and sear on both sides until golden brown.
instructions.7: Pour in the hot water, cover the pan, reduce heat, and simmer for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Add the fried potato cubes and cover again for 2–3 minutes.
instructions.9: Serve hot with parsley and green onions.

title: Kebab Cutlet
culturalNotes: Unfried slices can be frozen by placing each slice between two layers of plastic to make them easier to remove later.

instructions.1: Finely grind the ground beef and onion in the food processor.
instructions.2: Add salt, pepper, seven-spice mix, and sugar to the ground beef and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Pulse the mixture again in the food processor to form a firm, cohesive dough.
instructions.4: Prepare the coating: Mix flour, cornstarch, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
instructions.5: Prepare the egg mixture: Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper in another bowl.
instructions.6: Take a portion of the beef mixture and shape it into cutlets.
instructions.7: Dip each cutlet first in flour, then in the egg-milk mixture, and finally in breadcrumbs.
instructions.8: Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
instructions.9: Fry the cutlets until golden brown.
instructions.10: Serve the kebab cutlets hot.

title: Chicken with Mushrooms
culturalNotes: You can serve the dish with white rice and sautéed vegetables for a complete and delicious meal. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Add salt and pepper to the chicken slices and mix well.
instructions.2: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a pan over medium heat, then add the chicken slices and brown them until golden.
instructions.3: Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
instructions.4: In the same pan, add the chopped onion and garlic, and sauté until golden.
instructions.5: Add the mushrooms and stir until well seasoned.
instructions.6: Add the demiglace sauce (Knorr) and stir until dissolved.
instructions.7: Return the chicken to the pan and add about 3 cups of boiling water.
instructions.8: Simmer for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens and the chicken is fully cooked.
instructions.9: Stir in half a cup of cream and mix thoroughly.
instructions.10: Serve the dish with white rice and sautéed vegetables.

title: Chicken Piccata with Mushroom and Cream Sauce
culturalNotes: You can add a cube of feta cheese to the sauce for a better flavor. Serve the dish with white rice or pasta according to preference.

instructions.1: Season the chicken cutlets well with salt, pepper, and paprika.
instructions.2: Heat the butter and oil in a pan over medium heat, then brown the chicken cutlets on both sides until golden.
instructions.3: Remove the chicken from the pan and leave the browned oil in the pan.
instructions.4: Add the chopped onion and sauté until golden and well-seasoned.
instructions.5: Add the minced garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the mushrooms (fresh or canned) and stir until well blended.
instructions.7: Add the flour and stir continuously for 1 minute until cooked through.
instructions.8: Pour in hot water (about 3 cups) and stir until well combined.
instructions.9: Add salt, pepper, and adjust seasonings to taste.
instructions.10: Return the chicken to the pan, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes until fully cooked.
instructions.11: Stir in the cream (or 1 cup of milk with 2 tablespoons of sour cream) and mix well.
instructions.12: Let the sauce boil once, then reduce heat and simmer for 1 minute.
instructions.13: Serve hot with white rice or pasta, garnished with fresh parsley.

title: Chicken Preparations for Ramadan
culturalNotes: Marinades and chicken can be stored in the freezer for one to two months. When using, let them thaw before cooking. Chicken can be grilled, baked in the oven, or cooked on a pan. Kofta can be cooked on a pan or over charcoal for best results.

instructions.1: Prepare marinade for grilled chicken
instructions.2: Mix the following ingredients in a bowl: onion water, orange juice, vinegar, oil, ketchup, oregano, dried parsley, salt, black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, turmeric, chili powder, Chinese seasoning, sugar or honey, soy sauce.
instructions.3: Mix ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.4: Wash the chicken and cut into desired pieces.
instructions.5: Place chicken in marinade and toss well to coat.
instructions.6: Store chicken in the freezer in separate bags.
instructions.7: Prepare chicken cutlets (battered chicken)
instructions.8: Mix yogurt, ketchup or hot sauce, onion powder, cloves, garlic powder, dried coriander, chicken spices, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
instructions.9: Mix ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.10: Wash chicken breasts and drain well.
instructions.11: Place chicken breasts in marinade and toss well.
instructions.12: Mix ground breadcrumbs, flour, cornstarch, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and spices in another bowl.
instructions.13: Dip chicken pieces into the marinade, then coat with the breadcrumb mixture.
instructions.14: Store chicken in the freezer in separate bags with space between pieces.
instructions.15: Prepare grilled chicken kofta
instructions.16: Mix onion, garlic, parsley, bulgur, sugar, baking powder, salt, pepper, paprika, dried coriander, chicken spices, oregano, onion powder, and garlic powder in a bowl.
instructions.17: Mix ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.18: Shape kofta into fingers or skewers.
instructions.19: Store kofta in the freezer in separate bags with space between pieces.

title: Preparation of Minced Meat for Ramadan
culturalNotes: The mixture can be stored in the freezer for a long time. When using, let it thaw for about half an hour beforehand. The meat rolls can be served with baladi bread or dough, the brown kofta with basmati rice, grilled kofta on charcoal or in the oven, and the meat sauce with tagines and pans.

instructions.1: Prepare the meat rolls mixture:
instructions.2: Wash and chop the onion, tomato, sweet pepper, hot pepper, and parsley.
instructions.3: Mix the minced meat with the onion, tomato, sweet pepper, hot pepper, and parsley.
instructions.4: Add salt, pepper, seven-spice mix, chili, cumin, dried coriander, and flour.
instructions.5: Knead the mixture well.
instructions.6: Divide the mixture into bags and store in the freezer.
instructions.7: Prepare the brown kofta:
instructions.8: Wash and chop the onion and parsley.
instructions.9: Boil the rice in two cups of water with salt.
instructions.10: Mix the minced meat with the onion, parsley, boiled rice, salt, pepper, seven-spice mix, and sugar.
instructions.11: Knead the mixture well.
instructions.12: Shape the kofta into oval forms and store in a foam container.
instructions.13: Prepare the grilled kofta:
instructions.14: Wash and finely chop the onion, then drain it from water.
instructions.15: Mix the minced meat with the fat or lye or boosh, onion, cracked bulgur, salt, pepper, sugar, and baking powder.
instructions.16: Knead the mixture well.
instructions.17: Shape the kofta and store in a foam container.
instructions.20: Sauté the onion in ghee over heat.
instructions.21: Add the minced meat, salt, pepper, cinnamon, seven-spice mix, and sugar.
instructions.22: Stir the mixture well until cooked through.
instructions.23: Divide the mixture into bags and store in the freezer.

title: Chicken Stroganoff
culturalNotes: Serve the dish with a green salad or toasted bread. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts into small pieces, similar to shawarma style.
instructions.2: Chop the mushrooms into small pieces.
instructions.3: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter and 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.4: Add the chicken pieces and stir with salt and pepper until golden brown.
instructions.5: Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
instructions.6: Add another tablespoon of butter to the pan and sauté the onion until soft.
instructions.7: Add the chopped garlic and stir with the onion until fragrant and lightly browned.
instructions.8: Add the mushrooms and stir with the onion and garlic until well combined.
instructions.9: Return the chicken to the pan and add the demi-glace sauce dissolved in half a liter of cold water.
instructions.10: Stir well until the mixture comes to a boil.
instructions.11: Add the paprika and stir.
instructions.12: Pour in the cream and stir until the sauce is smooth and well blended.
instructions.13: Add the cooked pasta and stir for 3 minutes on low heat.

title: Chicken Roll with Ouzi Filling
culturalNotes: Serve chicken roll with oozie filling with a green salad or basmati rice. The chicken can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Heat the crystal butter-flavored ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the spices (oregano, cinnamon, black pepper) and stir briefly.
instructions.4: Add the ground meat and cook until fully browned.
instructions.5: Add the peas and carrots and stir briefly.
instructions.6: Add salt, rice, and mix well.
instructions.7: Pour in 1/2 cup of boiling water, cover the pot, and reduce heat to low. Cook until rice is tender.
instructions.8: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and spices (oregano, cinnamon, onion powder).
instructions.9: Fill the chicken with the rice mixture and wrap tightly with butter paper and aluminum foil.
instructions.10: Place the wrapped chicken in a baking tray and add about 2 cups of boiling water.
instructions.11: Cover the tray with aluminum foil and bake in the middle rack of the oven for 1 hour.
instructions.12: After removing the chicken from the oven, remove the aluminum foil and butter paper. Brush the chicken with ketchup.
instructions.13: Place under the broiler until the surface turns golden brown.

title: Tasbeera (Boiled Red Chicken)
culturalNotes: Tasbeera can be served with rice and broth as a main meal. You can also add some chopped vegetables to the broth for a richer flavor.

instructions.1: Prepare a large pot and add 2 liters of water, 3-4 squeezed lemons, 2 tablespoons of sugar, 2 tablespoons of salt, 1 tablespoon of ginger, and 1 cup of vinegar. Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.2: Wash the chicken thoroughly and rub it with salt and flour, then rinse well.
instructions.3: Prepare the marinade by combining 3 cloves of garlic, 1 onion, 1 tomato, salt, and black pepper. Blend all ingredients in a blender and generously coat the chicken with the mixture.
instructions.4: Add the chicken to the boiling water along with 1 laurel leaf, 1 carrot, 1-2 celery stalks, 1 teaspoon of sugar, salt, black pepper, 2 cinnamon pieces, and 2 cumin cloves. Cover the pot and simmer on low heat until the chicken is fully cooked.
instructions.5: After the chicken is cooked, drain it well and fry it in oil and ghee (local) with a pinch of salt until nicely browned.
instructions.6: Strain the broth through a sieve and serve the chicken with rice and broth.

title: Chicken and Potato Rice Pilaf
culturalNotes: You can serve the pilaf with a green salad or yogurt. To store, keep in the refrigerator for up to two days or in the freezer for up to one week.

instructions.1: Heat the butter or ghee with oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chicken pieces and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the bell peppers and seven-spice mix, and sauté with the chicken.
instructions.4: Add the minced onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.5: Add the minced garlic and sauté with the mixture.
instructions.6: Add the tomato juice and let it simmer for one minute.
instructions.7: Add salt, cumin, and sugar, and stir the mixture well.
instructions.8: Add boiling water according to the rice quantity (one cup of water per cup of local rice, two cups of water per cup of basmati rice).
instructions.9: Add the potatoes and cook until they are half-done.
instructions.10: Add the washed rice and stir well.
instructions.11: Add two bell peppers and cover the pot.
instructions.12: Let the rice absorb the water, then stir the mixture twice.
instructions.13: Reduce heat and let the pilaf cook until the rice is fully done.
instructions.14: Serve hot.

title: Kofta Stew
culturalNotes: Make sure the filling is completely cold before stuffing the kofta. Use stiff toothpicks to tightly close the kofta. You can use the leftover broth to make molokhia.

instructions.1: Heat oil and ghee in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add cumin seeds and stir until fragrant.
instructions.3: Add washed and drained rice and stir until lightly toasted.
instructions.4: Add cinnamon, black pepper, instant stock, and salt; mix well.
instructions.5: Add finely chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes.
instructions.6: Add garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.7: Add honey and mix thoroughly.
instructions.8: Add water, cover the rice, and reduce heat to low until half the water is absorbed.
instructions.9: Set the rice aside to cool completely.
instructions.10: Prepare the topping mixture by combining tomatoes, carrots, onion, laurel leaf, ground cardamom, salt, and pepper; mix well.
instructions.11: Spread the topping mixture evenly in a baking dish.
instructions.12: Place pre-stuffed kofta in the dish and season with salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.13: Stuff the kofta with cold filling, but do not overfill.
instructions.14: Close the kofta tightly using stiff toothpicks.
instructions.15: Arrange the kofta in the dish and cover with butter paper, then aluminum foil.
instructions.16: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 1 hour.
instructions.17: After cooking, remove from oven and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and parsley.
instructions.18: Serve the kofta stew with the cooked rice on the side in a separate bowl.

title: Baladi Hawawshi
culturalNotes: Make sure the dough rises well before shaping the hawawshi. You can add other ingredients like olives, tomatoes, and peppers according to preference.

fah-029-i8.name: 1/4 cup warm water for yeast test

instructions.1: Mix sugar and yeast in 1/4 cup warm water and let it sit for 10 minutes to test the yeast.
instructions.2: In a bowl, mix flour, salt, yogurt, and 1/4 cup oil.
instructions.3: Gradually add warm water and mix until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.4: Add the yeast mixture and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Knead the dough on a floured surface until smooth and elastic.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size.
instructions.7: In another bowl, mix ground beef, fat, finely chopped onions, tomatoes, green chili peppers, salt, black pepper, sugar, hawawshi spices, and cinnamon.
instructions.8: Once the dough has risen, divide it into equal-sized balls.
instructions.9: Flatten each ball on a floured surface and place a portion of the meat filling in the center.
instructions.10: Seal the hawawshi tightly and place them in an oiled baking tray.
instructions.11: Brush the tops of the hawawshi with a mixture of a pinch of instant coffee, 1/2 teaspoon sugar, 1 tablespoon powdered milk, and 5 tablespoons water.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 20 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.13: Serve hawawshi hot.

title: Hawawshi on Charcoal
culturalNotes: You can store hawawshi in the refrigerator for up to two days or freeze for up to one week. You can also serve hawawshi with a green salad or roasted potatoes.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling: Mix ground chicken, finely chopped onion, parsley, cilantro, hot peppers, bell peppers, tumtum, baladi ghee, garlic, salt, black pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, paprika, sugar, and chicken spices in a bowl.
instructions.2: Mix ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Prepare the bread: Cut the pita bread along the edges and gently open it.
instructions.4: Fill the pita with the mixture and spread evenly.
instructions.5: Grilling hawawshi: Heat a pan over medium heat and grease with oil.
instructions.6: Place hawawshi in the pan and cover for 5 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.7: Flip the hawawshi and cover again for 5 minutes until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.8: Serve hawawshi hot with pickled lemon, black seed, and sumac.

title: Alexandrian Hawawshi
culturalNotes: You can store hawawshi in the refrigerator for up to two days or freeze for longer storage. When serving, you can add sauces such as red sauce or white sauce.

instructions.1: Mix flour with salt, sugar, and yeast in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add warm water and knead until the dough becomes smooth and elastic.
instructions.3: Cover the dough and let it rest in a warm place for 30 minutes until risen.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix finely chopped onion, bell pepper, hot pepper, garlic, tomatoes, parsley, salt, black pepper, cumin, cilantro, seven-spice mix, sugar, allspice, and instant stock cube.
instructions.5: Add ground beef and tahini, then mix thoroughly.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into equal-sized balls (about the size of a large lemon).
instructions.7: Roll each ball into a flat circle, place meat filling in the center, then seal the hawawshi tightly.
instructions.8: Place hawawshi on an oiled baking tray, cover, and let rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Brush hawawshi with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 20–25 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.11: For frying, heat oil in a pan and fry hawawshi until golden brown on all sides.
instructions.12: Serve hawawshi hot with fresh julienned lettuce and parsley.

title: Chicken Drumsticks with Buffalo Sauce
culturalNotes: Chicken can be served with roasted potatoes or fusilli pasta. Extra sauce can be stored in the refrigerator for a long time.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken and cut into drumsticks.
instructions.2: Make small incisions on the chicken with a knife to help the flavor penetrate.
instructions.3: Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, seven-spice mix, and paprika.
instructions.4: Mix flour and cornstarch in a plastic bag.
instructions.5: Add the seasoned chicken to the bag and shake well to coat.
instructions.6: Heat oil in a deep frying pan or pot.
instructions.7: Fry the chicken until golden brown.
instructions.8: Transfer to paper towels to absorb excess oil.
instructions.9: In a bowl, mix ketchup, hot sauce, vinegar, black honey, sugar, and 1 teaspoon of cornstarch dissolved in a quarter cup of water.
instructions.10: Pour the mixture into a saucepan and stir over medium heat until thickened.
instructions.11: Add the fried chicken to the sauce and toss well to coat.
instructions.12: Serve the chicken with sauce and chopped parsley.

title: Chicken Kebabs
culturalNotes: You can use any chicken pieces you prefer. Make sure the marinade gets well under the skin and into the meat for a more flavorful result.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken kebabs and make a slit down the center with a sharp knife.
instructions.2: Mix smoked paprika, onion powder, instant stock powder, black pepper, garlic powder, chopped garlic, ketchup, lemon juice, vinegar, white honey, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.3: Coat the chicken kebabs evenly with the marinade on all sides, then refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours.
instructions.4: If short on time, place the chicken kebabs on a rack in a baking tray, skin side up and meat side down.
instructions.5: Preheat the oven to high heat, and place two cups of boiling water in the tray beneath the rack.
instructions.6: Put the tray in the oven and bake until the chicken is well grilled.
instructions.7: In another pan, melt the butter over low heat, add the chopped garlic, and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.8: Add white honey, ketchup, chopped parsley, salt, and black pepper; stir well to combine.
instructions.9: After grilling the chicken, pour the sauce over the kebabs.
instructions.10: Serve the chicken kebabs hot with saffron rice, pasta with sauce, salad, and pickles.

title: Roman Roast
culturalNotes: Roman roast can be served with rice pilaf and carrots, and tastes best when served with the cooking sauce.

instructions.1: Wash the Roman chicken breast and let it dry.
instructions.2: Use a sharp knife to make small incisions in the chicken breast.
instructions.3: Insert a small amount of salt, black peppercorns, and a garlic clove into each incision.
instructions.4: Season the chicken breast generously on all sides with salt, ground black pepper, and thyme.
instructions.5: Let the chicken breast marinate for one hour.
instructions.6: Heat a roasting pan on the stove and add the oil and butter.
instructions.7: Place the chicken breast in the pan and sear it until golden brown on all sides.
instructions.8: Remove the chicken breast and set it aside.
instructions.9: In the same pan, add the chopped vegetables (onion, carrot, tomato, celery, sweet pepper) and sauté for a few minutes.
instructions.10: Add the laurel leaves, sugar, salt, and black peppercorns.
instructions.11: Pour in boiling water until it reaches halfway up the chicken breast.
instructions.12: Cover the pan and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for one hour.
instructions.13: After 15 minutes, flip the chicken breast and continue cooking for another hour.
instructions.14: Remove the chicken breast, let it cool, then refrigerate.
instructions.15: Slice the chicken breast and serve with rice pilaf and carrots.

title: Stuffed Chicken Rolls
culturalNotes: You can increase the rice quantity according to preference. Leftover rice can be served as a side dish. Any type of bird can be used for the filling.

instructions.1: Prepare the chicken: Remove the bone and keep the skin, then pound the chicken until evenly flattened.
instructions.2: Prepare the filling: Wash the rice and soak it for 30 minutes, then drain. Chop the onion, liver, gizzard, tomato, and carrot.
instructions.3: Sauté the rice: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the rice with spices (cinnamon, pepper, salt, seven-spice mix, cumin).
instructions.4: Add the onion: Add the chopped onion to the rice and stir well.
instructions.5: Prepare the liver and gizzard: Sauté the liver and gizzard in hot oil with spices (cinnamon, pepper, seven-spice mix).
instructions.6: Mix the filling: Combine the rice with the liver and gizzard thoroughly.
instructions.7: Stuff the chicken: Fill the chicken with the mixture and roll it tightly using foil or parchment paper.
instructions.8: Bake setup: Place sliced onions, tomatoes, and carrots in the baking dish, then place the stuffed chicken on top. Add 1 or 2 cups of water and cover with aluminum foil.
instructions.9: Bake: Place the dish in the oven on the bottom rack for 15 minutes, then move it to the middle rack until fully cooked.
instructions.10: Prepare leftover rice: Place leftover rice in a pan and add boiling water until it reaches halfway up the rice. Cook until done.
instructions.11: Serve: Brush the chicken with ketchup and bake again until golden brown. Slice the chicken and serve with rice.

title: Lamb Rolls with Grape Leaves
culturalNotes: Serve the rolls with white rice or a green salad. The rolls can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Cut the lamb into wide, thin slices.
instructions.2: Season the lamb with salt, pepper, cumin powder, and seven-spice mix. Massage well.
instructions.3: Spread 2 tablespoons of sauce on both sides of the lamb.
instructions.4: Wash the grape leaves and cut them into suitable pieces.
instructions.5: Place a piece of lamb on a grape leaf and spread another grape leaf over the lamb.
instructions.6: Roll tightly and secure with string if desired.
instructions.7: Prepare the baking dish or pan and layer the tomato, onion, carrot, cabbage, laurel leaves, and rice.
instructions.8: Place the rolled lamb on top of the vegetables in the dish.
instructions.9: Pour water until it reaches halfway up the dish.
instructions.10: Seal the dish tightly with aluminum foil.
instructions.11: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius and place the dish on the bottom rack for 30 minutes.
instructions.12: After 30 minutes, move the dish to the middle rack and reduce the temperature to 160 degrees Celsius.
instructions.13: Continue cooking for 2 to 3 hours until the lamb and grape leaves are fully tender.
instructions.14: After cooking, let the rolls rest briefly before serving.

title: Mini Hawawshi Rolls
culturalNotes: You can use any spices you prefer in the meat mixture. Serve the rolls with tahini and yogurt sauce or any other sauce you like. The rolls can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Preparation: Chop the onion, red bell pepper, and tomato into small pieces and process in a food processor.
instructions.2: Preparation: Add the ground beef to the vegetable mixture and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Preparation: Add hawawshi spices and tahini to the mixture and combine well.
instructions.4: Preparation: Cut the tortilla bread on three sides to form a square shape.
instructions.5: Preparation: Spread a small portion of the meat mixture onto the tortilla and gently roll it up.
instructions.6: Preparation: Cut the rolls into small pieces, about 2 cm wide, and poke each with a toothpick.
instructions.7: Cooking: Lightly grease a baking tray with oil and place the rolls on it.
instructions.8: Cooking: Brush the tops of the rolls with oil and bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Finish: Prepare the tahini sauce by mixing tahini, yogurt, mayonnaise, mustard, black pepper, paprika, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and lemon juice.
instructions.10: Finish: Mix the tahini sauce thoroughly until smooth and well blended.
instructions.11: Finish: Serve the rolls on a serving platter with tahini sauce and sprinkle with nuts and pomegranate seeds.

title: Lamb Stuffed with Grape Leaves
culturalNotes: Make sure to tightly wrap the lamb with grape leaves and aluminum foil to ensure the meat cooks perfectly and stays moist. You can serve the stuffed lamb with white rice or Arabic bread.

instructions.1: Mix black pepper, salt, cayenne pepper, cinnamon, saffron powder, honey, sugar, and oil in a small bowl.
instructions.2: Rub the lamb generously with the marinade on all sides.
instructions.3: Wrap the lamb tightly with grape leaves on all sides.
instructions.4: Place laurel leaves, onion, and garlic in a baking dish.
instructions.5: Put a wire rack over the ingredients, then place the grape leaf-wrapped lamb on top of the rack.
instructions.6: Fill the baking dish with water until it reaches halfway up the lamb.
instructions.7: Cover the dish with butter paper, then with aluminum foil.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Reduce the heat and let the lamb bake for 2 to 3 hours.
instructions.10: Remove the dish from the oven and carefully peel off the grape leaves.
instructions.11: Serve the lamb hot with rice or bread.

title: Homemade Sujuk
culturalNotes: Sujuk can be served with bread and salads or as a main course. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or frozen for up to one month.

instructions.1: Clean the sausage casing thoroughly and wash it with water, vinegar, lemon juice, and baking soda.
instructions.2: Chop the red bell pepper, hot chili pepper, onion, and garlic finely.
instructions.3: Add the chopped red bell pepper, hot chili pepper, onion, and garlic to the ground beef.
instructions.4: Add salt, garlic and onion powder, black pepper, paprika, cumin, seven-spice mix, chili powder, sugar, and instant stock powder (if desired).
instructions.5: Knead the mixture well until fully combined.
instructions.6: Fill the sausage casing with the mixture using a funnel, ensuring even distribution.
instructions.7: Tie both ends securely and distribute the filling evenly along the casing.
instructions.8: Cut the sausage into small pieces or leave it as a long roll.
instructions.9: Bake the sujuk in the oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 30 minutes, or grill it over charcoal.

title: Smoked Chicken Sausage
culturalNotes: The sausage can be stored in the freezer in sealed bags and used as needed. It can be served for breakfast or as a midnight snack.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken breasts, pat them dry, cut them into pieces, and place them in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the red bell pepper, instant chicken broth, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, barbecue sauce, hot sauce, cornstarch, chopped garlic, salt, and black pepper.
instructions.3: Mix the ingredients thoroughly until smooth.
instructions.4: If you want a red color, add red food coloring.
instructions.5: Transfer the sausage mixture into a plastic bag and lightly coat it with oil.
instructions.6: Shape the mixture into sausage-like fingers and arrange them on a greased baking tray.
instructions.7: Place the tray with the sausages on top of another tray containing boiling water, and cover partially.
instructions.8: Steam for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: After cooking, remove the sausages and lightly coat them with oil.
instructions.10: Fry the sausages in a pan over medium heat until golden brown.
instructions.11: Serve the sausages in sandwiches with tomatoes, ketchup, mayonnaise, and mustard.
instructions.12: You can also slice the sausages and serve them with pasta or potatoes.

title: Lamb Tongue with Liver and Caramelized Onion
culturalNotes: Garnish the dish with fried nuts and parsley for an attractive appearance. Serve hot during gatherings.

instructions.1: Heat oil and butter in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add lamb tongue and stir until well browned and golden.
instructions.3: Add chopped onion and stir with the lamb tongue.
instructions.4: Add stock cube, safflower, pepper, spices, cinnamon, and mix well.
instructions.5: Pour in boiling water or stock until the lamb tongue is fully covered.
instructions.6: Add salt to taste and simmer on low heat until cooked through.
instructions.7: In another pot, heat oil and butter, then add onion and fry until caramelized.
instructions.8: Add liver and stir over high heat until browned.
instructions.9: Add pepper, spices, and cinnamon; mix well.
instructions.10: Season with salt after liver is cooked, then stir with caramelized onion.
instructions.11: Place the liver and caramelized onion on top of the lamb tongue.
instructions.12: Garnish the dish with fried nuts and parsley.

title: Fillet slices with brown sauce
culturalNotes: You can serve the sauce on the side for a more distinctive dish. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

fah-042-i11.name: Beef stock cube from Fine Foods

instructions.1: Season the fillet slices with salt and pepper, and rub them well.
instructions.2: Dip the fillet slices in flour.
instructions.3: Fry the fillet slices in hot ghee until golden brown.
instructions.4: In another pan, sauté half a kilogram of sliced onion.
instructions.5: Add sugar to the onion and stir until it turns brown.
instructions.6: Add the Fine Foods beef stock cube and boiling water.
instructions.7: Let the mixture boil for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Add the fried fillet slices to the sauce and let them cook for an additional 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Stir well until the sauce is well blended and darkens in color.
instructions.10: Serve the slices with grilled vegetables and white rice.

title: Smoked Chicken Breasts
culturalNotes: The breasts can be stored in the refrigerator for a long time or in the freezer for even longer. When using, remove them from the fridge one hour before serving to prevent drying out.

instructions.1: Buy large chicken breasts, clean them, wash, and pat dry.
instructions.2: Tie the breasts with cotton strings to keep them together.
instructions.3: Prepare the marinade by mixing black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, chicken seasoning, smoked paprika, mustard, barbecue sauce, soy sauce, honey, hot sauce (optional), and chili powder (optional).
instructions.4: Dip the breasts into the marinade and rub it well all over.
instructions.5: Cover the breasts and refrigerate overnight or for 3–4 hours.
instructions.6: Remove the breasts from the fridge and place them on a rack over a baking pan containing boiling water.
instructions.7: Cover the breasts with parchment paper, then with aluminum foil.
instructions.8: Bake the breasts in a preheated oven at high heat for 90 minutes.
instructions.9: Remove the breasts from the oven and brush them with oil to give them a browned color.
instructions.10: Cover the breasts again and let them rest in the refrigerator for 3–4 hours.
instructions.11: Store the breasts in the refrigerator or freezer for long-term storage.

title: Grilled Turkey Breasts with Saffron Rice
culturalNotes: You can keep the turkey breasts refrigerated for up to one day before serving for best results. Serve the dish with a green salad or grilled vegetables.

instructions.1: Prepare the brine: In a bowl, mix 1 liter of hot water with 4 laurel leaves, 5 nigella seeds, 2 cinnamon sticks, 10 cloves, 10 whole cloves, 2 tablespoons of sugar, and 2 tablespoons of salt. Bring to a boil, then add 2 liters of ice water, juice from 2 lemons, 1/2 cup of orange juice, and black pepper. Mix well and place the turkey breasts into the brine. Refrigerate for 2 hours.
instructions.2: Prepare the marinade: Grill the turkey breasts in a pan over medium heat with 1 tablespoon of butter and 1 tablespoon of oil. Add laurel leaves, cloves, cinnamon sticks, onion, tomatoes, carrots, celery, garlic, boiling water, and salt. Cook for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
instructions.3: Prepare the saffron rice: Rinse the rice and drain. In a pan, sauté the rice with ghee and oil. Add a cinnamon stick, cloves, whole cloves, water, salt, and saffron. Cover and cook until the rice is tender.
instructions.4: Prepare the mushroom sauce: In a bowl, sauté 1 tablespoon of ghee with 1 tablespoon of flour until lightly browned. Add black pepper, drained mushrooms, and stir well. Add cooking cream and stir until the sauce thickens.
instructions.5: Serve: Serve the grilled turkey breasts with saffron rice and creamy mushroom sauce. Garnish the dish with toasted nuts and raisins.

title: Chicken Breasts with Béchamel
culturalNotes: This dish can be served with salad, bread, pasta, or basmati rice. Adding mozzarella cheese will make it even more appealing.

instructions.1: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat until it liquefies.
instructions.2: Add the cubed chicken breasts and sauté until well browned on all sides.
instructions.3: Add the spices (pepper and chicken seasoning) and stir with the chicken.
instructions.4: Add the cubed onions and stir with the chicken until softened.
instructions.5: Add the grated potatoes and carrots and mix everything together.
instructions.6: Add salt and stir all ingredients well.
instructions.7: In another pan, melt the butter and add the flour, stirring until it turns pale golden.
instructions.8: Gradually add the milk while continuously stirring until the sauce thickens.
instructions.9: Add salt, pepper, and the instant chicken broth cube, and stir until boiling.
instructions.10: Add cream if desired and stir until the sauce becomes thick and smooth.
instructions.11: Transfer the chicken mixture to a baking dish and cover it with the béchamel sauce.
instructions.12: Add mozzarella cheese if desired.
instructions.13: Bake in a preheated medium oven until golden brown.
instructions.14: Serve hot with salad, bread, pasta, or basmati rice.
instructions.15: The dish is ready to serve.

title: Chicken Breasts with Corn
culturalNotes: You can serve the dish with white rice or roasted potatoes. To store, let it cool completely then place in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Cut the bell peppers into medium-sized cubes and remove the veins and seeds.
instructions.2: Cut the corn and white onion into medium-sized cubes.
instructions.3: Place the peppers, corn, and onion in a baking dish.
instructions.4: Butterfly the chicken breasts lengthwise and crosswise to help with seasoning.
instructions.5: Prepare the marinade by mixing salt, oregano, black pepper, chicken seasoning, paprika, chili powder, onion powder, garlic powder, honey, mustard, olive oil, and lemon juice.
instructions.6: Dip the chicken breasts into the marinade and let them sit for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
instructions.7: Add the marinated chicken to the baking dish with the vegetables.
instructions.8: Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 1 hour.
instructions.9: Make the garlic sauce by mixing garlic, salt, butter, honey, mustard, and parsley.
instructions.10: After cooking time is complete, remove the chicken from the oven and pour the garlic sauce over it.
instructions.11: Serve hot.

title: Chicken with Rice
culturalNotes: You can garnish the dish with fresh parsley to add a distinctive flavor and aroma. Serve with a green salad or your choice of side dish.

fah-047-i2.name: Chicken
fah-047-i2.amount: 1 whole chicken cut into 8 or 4 pieces

instructions.1: Heat the oil and ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and sugar, and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the spices (cloves, cinnamon, allspice, lemon peel, cardamom, bay leaves) and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the chopped garlic and stir for 1 minute.
instructions.5: Add salt, black pepper, ground cardamom, cumin, seven-spice mix, and stock cubes, and stir thoroughly.
instructions.6: Add the chicken pieces, cover the pot, and simmer on low heat for 30 minutes until cooked through.
instructions.7: Add boiling water to the pot and continue simmering on low heat for 30 minutes.
instructions.8: Remove the chicken from the pot and place it in a baking dish. Brush with ketchup and honey, then broil under the grill until golden brown.
instructions.9: Rinse the basmati rice and soak for 1 hour, then drain and add to the pot with boiling water.
instructions.10: Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low and cook until the rice is tender.
instructions.11: Garnish the dish with fresh parsley before serving.

title: Plate of Happiness (Eid Plate)
culturalNotes: You can add layers of vegetables such as peppers and tomatoes between the meat layers for a more varied flavor. The dish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Prepare the kofta: Mix ground beef with salt, pepper, onion, and knead thoroughly. Shape into small balls.
instructions.2: Prepare the gizzards: Cut gizzards into pieces and make small incisions using a sharp knife.
instructions.3: Prepare the sujuk: Cut sujuk into small pieces or leave whole, depending on preference.
instructions.4: Prepare the marinade: Mix tomatoes, hot pepper, bell pepper, crushed chili, crushed black pepper, and ketchup together.
instructions.5: Prepare the dish: Place gizzards, sujuk, liver, and klawa into the baking dish. Pour the marinade over and mix well.
instructions.6: Baking: Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated oven at high temperature for one hour.
instructions.7: Prepare the dough: Mix flour, oil, warm water, sugar, and yeast. Knead well. Cover and let rise.
instructions.8: Final baking: After the meat is cooked, remove the foil and place the dish back in the oven until golden brown.
instructions.9: Add the dough: Roll out the dough and place it over the dish. Bake again until golden brown.
instructions.10: Serving: Serve the dish hot with bread or rice.

title: Economic Chicken and Vegetables Bake
culturalNotes: Serve the bake with white rice or vermicelli rice. You can substitute any vegetables you don't prefer.

instructions.1: Cut the onion, carrots, zucchini, and potatoes into thin slices.
instructions.2: Slice the garlic thinly.
instructions.3: Mix the spices (cumin, parsley, black pepper, salt, sugar) with the onion, garlic, and instant stock cube.
instructions.4: Add the vegetables to the spice mixture and stir well.
instructions.5: Place the spice and vegetable mixture into a baking tray.
instructions.6: Add the washed and drained chicken wings to the tray and toss well.
instructions.7: Chop the tomatoes and peppers and distribute them over the tray.
instructions.8: Add the tomato sauce and boiling water, then stir well.
instructions.9: Cover the tray with aluminum foil and add 2 tablespoons of oil.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 1 hour.
instructions.11: Remove the foil after one hour and let it bake for an additional 10 minutes until golden brown.

title: Liver and Lamb Casserole
culturalNotes: You can substitute the liver with butter cubes or 2 tablespoons of ghee for a sweeter taste. Serve the casserole with flatbread or rice.

instructions.1: Cut the lamb and liver into small cubes.
instructions.2: Slice the lily into thin strips.
instructions.3: Chop the tomatoes, hot peppers, and bell peppers into medium-sized cubes.
instructions.4: Add the chopped onions and garlic to the casserole dish.
instructions.5: Add black pepper, cinnamon, seven-spice mix, and salt.
instructions.6: Add hot ketchup, mustard, and honey; mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.7: Cover the casserole with parchment paper, then with aluminum foil.
instructions.8: Place the casserole in a very hot oven for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Reduce the heat and let it cook for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Remove the casserole from the oven. Top it with ghee or butter, and cover immediately.
instructions.11: Return the casserole to the oven for an additional 10 minutes to finish cooking.

title: Grilled Kofta Bake
culturalNotes: You can smoke the kofta after removing it from the oven to give it a charcoal flavor. Serve the dish with Syrian bread, sumac onions, and parsley for a complete meal.

instructions.1: Prepare the vegetable mix: Place the onion, tomato, bell pepper, and red pepper in a food processor and blend thoroughly.
instructions.2: Prepare the kofta mix: Add the ground beef to the vegetable mixture, then add the breadcrumbs, black pepper, paprika, salt, sugar, meat spices, and baking powder. Mix thoroughly until well combined and firm.
instructions.3: Shape the kofta: Form the kofta into finger-shaped portions and make shallow cuts on the surface to mimic a grilling pattern.
instructions.4: Arrange the kofta in an oiled baking dish.
instructions.5: Add the bell pepper if desired to give a sweet aroma.
instructions.6: Place the dish in a preheated oven at maximum heat until fully cooked.
instructions.7: Prepare the sauce: In a pan, add paprika and sauce, then mix well.
instructions.8: Prepare the onion mix: Cut the onion into wedges, add salt and sumac, then mix well. Add the chopped parsley.
instructions.9: Prepare the bread: Spread the onion mixture on Syrian bread, then place the grilled kofta on top.
instructions.10: Serve hot.

title: Ground Beef and Potato Casserole
culturalNotes: Serve the dish with vermicelli rice, salad, and pickles. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Chop onions, garlic, parsley, peppers, and tomatoes in a food processor until finely ground.
instructions.2: Slice the potatoes into thin rounds.
instructions.3: Arrange the potato slices in a baking dish.
instructions.4: Add the ground beef and the minced meat to the finely chopped vegetable mixture.
instructions.5: Mix in black pepper, sugar, baking powder, salt, and instant stock cube into the meat mixture and knead thoroughly.
instructions.6: Spread the meat mixture evenly over the potato slices in the dish.
instructions.7: Place the dish in a preheated oven at high heat (about 200°C) on the middle rack.
instructions.8: Bake for 30 minutes, or until the meat and potatoes are fully cooked.

title: Chicken and Potatoes Bake with Béchamel
culturalNotes: A pinch of thyme and cinnamon can be added for a distinctive flavor. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Slice the potatoes into thin slices.
instructions.2: Slice the chicken breasts into thin strips.
instructions.3: Cut the onions into rings.
instructions.4: Melt the butter in a pan and sauté the chicken until golden, then set aside.
instructions.5: In the same pan, add the onions and stir until golden.
instructions.6: Add the sugar, salt, and pepper, and stir well.
instructions.7: Add the flour and stir until the color turns white.
instructions.8: Gradually pour in the cold milk and stir until the mixture becomes smooth and liquid.
instructions.9: Add more salt and pepper to taste, and stir well.
instructions.10: In a baking dish, layer potatoes, then chicken, then another layer of potatoes.
instructions.11: Pour the béchamel sauce over the layers.
instructions.12: Cover the dish and bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 30–45 minutes.
instructions.13: Once the potatoes are cooked through, remove the dish from the oven and sprinkle the cheese on top.
instructions.14: Return the dish to the oven until the cheese is golden and bubbly.
instructions.15: Serve hot.

title: Potatoes with Meat Casserole
culturalNotes: Serve the casserole with a salad and white rice for a complete meal. You can also add a small piece of lye to the meat for a distinctive flavor.

instructions.1: Prepare the spices and finely chopped onions: Mix salt, pepper, cumin, cilantro, paprika, ground cinnamon, and seven-spice mix with the finely chopped onions. Rub the onions well until the spice aroma is released.
instructions.2: Prepare the casserole dish: Place two sliced onions at the bottom of the dish. Arrange half of the browned potatoes on top of the onions.
instructions.3: Distribute the meat: Place half of the finely chopped and seasoned onions over the potatoes. Add the halved garlic cloves. Spread the meat over the onions and potatoes.
instructions.4: Complete the layering: Add the remaining chopped and seasoned onions on top of the meat. Distribute the tomato slices and the remaining browned potatoes on the surface.
instructions.5: Cover the casserole: Cover the dish with butter paper, then with aluminum foil. Press firmly on the edges to ensure a tight seal.
instructions.6: Bake the casserole: Place the casserole in the oven preheated to 200 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes. Then reduce the temperature to 160 degrees Celsius and bake for 2 hours.
instructions.7: Grill: After the cooking time is complete, remove the cover and place the casserole under the grill for 5 minutes until lightly browned.
instructions.8: Serve: Sprinkle paprika on top and serve hot with a salad and white rice.

title: Chicken Gratin with Potatoes
culturalNotes: You can skip the cheese if you'd like to make the dish more economical. Serve the gratin with vermicelli rice and salad for a complete meal.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and wash them, then cut them into thin slices.
instructions.2: Slice the onion thinly.
instructions.3: Season the potatoes and onion with salt, black pepper, paprika, seven-spice mix, and stock, then mix well.
instructions.4: Cut the chicken into thin pieces, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.5: Heat a pan on the stove, then add the butter cube and sauté the chicken until browned.
instructions.6: Place the potato and onion mixture into a baking dish, then add the chicken on top.
instructions.7: Mix everything thoroughly.
instructions.8: Add the flour and milk, then blend well in a blender.
instructions.9: Pour the mixture over the potatoes and chicken in the baking dish.
instructions.10: Cover the potatoes with the milk mixture, then place the dish in the oven at 200 degrees Celsius on the middle rack until the potatoes are cooked through.
instructions.11: Sprinkle cheese on top, then return the dish to the oven until the cheese melts and turns golden.
instructions.12: Serve hot with vermicelli rice and salad.

title: Meat and Vegetable Rice Bake
culturalNotes: You can use white basmati rice for better results. You can also add pistachios when serving for an extra flavor.

instructions.1: Cut the beef into small pieces.
instructions.2: Heat ghee and oil in a pot over medium heat, then add cinnamon sticks, cloves, and bay leaf.
instructions.3: Add the beef and stir until the color changes.
instructions.4: Lower the heat, cover the pot, and let the beef cook for 10 minutes until half-cooked.
instructions.5: Add the chopped onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.6: Add carrots and green beans, and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.7: Add the instant stock cube, salt, black pepper, and seven-spice mix. Cover the pot and let it cook for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: In another pot, boil the rice in boiling water with cinnamon sticks, lime, cinnamon, cloves, salt, and oil for 8 minutes until half-cooked.
instructions.9: Drain the rice and add it to the pot with vegetables and beef.
instructions.10: Add water and saffron, stir well, then cover and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.11: Add raisins, caramelized onions, and fresh parsley. Mix everything together.
instructions.12: Serve hot with mint yogurt salad.

title: Okaawi Casserole with Sauce
culturalNotes: You can serve the casserole with white rice or any other type of rice according to preference. Make sure the okaawi are well leveled before placing them in the casserole.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot over high heat.
instructions.2: Add the okaawi and sauté them thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add cumin, cardamom, laurel leaf, onion, and carrot, and sauté together.
instructions.4: Add boiling water and a small amount of sugar, and let the mixture boil.
instructions.5: Remove any foam or scum that forms on the surface.
instructions.6: Cover the pot and let the okaawi simmer on low heat for 3–4 minutes.
instructions.7: In another bowl, chop the onion, tomato, green pepper, red pepper, and hot pepper, and season with salt, black pepper, and meat spices.
instructions.8: Add the chopped garlic and mash them together.
instructions.9: Place the vegetable mixture into the casserole.
instructions.10: Add the well-leveled okaawi and a little of the broth.
instructions.11: Cover the casserole with butter paper, then with aluminum foil.
instructions.12: Place the casserole in the oven, on the middle rack, at the highest heat setting for 1 hour.
instructions.13: Serve the casserole with rice.
instructions.14: Enjoy the delicious flavor and rich, savory sauce.

title: Eid Casserole (Bomb Casserole)
culturalNotes: Serve the casserole with a green salad or fresh bread. The casserole can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Boil the meat with the carrot, tomato, onion, garlic, laurel leaf, cumin, mint, black pepper, and sugar in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add boiling water and let the meat simmer for 15 minutes.
instructions.3: Add salt after 15 minutes and let the meat simmer for 3 more minutes.
instructions.4: Sauté the onion in semolina and black pepper, then add the meat bouillon cube.
instructions.5: Add the freekeh and the meat cooking broth, then simmer on low heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Evenly distribute the meat and freekeh into the casserole dish.
instructions.7: Prepare the béchamel sauce by mixing the milk, flour, semolina, meat bouillon cube, salt, and black pepper over medium heat until thickened.
instructions.8: Spread the béchamel sauce over the casserole, then top with clotted cream and cream.
instructions.9: Bake the casserole in a preheated oven at high heat for 10 minutes, until the top is golden brown.

title: Chicken and Freekeh Tagine
culturalNotes: This tagine can be served at celebrations and is a complete and beautiful meal. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Clean the chicken thoroughly and soak it in water and vinegar for 10 minutes, then rinse and drain.
instructions.2: Add salt, pepper, and chicken, and mix well. Let it marinate for 1 hour.
instructions.3: Heat oil and ghee in a tagine pan over medium heat. Brown the chicken on all sides until golden.
instructions.4: Remove the chicken from the pan and add the chopped onion. Sauté until golden brown.
instructions.5: Return the chicken to the pan. Add boiling water, sugar, spices, and stock cube. Cover and simmer on low heat for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: After 30 minutes, remove the chicken and add freekeh and chopped tomatoes to the pan.
instructions.7: Return the chicken to the pan, cover, and cook on low heat until freekeh absorbs all the liquid and is fully cooked.
instructions.8: Serve hot, garnished with liver and nuts if available.

title: Caramelized Liver and Onion Tagine
culturalNotes: The dish can be garnished with nuts according to preference. Liver must be washed and soaked for 30 minutes before use for best results.

instructions.1: Heat ghee and oil in a pan over medium heat, then add the finely chopped onion and sauté until lightly golden.
instructions.2: Add the washed and drained liver and sauté with the onion for a few minutes.
instructions.3: Add the grated carrots, salt, black pepper, cinnamon, and stock cube, then pour in enough water to cover the ingredients.
instructions.4: Cover the pan and simmer on low heat until the liver is fully cooked.
instructions.5: In another pan, heat oil and add the sliced onions, cooking until they caramelize.
instructions.6: Add sugar and honey to the caramelized onions and stir until the onions turn golden.
instructions.7: Add the cooked liver to the caramelized onions, then pour in a quarter cup of boiling water.
instructions.8: Simmer on low heat until the liquid is absorbed, then serve hot.

title: Koura Tagine
culturalNotes: The tagine can be served with Koura soup as a complete meal. The tagine can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for up to one month.

instructions.1: Wash the koura and cut into medium-sized pieces.
instructions.2: Place the koura in a pressure cooker with boiling water and let it boil once, then discard the water.
instructions.3: Return the koura to the pot with fresh boiling water, and add tomatoes, onion, carrots, garlic cloves, laurel leaf, clove, mastic, salt, pepper, and sugar.
instructions.4: Add water until it reaches halfway up the pot, then cover tightly.
instructions.5: Simmer the koura on low heat for one hour until tender.
instructions.6: In another pan, heat two tablespoons of oil and add chopped garlic, sautéing until golden.
instructions.7: Add bell pepper and hot pepper, and stir for one minute.
instructions.8: Add tomato juice, stock cube, salt, pepper, cumin, and seven-spice mix, and simmer gently for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Transfer the koura to a baking dish, and pour two or three tablespoons of tomato sauce over it.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 30 minutes until the koura absorbs the sauce.
instructions.11: Serve hot with rice or bread.

title: Meat Casserole with Dough
culturalNotes: You can add more onions if desired, as it enhances the flavor of the casserole. You can also use leftover dough to make cheese-filled pastries for children.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the beef pieces and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add garlic, pepper, spices, and sugar; stir to combine.
instructions.4: Add onions and stir until golden brown.
instructions.5: Cover the pot and let the meat simmer on low heat until fully cooked.
instructions.6: Once the meat is cooked, add tomatoes and salt; let it boil briefly.
instructions.7: In another bowl, knead flour, yeast, salt, and warm water until the dough becomes soft.
instructions.8: Cover the dough and let it rise.
instructions.9: Roll out the dough to a thickness of half a centimeter.
instructions.10: Place the meat into a suitable baking dish.
instructions.11: Cover the meat with the dough and trim excess.
instructions.12: Mix ghee, Nescafe, sugar, powdered milk, and water; brush this mixture over the dough surface.
instructions.13: Sprinkle nigella seeds over the dough.
instructions.14: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 40 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.15: Remove from oven and serve hot.

title: Lamb and Caramelized Onion Tajine
culturalNotes: Make sure the broth is not too salty if using it, and adjust salt accordingly. Serve the tajine with rice or bread.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the lamb pieces and sauté well with the crushed garlic clove.
instructions.3: Add a pinch of sugar, black pepper, spices, ground cardamom, and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the sliced garlic cloves, laurel leaves, and cinnamon stick, and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the caramelized onions and stir with the lamb until the lamb is well browned.
instructions.6: Add salt and diced tomatoes.
instructions.7: Pour in the broth and let the mixture boil on medium heat.
instructions.8: Transfer the mixture to a tajine dish and cover tightly.
instructions.9: Place the tajine in a preheated oven at medium heat: bake on the bottom rack for 15 minutes, then move to the middle rack and cook for 2 hours or more until the lamb is tender and fully cooked.
instructions.10: Add the hot chili peppers on top before placing the tajine in the oven.
instructions.11: Leave the tajine in the oven until fully cooked and beautifully browned.
instructions.12: Serve hot.

title: Potato and Kofta Casserole
culturalNotes: The kofta can be frozen after shaping, placing plastic wrap between each layer in a foam container. Adding gravy to the casserole enhances its aroma. Serve the casserole with salad or bread.

instructions.1: Prepare the kofta:
instructions.2: Wash the rice and soak it for two hours, then drain thoroughly.
instructions.3: Chop the herbs (parsley, coriander, dill) and wash them; cut only the lower parts.
instructions.4: Chop the onions and garlic.
