instructions.5: Mix the ground meat with the cooked rice, chopped herbs, onions, garlic, and spices (salt, cumin, baking powder, garlic powder, onion powder, spices, sugar).
instructions.6: Knead the mixture well in a bowl until all ingredients are fully combined.
instructions.7: Shape the kofta into fingers or balls as desired.
instructions.8: Fry the kofta in hot oil until golden brown.
instructions.9: Prepare the casserole:
instructions.10: Cut the potatoes into cubes.
instructions.11: Heat the ghee in a pot and sauté the garlic and onions.
instructions.12: Add the tomato juice, gravy, and spices (salt, pepper, sugar, spices).
instructions.13: Add the potatoes and kofta, and stir well.
instructions.14: Pour the mixture into a baking dish or casserole pan and cover it.
instructions.15: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 15 minutes, then reduce heat and continue baking for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

title: Caramelized Onion Turlie Casserole
culturalNotes: Serve the casserole with white rice, bread, and salads. You may add other vegetables as desired.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the meat pieces and stir until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add 3 cloves of sliced garlic and stir.
instructions.4: Add half a kilogram of sliced onion and 1 teaspoon of sugar, and cook until the onion is caramelized.
instructions.5: Add the stock cube and let the ingredients simmer together.
instructions.6: Pour in 1 liter of water and let the meat cook gently until tender.
instructions.7: In a baking dish, arrange the vegetables (carrots, zucchini, potatoes, green beans).
instructions.8: Add the meat and caramelized onion to the dish, adjusting the water level as needed.
instructions.9: Cover the casserole and bake in the oven at 200°C for 30 minutes to 1 hour and 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Remove from the oven and serve hot.

title: Chicken Thighs with Potatoes and Cheese Casserole
culturalNotes: Serve the casserole with flatbread, pasta, or white rice. The casserole can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days and is best reheated before serving.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts into cubes.
instructions.2: Heat a pan on the stove and add a little oil, then add the chicken pieces and sauté.
instructions.3: Add chicken seasoning, black pepper, and instant broth, and stir well until the chicken changes color.
instructions.4: Add half a kilogram of diced white onion and stir with the chicken.
instructions.5: In another pan, heat oil and cut potatoes into cubes, then fry until golden and add a pinch of salt.
instructions.6: Add diced bell peppers to the chicken and stir for one minute.
instructions.7: Add one tablespoon of butter and three tablespoons of flour, and stir until the flour is cooked through.
instructions.8: Add one liter of milk and stir until the mixture boils and thickens.
instructions.9: Add a pinch of smoked paprika, then remove from heat.
instructions.10: Drain the fried potatoes and add them to the mixture.
instructions.11: Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish, then place the fried potatoes on top.
instructions.12: Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the top.
instructions.13: Preheat the oven to maximum temperature, and place the casserole on the middle rack.
instructions.14: Bake until the top is crispy and the cheese is bubbly and golden.
instructions.15: Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.

title: Meat and potato tagine topped with dough
culturalNotes: This tagine can be served with rice or pasta. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Cut the beef into small pieces.
instructions.2: Slice the onion into rings.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a pot and sauté the beef until browned.
instructions.4: Add the spices (chili, cumin, cinnamon, cloves, allspice) and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the onion and mix with the beef. Cover and let it simmer until tender.
instructions.6: Pour in boiling water to cover the meat, then add two bay leaves. Cover the pot and simmer on low heat until the meat is fully cooked.
instructions.7: In another bowl, mix the flour, salt, sugar, and yeast. Gradually add warm water and knead into a dough.
instructions.8: Add the oil and knead the dough for another 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
instructions.9: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place until doubled in size.
instructions.10: Fry the potatoes, bell pepper, and hot pepper in oil until golden brown.
instructions.11: Add salt and stir. Then add boiling water and cook for 5 minutes.
instructions.12: Place the meat and vegetable mixture into a baking dish, then cover it with the rolled-out dough.
instructions.13: Brush the dough with egg and yogurt, then sprinkle with nigella and sesame seeds.
instructions.14: Bake in a preheated oven on the rack until the dough turns golden brown and is fully cooked.

title: Fava beans with onions
culturalNotes: This dish can be served with a green salad or any preferred sauce. The rice can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Cut the fava beans into slices about 1.5 cm thick.
instructions.2: Season the meat with salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.3: Melt the butter in a pan and fry the meat on both sides until browned.
instructions.4: Add cumin, rosemary, and garlic to the meat and stir well.
instructions.5: Remove the meat from the pan and add the chopped onion.
instructions.6: Add sugar to the onion and stir until it turns golden brown.
instructions.7: Add dried mint and water to the onion and mix thoroughly.
instructions.8: Return the meat to the pan, cover, and simmer on low heat.
instructions.9: Prepare the rice: rinse the rice and place it in a pot with boiling water, salt, laurel leaves, cinnamon, cloves, and saffron (if using).
instructions.10: Add the stock cube (if using) and cover the rice. Cook until fully tender.
instructions.11: Add butter or oil to the rice and stir well.
instructions.12: Prepare the potatoes: peel and cut the potatoes into small cubes.
instructions.13: Boil the potatoes in salted boiling water for 4 minutes.
instructions.14: Drain the potatoes and fry them in hot oil until crispy.

title: Fatta
culturalNotes: Make sure to use the right cut of meat, such as shoulder, for a tender and delicious flavor. You can add a bone piece to make a rich and hearty broth.

instructions.1: Cut the meat into small pieces.
instructions.2: Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and sauté until fragrant. Then add the meat pieces and stir until browned.
instructions.3: Add the crushed cardamom pods, black pepper, sugar, and laurel leaf. Mix well.
instructions.4: Add the onion, carrot, and celery. Stir well and cook over medium heat.
instructions.5: Pour in water and bring to a boil. Then add salt, cover the pot, and simmer gently until the meat is tender.
instructions.6: Chop the tomatoes and hot pepper, then mash them together with a pinch of salt and squeeze out the juice.
instructions.7: Heat oil in another pot. Add garlic and sauté until golden brown. Then add the dried parsley and stir.
instructions.8: Add half of the minced garlic along with vinegar. Then add the tomato mixture, juice, sugar, parsley, black pepper, and stock cube. Mix thoroughly.
instructions.9: Simmer the sauce over low heat until thickened. Then add some broth to adjust the consistency.
instructions.10: Heat ghee and oil in a pot. Add cumin seeds and stir. Then add the washed and drained rice and stir until heated through.
instructions.11: Add 2 or 3 scoops of broth, then pour in boiling water. Mix well, add salt, cover, and cook over low heat until rice is done.
instructions.12: Cut the Egyptian flatbread into small squares and place them on a baking tray. Toast in the oven without oil until crisp.
instructions.13: Strain the tomato and vegetable broth, reserving the pulp that was set aside.
instructions.14: Place the toasted bread in the baking tray. Pour the broth and pulp over it, then add the sauce.
instructions.15: Add the rice and meat. Top with the sesame paste and gently mix everything together.
instructions.16: Serve hot.

title: Meat Fatta with Garlic and Cilantro
culturalNotes: You can serve Fatta with yogurt sauce on the side if desired. You can also sprinkle some chopped parsley for garnish.

instructions.1: Heat oil in a pot and add the small cubed beef. Add boiling water and let it boil. Skim off the foam on top using a spoon.
instructions.2: Add onion, carrot, tomatoes, laurel leaves, chopped garlic, cumin powder, cumin seeds, and sugar. Let the beef simmer until tender.
instructions.3: Add salt at the end of cooking and let it boil briefly, then remove from heat.
instructions.4: Toast the thin pita bread with ghee or butter in the oven until golden brown. Cut the bread into small cubes.
instructions.5: In another pot, heat ghee and oil, then add washed and drained rice. Stir the rice well until fully coated with ghee and oil.
instructions.6: Add the broth (water used to boil the beef) to the rice and let it cook on low heat. Add salt to taste.
instructions.7: Prepare the Fatta sauce by mixing yogurt, chopped garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper. Add mayonnaise if desired.
instructions.8: In a small pan, heat ghee and add chopped garlic. Fry until golden brown, then add chopped cilantro and cooked beef. Mix well.
instructions.9: Layer the toasted bread in a serving dish, then add the cooked rice, followed by the beef with cilantro. Pour the sauce over the top.
instructions.10: Serve Fatta hot and enjoy the delicious flavor.

title: Shawarma Fattah
culturalNotes: Fattah with shawarma can be served as a main meal or as child-friendly sandwiches. The fattah can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Slice the beef thinly and mix with shawarma marinade, tahini, soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar. Mix well and let marinate for 1 to 2 hours.
instructions.2: Fry the pita bread in butter or oil until crispy. Cut into small cubes.
instructions.3: Rinse the basmati rice and soak for 30 minutes. Drain and sauté in oil and butter over medium heat. Add spices (turmeric, curry powder, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, black pepper, and laurel leaf) and stir well. Add 4 cups of boiling water, cover, and simmer gently until rice is fully cooked.
instructions.4: Heat oil in a pan and add the marinated beef. Cook, stirring, until golden brown. Add sliced onions and fry until golden. Add bell peppers and tomatoes, and stir well. Mix in parsley and stir again.
instructions.5: Prepare the tahini sauce by combining vinegar, garlic, yogurt, mayonnaise, and pickled cucumber. Mix thoroughly until the consistency is smooth and medium.
instructions.6: Serve the shawarma fattah in a large serving dish. Layer the rice at the bottom, then the fried pita, followed by the shawarma. Drizzle the sauce over the shawarma.

title: Turkish Meat Casserole
culturalNotes: You can use any type of dough you prefer. Serve the casserole with a green salad or basmati rice.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the cubed ground meat and stir until browned on all sides.
instructions.3: Add salt, garlic, black pepper, and seven-spice mix and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the sliced onions and stir until softened.
instructions.5: Add sugar and stir until dissolved.
instructions.6: Add cubed tomatoes, water, and hot pepper. Simmer on low heat until cooked through.
instructions.7: Prepare the dough by mixing flour, water, sugar, and yeast. Let it rest until risen.
instructions.8: Add Nescafe and powdered milk to the dough and knead until smooth and even.
instructions.9: Cover the mixture with the dough and brush with oil.
instructions.10: Sprinkle nigella seeds or sesame seeds as desired.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20–25 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.12: Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving.

title: Chicken Thigh with Vegetables
culturalNotes: You can use a baking pan with aluminum foil if you don't have a thermal bag. Make sure to seal the pan tightly to prevent steam from escaping.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken thigh into suitable pieces.
instructions.2: Chop the vegetables (carrots, onion, tomatoes, potatoes, celery) into large chunks.
instructions.3: Mix sauce, honey, salt, black pepper, cinnamon powder, and seven-spice mix in a bowl.
instructions.4: Rub the chicken with the marinade mixture and insert it into the slits made with a knife.
instructions.5: Coat the chicken thoroughly with the marinade and let it rest in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours.
instructions.6: Place the chicken into a thermal bag with the chopped vegetables.
instructions.7: Seal the bag tightly and make 3-4 small cuts with a knife.
instructions.8: Place the bag in a baking pan and add boiling water (about 2-3 cups).
instructions.9: Preheat the oven and bake at high heat for 30 minutes.
instructions.10: Reduce the oven temperature and let the chicken cook for 3-4 hours until fully tender.
instructions.11: Serve the chicken with rice with raisins, carrots, and the cooked vegetables.

title: Hatta Chicken
culturalNotes: You can store honey in a cool, dry place for a long time without losing its properties. You can also serve the chicken with a green salad or basmati rice.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken thoroughly and let it dry.
instructions.2: Open the chicken lengthwise and spread it out to make seasoning easier.
instructions.3: Prepare the chicken for marinating.
instructions.4: Mix the marinade by combining salt, pepper, spices, paprika, thyme, garlic and onion powder, instant stock, ketchup, mustard, honey, oil, and lemon juice.
instructions.5: Insert the marinade into the slits you made in the chicken.
instructions.6: Place the chicken in a baking tray with a rack and cover it with aluminum foil.
instructions.7: Add 1 cup of boiling water under the tray.
instructions.8: Let the chicken marinate for 2 to 3 hours.
instructions.9: Bake the tray in a preheated oven at high heat for 1.5 hours.
instructions.10: Remove the foil and broil the chicken for 5 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.11: Serve the chicken garnished with chopped parsley.

title: Caramelized Onion Chicken
culturalNotes: You can serve caramelized onion chicken with white rice or Arabic bread. You can also add some fresh lemon for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken and cut into 4 pieces, then season with salt and pepper and let it marinate for 30 minutes.
instructions.2: Heat oil and butter in a pan, then brown the chicken on both sides until golden.
instructions.3: Transfer the chicken to a side plate, then slice the onions into wedges and add them to the pan, stirring until golden.
instructions.4: Add sugar to the onions and stir until caramelized.
instructions.5: Pour in the boiling water, then place the browned chicken into the sauce.
instructions.6: Add salt, pepper, thyme, laurel leaf, cumin powder, and seven-spice mix, then cover the pan and simmer on low heat until the chicken is fully cooked.
instructions.7: Serve the chicken hot with rice or bread.

title: Chicken with Eastern Marinade
culturalNotes: You can use this marinade with any type of meat, not just chicken. You can also add potatoes and onions under the chicken in the oven to make a complete meal.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken and dry it thoroughly.
instructions.2: Chop the onion, tomato, red pepper, green pepper, and garlic into small pieces and place them in a food processor.
instructions.3: Add 1/2 cup orange juice, salt, black pepper, paprika, instant stock cube, and seven-spice mix to the processor and blend well.
instructions.4: Add 1/4 cup oil to the marinade and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Insert the marinade into the chicken through the slits you made with a knife.
instructions.6: Toss the chicken well to ensure it is fully coated with the marinade.
instructions.7: You can store the chicken in the freezer or bake it in the oven with potatoes and onions.
instructions.8: Bake the chicken in the oven for 30 minutes until fully cooked.

title: Lemon Chicken
culturalNotes: You can serve the dish with rice or bread or a salad.

instructions.1: Wash the chickens thoroughly and cut them into 8 pieces.
instructions.2: Use a knife to make small incisions in the chicken to help the marinade penetrate.
instructions.3: Mix ginger, cumin, turmeric, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, allspice, seven-spice mix, black pepper, and chili in a bowl.
instructions.4: Add oil, lemon juice, and salt to the marinade and stir well.
instructions.5: Coat the chicken with the marinade and mix thoroughly.
instructions.6: Place potatoes in the baking dish and sprinkle the marinade over them.
instructions.7: Insert the marinade into the chicken using a knife.
instructions.8: Arrange the chicken on top of the potatoes in the baking dish.
instructions.9: Add two bell peppers to the dish.
instructions.10: Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 10 minutes.
instructions.11: Move the dish to the middle rack and bake for 1 hour.
instructions.12: Remove the aluminum foil and turn on the grill to achieve a golden-brown finish on the chicken.
instructions.13: Ensure the chicken and potatoes are fully cooked.

title: Chicken Marinated with Four Different Marinades
culturalNotes: These marinades can be used with various types of meat, not just chicken. The marinated chicken can be stored in the freezer for up to one month.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken and dry it thoroughly.
instructions.2: Prepare the four marinades:
instructions.3: Prepare the Eastern marinade: Mix onion, tomato, bell pepper, hot pepper, garlic, 1/2 cup orange juice, salt, black pepper, paprika, instant stock cube, and seven-spice mix in a bowl. Mix well and marinate the chicken.
instructions.4: Prepare the butter and lemon marinade: Mix 2 tablespoons butter, 1 tablespoon mustard, 4 cloves garlic, rosemary, 1/2 bunch fresh parsley, 1 teaspoon thyme, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and marinate the chicken.
instructions.5: Prepare the smoked Harissa marinade: Mix salt, black pepper, 1 tablespoon onion powder, 1 tablespoon garlic powder, 1 tablespoon pomegranate molasses, a pinch of saffron, cumin, parsley, 1 tablespoon paprika, 1/4 cup oil, and 1/4 cup lemon juice. Mix well and marinate the chicken.
instructions.6: Prepare the Mexican marinade: Mix 1/2 cup vinegar, 1/4 cup oil, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 2 tablespoons yogurt, 1 teaspoon minced garlic, thyme, paprika, and chicken seasoning. Mix well and marinate the chicken.
instructions.7: Wrap the chicken in the marinades and store in the freezer.
instructions.8: When cooking, place the chicken in a baking tray with potatoes and onions, then bake in the oven until fully cooked.

title: Stuffed Chicken with Spinach and Cheese
culturalNotes: Stuffed chicken can be frozen after being well wrapped in foam containers. Serve with white rice or grilled vegetables.

instructions.1: Melt butter in a pan over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.2: Add the spinach and chopped cilantro, and stir until well blended and cooked through.
instructions.3: Season with salt, black pepper, and cream cheese, and mix until ingredients are well combined.
instructions.4: Remove the filling from heat and stir in the mozzarella cheese until well blended.
instructions.5: Season the chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and chicken seasoning.
instructions.6: Stuff the chicken breasts with the filling and secure with kitchen twine.
instructions.7: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a frying pan over medium heat, then add the stuffed chicken rolls and fry until golden brown on all sides.
instructions.8: In another pan, combine 1 liter of milk and the béchamel packet, and stir until the sauce becomes creamy.
instructions.9: Add 2 or 3 tablespoons of the creamy sauce to the fried chicken and toss to coat.
instructions.10: Place the chicken in a baking dish, cover with a layer of creamy sauce, and top with a dollop of cream.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 15–20 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Roasted Chicken with Onions
culturalNotes: The chicken can be served with pasta, basmati rice, or bread. The juices released from the onions and chicken can be used to make a delicious sauce.

instructions.1: Chop the onion into coarse pieces.
instructions.2: Separate the chicken parts (thighs, drumsticks, breasts) and clean them thoroughly.
instructions.3: Place the chopped onion into the baking tray.
instructions.4: Add black pepper and salt to the onion.
instructions.5: Add the instant broth cube and cinnamon to the onion.
instructions.6: Place the chicken pieces on top of the onion.
instructions.7: Season the chicken with salt and black pepper.
instructions.8: Add olive oil and smoked paprika to the chicken.
instructions.9: Mix the chicken well with the spices.
instructions.10: Cover the tray with aluminum foil.
instructions.11: Preheat the oven to the highest temperature.
instructions.12: Place the tray in the oven on the bottom rack for 15 minutes.
instructions.13: Move the tray to the middle rack.
instructions.14: Let it cook for 1 to 1.5 hours.

title: Roasted Chicken in a Jar
culturalNotes: The sauce that drips from the chicken can be used to make pasta or rice.

instructions.1: Mix salt, onion powder, garlic powder, chicken spices, seven spices, instant stock, smoked paprika, oil, ketchup, pomegranate molasses, vinegar, and orange juice in a bowl.
instructions.2: Reserve 1/4 cup of the marinade separately.
instructions.3: Wash the chicken thoroughly and pat dry. Rub the marinade inside and outside the chicken, and let it marinate for 3-4 hours or overnight.
instructions.4: Grease the baking tray with oil. Cut the potatoes into medium-sized cubes and season them with the reserved 1/4 cup of marinade.
instructions.5: Spread the potatoes evenly on the baking tray.
instructions.6: Fill two jars halfway with boiling water, then place the chicken on top of the jars inside the tray.
instructions.7: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 30 minutes, then reduce the temperature to 170°C and continue roasting for 1 hour.
instructions.8: Baste the chicken with the sauce that drips from it to give it a shiny finish.
instructions.9: Serve the roasted chicken with the roasted potatoes.

title: Chicken Kneaded Stuffing
culturalNotes: Chicken kneaded stuffing can be used in many dishes such as lasagna, sambosa, feteer, fatayer, baked pasta, and more. Freezing it saves time and effort when preparing meals.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken breast and drain well.
instructions.2: Slice the onion into thin slices.
instructions.3: Cut the bell peppers into thin, small slices.
instructions.4: In a pan, heat 2 spoons of ghee and a little oil until hot.
instructions.5: Add the chicken pieces and fry until browned on both sides.
instructions.6: Add the onion slices and stir with the chicken.
instructions.7: Add salt, pepper, a pinch of sugar, a pinch of cinnamon, and 1 small spoon of thyme.
instructions.8: Stir well until the onions are soft and translucent.
instructions.9: Add the bell peppers and stir quickly for a few times only.
instructions.10: Turn off the heat and let the chicken cool.
instructions.11: Place the chicken in freezer bags and store in the freezer.

title: Crispy Chicken
culturalNotes: You can add chili to taste for a spicy flavor. Fried chicken can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken and soak it in water and vinegar for 10 minutes, then drain.
instructions.2: Mix the yogurt with salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, oregano, paprika, and sugar.
instructions.3: Place the chicken pieces into the mixture, cover, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
instructions.4: Drain the chicken from the marinade and place it in a tray.
instructions.5: Mix half a cup of flour, half a cup of cornstarch, and one teaspoon of baking powder; stir well.
instructions.6: Dip the chicken into the flour and cornstarch mixture and coat thoroughly.
instructions.7: Place the chicken in a pot with boiling water and cover. Cook for 30 minutes.
instructions.8: After 30 minutes, remove the chicken and dip it again into the flour and cornstarch mixture.
instructions.9: Heat oil in a pan and fry the chicken pieces, stirring occasionally, until golden brown.
instructions.10: Serve the crispy chicken hot.

title: Kebab al-Hati
culturalNotes: Fresh onion and tomatoes can be used, or canned ones. Sweet peppers and grilled onions can be added for serving.

instructions.1: Cut the onion into quarters and finely chop it in the food processor.
instructions.2: Place the finely chopped onion in a strainer to drain the water.
instructions.3: Squeeze the tomatoes and strain to remove the water.
instructions.4: Mix salt, black pepper, honey, lemon juice, vinegar, and oil in a bowl.
instructions.5: Add thyme and rosemary to the marinade and stir well.
instructions.6: Marinate the meat pieces with the mixture and let it rest in the refrigerator overnight or for at least 3–4 hours.
instructions.7: Cut the meat into rectangular slices and small cubes.
instructions.8: Wrap the meat pieces in a cloth and cut them into circles.
instructions.9: Alternate threading the meat pieces and the skewers.
instructions.10: Grill the kebabs on the grill, keeping a distance of 10 centimeters between the grilling rack and the charcoal.
instructions.11: Turn the kebabs occasionally until they turn golden and are fully cooked.
instructions.12: Serve the kebabs with grilled bread and grilled vegetables.

title: Chicken Kebab with Chicken Thighs
culturalNotes: Serve the kebab with rice or pasta and salad. You can also use chicken breasts instead of thighs if preferred.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the marinated chicken thighs and stir until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add salt, pepper, cinnamon, sugar, seven-spice mix, oregano, and clove powder; stir well to combine.
instructions.4: Add sliced garlic and sliced onions; stir until onions soften.
instructions.5: Add cubed tomatoes and laurel leaf; stir thoroughly.
instructions.6: Reduce heat, cover the pot, and let it simmer for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Add cubed and pre-fried potatoes; stir well.
instructions.8: Pour in 1 cup of boiling water, cover the pot, and let it cook for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: After 15 minutes, simmer on low heat for an additional 5 minutes.
instructions.10: Serve hot with rice or pasta and salad.

title: Kebab Roll
culturalNotes: Different types of meat can be used in the kebab roll, such as chicken or thinly sliced beef. The kebab roll can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours before grilling.

instructions.1: Grate the onion or blend it in a blender, then use only the juice and discard the pulp.
instructions.2: Add black pepper, salt, barbecue sauce, white honey, and lemon juice to the onion juice, and mix well.
instructions.3: Place the marinated beef tenderloin in the refrigerator for two hours.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix ground meat with onion pulp, cornstarch, spices, black pepper, salt, and sugar, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Cut the cotton cloth into pieces measuring 20×30 cm.
instructions.6: Place the marinated beef tenderloin pieces on the cloth, then spread a layer of ground meat on top.
instructions.7: Carefully roll the cloth like making a Swiss roll, then cut into pieces about 2 cm thick.
instructions.8: Place the kebab rolls on the grilling rack, and grill over charcoal for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally.
instructions.9: Serve the kebab roll hot.

title: Smoked Chicken Kebabs
culturalNotes: You can add tomatoes and chili peppers while grilling for extra flavor. You can also serve the kebabs with a green salad or basmati rice.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken breasts and cut them into small cubes.
instructions.2: Chop the onion and red bell pepper and squeeze out the excess water.
instructions.3: Mix the chopped onion and red bell pepper with minced garlic, spices, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.4: Add the cubed chicken, dried mint, and parsley to the mixture and knead thoroughly.
instructions.5: Add honey and knead again until the mixture becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.6: Shape the mixture into finger-like pieces or thread them onto skewers.
instructions.7: Place charcoal in a tray and cover it with aluminum foil.
instructions.8: Place the kebabs on the skewers and brush them with a mixture of onion and pepper water, oil, and salt.
instructions.9: Grill the kebabs in a preheated oven at high heat (about 200°C) for 15–20 minutes.
instructions.10: Serve the kebabs with ketchup, white pita bread, chili pepper, and grilled tomatoes.

title: Kabab Koubri
culturalNotes: Make sure the rice is well washed and drained before adding it to the mixture. You can increase the rice quantity as desired, but ensure the mixture is not too watery. Serve Kabab Koubri with white rice and roasted potatoes for a complete meal.

instructions.1: Mix the onion, garlic, parsley, and cilantro into the meat mixture.
instructions.2: Add the ground beef, cumin, dried mint, black pepper, salt, sugar, ground red pepper, and baking soda. Mix everything thoroughly.
instructions.3: Transfer the mixture to a bowl and knead well.
instructions.4: Shape the mixture into finger-like pieces and arrange them in an oiled dish.
instructions.5: In a pot, fry the onion until golden brown, then add tomato juice, salt, and pepper. Let the mixture simmer.
instructions.6: Add the stock and let it boil.
instructions.7: Place the sliced potatoes at the bottom of the pot, then add the meat pieces. Cover and simmer on low heat for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Serve Kabab Koubri hot with white rice and roasted potatoes.

title: Smoked Kofta
culturalNotes: The kofta can be frozen after shaping and before frying. When needed, remove from freezer and let thaw slightly, then fry in oil until golden brown.

instructions.1: Soak lentils in water for 30 minutes.
instructions.2: In a bowl, mix soaked lentils with finely chopped onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, cilantro, black pepper, onion powder, and salt.
instructions.3: Pound the mixture thoroughly until it becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.4: Shape the mixture into patties or balls, as desired.
instructions.5: Prepare a mixture of breadcrumbs and cornstarch, add 2 tablespoons of yogurt, and stir well.
instructions.6: Dip each patty into beaten eggs, then coat thoroughly in the breadcrumb and cornstarch mixture.
instructions.7: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the patties until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.8: Light the charcoal and place a sheet of aluminum foil on top.
instructions.9: Place the kofta patties on the foil and quickly cover with foil.
instructions.10: Let the kofta smoke for 5 minutes.
instructions.11: Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of parsley.

title: Nafsh Kebab
culturalNotes: Make sure the rice is well washed and drained before adding it to the mixture. You can serve the kebab with white rice and salads.

instructions.1: Mix the onion, garlic, parsley, and cilantro in the meat mixture.
instructions.2: Add the ground beef, dill, cumin, black pepper, salt, sugar, ground red pepper, and baking soda. Mix everything thoroughly.
instructions.3: Transfer the mixture to a bowl and knead well.
instructions.4: Shape the mixture into finger-like pieces and arrange them in an oiled baking dish.
instructions.5: In a large pot, sauté the onion in butter and oil until golden brown.
instructions.6: Add the tomato juice, salt, and pepper. Let the mixture simmer until thickened.
instructions.7: Add the stock and bring to a boil.
instructions.8: Place the potato slices at the bottom of the pot.
instructions.9: Add the kebab pieces, cover the pot, and simmer on low heat for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
instructions.10: After 1 hour and 15 minutes, uncover the pot and serve the kebab hot with white rice.

title: Chicken Liver with Pomegranate Molasses
culturalNotes: Chicken liver can be served with pasta, bread, or rice. Be sure not to over-stir the liver during cooking to avoid drying it out.

instructions.1: Wash the liver thoroughly and drain it in a colander until completely dry.
instructions.2: Cut the liver into medium-sized pieces.
instructions.3: Chop the green pepper into small pieces.
instructions.4: Mix the liver with minced garlic in a bowl.
instructions.5: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.6: Add the liver to the hot oil and gently stir until golden brown.
instructions.7: Add the green pepper, salt, and black pepper, and stir for 3–4 minutes until the liver is cooked through.
instructions.8: Add the pomegranate molasses and let the liver simmer on low heat for 2 more minutes to absorb the flavor.
instructions.9: Serve the liver hot with pasta, bread, or rice.

title: Liver with Onion
culturalNotes: Liver with onion can be served in sandwiches or alongside potatoes and salads. The liver can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Soak the liver in 3 tablespoons of vinegar for 3 minutes, then drain thoroughly.
instructions.2: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.3: Add the heart and kidneys and sauté well.
instructions.4: Add the onions and stir until golden brown.
instructions.5: Add a pinch of sugar and let it caramelize.
instructions.6: Transfer the heart, kidneys, and onions to a separate plate.
instructions.7: Heat two tablespoons of additional oil in the same pan.
instructions.8: Add the liver and stir until golden brown.
instructions.9: Add salt, black pepper, cumin, chili, and green pepper; stir well.
instructions.10: Return the heart, kidneys, and onions to the pan and stir with the liver for 6 minutes.
instructions.11: Add a pinch of cinnamon and stir well.
instructions.12: Serve the liver hot with parsley and green pepper.

title: Crispy Onion Chicken Liver
culturalNotes: Crispy Onion Chicken Liver can be served with white rice or in sandwiches with tahini sauce.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the onion and sauté until golden and caramelized.
instructions.3: Add 1 small spoon of sugar and stir until the mixture turns golden brown.
instructions.4: Add garlic slices and stir for a few minutes until fragrant.
instructions.5: Add the chicken liver and stir frequently over high heat until golden brown.
instructions.6: Add salt, pepper, and cumin, and mix well.
instructions.7: Let the chicken liver cook until fully done.

title: Liver with Onion and Tomato
culturalNotes: Serve liver with tahini salad and roasted potatoes for a distinctive flavor. Liver can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Place liver in the freezer for 15 minutes before slicing.
instructions.2: Slice liver into thin pieces.
instructions.3: Heat oil in a pan over high heat.
instructions.4: Add minced garlic and sauté until golden.
instructions.5: Add liver and stir-fry over high heat until browned.
instructions.6: Add black pepper, cumin, parsley, salt, sugar, and hot pepper. Mix well.
instructions.7: Add chopped onion and diced tomatoes. Combine all ingredients.
instructions.8: Add lemon juice and mix with the rest of the ingredients.
instructions.9: Add chopped fresh parsley and mix with the rest of the ingredients.
instructions.10: Add roasted potatoes and mix with the rest of the ingredients.
instructions.11: Serve liver with Egyptian bread (baladi) and tahini sauce.

title: Chicken Liver with Pomegranate Molasses
culturalNotes: Chicken liver with pomegranate molasses can be served in sandwiches with lemon slices and seasoned tomatoes. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Cut the onion into rings and sauté in oil over low heat with half a teaspoon of sugar until caramelized.
instructions.2: Dice the bell pepper, hot pepper, and tomatoes into small cubes.
instructions.3: Wash the chicken liver thoroughly and cut into small pieces.
instructions.4: Add the chicken liver to the caramelized onion and stir with two tablespoons of pomegranate molasses, salt, and black pepper.
instructions.5: Sauté the liver over high heat, stirring constantly, until cooked and all moisture has evaporated.
instructions.6: Add the bell pepper, tomatoes, cumin, and parsley, and stir well to combine.
instructions.7: Add two tablespoons of pomegranate molasses and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.8: Serve chicken liver with pomegranate molasses with roasted potatoes, pickles, and salads.

title: Chicken Liver with Onion and Potatoes
culturalNotes: You can serve this dish with bread or pasta. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix the liver with salt, black pepper, cinnamon, and tomato powder. Stir well.
instructions.2: Add the flour and mix thoroughly with the liver until well combined.
instructions.3: Heat oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the liver, spread it out in the pan, and avoid stirring too much until it turns golden brown.
instructions.4: Stir the liver occasionally until fully cooked.
instructions.5: In the same pan, add a small amount of oil, then add the onion, green pepper, and hot pepper. Sauté for a few minutes until their raw flavor softens.
instructions.6: Add the cubed potatoes and stir with the onion and peppers until they turn golden brown.
instructions.7: Combine the potato mixture with the liver and mix well.
instructions.8: Serve hot. You may sprinkle chili sauce and parsley to taste.

title: Liver with Ruda
culturalNotes: You can use chopped garlic instead of garlic powder if desired. Make sure the liver slices are thin to ensure they cook quickly.

instructions.1: Clean the liver and cut it into thin slices.
instructions.2: In a bowl, mix the garlic powder, onion powder, seven-spice mix, salt, black pepper, vinegar, and lemon juice.
instructions.3: Add the liver slices to the spice mixture and toss well until all pieces are evenly coated.
instructions.4: Cover the bowl and let the liver marinate for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
instructions.5: In another bowl, combine the ruda, flour, and cornstarch.
instructions.6: Dip each liver piece into the ruda-flour-starch mixture, pressing firmly to ensure full coverage.
instructions.7: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.8: When the oil is hot, reduce the heat and add the coated liver pieces.
instructions.9: Fry the liver, turning occasionally, until golden brown and crispy.
instructions.10: Remove the liver from the oil and place on paper towels to drain excess grease.
instructions.11: Serve the liver hot, seasoned with salt, pepper, and ground coriander to taste.

title: Economical Kofta
culturalNotes: Kofta can be stored in the freezer for up to one month. It can be served with sauce or with béchamel pasta.

instructions.1: Wash the bulgur without soaking it.
instructions.2: Chop the onion, red pepper, green pepper, tomato, and garlic in the food processor.
instructions.3: Add the pita bread to the mixture and pulse again.
instructions.4: Transfer the mixture to a large bowl.
instructions.5: Add the bulgur, black pepper, seven-spice mix, cinnamon, salt, fennel, baking powder, and instant stock. Mix thoroughly.
instructions.6: Add the ground meat and knead the mixture well.
instructions.7: Let the mixture rest in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
instructions.8: After 30 minutes, knead the mixture again until smooth and elastic.
instructions.9: Shape the kofta into oval or round forms.
instructions.10: Dip the kofta in beaten eggs and breadcrumbs, then fry until golden brown.
instructions.11: Kofta can be served with béchamel pasta or sauce.

title: Economical Kofta with Potatoes
culturalNotes: Kofta can be stored in the freezer for up to one month. It can be served with rice or Arabic bread.

instructions.1: Chop the onion, parsley, red pepper, and garlic into small pieces.
instructions.2: Add all the chopped ingredients to the kofta mixture and mince thoroughly.
instructions.3: Boil the potatoes until cooked through, then mash and let cool.
instructions.4: Add the mashed potatoes, ground beef, and crushed breadcrumbs to the mixture and knead well.
instructions.5: Shape the mixture into kofta fingers or balls.
instructions.6: Grease a baking tray with ghee and place the kofta on it.
instructions.7: Preheat the oven to maximum heat and place the tray inside until the kofta are well browned.
instructions.8: Reheat the roasted potatoes and place them on the serving plate with the kofta.
instructions.9: Cover the plate with aluminum foil to trap the steam and keep the heat inside.
instructions.10: To prepare the salad, chop the onion, cucumber, hot pepper, and tomatoes into small pieces.
instructions.11: Add salt, black pepper, cumin, dill, paprika, and chili to taste.
instructions.12: Mix all salad ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.13: Add lemon juice and water, then mix again.
instructions.14: Serve the kofta with potatoes, salad, and flatbread.

title: Breaded Chicken Kofta
culturalNotes: You can freeze the kofta before frying and use it anytime, saving you a lot of time and effort.

instructions.1: Mix the boneless, skinless, and dried chicken breasts with boiled rice, chopped parsley, finely chopped onion, garlic, salt, pepper, paprika, chicken spices, and instant stock cube in a bowl.
instructions.2: Knead the mixture thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Shape the mixture into oval forms and lightly flatten them.
instructions.4: Prepare the coating by mixing cornstarch, flour, panko, egg, and yogurt.
instructions.5: Dip the kofta into the coating mixture, then dip again into the same mixture.
instructions.6: Fry the kofta in plenty of hot oil over medium heat, turning occasionally, until golden brown.
instructions.7: Drain the kofta on paper towels to remove excess oil.

title: Grilled Chicken Kofta for Freezing
culturalNotes: The kofta can be stored in the freezer for up to 3 months. When using, let it thaw at room temperature before grilling.

instructions.1: Chop the bell peppers, onion, tomato, and garlic into small pieces.
instructions.2: Strain the mixture to remove liquid and set the liquid aside.
instructions.3: Return the mixture to the grinder and add the chicken breasts and thighs, parsley, black pepper, salt, onion powder, garlic powder, lamb mince, smoked paprika, seven-spice mix, and instant stock powder.
instructions.4: Knead the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.5: Add breadcrumbs and baking powder, and mix well.
instructions.6: Shape the kofta into balls or patties.
instructions.7: Place the kofta in foam trays for freezing, separating each layer with a plastic bag.
instructions.8: The kofta can be grilled over charcoal, on a pan, or in the oven as needed.

title: Chicken Kofta with Sauce
culturalNotes: Make sure the kofta mixture is firm before shaping. You can serve the kofta with white rice or boiled pasta and grilled vegetables for a complete meal.

fah-102-i3.name: 1 kg chicken breast and thigh meat

instructions.1: Mix 3 cloves of garlic, 2 stalks of parsley, 1 kg of chicken breast and thigh meat, 1 grated onion, black pepper, paprika, chicken seasoning, salt, and 2 tablespoons of breadcrumbs in a bowl.
instructions.2: Mix the ingredients thoroughly until the mixture becomes firm. If the mixture is too soft, add two more tablespoons of breadcrumbs.
instructions.3: Cut the red cheddar cheese into small cubes.
instructions.4: Form balls from the kofta mixture and stuff each ball with one cube of cheddar cheese.
instructions.5: Heat a little oil and butter in a pan over medium heat, then brown the kofta on all sides until golden.
instructions.6: In another pan, sauté 1 finely chopped onion and 1 or 2 cloves of garlic until golden.
instructions.7: Add 1 tablespoon of flour and stir well.
instructions.8: Add 1 stock cube, black pepper, salt, then add 2 cups of boiling water and stir until well combined.
instructions.9: Add 1 cup of yogurt and stir well until the sauce thickens.
instructions.10: Add the browned kofta to the sauce and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes until the kofta is cooked through and the sauce thickens.
instructions.11: Serve the kofta hot with white rice or boiled pasta and grilled vegetables.

title: Chicken Kofta with Mozzarella
culturalNotes: Kofta can be stored in the freezer for a long time. Serve hot with rice or fried potatoes.

instructions.1: Mix ground chicken with crushed breadcrumbs and spices (salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, oregano, seven-spice mix, and a pinch of sugar).
instructions.2: Knead the ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Take a piece of dough and place a piece of mozzarella cheese inside.
instructions.4: Wrap the cheese completely with dough so it doesn’t show.
instructions.5: Coat the kofta with flour, then with a mixture of egg and yogurt, then with the dry mix made of flour, ground oats, cornstarch, and breadcrumbs.
instructions.6: Repeat the previous steps until all ingredients are used.
instructions.7: Place the kofta in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to 1 hour before frying.
instructions.8: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.9: Fry the kofta on all sides until golden brown.
instructions.10: Remove the kofta from oil and place on kitchen paper towels to drain excess oil.

title: Chicken Kofta with Cheese Filling
culturalNotes: Kofta can be frozen and used as needed. When frying, make sure to fully cover the pan with kofta to ensure even cooking.

instructions.1: In a food processor, mix chicken breasts and thighs with paprika, chicken seasoning, black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, and salt until smooth.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of crushed breadcrumbs to the mixture and knead thoroughly.
instructions.3: Prepare one cup of flour and place it in a shallow bowl.
instructions.4: Cut the cheese into small cubes.
instructions.5: Take a portion of the mixture, make a small opening, insert a cheese cube, and seal tightly.
instructions.6: Dip each kofta first in flour, then in the egg and milk mixture, and finally in the Chinese-style crushed breadcrumbs.
instructions.7: Repeat the previous steps until all the mixture is used.
instructions.8: Fry the kofta in hot oil over medium heat until golden brown on all sides.
instructions.9: Place the fried kofta on paper towels to absorb excess oil.

title: Chicken Kofta with Tomato Sauce
culturalNotes: You can serve the kofta with white rice or pasta. You can also add some vegetables like carrots and peas for a more nutritious meal.

instructions.1: Mix the ground chicken breasts with the chopped onion and finely chopped parsley.
instructions.2: Add salt, sugar, black pepper, paprika, cumin, and oregano, then knead the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Form the mixture into balls and coat them with flour.
instructions.4: Heat ghee and oil in a pan, then fry the kofta balls on all sides until golden brown.
instructions.5: In the same pan, add the minced garlic and sauté lightly.
instructions.6: Pour in the tomato juice and let it simmer slightly, then add salt and sugar.
instructions.7: Add 1 cup of water and let the mixture come to a boil.
instructions.8: Add the kofta balls, cover the pot, and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes until cooked through.
instructions.9: Serve hot with white rice or pasta.

title: Kofta Kebabik with Potatoes
culturalNotes: You can use kibbeh paper instead of greasing the mold with ghee and breadcrumbs. Serve kofta with a green salad or basmati rice.

instructions.1: Mix ground meat with finely chopped onion, crushed breadcrumbs, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, sugar, and seven-spice mix.
instructions.2: Knead the ingredients thoroughly until well combined and firm.
instructions.3: Grease the kibbeh mold with ghee and sprinkle with crushed breadcrumbs.
instructions.4: Take a piece of dough and shape it into the kibbeh mold, arranging them so the tops slightly rise above the mold.
instructions.5: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden and fully cooked.
instructions.6: Boil potatoes with salt, pepper, and cream (ashta) until soft, then mash them.
instructions.7: Transfer mashed potatoes into a pastry bag and pipe them into the kofta.
instructions.8: Garnish the dish with grated carrots and chopped parsley.
instructions.9: Serve kofta hot.

title: Economic Kofta al-Kordi Bello
culturalNotes: You can freeze the kofta after shaping and before frying, then fry them as needed. This recipe is perfect for quick and economical meals.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and wash them thoroughly, then grate them using a grater.
instructions.2: Place the grated potatoes in a colander and squeeze them well to remove excess moisture.
instructions.3: Add chicken breast and thighs to the kofta mixture, then add crushed breadcrumbs, oregano, seven-spice mix, instant broth powder, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, mustard, and barbecue sauce.
instructions.4: Mix all ingredients thoroughly until you get a uniform mixture.
instructions.5: Cut beef or turkey rolls into small cubes and add them to the kofta mixture.
instructions.6: Mix all ingredients well until fully combined.
instructions.7: Add the well-squeezed grated potatoes to the kofta mixture and mix thoroughly.
instructions.8: Beat two eggs in a bowl, add 2 large spoons of yogurt, a pinch of salt, and a pinch of pepper, then mix well.
instructions.9: Prepare 1 cup of flour.
instructions.10: Take a portion of the kofta mixture, flatten it, place a slice of cheese in the center, and roll it tightly.
instructions.11: Use a plastic bag to help shape the kofta more easily.
instructions.12: Dip the kofta first in flour, then in the egg and yogurt mixture, then in the combined coating of breadcrumbs, flour, cornstarch, and vegetable mix.
instructions.13: Repeat the coating process for all kofta pieces until finished.
instructions.14: Fry the kofta in hot oil over medium heat until golden brown.
instructions.15: Serve hot with pasta or any sauce of your choice.

title: Surprise Kofta
culturalNotes: Fillings can be changed according to preference, such as cheese or rosewater filling. This kofta can be served at gatherings as a main course.

instructions.1: Heat ghee and oil in a pot over medium heat, then add onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.2: Add cinnamon and black pepper and stir well.
instructions.3: Add basmati rice and stir thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add instant stock, honey, and ground meat with bones, and mix well.
instructions.5: Add raisins as desired and salt, then add boiling water or stock as desired.
instructions.6: Let the rice boil, then reduce heat and simmer until it absorbs all the liquid.
instructions.7: Fry the nuts in a pan and place them on top of the rice.
instructions.8: Mix chicken breasts and thighs with salt, black pepper, instant stock, and seven-spice blend in a bowl.
instructions.9: Add chopped onion and parsley, and knead until the mixture becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.10: Stuff the kofta with rice, spiced meat, and nuts.
instructions.11: Arrange the kofta in a greased baking tray and bake in a preheated oven at high heat until fully cooked.
instructions.12: Prepare a sauce by mixing ketchup, salt, pepper, and honey, and stir well.
instructions.13: Brush the kofta with the sauce after cooking, and let it brown and develop a beautiful color.
instructions.14: Serve the kofta with leftover rice and chopped parsley.

title: Caramelized Onion Kofta
culturalNotes: Serve kofta with basmati rice or pasta. It can also be used in sandwiches.

instructions.1: Cut the onion into wedges and grate one large onion.
instructions.2: Mix ground beef with grated onion, salt, and pepper. Knead thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Shape the beef mixture into medium-sized balls.
instructions.4: Dust the beef balls with flour.
instructions.5: Heat butter and oil in a pan. Brown the beef balls on all sides until golden.
instructions.6: Transfer the browned beef balls to a separate plate.
instructions.7: In the same pan, add the onion wedges and 1 tablespoon of sugar. Sauté until caramelized.
instructions.8: Add chicken broth and let the mixture come to a boil.
instructions.9: Return the browned beef balls to the pan. Add salt, pepper, and spices. Mix well.
instructions.10: Cover the pan and simmer for 10 minutes on low heat.
instructions.11: Serve hot with basmati rice or pasta.

title: Kofta with Sauce and Mashed Potato
culturalNotes: Kofta can be served with a green salad or fried potato chips. Kofta can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Boil potatoes in salted boiling water, cover, and let them cook until tender.
instructions.2: Mix ground beef with salt and black pepper, and knead well until firm and cohesive.
instructions.3: Shape the meat into small balls.
instructions.4: Fry the kofta in hot oil until they change color.
instructions.5: Drain the potatoes and mash them while hot.
instructions.6: Add cream, rosemary, garlic, and butter to the pan, and cook over medium heat until well blended.
instructions.7: Add salt, black pepper, garlic, and rosemary, and stir well.
instructions.8: Add chopped parsley, chopped cilantro, minced garlic, vinegar, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, and oregano, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.9: Add chopped red and green peppers and olive oil, and stir well.
instructions.10: Mix mashed potatoes into the kofta and combine thoroughly.
instructions.11: Pour the sauce over the kofta and mix well.

title: Kofta with Syrian Bread
culturalNotes: You can spread butter or ghee on the bread before placing the kofta to improve the result. You can also cover the kofta after cooking for better texture.

instructions.1: Mix ground beef with finely chopped onion, grated tomatoes, finely chopped green pepper, crushed breadcrumbs, finely chopped garlic, salt, black pepper, and seven-spice mix.
instructions.2: Knead the mixture thoroughly until it holds together well.
instructions.3: Cut the Syrian bread into small pieces.
instructions.4: Take a piece of kofta and shape it into a long roll, then place it on one end of a bread piece.
instructions.5: Fold both ends of the bread over the kofta to form a roll.
instructions.6: Cut the roll into 3–4 cm pieces using a serrated knife.
instructions.7: Place the pieces in a greased baking tray with butter or ghee.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.9: Serve the kofta garnished with fresh parsley.

title: Kofta with White Sauce
culturalNotes: Kofta can be served with pasta or white rice. To store, place in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Prepare the kofta: Mix ground beef with finely chopped onion, salt, pepper, and sugar.
instructions.2: Knead the ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Shape the kofta into small balls.
instructions.4: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, then brown the kofta until golden.
instructions.5: Transfer the browned kofta to a baking dish or tray.
instructions.6: Prepare the white sauce: In another bowl, melt the ghee over low heat, then add flour and stir well until the color turns white.
instructions.7: Slowly add milk while continuously stirring with a whisk until the sauce thickens and becomes hot.
instructions.8: Add cream, salt, and pepper, and stir well.
instructions.9: Add cottage cheese or feta cubes and stir until melted.
instructions.10: Pour the white sauce over the kofta in the baking dish.
instructions.11: Top the kofta with mozzarella and cheddar cheese if desired.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C until bubbly and golden brown.
instructions.13: Serve hot with pasta if desired.

title: Kofta Baniyah
culturalNotes: Kofta can be frozen after covering and served as needed. When freezing, place them in a foam tray and cover with a plastic bag to prevent sticking. Let them rest slightly before frying to ensure they cook through inside.

instructions.1: Mix ground beef with boiled rice, chopped parsley, chopped onion, salt, pepper, sugar, allspice, and seven-spice mix.
instructions.2: Knead the mixture thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Shape the kofta into oval forms.
instructions.4: Prepare the coating mixture: place flour in one bowl, eggs in another with added salt and pepper, and breadcrumbs with cornstarch in a third bowl.
instructions.5: Coat each kofta ball with flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs and cornstarch.
instructions.6: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.7: Add kofta to hot oil and fry until golden brown.
instructions.8: Drain kofta on paper towels to remove excess oil.

title: Vegetable-Stuffed Kofta
culturalNotes: You can add raisins and nuts to the kofta for extra flavor. You can also serve the dish with tomato sauce or red sauce.

instructions.1: Chop the white onions finely and set aside.
instructions.2: In a bowl, mix the ground beef with the chopped onion, salt, black pepper, seven spices, and crushed breadcrumbs. Mix thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: In another bowl, mix the chopped onion, carrots, parsley, salt, black pepper, and 1/2 cup of boiling water. Mix well and let it cool.
instructions.4: Shape the kofta into flat rounds and stuff them with the vegetable mixture and mozzarella. Seal the kofta tightly.
instructions.5: Heat the oil and ghee in a pan, then place the kofta in it. Fry until golden brown on all sides.
instructions.6: In another pot, mix the basmati rice with oil and ghee. Add cumin, turmeric, saffron, salt, and instant stock. Add boiling water, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer until the rice is fully cooked.
instructions.7: In a bowl, mix the chopped onion with vinegar, sugar, and salt. Let it sit for 10 minutes, then drain.
instructions.8: Add cucumber, tomatoes, hot pepper, sweet pepper, and parsley to the drained onion. Add garlic powder, onion powder, and mayonnaise. Mix well.
instructions.9: Serve the stuffed kofta with the spiced rice and salad.

title: Fried Kofta
culturalNotes: Kofta can be stored in the freezer for a long time and is fried directly when needed. Kofta can be served with basmati rice, pasta, or muhallebi rice.

instructions.1: Soak the fine bulgur in water for 15 minutes, then drain thoroughly.
instructions.2: Chop the onion and parsley very finely.
instructions.3: Mix the ground beef with the soaked bulgur, onion, parsley, salt, pepper, and spices in a bowl.
instructions.4: Knead the mixture for 10 minutes to ensure everything is well combined.
instructions.5: Shape the kofta into finger-like pieces and arrange them in a dish.
instructions.6: Store any extra kofta in the freezer by placing them in a foam tray and wrapping tightly with plastic wrap.
instructions.7: Heat oil over medium heat and fry the kofta until golden brown.
instructions.8: Serve the kofta with basmati rice, pasta, or muhallebi rice.

title: Mixed Kofta
culturalNotes: You can grill the kofta over charcoal, in the oven, or on a griddle according to preference. Serve kofta with tahini salad and fresh vegetables.

instructions.1: Wash and dry the chicken breasts, then chop them.
instructions.2: Add 100 grams of lye and grind it in the food processor until smooth.
instructions.3: Add half a kilogram of ground meat and mix together.
instructions.4: Prepare the vegetables: chop 2 medium onions, 1 red pepper, 2 sprigs of parsley, and 3 cloves of garlic. Strain the vegetables well.
instructions.5: Add the vegetables to the meat and chicken mixture, then add salt, pepper, and seven-spice mix. Mix thoroughly.
instructions.6: Prepare the griddle and grease it with oil. Pour the kofta onto the griddle and cook over medium heat.
instructions.7: Preheat the oven to the highest temperature and place the kofta on the rack closest to the bottom.
instructions.8: Cover the kofta and let it rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Prepare the salad: slice the red onion thinly, add salt and sumac. Chop the pickled cucumber, tomato, hot pepper, and parsley. Mix together and add lemon juice.
instructions.10: Prepare the tahini sauce: mix tahini with yogurt, 2 tablespoons mayonnaise, a pinch of salt, vinegar, a little water, and 2 cloves of garlic.
instructions.11: Serve the kofta with the salad and tahini sauce. You can also make sandwiches using tortillas.

title: Kofta Harsha
culturalNotes: Serve kofta with white rice and sauce for a distinctive flavor. It can also be eaten with flatbread.

instructions.1: Prepare vegetable mixture: Chop hot and cold peppers, tomatoes, onions, garlic, and potatoes, then place them in the food processor.
instructions.2: Process for about 2 minutes until ingredients are well combined.
instructions.3: Add sesame paste, instant stock, black pepper, salt, and seven-spice mix; mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Prepare kofta mixture: Place half a kilogram of onions in the food processor and add salt, black pepper, and seven-spice mix.
instructions.5: Process until ingredients are well blended.
instructions.6: Add two kilograms of ground lamb and mix thoroughly with other ingredients.
instructions.7: Shape kofta into fingers, balls, or cylinders and arrange them on top of the vegetable mixture in the baking dish.
instructions.8: Make small cuts on top of kofta with the back of a knife to give it a grilled appearance.
instructions.9: Place the baking dish in the oven at maximum heat and bake for 30 minutes.
instructions.10: Serve kofta with white rice and sauce.

title: Chicken Roll
culturalNotes: You can store Chicken Roll in the freezer for up to one month. Serve with cheese sauce for a special flavor.

instructions.1: Wash chicken slices and soak them in vinegar for 10 minutes, then drain thoroughly.
instructions.2: Add spices (onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, salt, pepper, sugar) to chicken slices and mix well.
instructions.3: Cover the chicken and let it marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
instructions.4: Pound the chicken slices thoroughly using a plastic bag until they become thin.
instructions.5: Prepare the filling (beef or smoked turkey and cheddar cheese) and roll it into a log.
instructions.6: Carefully wrap the chicken slices around the filling.
instructions.7: Mix eggs with yogurt, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
instructions.8: Mix breadcrumbs with cornstarch, salt, and pepper in another bowl.
instructions.9: Dip the chicken slices into the egg mixture, then coat them in the breadcrumb and cornstarch mixture.
instructions.10: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, then reduce heat and fry the Chicken Rolls until golden brown.
instructions.11: Fry the Chicken Rolls in the oil until fully cooked on all sides.

title: Cordon Bleu
culturalNotes: Cordon Bleu can be stored in the freezer for up to one month. When ready to serve, heat it in the oven or fry it in oil.

instructions.1: Take the chicken breasts and cut them into small pieces.
instructions.2: Add black pepper, paprika, thyme, onion powder, garlic powder, chicken seasoning, salt, and mustard.
instructions.3: Mix the ingredients thoroughly in a bowl until you get a smooth paste.
instructions.4: Prepare the filling using slices of roast beef and cheddar cheese.
instructions.5: Take a piece of the mixture and roll it into a circle.
instructions.6: Place the filling in the center of the mixture and fold the edges to close it.
instructions.7: Repeat the previous steps until all the mixture is used up.
instructions.8: Coat the Cordon Bleu with a layer of flour, then dip in beaten egg mixed with milk, and finally coat with breadcrumbs mixed with cornstarch.
instructions.9: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.10: Add the Cordon Bleu to the hot oil and fry on all sides until golden brown.
instructions.11: Drain the Cordon Bleu on paper towels to remove excess oil.

title: Homemade Meat Lanchon
servings: Makes a large batch that lasts a week or more
culturalNotes: Lanchon can be stored in the refrigerator for a week or longer. Slice it thin or thick according to preference.

fah-120-i1.name: Half kilo of meat with some fat content

fah-120-i3.name: 8 pieces of triangular or square cheese

fah-120-i17.name: 1/4 small teaspoon of red food coloring powder

instructions.1: Mix the meat, eggs, cheese, flour, cornstarch, oil, black honey, instant broth, salt, spices, and red food coloring in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the cracked black pepper and mix the mixture thoroughly.
instructions.3: Wrap the mixture tightly with plastic wrap and squeeze out all the air.
instructions.4: Wrap the mixture again with aluminum foil and seal it well.
instructions.5: Place the wrapped mixture into boiling water with a bay leaf, 2 tablespoons of vinegar, and a little salt.
instructions.6: Simmer the mixture for 50 minutes over medium heat.
instructions.7: Let the lanchon cool completely before slicing.

title: Homemade Luncheon Meat
culturalNotes: This luncheon meat can be stored in the refrigerator for a long time. It can be served in sandwiches or as a light snack.

fah-121-i1.name: 1 kilo boneless chicken thighs and breasts

instructions.1: Place the chicken in a food processor and chop finely.
instructions.2: Add all the spices and seasonings (paprika, onion, garlic, cinnamon, salt, black pepper).
instructions.3: Add the cottage cheese and mix the mixture thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add the oil, eggs, black honey, and flour and mix well.
instructions.5: Add cayenne pepper if desired.
instructions.6: Wrap the mixture tightly in plastic wrap to remove air.
instructions.7: Wrap the mixture in aluminum foil and tie securely.
instructions.8: Divide the mixture into five portions and wrap each one the same way.
instructions.9: Place the portions in a pot with water, laurel leaves, cinnamon, salt, and pepper.
instructions.10: Cover the pot and simmer on medium heat for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
instructions.11: After cooking, let it cool, then slice and serve.

title: Smoked Chicken Lunch Meat
culturalNotes: You can easily slice the lunch meat after it has cooled completely. The lunch meat can be stored in the refrigerator for up to a week without losing quality.

instructions.1: Wash and dry the chicken breasts, then cut them into pieces.
instructions.2: Add cornstarch, oil, and ice water.
instructions.3: Add the seasonings: salt, black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and instant chicken broth.
instructions.4: Mix all ingredients thoroughly in a blender until smooth.
instructions.5: Transfer the mixture into a piping bag and shape it into a lunch meat log.
instructions.6: Wrap the lunch meat tightly in aluminum foil.
instructions.7: Boil water, place the lunch meat inside, cover, and simmer on low heat or in the oven for 1 hour.
instructions.8: After one hour, remove the lunch meat and let it cool completely.
instructions.9: Prepare a mixture of oil and barbecue sauce, then brush it over the lunch meat.
instructions.10: Place aluminum foil in the baking tray, add charcoal, lemon wood or sugarcane stick, and sugar.
instructions.11: Place the grill rack over the charcoal, put the lunch meat on it, and cover.
instructions.12: Turn the lunch meat occasionally to ensure even smoking and a rich, smoky flavor.
instructions.13: Let the lunch meat cool completely before slicing.
instructions.14: Store the lunch meat in the refrigerator for up to a week.

title: Meat with rice and roasted potatoes
culturalNotes: The dish can be served with a green salad or the rice can be covered with meat before serving.

instructions.1: Cut fennel seeds into slices about 1.5 cm thick.
instructions.2: Season the meat with salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.3: Melt the butter in a pan and fry the meat until golden on both sides.
instructions.4: Add rosemary, laurel leaves, cloves, and garlic, then stir the meat well.
instructions.5: Fry the onion until golden, then add sugar and stir until caramelized.
instructions.6: Add demiglace and water, then return the meat to the pan and cover, simmering on low heat for 20 minutes.
instructions.7: Boil water and add rice, salt, laurel leaves, cinnamon stick, cloves, and saffron (if available), then cover and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Add the stock cube (if available) and stir well, then add butter or oil and stir again.
instructions.9: Peel the potatoes and cut into small cubes, then boil in boiling water for 4 minutes.
instructions.10: Drain the potatoes and fry them in hot oil until crispy.

title: Lamb with Yellow Rice, Spices, and Roasted Nuts
culturalNotes: You can garnish with roasted nuts, parsley, or cilantro when serving. You may also drizzle white honey over the lamb before serving for a slightly sweet flavor.

instructions.1: Pat the lamb piece dry thoroughly.
instructions.2: Apply 2 tablespoons of mustard onto the lamb and massage it in.
instructions.3: Mix paprika, salt, bell pepper, and garlic powder; apply evenly over the lamb.
instructions.4: Add 2 tablespoons of honey to the lamb.
instructions.5: Heat a baking pan and add 2 tablespoons of oil.
instructions.6: Brown the lamb piece on all sides.
instructions.7: Spread the onion in the baking pan and season with salt, pepper, and 2 cloves of garlic.
instructions.8: Place the browned lamb on top of the onions.
instructions.9: Add 1/4 cup barbecue sauce and 1 cup of boiling water.
instructions.10: Cover the pan with parchment paper and aluminum foil. Bake in the oven on the lowest rack at high heat for 30 minutes.
instructions.11: Reduce the oven temperature and continue baking the lamb for 4 hours.
instructions.12: Prepare the red peppers by slicing them and mix with lemon juice and salt.
instructions.13: Prepare the pickling mix by combining sugar, salt, chili flakes, vinegar, and cumin seeds; add to the red peppers.
instructions.14: Blend red peppers, lemon juice, parsley, tomatoes, and vinegar in short pulses.
instructions.15: Add salt and olive oil to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.16: Scoop the lamb sauce and mix with rice, water, and salt; stir well.
instructions.17: Boil the rice and simmer on low heat until fully cooked.
instructions.18: Serve the lamb with rice, red peppers, and sauce.

title: Meat with Onion and Tomato
culturalNotes: This dish can be served with bread, rice, or pasta. You can also sprinkle some chopped parsley on top for garnish.

instructions.1: Cut the beef into small, evenly sized cubes.
instructions.2: Slice the onion into thin rings.
instructions.3: Chop the tomatoes into small cubes.
instructions.4: In a pot, heat the cumin and ghee until fragrant and slightly browned.
instructions.5: Add the beef and sauté until it turns golden brown.
instructions.6: Add the laurel leaf, black pepper, and beef spices, and stir the beef until it develops a sweet golden color.
instructions.7: Add the chopped garlic and stir until its aroma is released.
instructions.8: Add the sliced onion and stir until it softens and wilts.
instructions.9: Add the sugar and mix well.
instructions.10: Cover the pot and simmer on low heat until the beef starts releasing steam.
instructions.11: Stir the beef occasionally and continue cooking on low heat until fully tender.
instructions.12: Add salt and tomato cubes, then simmer on low heat until fully cooked.
instructions.13: If the beef is not fully cooked and the liquid has evaporated, add two tablespoons of hot water.
instructions.14: Serve hot with bread, rice, or pasta.

title: Lamb Qesbukko with Carrots and Mushrooms
culturalNotes: The dish can be served with white rice and sautéed vegetables. Instant stock can be used optionally, but high-quality meat does not require it.

fah-126-i9.name: Qesbukko (lamb cutlets)
fah-126-i9.amount: as needed for number of people

instructions.1: Season the qesbukko pieces with salt, pepper, and seven-spice mix on both sides.
instructions.2: Coat the pieces with flour.
instructions.3: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.4: Sear the qesbukko pieces on both sides until nicely browned.
instructions.5: Remove the pieces from the pan and set aside. Add the chopped onion to the same pan.
instructions.6: Add the carrots and mushrooms, and stir for a few minutes until vegetables reduce in volume.
instructions.7: Add the minced garlic and stir well.
instructions.8: Return the qesbukko pieces to the pan.
instructions.9: Pour in 2 cups of boiling water.
instructions.10: Add the instant stock packet (optional).
instructions.11: Cover the pan and simmer on low heat for 1 to 1.5 hours until the meat is tender.
instructions.12: Serve the lamb with white rice and sautéed vegetables.

title: Cold Tripe with Spices
culturalNotes: Cold tripe can be served with vermicelli or mixed rice. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Take the tripe and tie it securely with the doubou.
instructions.2: Use a knife to make small cuts in the tripe, then stuff it with whole peppercorns, salt, whole black pepper, and tomatoes.
instructions.3: Season the outside of the tripe with salt, black peppercorns, clove powder, and thyme.
instructions.4: Let the tripe marinate for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Heat a little oil in a pot over medium heat, then brown the tripe on all sides until it develops a golden-brown color.
instructions.6: Add the vegetables (onion, tomatoes, carrots, celery, and laurel leaves) to the pot.
instructions.7: Add two cups of boiling water, sugar, and salt.
instructions.8: Cover the pot with aluminum foil, then with the lid, and simmer on low heat for one hour.
instructions.9: After one hour, flip the tripe and cover it again for another hour.
instructions.10: After two hours, let the tripe cool, then refrigerate it overnight.
instructions.11: The next day, slice the tripe into thin pieces.
instructions.12: To prepare the vermicelli: dice the onion and colored bell peppers, then fry them in oil and ghee until golden brown.
instructions.13: Add the vermicelli and stir until golden brown.
instructions.14: Add the remaining vegetables and mix well with the vermicelli.
instructions.15: Pour in the broth (boiling water) and let the vermicelli boil and absorb the liquid.
instructions.16: Turn off the heat and let the vermicelli finish cooking on its own.
instructions.17: Sauté the liver in oil with salt, pepper, and cinnamon (optional step).

title: Smoked Meat
culturalNotes: You can add fresh herbs like basil or cilantro to the marinade for extra flavor. Smoked meat can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Wash the beef thoroughly and cut it into medium-sized pieces.
instructions.2: Mix the salt, black pepper, cinnamon, cardamom, and turmeric in a bowl.
instructions.3: Place the beef in a deep bowl and add the mixed spices, crushed garlic, apple cider vinegar, and olive oil. Mix well until the beef is fully coated with the marinade.
instructions.4: Cover the bowl and let the beef marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours to absorb the flavors.
instructions.5: After marinating, place the beef on a hot grill or in an oven preheated to 180°C (350°F) for 1.5 hours, until golden brown and smoked.
instructions.6: Serve hot with rice or bread.

title: Slow-Cooked Lamb in Clay Pot
culturalNotes: Serve the slow-cooked lamb with white rice or muhammara rice for a complete and delicious meal.

instructions.1: Prepare the marinade: In a large bowl, combine the finely chopped onion, salt, pepper, seven-spice mix, a pinch of sugar, laurel leaves, and fresh herbs. Add 1 large spoon of tomato sauce and 6 cloves of garlic. Mix thoroughly.
instructions.2: Add the cubed tomatoes, whole small potatoes, and intact onions. Mix again to ensure even distribution of spices.
instructions.3: Prepare the clay pot: Layer the vegetables at the bottom of the clay pot, followed by a layer of lamb, and continue alternating until the pot is full.
instructions.4: Pour 3 cups of boiling water over the mixture.
instructions.5: Seal the clay pot tightly using a dough made from flour and water.
instructions.6: Place the sealed pot in a preheated oven at the highest temperature for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 150°C and cook for 3 hours.
instructions.7: After cooking time, carefully open the pot and enjoy the delicious slow-cooked lamb.

title: Sparrow's Tongue with Chicken
culturalNotes: You can add more vegetables as desired, such as colored bell peppers and mushrooms. The dish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Heat the oil and ghee in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chicken pieces and brown them on both sides until golden.
instructions.3: Add curry powder, paprika, and salt; stir well to coat the chicken.
instructions.4: Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
instructions.5: Add the onions and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.6: Add the sparrow's tongue and stir with the onions until well combined.
instructions.7: Add the carrots, colored bell peppers, and mushrooms (if using); mix thoroughly.
instructions.8: Pour in the instant stock or boiling water, along with salt and black pepper.
instructions.9: Return the chicken to the pan and cover with liquid so it's about 2 cm deep.
instructions.10: Cover the pan and simmer on low heat for 3–4 minutes.
instructions.11: Gently stir the ingredients to ensure even distribution of the liquid.
instructions.12: Cover again and let simmer for 10 minutes until the sparrow's tongue is fully cooked.
instructions.13: Stir in the fresh parsley.
instructions.14: Serve hot.

title: Mazalika
culturalNotes: Mazalika can also be served with rice. Make sure the heat is high to ensure the liver comes out tender and well-cooked.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pan over high heat.
instructions.2: Add the heart, kidneys, and offal and sauté until all moisture has evaporated completely.
instructions.3: Add cumin and black pepper while sautéing.
instructions.4: Add garlic and stir until golden brown.
instructions.5: Add liver slices and stir occasionally until cooked through.
instructions.6: Add salt, black pepper, and remaining cumin.
instructions.7: Add green pepper to taste.
instructions.8: Add chopped onions and stir for 2 to 3 minutes.
instructions.9: Add grated tomatoes and cook for 1 to 2 minutes.
instructions.10: Serve Mazalika hot with fawaneer bread or baladi bread, tahini salad, and pickles.

title: Lamb with Rice
culturalNotes: You can use any type of meat according to preference. You can also add some vegetables like carrots and tomatoes to make the dish richer.

instructions.1: Place oil in a pressure cooker and brown the lamb pieces until golden.
instructions.2: Remove the lamb pieces and set them aside on a separate plate.
instructions.3: In the same pot, add the chopped onion and sauté until softened and golden.
instructions.4: Add the minced garlic and stir with the onion.
instructions.5: Add the spices (cassia bark, cinnamon sticks, cloves, saffron, black peppercorns, turmeric, cilantro, ground cinnamon, ground black pepper, cumin, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, meat spices, kabsa spices, curry powder) and fry them well.
instructions.6: Add the sauce and a pinch of sugar, then stir all ingredients together.
instructions.7: Add the grated tomato and salt, and mix everything thoroughly.
instructions.8: Return the lamb pieces to the pot and add boiling water until the meat is covered.
instructions.9: Close the pressure cooker and cook over medium heat for 40 minutes.
instructions.10: After 40 minutes, open the pot and check that the lamb is fully cooked.
