instructions.11: Add the rice and hot pepper, and distribute them evenly.
instructions.12: Close the lid again and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes.
instructions.13: After 15 minutes, open the pot and check that the rice is fully cooked.
instructions.14: Garnish the dish with fresh cilantro, nuts, and raisins.
instructions.15: Serve hot.

title: Hadhrami Mandi
culturalNotes: Make sure the oven is preheated for 30 minutes before placing the dish inside. You can extend the baking time depending on the type of meat used. Serve Mandi hot, garnished with nuts and fresh parsley.

instructions.1: Prepare the meat: Mix the meat with Mandi spices, salt, and whole spices. Rub the meat thoroughly until the fibers absorb the spices.
instructions.2: Prepare the sauce: In a pot over heat, add oil and butter. Add the chopped onion and whole spices, and sauté until well blended. Add the grated carrots and raisins, and stir well.
instructions.3: Prepare the broth: Add boiling water and stock cubes, stirring until the stock dissolves. Add salt and let the sauce boil.
instructions.4: Prepare the rice: Wash the rice thoroughly and place it in the baking dish. Pour the sauce over the rice, ensuring the water level covers the rice by about 2 cm.
instructions.5: Prepare the oven: Place a wire rack in the dish or use perforated aluminum foil. Put the meat on the rack, cover with butter paper, then seal with aluminum foil. Ensure the cover is tightly sealed.
instructions.6: Bake: Place the dish in the preheated oven at 200°C for 15 minutes on the bottom rack, then move it to the middle rack and reduce the temperature to 160°C. Bake for 3 hours and 15 minutes.
instructions.7: Serve: Remove the dish from the oven and serve Mandi hot, with meat, raisins, and fresh parsley as garnish.

title: Smoked Lamb
culturalNotes: You can use Danab lamb instead of regular lamb. You can also marinate the lamb an hour before cooking for better flavor. The lamb can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Prepare the lamb: Marinate the lamb with salt, pepper, seven-spice mix, and ground cinnamon.
instructions.2: Sear the lamb: Heat ghee in a pot over medium heat, then add the lamb and brown it on all sides until golden.
instructions.3: Add vegetables: Add onion, pepper, carrot, and spices (rosemary, oregano, chili flakes, laurel leaves).
instructions.4: Add water and stock
instructions.5: Simmer and cook: Add boiling water and the chicken stock cube, then cover the pot and let the lamb simmer gently until tender.
instructions.6: Smoke the lamb: Place the lamb in a baking dish and add a small amount of charcoal and oil, then bake in the oven until it develops a smoky aroma.
instructions.7: Serve: Serve the lamb with smoked rice and pickles.

title: Chicken Nuggets
culturalNotes: You can store the nuggets in the freezer for up to one month. When frying, make sure the oil is hot enough to prevent the nuggets from sticking.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken and cut it into small cubes.
instructions.2: Soak the chicken in water with lemon juice for a short while, then rinse and dry it.
instructions.3: Place the chicken in a bowl with the spices, mustard, and cornstarch, and mix until you get a smooth paste.
instructions.4: Mash the potatoes and mix them with the chicken mixture and eggs.
instructions.5: Knead the mixture well until it becomes homogeneous.
instructions.6: Scoop the mixture into a plastic bag and sprinkle flour over it.
instructions.7: Cut the mixture into small squares.
instructions.8: Dip the nuggets in flour, then in beaten egg, then in coarse breadcrumbs.
instructions.9: Arrange the nuggets on a tray and separate them with parchment paper if you plan to freeze them.
instructions.10: Fry the nuggets in hot oil over medium heat until golden brown.

title: Chicken Paper
culturalNotes: You can add any other vegetables according to preference. Serve the paper with rice and salad for a complete meal.

instructions.1: Prepare a baking tray and line it with aluminum foil.
instructions.2: Place a sheet of butter paper on top of the aluminum foil.
instructions.3: Put the chicken pieces into the tray.
instructions.4: Add the spices: salt, black pepper, paprika, onion powder, cinnamon, seven-spice mix, sauce, and honey.
instructions.5: Mix the chicken thoroughly until fully coated with the spices.
instructions.6: Place the mixed vegetables (bell peppers, potatoes, carrots, zucchini, tomatoes, mushrooms, and green beans) on top of the chicken.
instructions.7: Mix the mixture well until the vegetables are fully coated with the spices.
instructions.8: Cover the tray with butter paper, then tightly seal the aluminum foil.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated oven at high temperature for 15 minutes, then reduce heat and continue baking for 1 hour.
instructions.10: After one hour, open the tray and check that the chicken and vegetables are fully cooked.
instructions.11: Place the tray under the grill for a few minutes until it develops an attractive golden color.
instructions.12: Serve the paper hot with rice and salad.

title: Meat Paper
culturalNotes: You can add two tablespoons of oil or ghee before rolling the paper if desired. Serve the paper with white rice, basmati rice, or vermicelli rice.

instructions.1: Cut the meat into small cubes.
instructions.2: Slice the onion into rings.
instructions.3: Place the onion in a bowl, add salt, black pepper, cumin, and seven-spice mix, and rub the onion well.
instructions.4: Add the chopped garlic and stir.
instructions.5: Add the carrot, potato, cauliflower, laurel leaves, and hot or mild pepper, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.6: Add the meat and stir until fully coated with the marinade.
instructions.7: Add saffron and chopped tomatoes, and mix well.
instructions.8: Roll the paper using aluminum foil and parchment paper.
instructions.9: Place the rolled paper in a baking tray.
instructions.10: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees Celsius for 10 minutes.
instructions.11: Reduce the temperature to 160 degrees Celsius and bake for 2 hours.
instructions.12: After cooking, carefully open the paper to avoid steam.
instructions.13: Serve with rice, salads, and pickles.

title: Fish Strips
culturalNotes: You can use any type of fish according to preference. Fish strips can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days. Serve fish strips with white rice or salad.

fah-138-i1.name: Fish (butterfish, large boulty, or nageel fish)

fah-138-i2.name: Fish spices (thyme, cumin, parsley, paprika, dried parsley)

instructions.1: Cut the fish into medium-sized slices.
instructions.2: Mix fish spices, garlic powder, onion powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.3: Dip the fish slices into the spice mix and let them marinate for 30 minutes.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix flour, cornstarch, salt, onion powder, and fish spice mix.
instructions.5: Dip the fish slices in water, then in the flour and cornstarch mixture, repeating until a thick coating is achieved.
instructions.6: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.7: Fry the fish slices until golden brown and crispy.
instructions.8: Serve fish strips with pickled eggplant.

title: Crispy Shrimp with Basbousa
culturalNotes: You can add other spices to taste, such as black pepper or mixed spices. You can also serve the shrimp with salad or rice.

instructions.1: Wash the shrimp thoroughly under running water three times.
instructions.2: Remove the heads and devein the shrimp.
instructions.3: Rinse the shrimp again and drain well.
instructions.4: Mix the shrimp with cumin, parsley, salt, crushed garlic, lemon juice, and chili.
instructions.5: Coat the shrimp in flour.
instructions.6: Fry the shrimp in hot oil until golden brown.
instructions.7: Arrange the shrimp in groups of four, tied together in the traditional style.
instructions.8: Serve the shrimp hot with fried basbousa.

title: Grilled Fish Marinade
culturalNotes: The marinade can be stored in a jar in the refrigerator for months.

instructions.1: Prepare the marinade: Mash the garlic, hot pepper, green pepper, and red pepper in the blender.
instructions.2: Add the vinegar, lemon juice, cumin, dried parsley, and salt; mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Prepare the stuffing: Mix the grated carrots, parsley, dill, tomatoes, and onion with 4 tablespoons of the marinade and salt.
instructions.4: Stuff the fish with the mixture.
instructions.5: Grill the fish on the barbecue until golden brown.
instructions.6: Prepare the sauce: Mix the remaining stuffing with water and salt.
instructions.7: Pour the sauce over the grilled fish.

title: Tuna Peti
culturalNotes: Tuna Peti can be served with sliced onions and lemon juice, and salt can be added to taste.

instructions.1: Prepare the cooking ingredients: 2 kilograms mackerel, 1 bunch cilantro, 2 carrots, 3 lemons, 2 onions, 10 tomatoes, 2 laurel leaves, 2 tablespoons salt, 1 teaspoon cumin, 2 tablespoons vinegar.
instructions.2: Add 2 liters of water to a pot and let it boil.
instructions.3: Add all vegetables and spices to the boiling water.
instructions.4: Add the fish pieces to the water and let them boil for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Reduce the heat and let the fish simmer gently for 90 minutes.
instructions.6: Remove the fish from the water and remove the skin and bones.
instructions.7: Strain the water from the vegetables and spices and use it for storage.
instructions.8: Place the fish pieces into a clean, dry jar.
instructions.9: Add 2 laurel leaves and hot pepper to taste.
instructions.10: Pour 1/2 cup vinegar and 1/2 cup oil into the jar.
instructions.11: Mix the ingredients well and store the jar in the refrigerator for 3-4 days before consuming.
instructions.12: The jar can be stored in the refrigerator for over a month.

title: Tuna Bety
culturalNotes: Mackerel can be used instead of tuna for similar results. Garlic slices can be added during boiling for a stronger flavor.

instructions.1: Buy tuna fish and ask the seller to clean and slice it.
instructions.2: Place the slices in a large bowl and add water and vinegar; let it soak for one hour.
instructions.3: In a pot, add water, lemon slices, onion, carrot, cauliflower, black peppercorns, salt, and vinegar; bring to a boil.
instructions.4: Add the tuna slices to the pot and simmer gently for one hour.
instructions.5: After one hour, remove the tuna from the pot and place it on a colander to cool.
instructions.6: Once cooled, remove the meat from bones and skin.
instructions.7: Return the cooking liquid to the pot and add chopped garlic.
instructions.8: Place the tuna in sterilized jars and add red chili flakes and black peppercorns.
instructions.9: Fill the jars halfway with the liquid, then add half a cup of the liquid and half a cup of oil.
instructions.10: Seal the jars and refrigerate for 3–4 days before consuming.

title: Shrimp with Potatoes
culturalNotes: Make sure to use frying potatoes and that the oil is hot and the heat is medium to ensure the best results. The dish can be served with tomato sauce or any sauce you prefer.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into medium-sized pieces and blanch them in boiling water with a pinch of salt for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Drain the potatoes and let them cool.
instructions.3: Mix the flour with paprika, turmeric, onion powder, garlic powder, baking powder, salt, black pepper, and chili.
instructions.4: Gradually add water to the flour mixture to achieve a pancake-like consistency.
instructions.5: Dip the cooled potatoes into the flour mixture.
instructions.6: Heat the oil over medium heat and fry the potatoes one piece at a time until golden brown.
instructions.7: Fry the shrimp in the same flour mixture in the hot oil until golden brown.

title: Shrimp Spring Rolls
culturalNotes: You can freeze the spring rolls and use them as needed. Serve them hot with soy sauce and ketchup for a delicious taste.

instructions.1: Wash the shrimp thoroughly and clean them well, then remove the veins from the belly.
instructions.2: Add the fish marinade and soy sauce to the shrimp and mix well.
instructions.3: Let the shrimp marinate for 30 minutes.
instructions.4: Cut the veins from the belly to prevent the shrimp from curling during frying.
instructions.5: Take a spring roll wrapper and place a portion of shrimp in the center.
instructions.6: Roll the wrapper around the shrimp as shown in the video, and use water to seal the end.
instructions.7: Repeat the previous step until all the shrimp are used.
instructions.8: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.9: Serve the fried spring rolls with soy sauce and ketchup as desired.

title: Crispy Fish and Shrimp
culturalNotes: You can use other types of fish according to preference. Make sure the oil is hot enough before frying the fish and shrimp for perfect crispiness.

instructions.1: Wash the fish and shrimp thoroughly, then cut the fish into medium-sized pieces.
instructions.2: Prepare the marinade by mixing Vegetar Prost Max, water, garlic, and lemon juice. Mix well.
instructions.3: Marinate the fish and shrimp in the mixture and let sit for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: In a pan, heat oil over medium heat. Fry the fish and shrimp until golden and crispy.
instructions.5: In another pan, sauté the onion until golden. Add minced garlic and stir together.
instructions.6: Add the washed rice to the onion and garlic mixture and stir well. Add boiling water and salt, then stir again.
instructions.7: Cover the pan and let the rice cook on low heat until fully cooked.
instructions.8: Five minutes before the rice is done, add the sorbet and chopped cilantro, and stir well.
instructions.9: Serve the crispy fish and shrimp with the sautéed rice, sauce, pickles, fahana, and shafe.

title: Salted Sardines with Lemon and Oil
culturalNotes: Salted sardines can be eaten after two days of storage and can be kept in the refrigerator for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Open the sardine can and empty the contents.
instructions.2: Remove the heads and guts from the sardines and clean them.
instructions.3: Place the sardines in a bowl.
instructions.4: Squeeze the lemon over the sardines.
instructions.5: Cover the sardines completely with oil.
instructions.6: Seal the can tightly and store it in the refrigerator.

title: Salted Sardines
culturalNotes: Make sure to dry the sardines thoroughly before marinating to ensure proper pickling quality. Shake the jar daily to ensure even distribution of salt and oil.

instructions.1: Choose fresh sardines and wash them thoroughly.
instructions.2: Place the sardines in a colander and let them dry for two hours.
instructions.3: Pat the sardines dry with a clean cloth to ensure no moisture remains.
instructions.4: Mix the seasoning blend of salt, chili pepper, fawarika, and turmeric, and stir well.
instructions.5: Slice the celery and lemon thinly.
instructions.6: Fill the sardines' cavities with the seasoning mixture.
instructions.7: Sprinkle salt evenly over all sides of the sardines.
instructions.8: Place a layer of sliced celery and lemon at the bottom of the jar.
instructions.9: Layer the sardines in the jar, adding more celery and lemon between layers.
instructions.10: Pour vegetable oil over the sardines.
instructions.11: Seal the jar tightly and shake it daily until ready after 5 days.
instructions.12: Store the jar at room temperature or in the refrigerator.

title: Bouri Fish with Potatoes and Vegetables
culturalNotes: Mackerel can be used instead of bouri fish for a delicious flavor. The marinade can be stored in the freezer for use in other recipes.

instructions.1: Prepare the fish: Clean the fish, remove the fillets, and make incisions in it.
instructions.2: Prepare the vegetables: Cut the potatoes, onion, tomatoes, pepper, celery, and cilantro into slices.
instructions.3: Prepare the filling: Mix the marinade with celery and cilantro, then stuff the fish inside and out with the mixture.
instructions.4: Prepare the baking dish: Lay the potatoes, onion, tomatoes, and pepper in the oven dish.
instructions.5: Prepare the fish: Place the fish on top of the vegetables and garnish with lemon, tomato, and pepper slices.
instructions.6: Marinate: Coat the fish inside and out with vinegar and oil.
instructions.7: Bake: Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake in a preheated oven at 240°C for 30 minutes.
instructions.8: Brown: Remove the foil and place the dish under the grill until golden brown.
instructions.9: Serve: Serve the fish hot with white rice or Egyptian rice, as desired.

title: Smoked Fish
culturalNotes: Make sure the fish is fresh and well washed to achieve a distinctive flavor. You can use any type of fish according to preference.

instructions.1: Prepare the marinade: Mix the minced garlic, pomegranate molasses, chili, cumin, mustard, salt, oil, lemon juice, and smoked paprika in a bowl.
instructions.2: Apply the marinade: Spread the marinade evenly over the fish slices.
instructions.3: Preheat the oven: Arrange the fish slices in a baking tray and place in a very hot oven at the highest temperature.
instructions.4: Smoking: Cover the tray with aluminum foil and bake for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Serving: Remove the fish from the oven and garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Baked Fish with Tomato and Eggplant Salad
culturalNotes: Store the spice mix in a dry, moisture-free place for up to one month. Serve the meal with a green salad or yogurt.

instructions.1: Prepare the spice mix: Blend hot and sweet peppers, fresh parsley, chili pepper, garlic clove, vinegar, lemon juice, salt, cumin, and dried parsley in a blender until smooth.
instructions.2: Prepare the fish: Wash the fish thoroughly, then rub the spice mix inside and outside. Place the fish in aluminum foil and bake in a preheated oven at high heat until golden brown.
instructions.3: Prepare the shrimp: Clean and rinse the shrimp, then mix with chopped onion, tomatoes, bell peppers, grated carrot, spice mix, cilantro, lemon juice, and oil. Transfer to a baking tray and bake in the oven until fully cooked.
instructions.4: Prepare the marinated eggplant: Peel the eggplant and cut into slices. Sauté in a pan with a little oil until golden brown. Transfer to a serving dish and mix in the spice mix, fresh parsley, and tahini.
instructions.5: Prepare the rice: Sauté the onion in oil, then add sugar until the onion turns amber. Add boiling water, rice, salt, cumin, and vegetable stock. Cover the pot and simmer until the rice is fully cooked.

title: Fish and Potato Bake
culturalNotes: Any type of fish can be used according to preference. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days. This dish can be served with a green salad.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and cut them into thin slices.
instructions.2: Place the potatoes in a deep bowl and add lemon juice, mustard, cumin, salt, and garlic. Mix well.
instructions.3: Clean the fish thoroughly and open its belly. Place half of the mixture on the fish and spread it evenly.
instructions.4: Spread the remaining mixture over the potatoes and place them in the baking dish beneath the fish.
instructions.5: Add the seafood (sea urchin, kalamari, shrimp) to the dish and sprinkle the remaining mixture over them.
instructions.6: In another bowl, melt the butter and add the chopped onion. Sauté the onion until golden.
instructions.7: Add the flour and mix well until it disappears. Add milk, salt, black pepper, and boiling water. Mix until the consistency becomes light.
instructions.8: Pour the sauce over the fish, seafood, and potatoes. Add 2 tablespoons of cream.
instructions.9: Place the dish in the oven at the highest temperature, on the middle rack, for 30 minutes.
instructions.10: In another pan, heat oil and add the chopped onion. Sauté until golden.
instructions.11: Add the sieved tomatoes and sauce, and stir well.
instructions.12: Add the rice and the shrimp shell broth (prepared by boiling shrimp shells with water and spices). Mix well and adjust salt.
instructions.13: Cover the rice and cook over high heat until absorbed, then stir and reduce heat.
instructions.14: Serve the dish hot with red rice.

title: Scary Shrimp Tajine
culturalNotes: Make sure the oven is preheated for 15 minutes before placing the tajine inside for the best result. Serve the tajine with white rice or bread.

instructions.1: Wash the shrimp thoroughly, open them from the back, and remove the sandy vein.
instructions.2: Slice the onions into rings and add them to the tajine.
instructions.3: Add salt, dried parsley, garlic, and cumin, then mix all ingredients well.
instructions.4: Add the celery, tomatoes, hot and mild peppers, squeeze the lemons over the mixture, and leave the peels in the tajine.
instructions.5: Add the shrimp and mix everything thoroughly.
instructions.6: Cover the tajine and place it in the preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: After the time has passed, remove the tajine from the oven and serve it hot.

title: Baked Shrimp Tajine
culturalNotes: Can be stored in the refrigerator for up to a month. Serve the tajine with rice or stuffed eggplant.

instructions.1: Wash the shrimp thoroughly and clean them.
instructions.2: Slice the onion into thin slices.
instructions.3: Cut the tomato and bell pepper into slices.
instructions.4: Grate the carrot.
instructions.5: Prepare the dukkah as shown at the beginning of the video.
instructions.6: Chop the cilantro into small pieces.
instructions.7: Add the onion, tomato, bell pepper, and carrot to the dukkah.
instructions.8: Add the shrimp to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.9: Add the oil and boiling water to the mixture.
instructions.10: Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and cover it.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 30 minutes, until the shrimp are cooked through and have a beautiful color.
instructions.12: Serve the tajine hot.

title: Surprise Casserole
culturalNotes: You can add any other types of fish or shellfish according to preference. Serve the casserole with white rice or bread.

instructions.1: Cut the fish, climber fish, and crab into small cubes.
instructions.2: Cut the celery and bell peppers into small cubes.
instructions.3: Chop the onion and garlic into small pieces.
instructions.4: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and add the onion. Sauté until golden brown.
instructions.5: Add the garlic and stir until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the bell peppers and stir for 1 minute.
instructions.7: Add black pepper and salt, and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the flour and stir until it disappears.
instructions.9: Add the crab, fish, and climber fish, and stir until lightly browned.
instructions.10: Add the crab stock and stir until it comes to a boil.
instructions.11: Add the hot milk and stir until it boils and thickens.
instructions.12: Add the chili paste, cream, and cream cheese, and stir well.
instructions.13: Transfer the mixture into a baking dish and top with mozzarella cheese.
instructions.14: Bake in a preheated oven at the highest temperature until golden brown.

title: Shrimp Molokhia Casserole
culturalNotes: Make sure to clean the shrimp thoroughly and remove the sand vein from its back. Do not cover the casserole while cooking to prevent the molokhia from darkening. You can garnish the casserole with two shrimp pieces.

instructions.1: Heat 1 small spoon of semolina in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add one-third of the chopped garlic, one-third of the chopped chili pepper, and one-third of the dried coriander. Stir the ingredients until the garlic turns light golden.
instructions.3: Add the shrimp and stir with the garlic, chili, and coriander until the shrimp are fully cooked.
instructions.4: Add the bouillon cube, salt, and shrimp boiling broth. Let the mixture boil.
instructions.5: Add the remaining one-third of the chopped garlic and stir until the mixture tastes delicious.
instructions.6: Add the molokhia and stir with a wooden spoon until completely broken down.
instructions.7: Add more shrimp boiling broth or water as needed to achieve the ideal consistency.
instructions.8: Turn off the heat after the molokhia has boiled. Do not leave it on the heat for too long to prevent it from falling apart.
instructions.9: Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish and serve.
instructions.10: Reheat in a small pot using 1 small spoon of semolina.
instructions.11: Add the remaining garlic, chili, and dried coriander. Stir until the garlic turns light golden.
instructions.12: Pour the topping over the casserole and serve.

title: Bouri Fish Ferment
culturalNotes: Make sure to use coarse salt for the best results. Keep all tools clean to avoid contamination. Flip the container after one week to ensure even fermentation.

fah-156-i1.name: Bouri fish
fah-156-i1.amount: 4 pieces (each at least half a kilogram)

instructions.1: Buy bouri fish, each piece at least half a kilogram, with pink gills and a firm texture, and with scales intact.
instructions.2: Clean the fish thoroughly, insert your hand and rub the gills to remove dirt and residue.
instructions.3: Lay the fish on a colander and refrigerate overnight to drain excess moisture.
instructions.4: After 24 hours, press the fish to squeeze out moisture and wring it with a clean cloth.
instructions.5: Prepare the seasoning mix using coarse salt, chili, and turmeric, and mix them together.
instructions.6: Salt the fish inside and out, and place one tablespoon of the mixture into each gill cavity and on the head of the fish.
instructions.7: Prepare a large container, place a layer of salt at the bottom, then place the fish, followed by another layer of salt, and repeat until all fish are used.
instructions.8: Cover the fish completely with salt, then tightly seal the container and remove all air.
instructions.9: Wrap the container with plastic wrap to prevent air from entering, and store it in a dark, cool place away from sunlight and air.
instructions.10: After one week, flip the container to the other side, and leave it for another week.
instructions.11: After 14 days, the fermented fish will be ready.

title: Bouri Fish
culturalNotes: Make sure to remove excess salt from the bouri fish before serving. The bouri fish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Open the container holding the bouri fish after it has been marinated for 10 days.
instructions.2: Remove excess salt from the surface of the bouri fish using a cloth.
instructions.3: Cut the bouri fish into suitable pieces using scissors.
instructions.4: Open the bouri fish's string and remove any unwanted parts.
instructions.5: Serve the bouri fish with lemon, red pepper, green pepper, and sliced green onion.
instructions.6: Drizzle a little oil over the bouri fish before serving.

title: Artichokes with Béchamel
culturalNotes: Boiled artichokes can be stored in the freezer for a long time. The dish can be served hot with a green salad.

instructions.1: Wash the artichokes and peel them using a sharp knife, then remove the inner heart with a spoon.
instructions.2: Soak the artichokes in boiling water for 3 minutes, then rinse under cold water for storage.
instructions.3: In a pan over heat, melt the butter or oil, then add the chopped onion and sauté until golden.
instructions.4: Add the ground meat and stir well, then add salt, pepper, sugar, cinnamon, and seven-spice mix and stir thoroughly.
instructions.5: In a pot over heat, melt the butter or ghee, then add the flour and stir well until it turns white.
instructions.6: Gradually add the whole milk while stirring continuously, then add salt, pepper, nutmeg, cottage cheese, and cream and stir well.
instructions.7: Grease a baking dish with butter or ghee, then stuff the artichokes with the meat mixture and arrange them in the dish.
instructions.8: Pour the béchamel over the artichokes, then top with the dried mint and yogurt mixture.
instructions.9: Place the dish in a preheated oven at high temperature until the top is golden brown.

title: Eggplant Without Oil
culturalNotes: This appetizing dish can be served alone or with koshari, potatoes, and falafel. It can also be used as part of a breakfast meal.

instructions.1: Cut the Roma eggplant into medium-sized cubes.
instructions.2: Cut the pepper into large pieces; you can use hot or mild peppers as desired.
instructions.3: Boil water in a pot, add 1 large spoon of salt and 2 large spoons of vinegar.
instructions.4: Add the eggplant and pepper to the boiling water, cover the pot, and let it simmer for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: After 10 minutes, drain the eggplant and pepper in a colander to remove excess water.
instructions.6: Transfer the eggplant and pepper to a serving bowl, add a little olive oil and chopped fresh parsley.
instructions.7: Mix the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.8: Add a little vinegar and mix again.

title: Crispy Artichoke Cutlets
culturalNotes: Do not flatten the artichoke pieces when coating with dry mixture—keep them slightly irregular to maintain crispiness. You can freeze the coated artichoke pieces before frying and use them later.

instructions.1: Wash the artichoke thoroughly and cut it into small florets.
instructions.2: Add water to a pot and bring to a boil, then add one tablespoon of salt and one teaspoon of cumin.
instructions.3: Boil the artichoke florets in the boiling water for a few minutes, then drain and immediately transfer to cold water to stop the cooking process.
instructions.4: Mix flour, cornstarch, and spices (salt, pepper, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, baking powder) in a bowl.
instructions.5: Add beaten eggs, minced garlic, and parsley to half of the dry mixture, then gradually add water while stirring until the consistency resembles pancake batter.
instructions.6: Dip the artichoke florets into the wet batter, then coat them in the dry mixture.
instructions.7: Fry the coated florets in hot oil over medium heat until golden brown and crispy.
instructions.8: Serve the crispy artichoke cutlets garnished with fresh parsley and chopped parsley.

title: Boiled and Pickled Potatoes
culturalNotes: Boiled potatoes can be stored in the refrigerator and used in various recipes.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender.
instructions.2: Peel the potatoes and cut them into cubes.
instructions.3: Mix cumin with oil and turmeric.
instructions.4: Add the cumin mixture to the cubed potatoes and stir well.
instructions.5: Add parsley and dill and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.6: Serve the dish on a serving plate.

title: Cubed Potatoes
culturalNotes: Fried potatoes can be served as a snack or as part of a main meal. Fresh herbs such as parsley or cilantro can also be added for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and cut them into small cubes.
instructions.2: Rinse the cubes thoroughly under cold water.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.4: Add the potato cubes to the hot oil and stir well.
instructions.5: Add salt, black pepper, and sugar, and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.6: Continue frying until the potatoes are golden and crispy.
instructions.7: Drain the fried potatoes on paper towels.

title: Pickling Cucumber and Carrot
culturalNotes: Make sure to use a clean, dry spoon when removing the pickle to prevent mold formation. The pickle can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Wash the cucumber and carrot thoroughly, then slice them into thin pieces.
instructions.2: Place them in a bowl and add sliced pepper and celery.
instructions.3: Prepare the brine solution: Boil one liter of water and add 4 tablespoons of salt, 1 tablespoon of sugar, 1 teaspoon of turmeric, and 1/4 cup of vinegar. Mix well.
instructions.4: Pour the brine solution over the cucumber and carrot in the bowl.
instructions.5: Add laurel leaves, mustard seeds, garlic, hot pepper, cilantro, and cumin.
instructions.6: Cover the bowl tightly and let it sit for at least 6 hours.
instructions.7: After 6 hours, the cucumber will be ready to eat. Let the carrot sit for one or two additional days.
instructions.8: Add 2 drops of oil on top of the pickle to preserve it.

title: Spinach with Bird's Tongue
culturalNotes: Spinach with bird's tongue can be served with vermicelli rice and fried meat. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Heat a pot on the stove and add 1 tablespoon of ghee.
instructions.2: Add the laurel leaf, cassia seed, cumin seed, and black pepper.
instructions.3: Add the carrot, onion, and tomato, and stir the ingredients well.
instructions.4: Add the ground beef and stir until browned and well-coated.
instructions.5: Add the boiling water, salt, and sugar, then cover the pot and simmer on low heat until the meat is tender.
instructions.6: In another pot, heat 1 tablespoon of ghee and add the chopped onion, stirring until softened.
instructions.7: Add the chopped tomato, meat bouillon cube, salt, and sugar, stir well, and let the tomatoes thicken.
instructions.8: Add the spinach and parsley, and stir thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.9: Add the bird's tongue to the spinach mixture, stir well, then cover and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: In a small pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil and 1 teaspoon of ghee, add the vermicelli, and stir until golden brown.
instructions.11: Add the rice and stir with the vermicelli until well blended.
instructions.12: Add the boiling water and salt, cover the pot, and let the rice absorb the liquid.
instructions.13: After the rice has absorbed the water, gently fluff it with a fork, then cover and simmer on low heat until fully cooked.
instructions.14: In another pot, heat a little oil and ghee, add the meat, and stir until browned.
instructions.15: Add salt, black pepper, and parsley, and stir until the meat is fully cooked.

title: Pickled Tomatoes
culturalNotes: Pickled tomatoes can be served with koshari or any other dish you prefer.

instructions.1: Wash the tomatoes thoroughly.
instructions.2: Slice the tomatoes thinly, keeping the base attached.
instructions.3: Fill the space between each slice with dill.
instructions.4: Place the tomatoes in a container and cover it.
instructions.5: Store the tomatoes in the refrigerator for up to 3 months.

title: Pickled Peppers
culturalNotes: Pickled peppers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two weeks. Serve pickled peppers with ful medames, tamya, potatoes, masruba, and koshari for a delicious, tangy flavor.

instructions.1: Cut the peppers into small pieces, about 2-3 centimeters in size.
instructions.2: Add 4 cups of water to a pot and place it on the stove.
instructions.3: Add 2 tablespoons of salt to the water.
instructions.4: Add parsley, cumin, and minced garlic to the water.
instructions.5: Stir the ingredients well until the salt dissolves.
instructions.6: Add the pepper pieces to the boiling water and let them boil for 2-3 minutes.
instructions.7: Add vinegar to the water and remove the pot from the heat.
instructions.8: Let the peppers cool down.
instructions.9: Pack the peppers into a jar and store in the refrigerator.
instructions.10: Add a little oil to taste, if desired.

title: Home-Style Pickle
culturalNotes: Make sure to clean the jars thoroughly before using. You can add a spoonful of cumin to the brine to enhance the pickle's flavor.

fah-167-i7.name: Vinegar
fah-167-i7.amount: half cup per liter of water

fah-167-i8.name: Lemon juice
fah-167-i8.amount: quarter cup per liter of water

instructions.1: Wash the lemon well and soak it in boiling water for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Peel the carrot and cut it into small pieces, then soak it in boiling water for 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Remove the leaves from the parsley and chop them into small pieces, then soak them in boiling water with half a small spoon of cumin for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Wash the cucumber and cut it into small pieces, then soak it in boiling water.
instructions.5: Cut the green pepper and habanero into slices and soak them in boiling water.
instructions.6: Drain all the vegetables from the water and place them into clean jars.
instructions.7: Prepare the brine by mixing water, salt, vinegar, lemon juice, mustard seed, garlic, turmeric, and paprika.
instructions.8: Pour the brine over the vegetables in the jars until they are completely covered.
instructions.9: Add two tablespoons of oil on top of each jar to prevent air from entering.
instructions.10: Seal the jars tightly and let them sit for 3 days before using.

title: Mixed Pickles
culturalNotes: Make sure to use clean and sterilized jars. Cover the pickles completely with the brine solution to prevent spoilage. You can freeze any excess for later use.

instructions.1: Prepare the base mix: In a bowl, combine the mild red peppers, vinegar, lemon juice, salt, cumin, and parsley, then chop them thoroughly.
instructions.2: Prepare the brine solution: Mix 4 cups of cooled boiled water, 1/4 cup lemon juice, 1/4 cup vinegar, 1 small spoon of sugar, and 4 large spoons of salt.
instructions.3: Prepare the habanero peppers: In boiling water, add 1/4 cup sugar, 2 spoons of salt, 1/4 cup vinegar, lemon salt, and 2 cloves of garlic. Add the habanero peppers, stir once, then remove from heat and cover until cooled.
instructions.4: Prepare the eggplant: Cut the eggplant into small florets and boil them for 10 minutes. Remove and place in a clean jar. Add a small peel of beet, 2 spoons of the base mix, and the brine solution.
instructions.5: Prepare the small black eggplant: In boiling water, add 1/4 cup vinegar, 2 spoons of salt, 1 spoon of sugar. Add the small black eggplant pieces, boil for 10 minutes, then remove and place in a jar with sliced peppers, 2 spoons of base mix, and brine solution.
instructions.6: Prepare the yellow lemon: Mix the yellow lemon, mustard seeds, turmeric, base mix, and brine solution in a clean jar.
instructions.7: Prepare the onion: Boil the onion in water with 1/4 cup vinegar and 1 large spoon of salt for 5 minutes. Remove and place in a jar with 3 spoons of base mix and brine solution.
instructions.8: Prepare the cabbage: Place the cabbage in a clean jar with a small peel of beet, base mix, and brine solution.
instructions.9: Prepare the carrots: Cut the carrots into your desired shape, boil them, then remove and place in a jar with garlic cloves, cumin seeds, sugar, base mix, and brine solution.

title: Quick Mixed Pickle
servings: as many jars as you have
culturalNotes: You can add dill and mustard seeds for better flavor. Make sure jars are tightly sealed to ensure pickle quality.

instructions.1: Boil water and pour it over the turnip, then let it soak for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Soak the turnip in boiling water for 10 minutes and cover to retain heat.
instructions.3: Place red pepper, green pepper, cucumber, and carrot in a bowl and mix together.
instructions.4: If you have cabbage, add it as well.
instructions.5: Prepare red chili paste: crush 4 cloves of garlic and hot red pepper.
instructions.6: Add salt to hot water and stir until dissolved.
instructions.7: Add dried coriander and cumin to the brine solution.
instructions.8: If desired, add dill and mustard seeds.
instructions.9: Pour the hot brine solution over the vegetables in jars.
instructions.10: Make sure vegetables are completely covered by the brine.
instructions.11: Seal jars tightly and let sit for 3 days before opening.

title: Eggplant and Potato Bake Without Oil
culturalNotes: Serve this dish with white rice or Arabic bread. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Heat a frying pan over medium heat and add the sliced hot and sweet peppers.
instructions.2: Add the sliced onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the minced garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.4: Add the tomato juice and tomato paste, and mix well.
instructions.5: Add salt, parsley, cumin, sugar, and black pepper, and stir thoroughly.
instructions.6: Add the instant stock cube and stir until fully dissolved.
instructions.7: Pour in the boiling water and let it boil and thicken.
instructions.8: Cut the eggplant and potatoes into rounds and arrange them in a baking dish.
instructions.9: Pour the sauce over the eggplant and potatoes.
instructions.10: Cover the dish and bake in a preheated oven at high heat for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
instructions.11: After 1 hour and 15 minutes, remove the dish from the oven, take off the lid, and place under the broiler for a few minutes until golden brown.
instructions.12: Remove from the oven and serve hot.

title: Light and Quick Mansafah
culturalNotes: Mansafah can be served hot or cold. You can add more tomatoes as desired for a smoother consistency.

instructions.1: Cut the eggplant into long strips, sprinkle with salt, and let it sit in a colander for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Cut the potatoes into cubes and fry them until golden brown.
instructions.3: Chop the bell pepper into chunks and prepare the hot pepper to your preference.
instructions.4: In a pan, sauté the sliced onions in 2 tablespoons of oil until golden brown.
instructions.5: Add the minced garlic and ground meat, and stir until the meat changes color.
instructions.6: Add the bell pepper and hot pepper, and stir for 1 minute.
instructions.7: Add the tomato juice, cumin, salt, pepper, seven-spice mix, and sugar, and let the mixture boil.
instructions.8: In a baking dish, layer the vegetable and meat mixture, then add a layer of fried potatoes, followed by a layer of fried eggplant.
instructions.9: Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used up.
instructions.10: Cover the dish and bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 30 minutes.

title: Roasted Chickpeas
culturalNotes: Keep the chickpeas, hummus, and fava beans refrigerated to prevent flavor changes and foam formation. When removing from the refrigerator, use a clean, dry spoon. If foam appears, drain the water and replace it with fresh water, adding one teaspoon of salt per cup.

instructions.1: Wash the chickpeas, hummus, and fava beans thoroughly and drain well.
instructions.2: Soak the chickpeas and hummus in boiling water for 3 hours.
instructions.3: Dry roast the fava beans in an empty pan over medium heat, stirring constantly, until golden brown.
instructions.4: Prepare a brine solution by mixing 3 cups of boiling water with one tablespoon of salt per cup.
instructions.5: Soak the fava beans in the brine solution for 3 hours.
instructions.6: Drain the chickpeas and hummus from the soaking water and transfer them to fresh boiling water.
instructions.7: Simmer the chickpeas and hummus over low heat for 1.5 hours.
instructions.8: Drain the chickpeas and hummus and soak them in a cooled brine solution for 2 hours.
instructions.9: Refrigerate the chickpeas, hummus, and fava beans.
instructions.10: Serve the chickpeas, hummus, and fava beans with cumin, chili, and lemon.

title: Grilled Chickpeas
culturalNotes: Keep the split peas, chickpeas, and fava beans refrigerated to prevent flavor changes and foam formation. When removing from the refrigerator, use a clean, dry spoon. If foam appears, change the water to fresh water and add a small amount of salt.

instructions.1: Wash the split peas, chickpeas, and fava beans thoroughly and drain.
instructions.2: Soak the split peas and chickpeas in boiling water for 3 hours.
instructions.3: Roast the fava beans in an empty pan over medium heat, stirring constantly, until golden brown.
instructions.4: Prepare a brine solution by mixing 3 cups of boiling water with 1 tablespoon of salt per cup.
instructions.5: Soak the fava beans in the brine solution for 3 hours.
instructions.6: After 3 hours, drain the soaking water from the split peas and chickpeas, then transfer them to fresh boiling water.
instructions.7: Simmer the split peas and chickpeas over low heat for 1.5 hours.
instructions.8: Drain the split peas and chickpeas, then soak them in a fresh brine solution (8 cups water with 8 tablespoons of salt).
instructions.9: Refrigerate the split peas, chickpeas, and fava beans for at least 2 hours.
instructions.10: Serve the split peas, chickpeas, and fava beans with cumin, chili, and lemon.

title: Foul Medames with Tahini
culturalNotes: Foul medames can be served for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or suhoor. Additional spices can be added to taste for a stronger flavor.

instructions.1: Prepare the tahini paste and finely chop the onion and garlic.
instructions.2: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté the onion and garlic mixture until lightly golden.
instructions.3: Add the cucumber or chili pepper and sauté for 1 minute.
instructions.4: Add the chopped tomatoes and stir to combine.
instructions.5: Add black pepper, cumin, salt, and chili flakes (to taste) and mix well.
instructions.6: Simmer the mixture over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
instructions.7: Add the mashed fava beans (can use a food processor or fork) and mix thoroughly.
instructions.8: Pour in 1/4 cup of water to prevent the mixture from drying out.
instructions.9: Continue cooking until the mixture boils and adjust salt if needed.
instructions.10: Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley, crushed chili, and pickled eggplant.

title: Ful Medames with Cream and Nuts
culturalNotes: Ful can be served with roasted potatoes and feteer. The dish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the nuts and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the ful medames and stir well with the nuts.
instructions.4: Add a little water to keep the ful moist and tender.
instructions.5: Bring the mixture to a boil.
instructions.6: Add black pepper and salt, and stir well.
instructions.7: Add one tablespoon of cream and stir thoroughly.
instructions.8: Simmer for one more minute.
instructions.9: Add the second tablespoon of cream and stir well.
instructions.10: Transfer to a serving dish and serve hot.

title: Mixed Hummus
culturalNotes: Hummus can be served with stuffed feteer, lemon-pressed feteer, and egg yolk. Hummus can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Heat oil in a pan and sauté onion until golden brown.
instructions.2: Add bell peppers and hot pepper, and stir for 1 minute.
instructions.3: Add cumin and salt, and mix well.
instructions.4: Add 1 teaspoon of dried mint and stir for 1 minute.
instructions.5: Add fava beans and stir for 2 minutes until thoroughly heated.
instructions.6: In another pan, heat semolina and add broth, stirring until broth turns golden.
instructions.7: Add fava beans and stir for 2 minutes.
instructions.8: In a third pan, heat oil and add eggs, stirring until medium consistency.
instructions.9: Add fava beans and stir for 2 minutes.
instructions.10: In a fourth pan, heat semolina and add crushed nuts, stirring until nuts are golden.
instructions.11: Add raisins, chili paste, and salt, and mix well.
instructions.12: Add fava beans and stir for 2 minutes.
instructions.13: Serve hummus with stuffed feteer, lemon-pressed feteer, and egg yolk.

title: Foul with Kebab Flavor
culturalNotes: You can sprinkle some chopped parsley on top before serving for garnish. Foul can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Chop the onion, tomato, and green pepper finely in the food processor.
instructions.2: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.3: Add the chopped onion and sauté until lightly golden.
instructions.4: Add the onion, tomato, and green pepper mixture and stir well until well combined.
instructions.5: Add the cooked fava beans and 1/4 cup of water, then blend until smooth.
instructions.6: Stir in salt, black pepper, cumin, cilantro, and chili powder.
instructions.7: Add the blended fava bean mixture and stir well.
instructions.8: Transfer to a serving dish and place on low heat.
instructions.9: Add a small piece of charcoal and a few drops of oil, then cover the dish.
instructions.10: Let it sit for 5 minutes.
instructions.11: Serve hot with fresh parsley and pickles.

title: Foul Mudammas
culturalNotes: The sauce can be stored in the refrigerator for a long time without spoiling. Foul can be served either mashed or whole, according to preference.

instructions.1: Soak the fava beans, chickpeas, lentils, and crushed fava beans in boiling water overnight.
instructions.2: Drain the water and transfer the ingredients to a large pot.
instructions.3: Add the grated carrots and cover with water until the ingredients are submerged by about 6 cm.
instructions.4: Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low and simmer until cooked through.
instructions.5: Add half a cup of rice flour and one teaspoon of turmeric, and stir well.
instructions.6: Add cumin and stir thoroughly.
instructions.7: In a separate pan, heat two teaspoons of sesame paste and sauté the parsley and green pepper. Then add the fava beans and stir well.
instructions.8: Season with salt and pepper, transfer the mixture to a baking dish, and bake in the oven.
instructions.9: In another pan, heat oil and sauté the chopped onion and garlic. Add the tomatoes, bell pepper, hot pepper, and sauce, and stir well.
instructions.10: Season with salt, cumin, cilantro, and chili. Then add the fava beans and mix thoroughly.
instructions.11: Prepare the sauce by mixing tahini, vinegar, dried mint, boiling water, and oil. Chill in the refrigerator.
instructions.12: Blend the fava beans in a blender, then add oil, cumin, and salt. Mix well.
instructions.13: Sauté the fava beans in a pan with a pinch of cumin and salt. Then add the sauce.
instructions.14: In a pan, combine the fava beans with yogurt and dried mint. Add onion, pepper, tomatoes, and parsley. Stir well.
instructions.15: Drizzle olive oil on top.

title: Foul Medames
culturalNotes: The sauce can be stored in the refrigerator for a long time without spoiling. Foul can be served with bread, cheese, and olives.

fah-179-i8.name: Water
fah-179-i8.amount: enough to cover the fava beans

instructions.1: Soak the fava beans, chickpeas, lentils, and foul mash in boiling water overnight.
instructions.2: Drain the water and place the fava beans in a large pot.
instructions.3: Add the grated carrots and enough boiling water to cover the fava beans by about 6 centimeters.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.5: Reduce heat and let the fava beans simmer gently until fully cooked.
instructions.6: Add half a cup of rice flour, one teaspoon of turmeric, and one cup of water. Mix well.
instructions.7: Let the fava beans cook for 10 more minutes until the consistency is perfect.
instructions.8: To prepare the first topping: Add two tablespoons of ghee, two tablespoons of parsley, green pepper, and khorshof beans. Stir on medium heat.
instructions.9: Add salt and pepper, then transfer the mixture to a baking dish. Place the eggs in the center of the fava beans and cover with more ghee.
instructions.10: To prepare the second topping: Add a little oil, one teaspoon of chopped garlic, and chopped onion. Sauté on medium heat.
instructions.11: Add tomato, bell pepper, hot pepper, and sauce. Mix well.
instructions.12: Add salt, cumin, dill, and chili. Then mix the fava beans into the mixture and stir thoroughly.
instructions.13: To prepare the sauce: Mix tahini, vinegar, dukkah, cumin, dill, chili, and boiling water. Then add oil and stir well.
instructions.14: To prepare the third topping: Mix fava beans with oil, cumin, and salt. Transfer to a pan and add the sauce.
instructions.15: To prepare the fourth topping: Mix yogurt with dukkah, garlic, and pepper. Then add the mashed fava beans and stir well.
instructions.16: Add onion, tomato, hot pepper, and parsley. Mix thoroughly.
instructions.17: Transfer the mixture to a pan and add olive oil.

title: Foul Mutabak
culturalNotes: You can add more spices according to preference. Foul can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Chop the bell pepper, onion, tomatoes, and hot pepper into small pieces.
instructions.2: Add garlic, hot pepper, and mild pepper to the food processor and grind them thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add salt, black pepper, cumin, and fresh parsley to the mixture and grind again.
instructions.4: Add vinegar to the mixture and grind thoroughly.
instructions.5: Heat a pan on the stove and add the chopped onion.
instructions.6: After the onion softens, add tomatoes, bell pepper, and hot pepper.
instructions.7: Add cumin, fresh parsley, and salt to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.8: Add fava beans to the mixture and stir together.
instructions.9: Pour boiling water into the mixture and let it cook for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: After the mixture is cooked, transfer it to a serving dish.
instructions.11: Add the prepared paste and tahini to the dish.
instructions.12: Serve foul with Baladi bread.

title: Grilled Foul
culturalNotes: Do not use wet hands or a wet spoon when storing grilled fava beans to maintain quality for longer.

instructions.1: Soak fava beans and chickpeas in boiling water for 3 hours.
instructions.2: Drain and rinse fava beans and chickpeas thoroughly.
instructions.3: Boil fava beans and chickpeas in boiling water for 1 to 1.5 hours.
instructions.4: Drain and rinse fava beans thoroughly.
instructions.5: Grill fava beans over medium heat until they turn golden.
instructions.6: Place fava beans in a bowl, pour boiling water mixed with 2 tablespoons of salt over them, and let them simmer until fully cooked.
instructions.7: Prepare the marinade: Mix water, salt, cumin, paprika, chili powder, and lemon juice in a bowl.
instructions.8: Add fava beans, chickpeas, and fava to the marinade and ensure they are fully submerged.
instructions.9: Let the mixture sit for 2 to 3 hours.
instructions.10: Store the grilled fava beans in sealed containers in the refrigerator.

title: Foul Medames
culturalNotes: The sauce can be stored in the refrigerator for a long time without spoiling. You can serve the foul with bread or filo pastry.

instructions.1: Soak the fava beans, chickpeas, lentils, and fowl mash in boiling water overnight.
instructions.2: Drain the water and transfer the fava beans to a large pot.
instructions.3: Add grated carrots and enough water to cover the fava beans by about 6 cm.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.5: Reduce heat and let the fava beans simmer gently until fully cooked.
instructions.6: Add half a cup of rice flour and turmeric, and stir well.
instructions.7: Add two teaspoons of ghee, two tablespoons of basil, green pepper, and fava beans (Khorramani), and stir over heat.
instructions.8: Drain the fava beans into a baking dish, place the eggs in the center, and add one teaspoon of traditional ghee.
instructions.9: Add a little oil, finely chopped onion, tomatoes, bell pepper, hot pepper, sauce, salt, cumin, parsley, and chili, and stir well.
instructions.10: Add tahini, vinegar, dukkah, hot water, and stir well until the consistency thickens.
instructions.11: Blend the cooked fava beans in a food processor, then stir over heat with a pinch of cumin and salt.
instructions.12: Add yogurt and dukkah, and stir well.
instructions.13: Add onion, tomatoes, bell pepper, hot pepper, and parsley, and stir well.
instructions.14: Serve the fava beans hot with sauce and yogurt.

title: Mambar Mix
culturalNotes: Mambar can be stored in the refrigerator and used as needed. To enhance aroma and flavor, fry the mambar in hot oil before serving.

instructions.1: Prepare the mixture: Chop the onion, vegetables, and tomatoes into small pieces.
instructions.2: Place the onion in a bowl and mix the spices (salt, pepper, cumin, parsley, seven-spice mix, cinnamon, sugar) with it.
instructions.3: Add the chopped tomatoes and vegetables, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add 1 tablespoon of sauce and mix again.
instructions.5: Rinse the rice, drain it, and add it to the mixture along with 1/2 cup of oil. Mix everything well.
instructions.6: Prepare the mambar: Soak the mambar in warm water with vinegar and baking soda for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Peel and clean the mambar thoroughly, then soak it in flour and coarse salt for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Fill the mambar with the mixture and tightly close both ends.
instructions.9: Cook the mambar: Bring water to boil in a pot with laurel leaf, clove, mastic, salt, and pepper.
instructions.10: Add the stuffed mambar to the boiling water and simmer for 1 to 1.5 hours.
instructions.11: Remove the mambar from the pot and serve with parsley, salt, and pepper to taste.

title: Lamb Grape Leaves Casserole
culturalNotes: Make sure the grape leaves are soft and light in color, and arrange them properly in the casserole dish to prevent tearing. You can add sliced potatoes for a heartier dish.

fah-184-i6.name: Spices (salt, pepper, cumin, cinnamon, seven-spice blend, pinch of sugar)

instructions.1: Choose soft, light-colored grape leaves, remove the stems, wash them, and arrange them overlapping in the same direction.
instructions.2: In a small pot, place the grape leaves with salt, cumin, and two tablespoons of oil, then boil and stir them.
instructions.3: In a bowl, mix the rice, sauce, vegetables, chopped onion, and spices.
instructions.4: In a pan over heat, add one clove of garlic and one bay leaf, then add the cubed lamb and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.5: Add the cinnamon, yellow pepper, salt, and sugar, then cover and let it simmer.
instructions.6: Fill the grape leaves with the rice mixture, then place them into the casserole.
instructions.7: Add sliced tomatoes, onions, potatoes, vegetables, and garlic, then place the remaining grape leaves on top.
instructions.8: Pour in hot broth, pomegranate molasses, and lemon juice, then shake the casserole well.
instructions.9: Cover the casserole with a plate to prevent the leaves from tearing, then simmer on low heat until cooked through.
instructions.10: Prepare a yogurt cucumber mint salad with salt and oil.

title: Economic Kibbeh
culturalNotes: Kibbeh can be frozen after shaping and kept in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. When frying, ensure the oil is hot enough to prevent oil absorption.

instructions.1: Grind the bulgur until fine.
instructions.2: Add 3 cups of boiling water to the ground bulgur, stir, cover, and let sit for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes.
instructions.3: Prepare the filling: In another bowl, combine 1 kilogram of ground meat, 1.5 cups of finely chopped onion, salt, black pepper, seven-spice mix, and mix well.
instructions.4: Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame paste in a pan, add the chopped onion, and sauté until golden brown, then add the meat and cook until fully done.
instructions.5: Add salt and spices to the meat, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.6: Sauté the nuts in 1 teaspoon of oil until golden brown, then add them to the filling.
instructions.7: After the bulgur has cooled, add flour, dried mint, black pepper, seven-spice mix, chopped onion, salt, oil, and knead until the dough is smooth and not sticky.
instructions.8: Shape the kibbeh: Wet your hands with oil, take a portion of dough, make a hole in the center, fill with the mixture, and close the kibbeh tightly.
instructions.9: Arrange the kibbeh on a tray and refrigerate for 30 minutes before frying.
instructions.10: Fry the kibbeh in hot oil over medium heat until golden brown.

title: Stuffed Mummbar with Vegetables and Rice
culturalNotes: Make sure the mummbar is completely cooled before frying to achieve the best crispiness. You can prepare the mummbar a day before Eid to avoid last-minute stress.

instructions.1: Wash the red tomatoes and chop them into small pieces.
instructions.2: Add the hot red pepper and bell pepper to the tomatoes.
instructions.3: Blend all ingredients in a blender until smooth.
instructions.4: Heat the sesame seeds in a pot over medium heat, then add the blended mixture and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the stock cube, sugar, and tomato sauce, then simmer for a few minutes.
instructions.6: Wash the herbs (onion, parsley, coriander, cilantro) and finely chop them.
instructions.7: Mix the herbs with salt, black pepper, cumin, seven-spice mix, and cinnamon.
instructions.8: Knead the onion with the spices thoroughly.
instructions.9: Add the washed and drained rice to the mixture, then add oil and stir all ingredients together.
instructions.10: Clean the mummbar with coarse salt, sodium bicarbonate, and vinegar, then rinse thoroughly with water.
instructions.11: Stuff the mummbar with the mixture, leaving a small portion at the end open.
instructions.12: Add boiling water to the pot with onion, carrot, tomato, garlic, cumin seeds, laurel leaf, cinnamon stick, cardamom pod, mastic, and black pepper.
instructions.13: Place the stuffed mummbar into the pot, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Then reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour.
instructions.14: Drain the mummbar, then fry it in a pan with sesame seeds and oil.
instructions.15: Add the spices (salt, cumin, cilantro, chili, black pepper) to the hot mummbar and mix thoroughly.

title: Yellow Rice
culturalNotes: You can use instant broth instead of fresh meat broth if you don't have ready-made broth. You can also toast the nuts before adding them to the rice for a stronger flavor.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the rice and stir for 1 minute until fully coated with oil.
instructions.3: Add turmeric, black pepper, and salt and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the broth and water and mix ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.5: Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and cover the pot.
instructions.6: Let the rice cook for 15–20 minutes until fully cooked.
instructions.7: After cooking time, let the rice rest for 5 minutes, then gently fluff with a fork.
instructions.8: Serve the rice topped with nuts and cilantro or parsley, to taste.

title: Guest Rice
culturalNotes: This rice can be served with roasted chicken breasts and chicken liver. You can also add some nuts or raisins for garnish.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee and oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the rice and stir well for 1 minute.
instructions.3: Add the cinnamon, black pepper, salt, and black honey; mix the ingredients together.
instructions.4: Add the stock and cover the pot; let the rice boil.
instructions.5: After boiling, stir once, reduce the heat, and cover again.
instructions.6: Let the rice finish cooking for 20 minutes.
instructions.7: In another pot, heat 1 tablespoon of ghee and add the chopped chicken liver.
instructions.8: Add salt, black pepper, and cinnamon; stir the liver until its color changes.
instructions.9: Let the liver finish cooking until fully ready.

title: Chicken with Rice
culturalNotes: The dish can be served with a green salad or any other side dish of choice. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken into halves and boil them.
instructions.2: Prepare the marinade: Mix paprika, saffron, chili, chicken seasoning, paprika, oil, salt, and black pepper. Apply the mixture to the chicken and toss well.
instructions.3: Place the chicken in the oven until golden brown.
instructions.4: Prepare the rice: In a pot, combine chicken broth with salt, black pepper, stock cubes, butter, and ghee. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and let it simmer.
instructions.5: Prepare the delicious mixture: Cut potatoes and hot peppers into cubes, onions into medium-sized cubes, and parsley into small pieces.
instructions.6: Heat oil in a pan, add minced garlic, and sauté until golden.
instructions.7: Add onions and sauté until golden.
instructions.8: Add hot peppers, salt, black pepper, and saffron. Stir well.
instructions.9: Add potatoes and parsley. Mix thoroughly.
instructions.10: Add 2 tablespoons of sauce and mix well.
instructions.11: Add 2 tablespoons of cooked rice and mix thoroughly with the rice.
instructions.12: Serve the rice with the golden-brown chicken.

title: Basmati Rice
culturalNotes: You can add a stock cube for extra flavor. Serve the rice with grilled meat or fish.

instructions.1: Rinse the rice thoroughly under cold water until the water runs clear.
instructions.2: Drain the rice and transfer it to a pot.
instructions.3: Add boiling water to the rice.
instructions.4: Add salt, bay leaf, cinnamon sticks, cloves, and saffron (if using).
instructions.5: Stir the ingredients well.
instructions.6: Cover the pot and place it over medium heat until the water comes to a boil.
instructions.7: Reduce heat and let the rice cook for 15 minutes or until fully cooked.
instructions.8: Add butter cubes or oil and gently stir the rice.
instructions.9: Let the rice simmer on low heat for an additional 5 minutes.
instructions.10: Turn off the heat and let the rice rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Basmati Rice with Peas and Carrots
culturalNotes: You can use baladi rice instead of basmati rice for a different flavor. The rice can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for up to one month.

instructions.1: Heat the oil and butter in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the sugar and stir briefly to achieve a darker color if desired.
instructions.4: Add the peas and carrots and sauté with the onion for 3–4 minutes on low heat.
instructions.5: Add the washed and soaked basmati rice and stir well.
instructions.6: Add salt, pepper, and black honey and mix thoroughly.
instructions.7: Pour the hot broth over the rice and cover the pot.
instructions.8: Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low and simmer for 15–20 minutes until fully cooked.
instructions.9: In a separate pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil and add the diced liver, cooking until done.
instructions.10: Add salt, pepper, and seven-spice mix and stir well.
instructions.11: Serve the rice with the fried liver and toasted nuts if desired.

title: Farmer's Bakkakins (Kamaj)
culturalNotes: You can use thick yogurt or regular yogurt according to preference, but thick yogurt is recommended for better results. Serve bakkakins with butter and cheese or as sandwiches.

fah-192-i2.name: 1/2 kilogram thick yogurt or regular yogurt

instructions.1: Mix flour, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add powdered milk, cream, vinegar, sugar, and yeast to the flour and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add half a cup of ghee or oil and mix until the texture resembles sand grains.
instructions.4: Add half a kilogram of thick yogurt and regular yogurt and knead well until fully combined.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: After the dough has risen, divide it into balls according to desired size.
instructions.7: Lightly dust flour on the rolling surface and roll each ball with a rolling pin until about half a centimeter thick.
instructions.8: Place the bakkakins on a kitchen towel, cover, and let them rise again for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Preheat the oven to high heat and place the bakkakins on baking trays.
instructions.10: Bake for 3-4 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.11: Remove from oven and brush lightly with water to keep them soft and shiny.
instructions.12: Transfer to serving dish and cover to prevent drying out.

title: Homemade Baladi Bread
culturalNotes: Make sure the dough is very soft, as rye and shafan flour absorb a lot of liquid. Cover the loaves well while rolling to prevent drying out.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, rye flour, shafan flour, baking powder, yeast, sugar, and salt thoroughly.
instructions.2: Gradually add the warm water and knead until the dough is soft and not dry.
instructions.3: Knead for at least 10 minutes until the dough becomes smooth and elastic.
instructions.4: Place the dough in an oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap and clean towels.
instructions.5: Let the dough rise in a warm place for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
instructions.6: After the dough has risen, divide it into balls according to the desired size.
instructions.7: Roll each ball on a surface dusted with a mix of rye and flour.
instructions.8: Let the loaves rise again for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Preheat the oven to the highest temperature and place the loaves on a hot baking sheet.
instructions.10: Bake the loaves until puffed and golden brown, about 10 minutes.
instructions.11: Repeat the process until all the loaves are baked.

title: Homemade Bread on the Griddle
culturalNotes: You can use a kitchen towel to help transfer the loaves to the griddle. Slight variations in browning between loaves are normal and do not affect flavor.

instructions.1: Mix half the sugar with the flour and the other half of the sugar with the warm water, then add the yeast and stir. Let it sit for 5 minutes.
instructions.2: Add the salt and baking powder to the flour and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the yeast and sugar mixture to the flour and stir.
instructions.4: Add the vinegar and begin kneading the dough, gradually adding the warm water until you get a soft dough.
instructions.5: Knead the dough for at least 7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
instructions.6: Cover the dough with a plastic bag and let it rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Shape the dough into small balls according to preference.
instructions.8: Cover the balls and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Roll each ball on a floured surface into a thin circle about 3 mm thick.
instructions.10: Place the loaves on a baking tray lined with a kitchen towel.
instructions.11: Let the loaves rest for an additional 10 minutes to rise slightly.
instructions.12: Heat the griddle over medium heat and lightly grease it with oil.
instructions.13: Place each loaf on the griddle and cook for 20 seconds, then flip and cook for another 20 seconds until golden brown.
instructions.14: Repeat the process with the remaining loaves.

title: Healthy Black Flour and Whole Grain Bread
culturalNotes: This healthy bread can be used to make wraps, toast, and Kaiser rolls. The bread can be stored in an airtight plastic bag for up to 3 days in the refrigerator.

fah-195-i2.name: Whole grains (oats, wheat germ, quinoa, flaxseed)

instructions.1: Mix the whole grains with 1 cup of boiling water and let them soak for 30 minutes.
instructions.2: In a small bowl, mix the yeast with sugar and 1/4 cup of warm water, and let it sit for 10 minutes to test the yeast.
instructions.3: In a large bowl, combine the brown flour, salt, and baking powder.
instructions.4: Add the yogurt, oil, vinegar, and tested yeast to the flour and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Gradually add the soaked grains into the dough and mix until all ingredients come together.
instructions.6: Sprinkle flour on a clean surface and knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes firm and elastic.
instructions.7: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap and a clean towel, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
instructions.8: After the dough has risen, divide it into portions and shape as desired (Kaiser, toast, roll).
instructions.9: Place the shapes on an oiled baking tray and let them rise again for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush the shapes with a mixture of milk powder, Nescafe, sugar, and water.
instructions.11: Sprinkle the grains on the shapes according to preference.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 20–30 minutes, until the bread turns golden brown.
instructions.13: Let the bread cool before serving.

title: Egyptian Kuskus
culturalNotes: Kuskus can be served sweet or savory depending on preference. Honey or caramelized sugar can be added for garnish.

instructions.1: Mix the flour in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the water mixed with salt and stir until small clumps form.
instructions.3: Add the oil and mix the kuskus until it becomes fluffy and light.
instructions.4: Place the kuskus in a cloth bag or a bowl and let it rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Transfer the kuskus to a tray and stir again.
instructions.6: Place the kuskus in a clean sieve and cover it.
instructions.7: Put the sieve over a pot of boiling water and cover for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Stir the kuskus again and let it rest for an additional 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Transfer the kuskus to a pan and toss it with ghee over medium heat until warmed through.
instructions.10: Serve the kuskus with powdered sugar, nuts, and yogurt to taste.

title: Mashed Potatoes
culturalNotes: This dish can be served as a snack or part of a main meal. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender.
instructions.2: Mash the boiled potatoes.
instructions.3: Chop the red and green peppers into small cubes.
instructions.4: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.5: Add the chopped garlic and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.6: Add the red and green peppers, cumin, vinegar, turmeric, dill, parsley, salt, and black pepper. Stir well to combine.
instructions.7: Add the mashed potatoes to the mixture and stir thoroughly until all ingredients are well blended.
instructions.8: Serve the dish on a serving plate and garnish with fresh parsley.

title: Healthy Brown Spoon Bread
culturalNotes: You can add your favorite seeds such as flax, quinoa, or sunflower seeds. This bread is healthy and high in fiber, suitable for diets, and perfect for packed lunches.

instructions.1: Mix 1 cup of white flour with 1 teaspoon of yeast and 1 teaspoon of sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add 1 cup of tap water and mix the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Cover the bowl and let it rest for 30 minutes until the dough rises.
instructions.4: Add 4 cups of whole wheat flour to the risen dough.
instructions.5: Add a pinch of salt and another 1 cup of water, then mix well with a spoon.
instructions.6: Add 2 tablespoons of oil and mix the dough again.
instructions.7: Cover the dough and let it rest for another 30 minutes to rise.
instructions.8: Knead the dough with your hands, pinch the edge, fold it over, and flatten it.
instructions.9: Add 2 tablespoons of water, cover the dough again, and let it rest for 30 minutes.
instructions.10: Knead the dough again with your hands and cover it for another 30 minutes.
instructions.11: Heat the griddle and lightly grease it with oil.
instructions.12: Shape the dough into rounds using a spoon and cut them into desired sizes.
instructions.13: Place the rounds on the griddle and cook until golden brown.
instructions.14: Serve warm or pack in a lunch box.

title: Healthy Pocket Bread
culturalNotes: The bread can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. It can be served with butter, cheese, or jam.

fah-199-i1.name: 3 and a half cups warm water

instructions.1: Mix 3 and a half cups of warm water with 1 tablespoon of yeast, 2 tablespoons of olive oil, and 1 tablespoon of white honey.
instructions.2: Add 1 kilogram of whole wheat flour and mix the ingredients well with a spoon until combined.
instructions.3: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.4: Add 1/2 cup of warm water and 1/2 teaspoon of salt and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Add the mixture to the dough and knead by hand for 5 minutes.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and let it rise for another 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Repeat the kneading and rising process 3 additional times, each for 30 minutes.
instructions.8: After the final rise, roll out the dough on a surface lightly dusted with flour.
instructions.9: Shape the dough into various forms such as sandwich bread or fano bread.
instructions.10: Grease the molds with oil and sprinkle the seeds on top.
instructions.11: Bake the dough in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 20–25 minutes.
instructions.12: Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool completely before serving.

title: Whole Grain Healthy Bread
culturalNotes: The loaf can be frozen in bags and reheated as needed. The bread can be used to make sandwiches.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, salt, yeast, and sugar or honey in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the warm water and knead the ingredients for at least 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover it, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size.
instructions.4: Wash the dough and divide it into small pieces, each about the size of a lemon.
instructions.5: Roll each piece on a surface dusted with whole wheat flour or semolina.
instructions.6: Cover the loaves and let them rest for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Heat the pan over medium heat and place the loaves in it.
instructions.8: Flip the loaves until they turn golden and start to bubble.
instructions.9: Repeat the process until all the loaves are cooked.

title: Rice with Sauce
culturalNotes: Basmati rice can be replaced with baladi rice according to preference. The rice can be served with crispy chicken slices and sauce.

instructions.1: Heat oil and butter in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add grated onion and sauté for 1 minute until translucent.
instructions.3: Add chopped garlic and sauté until golden.
instructions.4: Add hoi sin sauce, barbecue sauce, ketchup, black honey, instant stock, salt, and white pepper; stir well to combine.
instructions.5: Pour in hot water and stir to mix thoroughly.
instructions.6: Add washed and drained rice; stir well to combine.
instructions.7: Cover the pot and bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat and simmer for 15–20 minutes until rice is fully cooked.
instructions.8: Gently stir the rice and let it sit on low heat for 5 additional minutes.

title: Baladi Rice with Demi-Glace
culturalNotes: You can sprinkle nuts on top of the dish before serving for an extra flavor and texture.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix 3 tablespoons sugar with 3 tablespoons water and let it sit until crystallized.
instructions.2: Add 6 cups boiling water and 2 instant broth cubes, and stir well.
instructions.3: Add salt, pepper, and cinnamon, and stir well.
instructions.4: Add 2 tablespoons ghee and oil, and stir until melted.
instructions.5: Add the rice and stir well.
instructions.6: Place the pot over medium heat until it comes to a boil, then reduce heat and cover.
instructions.7: Add raisins and stir well.
instructions.8: Let the rice finish cooking for 15–20 minutes.
instructions.9: Serve the rice with grilled meat, liver, and sauce.

title: Saffron Rice
culturalNotes: You can use saffron powder instead of crushing fresh saffron. Serve the rice with grilled chicken breast and creamy mushroom sauce for a luxurious meal.

instructions.1: Crush the saffron and soak it in hot water for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Rinse the rice and drain it.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee and oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.4: Add the rice and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, and salt and mix thoroughly.
instructions.6: Add the hot water (4 cups per 1 cup of rice) and bring to a boil.
instructions.7: Add the soaked saffron and stir well.
instructions.8: Cover the pot and simmer on low heat for 20 minutes.
instructions.9: After cooking, gently fluff the rice and serve.

title: Rice with Nuts
culturalNotes: You can add a small amount of saffron to the broth for a distinctive color and flavor. The rice can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for up to one month.

instructions.1: Heat the oil and ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the almonds and raisins and sauté until golden brown.
