instructions.2: Add the flour and salt to the yeast and milk mixture, then add the oil. Knead the ingredients thoroughly until the dough becomes smooth and elastic.
instructions.3: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes, until doubled in size.
instructions.4: Punch down the dough and divide it into 6 balls. Cover and let rest for 15 minutes to rise again.
instructions.5: Dip each ball into the milk, then into the white sesame seeds.
instructions.6: Roll each ball on a floured surface to a thickness of about half a centimeter, then cut into 4 pieces.
instructions.7: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, then fry the bread until puffed and golden brown on both sides.
instructions.8: Drain the bread on paper towels to absorb excess oil.

title: Home Bread
culturalNotes: You can use a toaster pan or an English cake pan to make a hollowed toast. You can freeze the bread and use it later to make sandwiches.

instructions.1: Mix the flour thoroughly in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the warm milk, oil, yeast, salt, egg, egg yolk, sugar, and baking powder.
instructions.3: Stir the ingredients well until fully combined.
instructions.4: Let the dough rest for 10 minutes to rise.
instructions.5: Gradually add more flour and mix until you get a smooth, lump-free dough.
instructions.6: Grease the baking pan with butter and dust it with flour.
instructions.7: Pour the dough into the pan and spread it evenly.
instructions.8: Cover the dough and let it rise for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Brush the top of the dough with egg white and sprinkle with nigella seeds, sesame seeds, and flax seeds.
instructions.10: Place the pan in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius.
instructions.11: Bake for 15 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.12: Remove from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.

title: Breakfast and Evening Bread
culturalNotes: This bread can be served with cheese, eggs, honey, or any other favorite dishes for breakfast or dinner. The bread can be stored in an airtight plastic bag for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, dried milk, sugar, yeast, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the egg, vinegar, oil, and warm milk, then knead until the dough is soft and slightly sticky.
instructions.3: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it doubles in size.
instructions.4: Press the dough into an oiled baking tray and let it rise again for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Brush the dough with the egg yolk mixed with a little vinegar.
instructions.6: Shape the dough into squares and sprinkle with sesame seeds and nigella seeds.
instructions.7: Bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 15–20 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.8: Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool slightly, then cut and serve.

title: Eid Pastries
culturalNotes: You can add any preferred extras such as nuts, raisins, or cheese. The pastries can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with baking powder, sugar, and salt.
instructions.2: Add the oil and mix the ingredients thoroughly until they resemble damp sand.
instructions.3: Gradually add the warm water until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Knead the dough well until it becomes soft and easy to shape.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.
instructions.6: Roll each ball on a surface dusted with cornstarch, and grease each layer with oil.
instructions.7: Place the pastries on a greased baking tray and fry them over medium heat until golden on both sides.
instructions.8: In another pan, sauté the onion in ghee until golden, then add black pepper, cinnamon, dried mint, and clove.
instructions.9: Add the ground meat and stir until fully cooked and dry, then season with salt and sugar.
instructions.10: Prepare the filling mixture using ghee, dried mint, and instant broth.
instructions.11: Place a layer of pastry in a greased baking dish, add 4–5 tablespoons of the filling mixture, and repeat until all pastries are used.
instructions.12: Top with the cooked ground meat and add your preferred extras such as nuts, raisins, and cheese.
instructions.13: Cover with another layer of pastry and repeat until all ingredients are used.
instructions.14: Cut the pastries into squares or rectangles before baking.
instructions.15: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 30 minutes until golden brown.

title: Samosa with Cream
culturalNotes: You can add a small stock cube to the broth to give it a stronger flavor. You can also grease the edges with ghee to prevent meat leakage.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the ground beef and stir with the onion until the meat turns golden brown.
instructions.4: Add the cinnamon, black pepper, and salt, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Pour in the broth and yogurt, and stir well to combine.
instructions.6: Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Mix the ghee and baking powder in a small bowl and stir well.
instructions.8: Prepare the baking dish and grease it with ghee.
instructions.9: Lay a layer of samosa pastry into the dish and spread it evenly.
instructions.10: Spread a layer of the meat and broth mixture over the pastry.
instructions.11: Add another layer of samosa pastry and spread it evenly.
instructions.12: Spread another layer of the meat and broth mixture.
instructions.13: Add another layer of samosa pastry and spread it evenly.
instructions.14: Brush the top with the ghee and baking powder mixture.
instructions.15: Place the dish in a preheated oven at 220°C (428°F).
instructions.16: Bake for 20–25 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.17: Remove from the oven and let cool slightly.

title: Phyllo Rolls Stuffed with Sausage and Cheese
culturalNotes: You can add chili pepper if you prefer a spicy flavor. You can also prepare the rolls in advance and store them in the refrigerator for up to one hour before baking.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling: Slice the onion and green pepper thinly.
instructions.2: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, then add the onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the green pepper and stir together for one minute.
instructions.4: Add the sausage cut into small pieces and stir with the onion and pepper for two minutes.
instructions.5: Add salt, black pepper, seven-spice mix, and sesame paste; stir well.
instructions.6: Add cumin and parsley; stir again.
instructions.7: Remove the filling from heat and let it cool slightly, then mix in the mozzarella cheese.
instructions.8: Prepare the rolls: Brush phyllo sheets with a mixture of butter and oil, or ghee and oil.
instructions.9: Place a portion of the filling in the center of a phyllo sheet, then tightly roll it up and seal the edges.
instructions.10: Arrange the rolls in a greased baking dish.
instructions.11: Brush the tops of the rolls with the remaining fat mixture.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.13: Remove from oven and cover with aluminum foil for 5 minutes to keep them soft and tender.

title: Multilayered Sandwich with Various Fillings
culturalNotes: You can use any fillings you prefer, such as ground meat or shawarma. Make sure the dough is soft and slightly sticky to achieve soft, fluffy sandwiches.

instructions.1: Mix the warm milk, warm water, salt, sugar, yeast, and oil in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the flour and mix thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Knead the dough for at least 10 minutes until soft and slightly sticky.
instructions.4: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap and a kitchen towel, and let it rise in a closed oven for 5 minutes.
instructions.5: After the dough has risen, punch it down to release air and divide it into small balls.
instructions.6: Fill each ball with your preferred filling (feta cheese, parmesan cheese, Nutella chocolate).
instructions.7: Roll each ball into a rectangle, place the filling in the center, and shape the sandwiches into a roll.
instructions.8: Place the sandwiches in an oiled baking tray, making sure the seam is facing down.
instructions.9: Let the sandwiches rise again.
instructions.10: Brush the sandwiches with beaten egg mixed with a little vinegar.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at high temperature for 10 minutes.
instructions.12: After removing the sandwiches from the oven, cover them with a damp, wrung-out towel to keep them soft and fluffy.

title: Soft Cheese and Parsley Sandwiches
culturalNotes: You can change the filling as desired, such as adding ground meat or scrambled eggs. The sandwiches can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the warm water and knead until the dough is well combined.
instructions.3: Add the oil and mix thoroughly until the dough is soft and not sticky.
instructions.4: Cover the dough with a plastic bag and let it rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Fill the sandwiches with cheese, parsley, and chopped green pepper.
instructions.6: Shape the dough into equal-sized balls and roll them out with a rolling pin.
instructions.7: Place the filling in the center of each dough piece and seal the edges by pressing them together with your hands and tines of a fork.
instructions.8: Lightly dust a baking tray with flour and place the sandwiches on it.
instructions.9: Heat a pan over medium heat and add one tablespoon of oil.
instructions.10: Fry the sandwiches until golden brown on both sides.

title: Crispy and Soft Kishke Sandwiches
culturalNotes: You can change the filling as desired, such as cheese and sausage or cheese and sugar. You can also freeze the sandwiches and use them later.

instructions.1: Mix 1/2 cup warm water with 1/2 cup warm milk, 1 large spoon sugar, and 1 large spoon yeast. Cover the mixture and let it sit for 10 minutes to activate the yeast.
instructions.2: In a large bowl, mix 3 cups baking flour, 4 tablespoons milk powder, and 1 small spoon baking powder.
instructions.3: Add the yeast mixture to the flour, then add 1/2 cup oil and 1/2 small spoon salt. Knead the ingredients well.
instructions.4: If the dough needs more water, add warm water gradually, a little at a time, until the dough becomes smooth and soft.
instructions.5: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and a clean towel, and let it rest in a warm place for 1 hour until it rises.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into 18 balls the size of a large lemon.
instructions.7: Fill each ball with pastrami and cheese, and seal them tightly.
instructions.8: Place the sandwiches in a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.9: Cover the sandwiches and let them rise again for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
instructions.11: Bake the sandwiches for 20–25 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.12: Remove the sandwiches from the oven and let them cool slightly before serving.

title: Shaboura
culturalNotes: Shaboura can be served in the traditional way or crispy after dipping in milk tea or plain tea. The aroma of baked goods creates a wonderful atmosphere at home, especially during winter.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and baking powder in a bowl and sift them well.
instructions.2: Add the sugar, oil, ghee, vanilla, and salt to a mixer and blend thoroughly until the color lightens.
instructions.3: Gradually add the flour and baking powder mixture to the liquid mixture and mix well.
instructions.4: Slowly add the warm milk and mix until the batter is smooth and uniform.
instructions.5: Grease a baking tray with ghee and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.
instructions.6: Pour the batter into the tray and bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 45 minutes.
instructions.7: Remove from the oven and check for doneness.
instructions.8: Serve hot, or cut in half and dip into milk tea or plain tea.

title: Quick Bread Slices
culturalNotes: You can serve these slices for breakfast or dinner, and they're perfect for students in a lunchbox. You can also stuff them with butter and cheese or any filling you prefer.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix 1 cup warm milk with 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 tablespoon active dry yeast. Stir well and let sit for 10 minutes until frothy.
instructions.2: In another bowl, combine 3 1/2 cups baking flour with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1 teaspoon baking powder.
instructions.3: Add the frothy milk mixture to the flour along with 1 tablespoon vinegar and 2 tablespoons olive oil. Knead until the dough is soft and smooth.
instructions.4: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and a clean towel. Let it rest in a warm place for 30 minutes until doubled in size.
instructions.5: After the dough has risen, roll it out on a floured surface to about 1 cm thickness.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into suitable-sized squares.
instructions.7: Heat a greased griddle over medium heat. Place the slices on it, cover, and let them rise again for 5 minutes.
instructions.8: Prepare the brushing mixture by combining 1/4 cup olive oil with 1 teaspoon chopped garlic, 1 teaspoon fresh thyme, and 1 teaspoon smoked paprika.
instructions.9: Brush the slices with the mixture, then bake in a preheated oven at the highest temperature for 10 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.10: Serve the slices warm. You can stuff them with butter and cheese or any filling you prefer.

title: Light and Soft Flaky Dough
culturalNotes: This dough can be used to make sweet and savory pastries. The pastries can be frozen for long-term storage. You can shape the dough into any form you like and fill it with any filling you prefer.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg white, yogurt, and oil, and mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Gradually add the baking soda, a little at a time, until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes soft and smooth.
instructions.5: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover it, and let it rest in a warm place for 1 hour until risen.
instructions.6: Shape the dough into small balls and arrange them on a flour-dusted tray.
instructions.7: Roll each ball with a rolling pin until it is about 0.5 cm thick, and shape as desired.
instructions.8: Brush the tops of the pastries with diluted vinegar mixed with water, then bake in a preheated oven at 220°C.
instructions.9: Bake for 10–15 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.10: Let the pastries cool before freezing or serving.

title: Light and Crispy Dough for Breads and Baked Goods
culturalNotes: You can use this dough to make various baked goods such as pizza and manakeesh. To store the dough, place it in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix 3 cups warm water with 2 tablespoons yeast, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1 teaspoon salt, and 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Stir the ingredients well and cover the bowl. Let it sit for 10 minutes until the yeast activates and bubbles appear.
instructions.3: Gradually add 1 kilogram of flour and mix until the dough comes together and feels soft.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rest for 30 minutes until it rises and doubles in size.
instructions.5: After 30 minutes, wash your hands with water and begin folding the dough from all four sides. Cover again and let it rest for another 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Repeat the folding and covering process two more times, each time letting it rest for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: After the third fold, wash your hands with water and fold the dough one final time. Cover and let it rest for 30 minutes.
instructions.8: After 30 minutes, wash your hands with water and fold the dough one last time. Cover and let it rest for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Lightly dust your work surface with flour and semolina. Roll out the dough.
instructions.10: Cut the dough into equal portions and fill each with thyme and olives, or cheese, labneh, parsley, and cherry tomatoes.
instructions.11: Place the portions onto an oiled baking tray and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.12: Preheat the oven to 250 degrees Celsius. Bake the portions for 10–15 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.13: Remove from the oven and let cool slightly before serving.

title: Japanese Crispy and Puffed Dough
culturalNotes: You can shape the dough into any form you like and fill it with various fillings. The dough becomes crispy and puffed after cooking, making it perfect for serving at different occasions.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix 6 cups warm milk with 3 tablespoons flour and stir well while cooling.
instructions.2: Transfer the mixture to a saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the flour is fully cooked and the consistency becomes creamy.
instructions.3: Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix the yeast with 3 tablespoons sugar, 1 tablespoon milk powder, and 1.5 teaspoons salt.
instructions.5: Add the egg and yogurt, and mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.6: Gradually add the cooled dough mixture to the bowl and knead until well combined.
instructions.7: Add 80 grams soft butter and knead the dough until smooth and not sticky.
instructions.8: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: After rising, divide the dough into small balls and shape them into muffin or cupcake forms.
instructions.10: Add your preferred filling, either sweet or savory.
instructions.11: Place the dough cups into muffin tins and bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 10 minutes.
instructions.12: Serve warm or cold, according to preference.

title: Sponge Bread Without Oven
culturalNotes: Fatta can be served with white cheese or honey or any filling you prefer. Make sure the dough is slightly sticky when kneading to achieve light and fluffy fatta.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and sugar in the warm yogurt and warm water, and stir together.
instructions.2: Leave the mixture in a warm place for 10 minutes until the yeast is activated.
instructions.3: Add the salt and egg, and stir into the mixture.
instructions.4: Gradually add the flour and knead the dough with the warm water.
instructions.5: Add the oil and knead for 5 minutes until the dough becomes elastic and sticky.
instructions.6: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest in a warm place for 30 minutes until risen.
instructions.7: Divide the dough into 6 parts and brush each with oil.
instructions.8: Let the pieces rest for 10 minutes to relax.
instructions.9: Heat a frying pan over medium heat and add 2 tablespoons of oil.
instructions.10: Take a piece of dough and roll it out on an oiled surface.
instructions.11: Place the fatta in the pan and cover until the bottom is golden, then flip.
instructions.12: Repeat the process with the remaining dough pieces.

title: Pita Bread
culturalNotes: Pita bread can be served with honey, butter, feta cheese, or garlic paste. It can also be served alongside any other dish you prefer.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the water while kneading until the dough becomes firm and no longer sticks to your hands.
instructions.3: Knead the dough thoroughly until it becomes smooth.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into equal-sized balls (about 10-14 balls).
instructions.5: Cover the balls with a plastic bag and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Lightly grease the pan with oil and roll each ball with a rolling pin until thin.
instructions.7: Place the rolled dough onto the hot pan over medium heat.
instructions.8: Flip and cook until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.9: Repeat the process until all the balls are used.

title: Bakakine Bread
culturalNotes: Bakakine bread can be baked on a griddle if available. The bread becomes soft and delicious when baked in a hot oven.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast with sugar and warm water, and let it sit for 10 minutes until it becomes frothy.
instructions.2: Add the flour, butter oil, and vinegar, and knead thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add Dream yeast and knead well until the dough becomes soft and not sticky.
instructions.4: Gradually add dried yogurt or yogurt, a little at a time, until the dough forms a ball.
instructions.5: Add salt 5 minutes after kneading, and knead again.
instructions.6: Let the dough rise until it doubles in size.
instructions.7: Divide the dough into small balls and let them rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Roll each ball with flour until thin.
instructions.9: Arrange the bread on a baking tray, leaving space between them.
instructions.10: Bake in a hot oven (top and bottom heat) until golden brown.
instructions.11: Let the bread cool slightly before serving.

title: Baladi Bread
culturalNotes: Can be stored in a sealed plastic bag for up to 3 days. Can be served with cheese, hummus, or any filling of your choice.

instructions.1: Heat the water very hot and pour it over the semolina flour, then mix the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.2: Add the all-purpose flour, sugar, yeast, salt, butter, and cottage cheese to the mixer and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the semolina dough to the rest of the ingredients in the mixer and knead for at least 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Grease a deep bowl with oil, place the dough inside, then grease the top and cover with plastic wrap and a clean towel.
instructions.5: Let the dough rise until it doubles in size.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into small balls (about the size of a small grapefruit).
instructions.7: Roll each ball into a log or a circle.
instructions.8: Let the dough rise again until it doubles in size.
instructions.9: Brush the dough with a mixture of powdered milk, instant coffee, and sugar.
instructions.10: Make incisions on the dough using a fluted rolling pin.
instructions.11: Let the dough rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.12: Bake the bread in a preheated oven at 220°C for 10 minutes on the lower rack.
instructions.13: After removing from the oven, sprinkle the bread with water and cover it with a clean towel.

title: Light and Delicious Turkish Bread
culturalNotes: Serve the bread with cheese and a cup of tea for a delicious breakfast. Homemade bread has a completely different taste and aroma compared to store-bought versions.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, baking powder, yeast, salt, and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg white, warm milk, and warm water. Knead the ingredients for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the oil and knead for an additional 5 minutes until the dough becomes soft and elastic.
instructions.4: Place the dough in an oiled bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and a clean towel. Let it rise until doubled in size.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into 4 equal-sized balls and place them on an oiled baking tray, leaving space between them.
instructions.6: Cover the balls and let them rest.
instructions.7: Mix the egg yolk with 1 large spoon of yogurt and brush this mixture onto the tops of the loaves.
instructions.8: Sprinkle poppy seeds or sesame seeds on top as desired.
instructions.9: Preheat the oven to the highest temperature. Place the loaves on the bottom rack and bake until cooked through.
instructions.10: Leave the loaves in the oven until they turn golden brown.

title: Arabic Bread
culturalNotes: Make sure the dough rises well in a warm place. You can use the oven or a skillet for baking, depending on your preference.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the powdered milk, butter, and yogurt, and knead the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Use a mixer to combine the ingredients for at least 10 minutes until the dough is smooth and doesn't stick to your hands.
instructions.4: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and a clean towel, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour until puffed.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into small balls, about the size of an egg.
instructions.6: Cover the balls and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll each ball in flour until it reaches a thickness of 3–4 mm.
instructions.8: Arrange the loaves on an oiled baking tray.
instructions.9: Bake the loaves in the oven for 30 seconds on each side over medium heat.
instructions.10: If using a skillet, cook each loaf for 30 seconds on each side.
instructions.11: Bake the loaves in the oven for 10 minutes until golden brown.

title: Baladi Bread Without Yeast
culturalNotes: Make sure the dough is firm and thin when rolled out. You can store the Baladi bread in a tightly sealed plastic bag for a few days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, salt, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and yogurt, then knead the ingredients together with warm water until the dough is well combined.
instructions.3: Knead the dough thoroughly until it becomes firm and smooth.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into equal-sized small balls.
instructions.5: Cover the balls and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Roll each ball on a floured surface until very thin.
instructions.7: Heat a skillet over high heat and place the bread flat on it.
instructions.8: Cook the bread until it puffs and turns slightly brown, then flip and cook the other side.
instructions.9: Cover the bread after cooking to keep it soft and warm.

title: Fino bread with potatoes
culturalNotes: You can use Fino bread to make sandwiches for breakfast or lunch. Store the bread in a sealed plastic bag for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the mashed potatoes, warm milk or water, and egg white. Knead the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: If the dough needs more moisture, add warm water, one tablespoon at a time, until smooth.
instructions.4: Let the dough knead for 5 minutes, then add the oil and knead for an additional 5 minutes.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rise until doubled in size.
instructions.6: Take small portions of the dough and arrange them on an oiled baking tray.
instructions.7: Let the bread rise again.
instructions.8: Mix the egg yolk with 1 tablespoon of yogurt and brush the bread with the mixture, then sprinkle with sesame seeds.
instructions.9: Bake the tray in a preheated oven at the highest temperature for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: After removing the bread from the oven, cover it for 5 minutes to prevent drying out.

title: Shepherd's Pie
culturalNotes: Serve the pie hot with a green salad or your choice of side dish. The pie can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and cut them into small pieces, then boil until soft.
instructions.2: Add the boiled potatoes to a bowl, then add spices, salt, pepper, and 2 tablespoons of butter. Mash thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add 1 cup of milk and mix until well combined.
instructions.4: Add cheese and mix into the mixture, then let it chill in the refrigerator.
instructions.5: In another bowl, combine the finely chopped meat and spinach.
instructions.6: Add 1 tablespoon of flour and mix well.
instructions.7: Add the stock cube and mix again.
instructions.8: Cook on the stove until the flour thickens and the mixture is well blended.
instructions.9: In a baking dish, spread the potato mixture on the bottom, then place the meat and spinach mixture on top.
instructions.10: Sprinkle paprika on top according to taste.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes, until the top turns golden brown.

title: Kebab Kibbeh Pie
culturalNotes: Serve the pie with the leftover sauce from the kibbeh for an extra flavor boost. The pie can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling: Cut the meat into small cubes, onions into rings, potatoes into cubes, and sauté them.
instructions.2: Heat ghee and oil in a pot, then add the meat along with mastic and laurel leaves and sauté until browned.
instructions.3: Add the onions and stir well, then add sugar and mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and reduce heat, then let it simmer until the meat is fully cooked.
instructions.5: Add two cups of water and let it boil, then cover and continue cooking until the meat is tender.
instructions.6: Prepare the dough: Mix flour with yeast, sugar, baking powder, and salt, then add dried yogurt and warm water and knead into a smooth dough.
instructions.7: Let the dough rest for 10 minutes, then divide it into two equal portions.
instructions.8: Roll out each portion into a thin layer (about 0.5 cm thick), then place one layer into an oiled baking pan.
instructions.9: Add the filling onto the bottom layer, then cover it with the second layer of dough.
instructions.10: Brush the top with a mixture of milk powder, Nescafe, and sugar, then sprinkle with sesame seeds or nigella seeds.
instructions.11: Bake the pie in a preheated oven at 200°C for 10 minutes, then switch to grill mode and brown the top until golden.
instructions.12: Repeat the above steps to make a second pie.

title: Meat and Potato Fattoush
culturalNotes: You can store the pastries in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. You can also freeze them in plastic bags for later use.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling: Grate the potatoes and onions and mix them well.
instructions.2: Mix the ground beef with the grated potatoes, onions, salt, pepper, cumin, parsley, chili, seven-spice mix, and sugar. Combine thoroughly.
instructions.3: Prepare the dough: Mix the flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a bowl. Gradually add water and knead until the dough is smooth and elastic.
instructions.4: Add 2–3 tablespoons of oil to the dough and knead again. Cover the dough and let it rest for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
instructions.5: After resting, roll out the dough into a square shape, about half a centimeter thick.
instructions.6: Place the filling onto the dough and roll it up like a log.
instructions.7: Cut the log into pieces, about 2–3 centimeters wide.
instructions.8: Heat a pan over medium heat and add a small amount of oil. Fry the pastries until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.9: Serve hot with pickles, hummus sauce, and fresh parsley.

title: Pita Crisps
culturalNotes: You can substitute oil with ghee or a mix of oil and ghee. You can also store the crisps in an airtight container for a long time.

instructions.1: Mix the flour in a deep bowl.
instructions.2: Add sugar, toasted sesame seeds, salt, baking powder, yeast, and cumin and fennel seeds. Mix ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add oil and mix until the flour fully absorbs the oil.
instructions.4: Gradually add water and knead until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rest in a warm place for 15 minutes.
instructions.6: Roll out the dough on parchment paper into a rectangular shape.
instructions.7: Cut the dough into small pieces.
instructions.8: Place the pieces onto a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Serve with cream cheese, olive oil, and mint.

title: Whole Wheat Flatbread
culturalNotes: You can serve the flatbreads with honey and jam, or with feta cheese and a cup of mint tea. The flatbreads can be stored in a sealed plastic bag for up to two days.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix 1 cup of warm water with 1 tablespoon of sugar and stir well.
instructions.2: Add 1 tablespoon of active dry yeast and stir the mixture thoroughly. Cover the bowl and let it sit for 10 minutes until the yeast becomes frothy.
instructions.3: In a pan, heat 1/2 cup of oil and 1/2 cup of ghee. Once the mixture is hot, remove it from the heat and add 2 tablespoons of cream and 2 tablespoons of sugar. Mix well.
instructions.4: Add the warm mixture to the yeast mixture and stir thoroughly.
instructions.5: Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt and mix well.
instructions.6: Gradually add 1 kilogram of whole wheat flour and mix until the dough comes together. You may need to add an additional cup of water if the dough feels too dry.
instructions.7: Knead the dough until it becomes soft and smooth, with no lumps. Do not overwork the dough, or it will become tough.
instructions.8: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30 minutes, until it doubles in size.
instructions.9: Divide the dough into equal-sized balls and place them on a greased baking tray, leaving space between each ball.
instructions.10: Roll each ball into a thin, flat circle, but not too thin. Let the flatbreads rise again for 30 minutes.
instructions.11: Preheat the oven to high heat. Place the flatbreads on the oven rack and bake them on the bottom rack until golden brown on the bottom, then switch to the broiler to brown the top.
instructions.12: Serve the flatbreads warm with feta cheese, olives, tahini, and mint tea.

title: Soft Crescent Pastries with Cream
culturalNotes: These soft crescent pastries with cream can be served with a cup of tea or coffee. They can be stored in a sealed plastic bag for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Warm the milk and add the sugar, clotted cream, and yeast. Mix well and set aside.
instructions.2: In another bowl, add the flour, baking powder, and salt. Mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the yogurt, ghee, and vinegar to the flour mixture. Mix until fully combined.
instructions.4: Add the milk and cream mixture to the flour. Mix well until the dough forms.
instructions.5: Knead the dough for 4 minutes until soft and smooth.
instructions.6: Cover the dough with a clean cloth and place it in a warm, turned-off oven for 10 minutes to speed up rising.
instructions.7: After rising, divide the dough into small pieces and shape them into balls.
instructions.8: Lightly grease a baking tray and place the balls on it, leaving space between them.
instructions.9: Let the balls rise again for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: After rising, flatten the balls slightly and bake them in a preheated oven on the lower rack for 10 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.11: Let the pastries cool slightly before serving.

title: Soft Farmer's Flatbread
culturalNotes: Make sure the dough is very soft, and let the flatbreads rise twice for the best result. When baking, ensure the oven is very hot before placing the flatbreads inside. After removing from the oven, cover the flatbreads immediately to keep them soft.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, dry milk powder, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Dissolve the yeast in sugar and let it sit until frothy.
instructions.3: Gently heat the butter, oil, and cream over low heat until melted.
instructions.4: Add the butter-oil-cream mixture to the flour while stirring.
instructions.5: Add the yogurt and prepared yeast mixture, then knead until the dough is soft and smooth.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and let it rise until doubled in size.
instructions.7: Divide the dough into small balls and let them rise again.
instructions.8: Fill each ball with date paste, or cinnamon and sugar, or cheese and labneh.
instructions.9: Roll each ball flat and seal the filling well.
instructions.10: Arrange the flatbreads on the baking tray and let them rise once more.
instructions.11: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees Celsius.
instructions.12: Bake the flatbreads until fully cooked.
instructions.13: Cover the flatbreads immediately after removing from the oven to keep them soft.
instructions.14: Store the flatbreads in freezer bags once completely cooled.

title: Farmer's Flatbread
culturalNotes: These flatbreads can be served warm with tea or coffee. They can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and sugar in a cup of warm water and let it sit for 10 minutes until frothy.
instructions.2: In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, baking powder, and milk powder.
instructions.3: Add the yogurt, clotted cream, oil, and butter to the flour and mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Gradually add the warm water until a soft and smooth dough forms.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30 minutes in a warm place.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into small balls about the size of a lemon.
instructions.7: Roll each ball on a floured surface until it reaches a thickness of about half a centimeter.
instructions.8: Bake the flatbreads in a greased tray in an oven preheated to 200 degrees Celsius for 10–15 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.9: For filling, spread the date paste with 1 teaspoon of butter and sesame seeds, then place it in the center of each flatbread and fold it over.
instructions.10: Bake the filled flatbreads in the same way.

title: Pizza Bomb
culturalNotes: You can add or remove filling ingredients according to preference. Serve the bombs hot with tomato sauce or ketchup.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and sugar in a cup of warm water and let it sit for 10 minutes until activated.
instructions.2: In a bowl, combine the flour, salt, and baking powder and mix well.
instructions.3: Gradually add the yeast mixture along with the warm yogurt and knead until the dough is well combined.
instructions.4: Add the ghee and oil and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and soft.
instructions.6: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap and a clean cloth, and let it rise for 1 hour.
instructions.7: Divide the dough into 12 pieces and shape them into balls.
instructions.8: Cover the balls again and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Prepare the filling by mixing the cheese, tomatoes, peppers, olives, oregano, and ketchup.
instructions.10: Roll out each dough ball and place 1 tablespoon of filling in the center.
instructions.11: Wrap the filling with the dough and shape into a ball.
instructions.12: Dip the balls in yogurt, then in breadcrumbs.
instructions.13: Arrange the balls in an oiled baking dish and let them rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.14: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the balls until golden brown on all sides.
instructions.15: Drain the balls on paper towels.

title: Phyllo Pastries with Secret Filling
culturalNotes: You can add fresh thyme to the filling according to preference. Serve the pastries with tea for a delightful taste.

instructions.1: Mix the butter, milk, yogurt, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a bowl until well combined.
instructions.2: Take a phyllo sheet and brush it with the secret mixture.
instructions.3: Place another phyllo sheet on top and brush it as well.
instructions.4: Cut the two sheets in half, then cut them lengthwise.
instructions.5: Brush the top surface again with the secret mixture.
instructions.6: Place the filling on the sheet and fold the edges to close.
instructions.7: In a bowl, beat the egg and vinegar together.
instructions.8: Brush the top with the egg mixture until golden and shiny.
instructions.9: Place the pastries on a baking tray and put them in the oven on the middle rack.
instructions.10: Bake until golden brown.

title: Brioche Roses
culturalNotes: Make sure the dough is soft and elastic when kneading. Let the dough rise in a warm place to ensure proper rising. Brioche roses can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: In a pan, mix the flour, sugar, dried milk, yeast, and salt.
instructions.2: Add the warm milk, butter, and egg, and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the vinegar and vanilla, and stir again.
instructions.4: Transfer the mixture to a mixer and knead for at least 10 minutes until the dough becomes soft and elastic.
instructions.5: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap and a clean cloth. Let it rise in a warm place until doubled in size.
instructions.6: After the dough has risen, divide it into small balls and cover them.
instructions.7: Roll each ball into an oval shape and brush with butter.
instructions.8: Fold the dough over itself and cut into small pieces.
instructions.9: Twist the pieces around each other to form a rose shape.
instructions.10: Place the roses in an oiled baking tray, leaving space between them.
instructions.11: Let the roses rise again.
instructions.12: Prepare the brushing mixture using egg, milk, and Nescafe, then brush the roses with it.
instructions.13: Lightly sprinkle sugar over the roses.
instructions.14: Bake in a preheated oven at 220 degrees Celsius, on the lower rack, until golden brown.
instructions.15: Turn off the bottom heat and turn on the top heat to achieve a golden brown color on top.
instructions.16: After removing the roses from the oven, sprinkle them with sugar dissolved in water, cover with a clean cloth, and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Sausage Rolls
culturalNotes: You can use the dough to make various pastries such as pizza and donuts. To store the dough, place it in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar and yeast in warm water and stir well.
instructions.2: Let the mixture sit for 10 minutes to ensure the yeast is activated.
instructions.3: In a large bowl, combine the flour, dry milk powder, baking powder, and salt.
instructions.4: Add the yogurt and mayonnaise to the dry ingredients and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Knead the dough for 10 minutes until soft and elastic.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size.
instructions.7: Divide the dough into equal-sized balls.
instructions.8: Roll each ball into a thin rectangle.
instructions.9: Place a piece of sausage on the dough and roll it up like a burrito.
instructions.10: Seal the edges well and make 3-4 small slits on the sausage.
instructions.11: Place the rolls on an oiled baking tray and let them rise again for 15 minutes.
instructions.12: In a small bowl, mix the egg yolk, milk, and instant coffee.
instructions.13: Brush the rolls with the mixture and sprinkle with nigella seeds or sesame seeds as desired.
instructions.14: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees Celsius.
instructions.15: Bake in the oven for 20 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.16: Serve the rolls hot.

title: Village Tzatziki
culturalNotes: You can use fresh yogurt instead of dry yogurt if you don't have dry yogurt. Village Tzatziki is stored in the refrigerator and served cold.

instructions.1: Place dry yogurt in a wire strainer.
instructions.2: Add 1 teaspoon of salt to the dry yogurt and mix well.
instructions.3: Add 1 teaspoon of red pepper and ground cumin and mix well.
instructions.4: Add Turkish pepper and sumac to taste and mix well.
instructions.5: Cover the mixture and let it sit for 24 hours.
instructions.6: After 24 hours, add sheep cheese and cottage cheese to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.7: Cover the mixture and let it sit for two to three weeks.

title: Farmhouse Qareesh Cheese
culturalNotes: Make sure to use good, fresh milk for the best results. You can store the Qareesh cheese in the refrigerator for a long time without worrying about spoilage.

instructions.1: Prepare the milk: Warm 5 kilograms of milk over low heat for just one minute in winter; in summer, no heating is required.
instructions.2: Pour the milk: Transfer the milk into a pot, cover it with a clean cloth, and place it in the oven. Let it sit for two days in winter, and one day in summer. Make sure not to shake or move the pot.
instructions.3: Separate the cream: After the specified time, separate the cream from the cheese. You will notice the milk has turned into a solid mass.
instructions.4: Strain the cheese: Place the cheese in a strainer or cheesecloth to drain the liquid. Add salt to taste and mix the cheese thoroughly.
instructions.5: Storage: After straining, place the cheese in a container, cover it with the drained liquid, and add two tablespoons of salt per liter of liquid. Also add the green pepper. Store the cheese in the refrigerator.
instructions.6: Usage: You can use the Qareesh cheese in various dishes or eat it directly.

title: Creamy Cheese from Labneh
culturalNotes: You can use labneh to make a quick and easy creamy cheese. Add your favorite flavors such as parsley, mint, thyme, feta cheese, or chili pepper to make it more diverse. Labneh is rich in protein and calcium, making it perfect to serve with toasted bread or in school sandwiches.

instructions.1: Add labneh and milk to the blender.
instructions.2: Blend ingredients thoroughly until the texture becomes creamy.
instructions.3: If you prefer a richer cheese, add 2 tablespoons of oil.
instructions.4: Add your favorite flavors such as parsley, mint, thyme, feta cheese, or chili pepper, then blend again.
instructions.5: Blend the cheese once more until the texture is smooth and even.
instructions.6: Add a pinch of nigella seeds and 2 teaspoons of olive oil to the plain cheese.
instructions.7: Serve the creamy cheese with toasted bread or in school sandwiches.

title: Kofta Phyllo Rolls
culturalNotes: These rolls can be served as a light meal or as summer sandwiches. The rolls can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix Knorr kofta mix with ground beef and grated onion.
instructions.2: Knead the kofta thoroughly until all ingredients are well combined.
instructions.3: Prepare the phyllo glaze: mix half a cup of softened butter with a tub of yogurt and one teaspoon of baking powder.
instructions.4: Take one sheet of phyllo dough, brush it with the glaze, then place two more sheets on top and brush each one with the glaze.
instructions.5: Place a portion of kofta at one end of the phyllo, then roll it tightly and evenly.
instructions.6: Repeat the previous steps until all phyllo sheets are used.
instructions.7: Place the rolls in a greased baking tray.
instructions.8: Brush the top of the phyllo with butter or oil before placing in the oven.
instructions.9: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius, then place the tray in the middle rack.
instructions.10: Bake the rolls until golden brown, about 20 minutes.
instructions.11: Remove from oven and serve hot with tahini sauce and roasted pickled potatoes.

title: Peanut Butter
culturalNotes: Peanut butter can be stored in a jar for up to one month in the refrigerator. Serve with bread or in sandwiches.

instructions.1: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.2: Place the peanuts in an oven tray and bake them until golden brown.
instructions.3: Let the peanuts cool slightly, then grind them in a blender until smooth.
instructions.4: Add the honey, oil, and salt, and mix thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.5: Bake the mixture for 10 minutes at 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.6: Transfer the peanut butter to a clean, dry jar.

title: Spicy Shatitah
culturalNotes: Spicy Shatitah can be served with breakfast, fava beans, feteer, potatoes, pasta, koshari, okra, and molokhia. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to one week.

instructions.1: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add hot pepper and stir for one minute until it starts to change color.
instructions.3: Add chopped onion and spices (salt, cumin, parsley, black pepper) and stir for one more minute.
instructions.4: Add tomato cubes and stir for one minute.
instructions.5: Add vinegar and let it boil for two minutes.
instructions.6: Transfer the mixture to a bowl and let it cool.
instructions.7: Store shatitah in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

title: Cheesy Sauce
culturalNotes: This sauce can be served with roasted potatoes, pizza, or chicken cutlets. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Place the milk in a saucepan over low heat.
instructions.2: Add the cornstarch and stir well.
instructions.3: Continue stirring over low heat until the mixture thickens.
instructions.4: Add the cheese and stir until fully melted.
instructions.5: When the mixture begins to boil, add the butter and stir until melted.
instructions.6: Remove the saucepan from the heat and continue stirring until the desired consistency is reached.

title: Steak and Onion Pasta Sauce
culturalNotes: This dish can be served with a green salad or fresh bread. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the oil and butter in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the steak and cook until golden brown on all sides.
instructions.3: Add salt and black pepper and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the minced garlic and stir until golden brown.
instructions.5: Add the onion and stir until golden brown.
instructions.6: Add sugar and stir well.
instructions.7: Add demiglace powder and stir well.
instructions.8: Add boiling water and let it come to a boil.
instructions.9: Add the pasta and stir well.
instructions.10: Add pasta cooking water and stir well.
instructions.11: Add crushed pepper and stir well.
instructions.12: Add cream as desired.

title: Cheese-filled Pancakes
culturalNotes: Serve the pancakes hot with a side green salad. Use different types of cheese according to preference.

instructions.1: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the flour and stir for one minute.
instructions.3: Add the milk and stir until the flour dissolves.
instructions.4: Add the cream cheese, cheddar, and mozzarella and stir until the cheese melts.
instructions.5: Add a pinch of saffron color, salt, and pepper and stir well.
instructions.6: In another pan, sauté the sausage, bell peppers, dried tomatoes, za'atar, and pasta, then add the cheese sauce and stir.
instructions.7: Prepare the pancakes and fill them with the pasta and sauce mixture, then top with cheese.
instructions.8: Repeat the previous step to prepare the potato, spicy pepper, sauce, and cheese pancake.
instructions.9: Repeat the previous step to prepare the sujuk, bell pepper, sauce, and cheese pancake.
instructions.10: Bake the pancakes in a preheated oven at 180°C for 20 minutes, until the cheese melts and the top turns golden brown.

title: Alexandrian Fatta
culturalNotes: You can add a stock cube to the sauce for a stronger flavor. Fatta can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days and should be reheated before serving.

instructions.1: Heat the suet in a pot over medium heat, then add the cumin and stir until melted.
instructions.2: Add the ground beef and stir until the color changes.
instructions.3: Add the carrot, onion, tomatoes, laurel leaf, cumin powder, and stir well.
instructions.4: Add water until the meat is fully covered, then simmer on low heat until tender.
instructions.5: Rinse the rice and drain. Sauté it in a pot with suet, oil, and cumin until glossy.
instructions.6: Add salt and instant stock powder, then pour in water to cover the rice by about 1 cm.
instructions.7: Cover the rice and simmer on low heat until fully cooked.
instructions.8: Prepare the sauce by blending the red chili pepper and tomatoes in a blender, then strain.
instructions.9: Mash the garlic with salt, then sauté in a pan with suet until golden brown.
instructions.10: Add vinegar and chopped tomatoes, then simmer until thickened.
instructions.11: Cut the Egyptian bread into small cubes and toast in the oven until golden.
instructions.12: Prepare the tash by mixing the remaining garlic with suet, then add vinegar and beef broth.
instructions.13: Place the toasted bread in a serving dish, then pour beef broth over it.
instructions.14: Add the sautéed rice, then pour more broth over it.
instructions.15: Layer the cooked beef on top, then drizzle with the sauce and tash.
instructions.16: Serve hot.

title: Hawawshi Fatta
culturalNotes: You can use any long-grain rice instead of basmati rice. You can also sprinkle some grated cheese on top of the hawawshi before placing it in the oven to create a golden, crispy layer.

instructions.1: Mix ground beef with hawawshi spices, tahini, finely chopped onion, finely chopped green pepper, black pepper, and salt.
instructions.2: Knead the mixture thoroughly until smooth.
instructions.3: Take a piece of tortilla bread and place a portion of the mixture on it, spreading it evenly.
instructions.4: Roll the bread tightly into a log and cut it into slices about 1 centimeter thick.
instructions.5: Heat oil in a pan and fry the hawawshi slices until golden brown.
instructions.6: Place the fried hawawshi slices in a baking dish and bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Rinse the basmati rice and drain it, then transfer it to a pot with saffron and oil, stirring to coat.
instructions.8: Add the spices (cinnamon stick, cloves, cardamom pods, whole black pepper) and stir with the rice.
instructions.9: Add broth and salt, then let the rice simmer gently for 15 minutes while absorbing the liquid.
instructions.10: Stir in the ground saffron and mix well, then cover the pot and let the rice cook until fully done.
instructions.11: Mix tahini, yogurt, dukkah, lemon juice, vinegar, mayonnaise, and water until the sauce reaches a medium consistency.
instructions.12: Place the cooked rice in a serving dish and arrange the hawawshi slices on top.
instructions.13: Drizzle the tahini sauce over the hawawshi and garnish the dish with parsley or fresh coriander, peanuts, and pomegranate molasses.

title: Liver Fatta
culturalNotes: You can add chili to taste. Fatta can be stored in the refrigerator for up to one day.

instructions.1: Cut the liver into small cubes.
instructions.2: Marinate the liver with cinnamon, parsley, cumin, salt, pepper, garlic, and vinegar. Mix ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Heat oil in a pan and add the liver. Stir until well cooked, but do not over-stir.
instructions.4: Add colored peppers and hot pepper. Stir for 1 minute.
instructions.5: In another pan, heat a little oil and add garlic. Sauté garlic until golden.
instructions.6: Add parsley and vinegar. Mix well. Add 1/2 cup of sauce and let it boil.
instructions.7: Add 1/2 cup of water. Adjust salt and pepper. Let the sauce thicken.
instructions.8: Cook white rice in boiling water with ghee, oil, and cloves until cooked.
instructions.9: Toast the bread in the oven until golden and crispy.
instructions.10: In a serving bowl, place the white rice and toasted bread. Pour the sauce over them.
instructions.11: Spread the liver and colored peppers over the rice and bread.
instructions.12: Prepare the tahini sauce by mixing tahini, mayonnaise, minced garlic, salt, pepper, cumin, parsley, vinegar, and 1/2 cup of water. Pour the sauce over the fatta.
instructions.13: Serve fatta hot.

title: Caramel Popcorn
culturalNotes: Make sure to keep the heat low when making popcorn to avoid burning. Do not add too much baking soda or the caramel will become too airy.

instructions.1: Place a pot on the stove and add 2 tablespoons of oil, then reduce the heat.
instructions.2: Add the popcorn kernels and cover the pot, leaving a small opening for ventilation.
instructions.3: Let the popcorn cook on low heat until popping begins.
instructions.4: Prepare a baking tray and generously grease it with oil.
instructions.5: In a separate pan, place 1 cup of sugar and 1/4 cup of water over heat until the sugar caramelizes.
instructions.6: Do not stir the caramel at first; gently shake the pan instead.
instructions.7: When the caramel turns golden, add 1/4 teaspoon of baking soda and stir well.
instructions.8: Pour the caramel over the popcorn and mix thoroughly until all the popcorn kernels are evenly coated.
instructions.9: Pour the caramel-coated popcorn into the greased tray and let it cool and dry completely.
instructions.10: Once cooled, gently break apart the popcorn and serve.

title: Syrian Chickpea Falafel
culturalNotes: The dough can be stored without spices in the freezer for a long time. Make sure the oil is hot but not boiling when frying to avoid absorbing excess oil.

instructions.1: Soak the chickpeas for at least 12 hours, then rinse and drain them.
instructions.2: Place the chickpeas in the food processor with parsley, cilantro, onion, and garlic, and grind until smooth.
instructions.3: If the dough needs more moisture, add 1/4 cup of water.
instructions.4: Add salt, cumin, cilantro, and baking soda, then mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into small balls and roll them in sesame seeds.
instructions.6: Fry the falafel in hot oil until golden and crispy.
instructions.7: Prepare the tahini sauce by mixing tahini, yogurt, sumac, and water.
instructions.8: Serve the falafel with pita bread, tomatoes, pickled cucumber, tahini sauce, pomegranate seeds, and parsley.

title: Kofta Kabsa
culturalNotes: Kabsa can be served with dukha salad or any salad you prefer. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

fah-328-i1.name: Half a kilo of ground meat

fah-328-i8.name: Half a cup of crushed breadcrumbs

instructions.1: Mix the ground meat with chopped parsley, chopped garlic, crushed breadcrumbs, seven-spice blend, salt, and pepper.
instructions.2: Knead the ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Shape the mixture into small, evenly sized meatballs.
instructions.4: Heat the oil and ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.5: Add the meatballs and fry until golden brown on all sides.
instructions.6: Remove the meatballs from the pot and set aside.
instructions.7: In the same pot, add the chopped onion and garlic, and sauté until golden.
instructions.8: Add the dried lemon, cinnamon, cloves, salt, and pepper, and stir well.
instructions.9: Add the concentrated tomato juice and simmer until thickened.
instructions.10: Add the boiling water and bring to a boil.
instructions.11: Return the meatballs to the pot with the sauce.
instructions.12: Add the instant stock and simmer until boiling.
instructions.13: Add the rice and let it cook until fully submerged in water or sauce.
instructions.14: Add the peppers, cover the pot, and simmer on low heat until the rice is fully cooked.
instructions.15: Gently stir the kabsa once, then cover again and let it cook until completely done.

title: Kuwaiti Mota
culturalNotes: You can add local sausage or Turkish sausage to the sauce for extra flavor. You can also serve Kuwaiti Mota with tomatoes, cucumber, and black olives.

instructions.1: Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the yellow cornmeal and stir until lightly browned.
instructions.3: Pour in the water and stir well until the mixture is smooth and blended.
instructions.4: Add the mozzarella cheese and stir until fully melted and the mixture is smooth.
instructions.5: In another saucepan, heat the ghee and add the chopped onion. Sauté until golden and soft.
instructions.6: Add the hot pepper and stir briefly.
instructions.7: Add the grated tomatoes, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for a few minutes.
instructions.8: Stir in the eggs and gently mix until cooked through.
instructions.9: Serve the Kuwaiti Mota hot with Turkish yogurt and tea.

title: 3 Easy and Quick Recipes for Sudden Hunger
culturalNotes: These recipes can be served as quick lunch, dinner, or breakfast meals. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Prepare tortilla pizza: Cut tortilla bread into pieces and place in the Air Fryer.
instructions.2: Spread cream cheese and mozzarella cheese over the bread.
instructions.3: Brush the bread with ketchup and oregano, then add pepperoni, peppers, and black olives.
instructions.4: Cook the pizza in the Air Fryer for 5 minutes.
instructions.5: Prepare stuffed rolls: Mix ground meat with chopped onion, salt, pepper, and spices.
instructions.6: Roll out the tortilla bread and spread a layer of meat and cheese.
instructions.7: Roll the bread tightly and cut into 2 cm pieces.
instructions.8: Arrange the pieces in the Air Fryer and cook for 20 minutes at 180 degrees.
instructions.9: Prepare oregano cakes: Mix flour, oil, vinegar, sugar, salt, and yogurt.
instructions.10: Add baking powder, oregano, olives, peppers, and cheese.
instructions.11: Place the mixture into molds and bake in the Air Fryer for 20 minutes at 160 degrees.

title: 4 Different Dishes from Boiled Potatoes
culturalNotes: Boiled potatoes can be stored in the refrigerator and used later to quickly prepare these dishes.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender.
instructions.2: Cut the potatoes into small cubes.
instructions.3: Prepare the dill sauce: Mix dill with oil and turmeric, and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the dill mixture to the cubed potatoes and toss thoroughly.
instructions.5: Add cilantro and parsley, and mix well.
instructions.6: Prepare the pickled potatoes: Mix the cubed potatoes with green and red peppers, vinegar, minced garlic, cumin, basil, cilantro, salt, and pepper.
instructions.7: Prepare the potato casserole: Mix mashed potatoes with butter, salt, and pepper over heat, then add cheese, tomatoes, and sliced peppers.
instructions.8: Prepare the potato omelet: Whisk eggs in a pan with butter, then add boiled or mashed potatoes and stir well.
instructions.9: Serve the dishes garnished with cilantro and pepper as desired.

title: 6 School Sandwich Ideas
culturalNotes: Different types of bread such as baladi, shami, tortilla, or toast can be used according to preference. Favorite vegetables can be added to increase nutritional value.

instructions.1: Cut potatoes into slices, soak in hot water for 5 minutes, then roast in the oven or in oil.
instructions.2: In a bowl, mix one tablespoon of cream cheese and spread it on the bread.
instructions.3: Add roasted potato slices, romano cheese, and bell peppers.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mash the hard-boiled egg and mix with one tablespoon of cream cheese and bell peppers. Combine well and spread on the bread.
instructions.5: Add black olives and kabocha squash.
instructions.6: Dice potatoes into small cubes and sauté in oil until golden brown. Add pastirma and bell peppers, and stir well.
instructions.7: Add grated cheese and stir until melted.
instructions.8: In a bowl, mix the egg, diced potatoes, salt, pepper, and paprika. Combine thoroughly.
instructions.9: Add grilled halloumi cheese, mayonnaise, cucumber, pepper, pomegranate, and mint.
instructions.10: In a bowl, mix cream cheese, stilton cheese, diced pepper, and diced tomatoes. Combine well.
instructions.11: Add scallions and cucumber.

title: Chicken Patties
culturalNotes: The patties can be frozen after shaping and placed in a foil or foam tray, with a plastic bag between each tray to prevent sticking. Additional vegetables such as carrots or zucchini can be added for improved flavor and color.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken breasts and pat them dry thoroughly.
instructions.2: Chop the chicken breasts in a food processor until finely ground.
instructions.3: Add flour, mozzarella cheese, eggs, bell peppers, parsley, onion powder, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt to the ground chicken.
instructions.4: Mix the ingredients well until fully combined.
instructions.5: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.6: Shape the mixture into patties as desired.
instructions.7: Fry the patties until golden brown on both sides, covering the pan to ensure even cooking.
instructions.8: Serve the patties hot with ketchup, bread, mayonnaise, or cottage cheese, as preferred.

title: Rolled Eggs
culturalNotes: Rolled eggs can be served with yellow koshari and pickled tomatoes for a quick and delicious meal. Rolled eggs can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until fully hard-boiled.
instructions.2: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.3: Add the hard-boiled eggs to the butter and toss until evenly coated.
instructions.4: Serve the rolled eggs with yellow koshari and pickled tomatoes.

title: Cinnamon Roll from French Bread
culturalNotes: You can use French bread or homemade toast for better results. Serve the cinnamon roll with ice cream for a more delicious taste.

instructions.1: Cut the French bread or toast into thin slices.
instructions.2: Place the slices in a baking dish.
instructions.3: In a bowl, beat the eggs with vanilla, cinnamon powder, sugar, milk, and melted butter.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture over the sliced bread in the baking dish.
instructions.5: Place the dish in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius.
instructions.6: Bake until golden brown and the mixture is set (about 20 minutes).
instructions.7: Remove the dish from the oven and gently flip it.
instructions.8: Sprinkle powdered sugar over the cinnamon roll.
instructions.9: Garnish the cinnamon roll with strawberries or any available fruit, nuts, or caramel as desired.
instructions.10: Serve warm or with ice cream.

title: Shetita with Lentil Dumplings
culturalNotes: You can use any type of pepper according to preference, whether spicy or sweet. You can also sprinkle some chopped parsley on top before serving for garnish.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.2: Add the tomato juice and lentils, then simmer together covered on low heat.
instructions.3: In another pot, heat the oil and add the sliced green and red peppers, then sauté until fragrant.
instructions.4: Add the chopped garlic and stir with the peppers.
instructions.5: Add the cumin, black pepper, salt, and stock cube, then mix all ingredients together.
instructions.6: Add the cubed tomatoes and let them simmer with the other ingredients.
instructions.7: Add 1/2 tablespoon of vinegar and let the mixture boil.
instructions.8: In a small pan, heat 1 tablespoon of ghee and add the chopped garlic, then sauté until golden.
instructions.9: Add the dried parsley and stir well.
instructions.10: Add the dumplings to the lentil stew once it is completely smooth.
instructions.11: Serve Shetita with lentil dumplings hot, accompanied by bread.

title: Korean-style bread trend
culturalNotes: You can use different types of cheese according to preference. Serve the Korean-style bread hot with tomato sauce or any sauce you like.

instructions.1: Mix cream cheese with milk in a bowl.
instructions.2: Transfer the mixture into a piping bag and cut a small hole at the tip.
instructions.3: Prepare the Kaiser bread and slice it open from the middle.
instructions.4: Pipe the mixture into the bread through the hole.
instructions.5: Arrange the bread on an oiled baking tray.
instructions.6: Whisk butter with chopped tomatoes, parsley, and salt.
instructions.7: Spread the butter-tomato-parsley mixture over the top of the bread.
instructions.8: Sprinkle mozzarella cheese on top of the bread.
instructions.9: Bake the bread in the oven at the highest heat under the grill for 10 minutes until golden brown.

title: The Amazing Najaresh
culturalNotes: Leftover boiled chicken can be used to make Najaresh, saving time and effort. Serve the dish hot with a side salad.

instructions.1: Heat two tablespoons of butter in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add chicken pieces (either raw or leftover boiled) and stir until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add sliced onions and stir until softened.
instructions.4: Add salt, pepper, sugar, paprika, and seven-spice mix. Stir well.
instructions.5: Add mushrooms (if available) and stir.
instructions.6: Transfer the mixture to a separate bowl and set aside.
instructions.7: In the same pan, add two tablespoons of butter and four tablespoons of flour. Stir well until blended.
instructions.8: Gradually add cold milk while continuously stirring until smooth and well combined.
instructions.9: Add salt, pepper, and two tablespoons of cream. Stir thoroughly.
instructions.10: Add the partially cooked pasta and the chicken with mushrooms. Mix well.
instructions.11: Pour the mixture into a baking dish or casserole and sprinkle cheese on top.
instructions.12: Place the dish in a preheated oven, set to the middle rack, until golden brown.
instructions.13: Remove from oven and serve hot.

title: Homemade Indomie
culturalNotes: You can add more vegetables as desired to boost nutritional value. Serve Indomie with a side salad for a complete meal.

instructions.1: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add garlic and ginger and sauté until fragrant.
instructions.3: Add chicken pieces and sauté until all moisture evaporates.
instructions.4: Add onion and sauté until soft.
instructions.5: Add carrots, bell peppers, cabbage, and mushrooms; stir well.
instructions.6: Add chicken stock cube and tomato sauce; mix thoroughly.
instructions.7: Add vinegar, hot sauce, and soy sauce; stir well.
instructions.8: Boil noodles in boiling water for 3–4 minutes until partially cooked.
instructions.9: Add the noodle cooking water to the sauce mixture.
instructions.10: Add noodles to the sauce and mix thoroughly.
instructions.11: Serve hot.

title: Potato Burger
culturalNotes: Serve the burger with a green salad or fried potatoes for a complete meal. The burger can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into small cubes.
instructions.2: Boil the potatoes in boiling water with a teaspoon of salt for 5 minutes until partially cooked.
instructions.3: Drain the boiled potatoes and add Knorr potato seasoning, then mash thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add chopped parsley, bosturma, egg, flour, and grated cheese to the mixture and knead well.
instructions.5: Shape the mixture into patties of suitable size.
instructions.6: Heat a frying pan over medium heat and add a little oil.
instructions.7: Fry the patties on both sides until golden brown.
instructions.8: Serve the burger with mayonnaise and ketchup to taste.

title: Potato Burger Sandwich
culturalNotes: You can use any type of cheese you prefer. You can also add sliced onions or sweet peppers for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and mash them while still hot.
instructions.2: Add the chopped parsley, breadcrumbs, egg, salt, and pepper, and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.3: Press the mixture into a potato press or use the lid of a large jar to shape the burgers.
instructions.4: Heat a frying pan over medium heat and add the oil.
instructions.5: Fry the burgers in the hot oil, turning them until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.6: Place cheese slices on top of the burgers to let them melt.
instructions.7: Spread mayonnaise and ketchup on the burger buns.
instructions.8: Place the burgers, tomato, and pepper slices on the buns and serve hot.

title: Potatoes with Tahibisha
culturalNotes: This dish can be served for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. You can also add some cooked fava beans to make it more filling.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into small cubes and sprinkle with a little salt, then toss to coat.
instructions.2: Fry the potatoes in hot oil over medium heat until crispy and golden brown.
instructions.3: Remove the potatoes from the oil and drain them on paper towels to remove excess oil.
instructions.4: Cut the red, green, and hot peppers (if using) into small cubes.
instructions.5: Fry the peppers in the oil over medium heat until tender, then remove and drain.
instructions.6: In the same pan, add one tablespoon of oil and one tablespoon of garlic, and sauté the garlic until golden.
instructions.7: Add the cubed tomatoes to the garlic and let them cook slightly.
instructions.8: Add the cumin, black pepper, and paprika, then stir well to combine.
instructions.9: Add the vinegar to the mixture and let it boil for a moment.
instructions.10: Return the fried peppers to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.11: Drain the fried potatoes and add them to the mixture, then stir thoroughly until flavors are well combined.
instructions.12: Serve the dish hot with Egyptian flatbread.

title: Boiled Potatoes with Tahini
culturalNotes: This dish can be served as an appetizer or side with breakfast, lunch, or dinner. You can also sprinkle some grated cheese on top for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Heat the pan on the stove and add 1 tablespoon of garlic.
instructions.2: Sauté the garlic until golden.
instructions.3: Add the spices (cumin, parsley, chili) and stir with the garlic.
instructions.4: Add sliced bell peppers and mix with the mixture.
instructions.5: Add a pinch of turmeric and 1/4 cup of vinegar, then stir all ingredients together.
instructions.6: Add the boiled and mashed potatoes (half a kilogram) and mix thoroughly.
instructions.7: Season with salt and stir again.
instructions.8: Add fresh green parsley and chopped dill, and mix well.
instructions.9: Serve hot.

title: Oil-Free Roasted Potatoes
culturalNotes: Oil-free roasted potatoes can be served as a light snack or alongside main meals. Additional spices can be added according to preference.

instructions.1: Wash the potatoes thoroughly and peel them if desired.
instructions.2: Cut the potatoes in half, then cut each half into three pieces.
instructions.3: Place a pot on the stove, add water and salt, then boil the potatoes for exactly 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Drain the potatoes and transfer them to a baking tray.
instructions.5: Prepare the marinade by mixing mayonnaise, mustard, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, chili flakes, potato seasoning, cornstarch, water, and oil.
instructions.6: Add the potatoes to the marinade and toss well to coat.
instructions.7: Place the potatoes in a greased baking tray or one lined with butter paper, spreading them evenly.
instructions.8: Preheat the oven to the highest setting, then place the tray in the middle rack.
instructions.9: Bake until the potatoes are golden brown and crispy.
instructions.10: Serve hot with mayonnaise and ketchup if desired.

title: Mozzarella Sticks and Onion Fries
culturalNotes: Make sure the oil is very hot when frying the mozzarella to prevent the cheese from melting. These can be served with tomato sauce or any sauce you prefer.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into medium-sized fries.
instructions.2: Place the potatoes in a large bowl, add boiling water, and cover for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Slice the white onion into medium-thick circular rings.
instructions.4: Separate the rings from each other.
instructions.5: Drain the potatoes after 5 minutes of boiling water soaking.
instructions.6: Season the potatoes and onion with salt and Knorr potato seasoning.
instructions.7: Prepare the egg wash by mixing 1/2 cup yogurt, salt, and black pepper.
instructions.8: Prepare the coating mixture using ground cumin, cornstarch, and Knorr vegetable mix.
instructions.9: Dip the mozzarella sticks into the egg wash, then into the coating mixture twice to ensure full coverage.
instructions.10: Place the mozzarella sticks in the freezer for a short time.
instructions.11: Dip the onion rings into the egg wash, then into the coating mixture twice.
instructions.12: Dip the potato fries into the egg wash, then into the coating mixture twice.
instructions.13: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.14: Fry the onion rings until golden brown, then drain on a colander.
instructions.15: Fry the potato fries in the same way, then drain on a colander.
instructions.16: Fry the mozzarella sticks in very hot oil over high heat until golden brown.

title: Half-Fried Potatoes for Freezing
culturalNotes: Make sure potato slices are uniform in size for even cooking. Half-fried potatoes can be stored in the freezer for a long time without spoiling.

instructions.1: Cut potatoes into medium-thick slices, making sure all pieces are uniform in size.
instructions.2: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.3: Add potatoes to hot oil without adding salt or any spices.
instructions.4: Fry potatoes until they turn light golden brown, but do not let them turn dark brown.
instructions.5: Remove potatoes from oil and drain on a wire rack—do not place them on paper towels.
instructions.6: Let potatoes cool completely.
instructions.7: Prepare a large baking tray and place a plastic bag at the bottom.
instructions.8: Place cooled potatoes into the plastic bag, arranging them so they don’t touch each other.
instructions.9: Repeat the previous step until all potato pieces are packed, placing a layer of plastic bag between each layer of potatoes.
instructions.10: Place the tray in the freezer until potatoes are fully frozen.
instructions.11: After freezing, transfer potatoes to freezer bags and remove air before sealing.
instructions.12: Return bags to the freezer.
instructions.13: When ready to use, remove the desired amount from the freezer and fry in hot oil until golden brown.
instructions.14: Serve half-fried potatoes with spices of choice.

title: Potatoes and Eggplant with Garlic and Vinegar
culturalNotes: This dish can be served as an appetizer for lunch or dinner, or as a breakfast side with eggs, fava beans, or cheese.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into thin slices, then into sticks, then into small cubes.
instructions.2: Cut the eggplant in the same way.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.4: Add the potatoes and eggplant and fry them until lightly golden.
instructions.5: Cover and let simmer for 1 or 2 minutes until cooked through.
instructions.6: Add the garlic and salt and mash them well.
instructions.7: Add the red pepper, green pepper, tomatoes, cumin, and stir briefly.
instructions.8: Add the vinegar and stir well.
instructions.9: Cover and let simmer for 1 minute.
instructions.10: Chop the fresh parsley and sprinkle over the dish while hot.

title: Potato Pancakes
culturalNotes: Potato pancakes can be served with pickles, boiled eggs, and bread. This meal is suitable for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and wash them.
instructions.2: Slice the potatoes into thin or medium rounds.
instructions.3: Place the potatoes in boiling water with salt and cumin, and cook until tender.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and let it simmer until the potatoes are soft but not mushy.
instructions.5: In a bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, salt, pepper, cumin, seven-spice mix, paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder.
instructions.6: Gradually add water until you get a medium consistency batter.
instructions.7: Dip the potato slices into the batter.
instructions.8: Fry the potato slices in hot oil over medium heat until golden brown.
instructions.9: Flip the pancakes to the other side and fry until golden brown.
instructions.10: Cook until the pancakes puff up and turn golden brown.
instructions.11: Drain the pancakes on paper towels to remove excess oil.

title: Crispy Bani with Tomato Sauce and Macaroni
culturalNotes: You can serve the dish with a green salad or fresh bread. You can also sprinkle some grated cheese on top for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Prepare the bani marinade by mixing the large yogurt can, half a cup of onion water, 1 small spoon of black pepper, a pinch of cumin, and salt. Mix well.
instructions.2: Add 1 small spoon of chili powder if you prefer heat.
instructions.3: Add the well-drained bani to the marinade and mix thoroughly. Let it rest for 2 hours.
instructions.4: In another pot, add a little oil and sauté the onions until golden, then add garlic and sauté until golden.
instructions.5: Add half a kilo of chopped tomatoes, one packet or cube of instant stock, black pepper, cumin, parsley, 2 large spoons of sesame paste, and mix well.
instructions.6: Add salt and a pinch of sugar, then cover the pot and let it simmer.
instructions.7: Add 1 large cup of boiling water and let it boil for 2 minutes.
