culturalNotes: You can add any sliced meats such as pastrami or diced chicken if available. This dish can be served for breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

instructions.1: Cut the pita bread into small pieces and set aside.
instructions.2: In a bowl, beat the eggs with milk, salt, and black pepper.
instructions.3: Add the chopped tomatoes and bell pepper to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.4: Heat the butter in a pan over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and sauté until soft.
instructions.5: Pour the egg mixture (with tomatoes and bell pepper) into the pan with the onion and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the pita bread pieces to the mixture, then top with grated cheese and oregano.
instructions.7: Cover the pan and cook on low heat until the cheese is melted.

title: Fajita with Falafel
culturalNotes: Serve hot with a green salad or your choice of side dish. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Melt the butter in a pan and brush it over pita bread or tortillas. Cut the bread into cubes and bake in the oven at 220°C for 10 minutes until crispy.
instructions.2: In a pot, heat the oil and butter. Add the onion, laurel leaf, cinnamon stick, and cumin. Add the rice and stir well. Pour in the broth or water and chicken stock. Cover and simmer until the rice is fully cooked.
instructions.3: In a bowl, mix tahini, yogurt, dill, cumin, parsley, vinegar, and water until smooth and well blended.
instructions.4: Slice the chicken breasts thinly. Mix with minced garlic, hummus, vinegar, lemon juice, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, chili pepper, oregano, cumin, parsley, black pepper, and salt. Let the chicken marinate for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Slice the onion and bell peppers thinly. Sauté in a pan until golden brown.
instructions.6: In the same pan, cook the marinated chicken until golden brown. Add the sautéed onions and peppers and stir together.
instructions.7: In a large serving dish, layer toasted pita, rice, and the chicken with roasted vegetables. Pour the sauce over the top and garnish with dried parsley.
instructions.8: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a small pan. Add chili or paprika and stir. Pour the mixture over the dish.

title: Eid Fatta - Mixed Skillet
culturalNotes: Additional ingredients can be added as desired. The skillet can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Cut the sujuk in half and separate the pieces.
instructions.2: Slice the hot and sweet peppers and onion thinly.
instructions.3: Mix the kofta and shape into balls.
instructions.4: Heat oil in a skillet.
instructions.5: Add the heart first and fry until golden brown.
instructions.6: Move the heart to the side of the skillet to finish cooking.
instructions.7: Add the kisra and fry until golden brown.
instructions.8: Add the liver and fry until cooked through.
instructions.9: Add the onion and peppers and stir well.
instructions.10: Add salt, black pepper, and cumin, and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.11: Serve the skillet hot with desserts.

title: Chicken Fatta
culturalNotes: You can use any type of bread available instead of Syrian bread. You can also add some chopped parsley to the fatta sauce for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Heat oil and butter in a pot over medium heat, then add cloves and washed, drained rice. Sauté the rice until it glistens and is well heated.
instructions.2: Add salt and stir rice thoroughly. Add boiling water (1 cup water for every 1 cup rice) and instant stock cube. Cover the pot and let the rice boil, then flip it, reduce heat, and simmer until fully cooked.
instructions.3: Toast the Syrian or baladi bread in the oven after brushing it with clarified butter. Cut the bread into small cubes.
instructions.4: Mix the washed and drained chicken with Knorr's kofta mix. Shape the chicken into small balls.
instructions.5: Heat a pot over high heat and add butter. Add the chicken balls and sauté until browned on all sides. Add half a cup of boiling water, cover the pot, and simmer the chicken on low heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.6: Prepare the fatta sauce: crush garlic with salt, then add tahini, vinegar, lemon juice, cumin, parsley, and yogurt. Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.7: Assemble the fatta: place the rice in a serving dish, then arrange the toasted bread around the rice. Place the chicken balls on top of the rice and pour the fatta sauce over everything. Sprinkle with fresh green parsley.
instructions.8: Serve the fatta hot.

title: Chicken Kofta Fatta
culturalNotes: You can use any type of rice instead of basmati rice. You can also add toasted nuts and chopped parsley as desired for garnish.

instructions.1: Prepare the kofta: Mix ground chicken breast with chopped parsley, chopped coriander, crushed breadcrumbs, chopped onion, minced garlic, paprika, black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, and salt.
instructions.2: Knead the ingredients thoroughly until the mixture becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.3: Shape the mixture into small, evenly sized balls.
instructions.4: Fry the kofta in oil over medium heat until golden brown.
instructions.5: Add water to the kofta and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes until fully cooked.
instructions.6: Prepare the rice: Rinse the rice thoroughly and drain.
instructions.7: Heat oil in a pot and add cinnamon stick, cloves, cassia stick, turmeric, stock, and salt.
instructions.8: Add the rice and stir well to coat with the spices.
instructions.9: Add boiling water (2 cups per 1 cup of rice) and simmer on low heat until the rice is fully cooked.
instructions.10: Prepare the sauce: Mix mayonnaise, yogurt, minced garlic, salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
instructions.11: Toast the pita bread in the oven until golden and crispy.
instructions.12: Serve the fatta: Place a layer of rice in the serving dish, then add the kofta on top.
instructions.13: Drizzle the sauce over the kofta and rice.
instructions.14: Sprinkle the toasted pita bread on top of the kofta and rice.
instructions.15: You can add toasted nuts and chopped parsley as desired.

title: Zahkani Breakfast: Grilled Chicken, Saffron Basmati Rice, and Tamarind Juice with Yogurt
culturalNotes: You can add sliced cucumber, tomato, and parsley as a side sauce to serve with the chicken and rice.

instructions.1: Wash the chicken breasts and cut them into small pieces.
instructions.2: Mix the chicken with yogurt, oil, and shish tawook mix, and stir well.
instructions.3: Place the chicken in the refrigerator for 15 minutes.
instructions.4: In a pot on the stove, heat the ghee and oil until hot.
instructions.5: Add the cinnamon sticks, cloves, cassia buds, laurel leaf, and black pepper, and sauté on medium heat until fragrant.
instructions.6: Add the washed and drained rice, and stir well over heat until warmed through.
instructions.7: Add the instant stock and salt, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.8: Pour in hot water (4 cups per 1 cup of rice), and stir the rice well.
instructions.9: Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low, cover the pot.
instructions.10: After 10 minutes, add the raisins and saffron powder to half of the pot, and stir well.
instructions.11: Cover the pot and let the rice cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
instructions.12: Place a hot coal on a heat-resistant plate, add two drops of oil, cover the pot, and let it sit for 5 minutes.
instructions.13: On a grill over heat, place the chicken pieces and grill until golden brown.
instructions.14: Remove seeds from tamarind, add to milk, and mix in tamarind paste.
instructions.15: Blend the mixture until smooth, then pour into glasses.
instructions.16: Serve the grilled chicken and saffron basmati rice with tamarind juice mixed with yogurt.

title: Happiness Breakfast Without Bread
culturalNotes: Make sure the heat is high and the pan does not stick. You can add other ingredients to the filling as desired.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with salt and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg, water, and milk, and knead the ingredients thoroughly until the dough becomes smooth and lump-free.
instructions.3: Strain the dough if it contains lumps.
instructions.4: Heat the pan on high heat and grease it lightly with oil.
instructions.5: Place a scoop of dough into the pan and flip it until both sides are golden brown.
instructions.6: Repeat the process until all the dough is used up.
instructions.7: Prepare the filling by mashing the potatoes with potato spices, feta cheese, colorful peppers, green pepper, and green onion.
instructions.8: Add salt to taste and mix the filling well.
instructions.9: Fill the dough with the mixture and fold it into a pouch shape.
instructions.10: Fry it in a tablespoon of butter until golden brown.
instructions.11: Serve hot.

title: Restaurant-Style Breakfast: French Coffee and Cheese Croissant
culturalNotes: You can use any type of cheese available at home to garnish the croissant. You can also add some dried fruits or honey to the coffee for extra flavor.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix 1/2 teaspoon of coffee beans with 1 1/4 teaspoons of coffee.
instructions.2: Add 1/2 cup of water and 1/2 cup of milk, then stir the ingredients well.
instructions.3: Place the mixture on low heat and stir once halfway through cooking.
instructions.4: When the coffee starts to boil, add the caramel chocolate cube and pour the hot coffee over it to help it melt.
instructions.5: Meanwhile, prepare the cheese croissant. Place 1 slice of egg cheese or cream cheese on the croissant.
instructions.6: Serve the croissant with French coffee, and cucumber and tomato slices as garnish.

title: Quick Breakfast: Feta Cheese Sandwiches with Yogurt Tea
culturalNotes: You can add other ingredients like tomatoes or parsley according to preference. The dough can be stored in the refrigerator for up to one day.

instructions.1: Prepare yogurt tea: In a pot, combine 1 cup water and 1 cup yogurt. Add 2 tea bags and 1 teaspoon of sugar. Simmer on low heat for 5 minutes, then remove from heat.
instructions.2: Prepare the dough: In a bowl, mix half a cup of flour with 1/4 cup of water, a pinch of salt, a pinch of sugar, 1 egg, and 1 tablespoon of oil. Beat thoroughly until the dough is smooth and lump-free.
instructions.3: Heat a pan over medium heat. Add a small amount of oil and spread it evenly. Pour a small amount of dough into the pan and cook until golden and puffed.
instructions.4: Flip the dough when it starts to turn golden, then place feta cheese on one side and fold it over. Cook until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
instructions.5: Serve the sandwiches with yogurt tea, cucumber, and olives.

title: Quick Breakfast Fattoush Without Oven or Kneading
culturalNotes: Serve the fattoush with any drink, such as tea with milk. Use any type of cheese you have available.

fah-427-i7.name: Feta or cheddar or mozzarella cheese

instructions.1: Place the pan on the stove and add 1 tablespoon of butter.
instructions.2: Add pieces of pastirma and cook until browned.
instructions.3: In another bowl, beat the eggs and add salt and black pepper.
instructions.4: Pour the egg mixture over the pastirma in the pan and let it set slightly.
instructions.5: Place shawarma bread or tortilla on top of the egg mixture.
instructions.6: Add cheese, hot or mild pepper, and olive on top of the bread.
instructions.7: Place another piece of bread on top and press firmly to hold all ingredients together.
instructions.8: Gently flip the fattoush to brown the other side.
instructions.9: Cook until crispy on both sides and the cheese is melted inside.

title: Quick Breakfast Feteer
culturalNotes: You can use a small skillet and prepare the mixture in two batches if the skillet is too small. You can also add cheese to taste.

instructions.1: Wash the potatoes and grate them finely.
instructions.2: Squeeze out excess water from the grated potatoes.
instructions.3: Place the potatoes in a deep bowl.
instructions.4: Add the eggs, milk, salt, pepper, baking powder, and flour.
instructions.5: Mix thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.6: Heat a 28 cm skillet over medium heat.
instructions.7: Add 1 tablespoon of butter and let it melt and heat up.
instructions.8: Pour the mixture into the skillet and spread it evenly.
instructions.9: Cover the skillet and cook until golden brown on the bottom.
instructions.10: Flip the feteer and cook the other side until golden brown.
instructions.11: Sprinkle grated cheese on top if desired.
instructions.12: Cover again and cook until the cheese melts.
instructions.13: Transfer the feteer to a serving plate.
instructions.14: Garnish with chopped parsley or green onion.
instructions.15: Cut into triangular pieces like pizza.

title: Pizza Boats with Economical Dough
culturalNotes: The boats can be frozen and used as needed. They can be served for breakfast or dinner.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, yeast, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt or dry yogurt and oil, and mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Gradually add the warm water until the dough becomes soft and slightly sticky.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for at least 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
instructions.5: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, until doubled in size.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into egg-sized balls and cover them with a clean cloth.
instructions.7: Roll each ball into an oval shape, spread with labneh, then add the filling (cheese, pastirma, olives, tomatoes, peppers).
instructions.8: Seal the edges to form the boats.
instructions.9: Place the boats on an oiled baking tray, lightly dusted with flour.
instructions.10: Brush the boats with the mixture of egg, milk, Nescafe, and sugar.
instructions.11: Let the boats rise again for 10 minutes.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.13: Serve hot with your favorite sauce.

title: Kunafa Kebab with Shawarma
culturalNotes: Kunafa kebabs with shawarma can be served hot or cold. They can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix the shredded chicken with the shawarma seasoning and 3 spoons of oil, then refrigerate for 15 minutes.
instructions.2: Mix half a cup of oil with the kunafa and stir well.
instructions.3: Place the kunafa into muffin molds and brush with ghee.
instructions.4: Bake in the oven at 180°C for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.5: Mix tahini with water, lemon juice, and garlic, then add mayonnaise and yogurt. Stir well.
instructions.6: In a pan over heat, add the shawarma with onions, red pepper, yellow pepper, and parsley. Stir well.
instructions.7: Add salt and pepper to taste.
instructions.8: Remove the kunafa from the oven and let it cool slightly.
instructions.9: Fill the kunafa with the sauce, then with the shawarma.
instructions.10: Drizzle with sweet sauce on top.

title: Chicken Casserole
culturalNotes: You can add yellow beans, red beans, and mushrooms to taste for extra flavor. Serve the casserole with tomato sauce or spicy sauce.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts into small cubes.
instructions.2: Chop the onion, bell peppers, and tomatoes into small pieces.
instructions.3: Mix salt, black pepper, oregano, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder in a bowl.
instructions.4: Place the chicken pieces in the marinade and let sit for 15 minutes.
instructions.5: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.6: Add the chicken pieces and stir-fry until fully cooked.
instructions.7: Add the onion and stir until softened.
instructions.8: Add the bell peppers and tomatoes, and stir for 2 minutes.
instructions.9: Remove the mixture from heat and set aside.
instructions.10: Reheat the pan and add a small amount of oil.
instructions.11: Place the flatbread in the pan and sprinkle a little cheese on top.
instructions.12: Add a portion of the chicken mixture onto the bread.
instructions.13: Sprinkle more cheese on top.
instructions.14: Press down on the bread and flip it until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.15: Serve the casserole hot.

title: Potato Kibbeh
culturalNotes: Kibbeh can be frozen after shaping and used later. Kibbeh is perfect for iftar during Ramadan or for lunch.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes thoroughly until fully cooked.
instructions.2: Drain the potatoes and mash them well.
instructions.3: Add cornstarch and salt to the mashed potatoes and mix thoroughly until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.4: Add more cornstarch if the dough is too soft or sticky.
instructions.5: Prepare the filling using the minced meat.
instructions.6: Shape the dough into small balls.
instructions.7: Open each ball and fill it with minced meat.
instructions.8: Seal the kibbeh tightly and shape them.
instructions.9: Fry the kibbeh in hot oil until golden brown.
instructions.10: Serve the kibbeh on a bed of parsley with your preferred sauce.

title: Pizza and Chocolate Balls
culturalNotes: You can add any fillings you prefer inside the pizza balls. You can also serve the balls with tomato sauce or any other sauce you like.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar, salt, and dry milk powder in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the yogurt and mayonnaise, and knead the ingredients well.
instructions.3: Slowly add the warm water until you get a firm and soft dough.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Mix the tomato sauce, ketchup, onion powder, garlic powder, and oregano to prepare the pizza sauce.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into small balls and shape them.
instructions.7: Roll each ball on a floured surface and place one teaspoon of pizza sauce in the center.
instructions.8: Add your favorite fillings (such as peppers, tomatoes, olives, cheese, or basturma) and close the balls.
instructions.9: Place the balls on an oiled baking tray and let them rise for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush the tops of the balls with the mixture of dry milk powder, sugar, Nescafé, and water.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20-25 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.12: Remove the balls from the oven and serve hot.

title: Crispy Chicken Rolls
culturalNotes: The rolls can be frozen after coating with crispy crumbs and before frying. When ready to serve, remove from freezer and fry until golden brown.

instructions.1: Prepare the chicken: Cut chicken breasts into small pieces and place in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the spices: Add onion powder, garlic powder, black pepper, smoked paprika, chili flakes, instant stock powder, ginger powder, clove, and 1 tablespoon of salt. Mix well.
instructions.3: Pound the chicken: Place the chicken in a food processor and add half of the spice mix. Pulse until finely minced.
instructions.4: Prepare the rolls: Spread the minced chicken evenly on tortilla bread, forming a thin layer. Roll up tightly.
instructions.5: Cut the rolls: Use a sharp knife to cut the rolls into small pieces.
instructions.6: Prepare the batter: In a bowl, mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, remaining spices, ricotta cheese, and salt. Gradually add water until you get a thick consistency.
instructions.7: Coat the rolls: Dip the rolls into the batter, then coat with crispy crumbs.
instructions.8: Fry the rolls: Fry in hot, deep oil until golden brown.
instructions.9: Prepare the sauce: Mix pickled cucumber, mayonnaise, ketchup, onion powder, garlic powder, sugar, and black pepper.
instructions.10: Serve: Serve the rolls hot with the sauce.

title: Shawarma Roll with Crispy Crust
culturalNotes: You can use any flatbread instead of tortilla bread. You can also add other vegetables such as tomatoes or fresh cucumber for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Mix the Syrian shawarma mix with 3 tablespoons of oil in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the chicken slices and stir well.
instructions.3: Let the chicken marinate for 1 hour.
instructions.4: Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a pan, then add the shawarma once the oil is hot.
instructions.5: Stir the shawarma occasionally until golden brown.
instructions.6: Prepare the sandwich sauce: mix 4 tablespoons of mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons of ketchup, a pinch of onion powder, a pinch of garlic powder, and 2 tablespoons of pickled cucumber.
instructions.7: Place a spoonful of sauce on a tortilla, then add the shawarma, fried potatoes, and cheese.
instructions.8: Roll the tortilla to form a roll and secure with toothpicks.
instructions.9: Prepare the egg and milk mixture, then dip the roll into it.
instructions.10: Dip the roll into breadcrumbs or crushed pita.
instructions.11: Heat oil in a pan over high heat and fry the roll until golden brown.
instructions.12: Drain the roll from excess oil and serve with fried potatoes and leftover sauce.

title: Vegetable Crepes
culturalNotes: You can add any other vegetables according to preference. Serve the crepes with tomato sauce or white sauce.

instructions.1: Mix the warm milk with sugar and yeast, then let it rest aside for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Mix the potatoes with black pepper, salt, and oregano.
instructions.3: Add the warm milk and yeast mixture to the potatoes and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the flour and baking powder and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Add the oil and mix the dough well.
instructions.6: Add the cheese, tomatoes, black olives, pepper, and finely chopped sausage, and mix well.
instructions.7: Heat a pan over medium heat and lightly grease it with oil.
instructions.8: Scoop a portion of the dough into the pan and spread it evenly.
instructions.9: Cook until golden on one side, then flip and cook the other side.
instructions.10: Place cheese on half of the crepe and fold it closed.
instructions.11: Repeat the process until all the dough is used up.

title: Koshari
culturalNotes: Make sure the lentils are soaked for one hour before starting to cook. You can reduce the ingredient quantities according to the number of people you wish to serve. Koshari can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Slice the white onion thinly and mix with salt and cornstarch, then toss well.
instructions.2: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat, then add the onions and fry until golden brown.
instructions.3: Remove the fried onions and spread them on paper towels, separating them to cool.
instructions.4: In a small pan, add a little oil and sauté the minced garlic until golden.
instructions.5: Add the freshly squeezed tomatoes, red bell pepper, instant stock cube, sugar, tomato paste, cumin, black pepper, and dried parsley, then stir well.
instructions.6: Add one cup of boiling water and let the sauce thicken.
instructions.7: In the same oil, add the vermicelli and fry until lightly browned.
instructions.8: Add the rice and stir with the vermicelli until lightly toasted.
instructions.9: Add the soaked lentils to the boiling water and mix everything together.
instructions.10: Add the small pasta and mix with the rest of the ingredients.
instructions.11: Add boiling water until the ingredients are covered by about 2 cm, then bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.12: Stir well, cover the pot, and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes.
instructions.13: In a separate pan, combine water, minced garlic, chopped chili, cumin, dried parsley, salt, vinegar, and lemon juice, then bring to a boil.
instructions.14: Remove from heat and set aside in a separate bowl.
instructions.15: Serve Koshari hot, topped with the sauce, fried onions, the spicy sauce, and lemon wedges.

title: Potato Kofta with Cheese
culturalNotes: Kofta can be frozen and used as needed. Leftover chicken or ground meat can be used instead of pastrami.

instructions.1: Boil potatoes with their peels on, then peel and mash them.
instructions.2: Dice the bell peppers into small cubes.
instructions.3: Sauté the pastrami in 1 tablespoon of butter.
instructions.4: Mix the mashed potatoes with the cheeses, diced bell peppers, sautéed pastrami, and seasonings (salt and pepper).
instructions.5: Spread the mixture onto a greased baking sheet or plastic wrap-lined tray.
instructions.6: Refrigerate for 1 hour or freeze for 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Cut the mixture into desired shapes (such as small cylinders).
instructions.8: Dip each piece into flour, then beaten egg mixed with cornstarch and yogurt, then coat with breadcrumbs.
instructions.9: Fry the kofta in hot oil until golden brown.
instructions.10: Serve the kofta hot.

title: Kofta with Cheese and Vegetables
culturalNotes: You can use any type of cooked white rice, and you can skip the cheese if unavailable. You can also use Knorr spicy vegetables for a spicy flavor.

instructions.1: Wash and finely chop the boiled chicken, then mix with salt, black pepper, onion powder, chopped parsley, and chopped green onion.
instructions.2: Add the cooked white rice and mix all ingredients until well combined.
instructions.3: Add the egg and mix again until the mixture becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.4: Shape the kofta into evenly sized balls and place a cube of cheese in the center if desired.
instructions.5: Reform the kofta to completely cover the cheese.
instructions.6: Place the kofta in a deep bowl and dip them into milk.
instructions.7: Dip the kofta into a mixture of crushed crackers, cornstarch, and Knorr vegetables.
instructions.8: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and add the kofta.
instructions.9: Fry the kofta, turning occasionally, until golden and crispy.
instructions.10: Serve the kofta on a bed of chopped parsley.

title: Kofta with Rice in One Pot
culturalNotes: You can use any type of rice, but Toldeo rice gives a distinctive flavor and excellent taste. You can also add a bit of lemon juice for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Mix the ground beef with cornstarch, salt, black pepper, seven-spice mix, and finely grated onion.
instructions.2: Knead the mixture well until it becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.3: Shape the mixture into small meatballs.
instructions.4: Heat oil in a large pot and add the meatballs. Cook until browned on all sides.
instructions.5: Remove the meatballs from the pot and set them aside on a separate plate.
instructions.6: Add Toldeo mushrooms, onion, sugar, and carrot to the pot. Cook until they are well sautéed.
instructions.7: Add raisins, spices, salt, black pepper, cinnamon stick, and instant stock cube. Stir well to combine.
instructions.8: Soak the Toldeo rice in water for 30 minutes, then drain.
instructions.9: Add the soaked rice to the pot and stir to mix with the other ingredients.
instructions.10: Return the meatballs to the pot. Pour in boiling water until it covers the rice and meatballs completely.
instructions.11: Cover the pot and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.12: Stir the rice and meatballs once, then cover again and reduce heat.
instructions.13: Simmer on low heat until the rice is fully cooked and the mixture is well combined.
instructions.14: Serve the kofta with rice hot, garnished with fresh parsley.

title: Spicy Kofta with Baked Potatoes and Unleavened Bread
culturalNotes: You can store the bread in an airtight plastic bag for up to 3 days in the refrigerator. You can serve the sandwiches with tomato sauce or spicy sauce according to preference.

instructions.1: Prepare the bread: Mix flour, yeast, salt, sugar, and dry milk powder in a bowl. Gradually add warm water and knead for 10 minutes until the dough becomes smooth and elastic. Cover the dough and let it rise.
instructions.2: Prepare the potatoes: Wash the potatoes thoroughly and cut them in half. Boil them in salted boiling water until slightly soft. In another bowl, mix oil, onion powder, garlic powder, oregano, paprika, salt, black pepper, cumin, parsley, and chili. Add the potatoes to the mixture and toss well.
instructions.3: Prepare the kofta: Mix ground meat, chopped onion, and kofta mix in a bowl. Shape the mixture into kofta balls using your hands.
instructions.4: Bake the bread: Roll out the dough on a floured surface to a thickness of less than half a centimeter. Cut the bread into desired sizes and place on a baking tray. Bake in a preheated oven at high heat until cooked through.
instructions.5: Grill the kofta: Place the kofta in the oven at high heat until fully cooked.
instructions.6: Bake the potatoes: Place the potatoes in the oven at high heat until cooked and crispy.
instructions.7: Prepare the salad: Chop tomatoes, onion, and bell pepper into small cubes. Add the dukha dressing and mix all ingredients well.
instructions.8: Serve the sandwiches: Open the bread and place the cooked kofta, crispy potatoes, and salad inside.

title: Savory Cake
culturalNotes: You can add pastrami or diced chicken breast to the mixture for extra flavor. Serve the cake warm or cold—it's perfect for breakfast or dinner.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs with sugar and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add 0.5 cup of oil and dry yogurt or yogurt, then mix well.
instructions.3: In another bowl, mix the flour with baking powder.
instructions.4: Gradually add the flour mixture to the egg mixture and stir until well combined.
instructions.5: Add half of the sliced olives and half of the chopped cheese to the mixture and mix thoroughly.
instructions.6: Pour the mixture into a greased and floured baking pan.
instructions.7: Sprinkle the remaining olives and cheese on top.
instructions.8: Place the pan in a preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.9: Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown.
instructions.10: Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.

title: Pizza Box Lunch
culturalNotes: You can add any additional ingredients as desired, such as mushrooms or sweet peppers. The meals can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Cut the potatoes into cubes and fry them until golden.
instructions.2: Chop the bell pepper and add it to the potatoes.
instructions.3: Add ground beef or turkey along with oregano and garlic powder.
instructions.4: Add Roma sauce, ketchup, and mozzarella cheese; mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.5: Fill the potato mixture into cupcake molds and arrange them on a baking tray.
instructions.6: Place the tray in a preheated oven at the highest temperature for 10 minutes, until the cheese melts.
instructions.7: In a bowl, mix yogurt, oil, egg, salt, and sugar.
instructions.8: Add Roma spice mix, baking powder, oregano, olives, and meat; mix all ingredients well.
instructions.9: Fill the muffin mixture into cupcake molds up to two-thirds full and arrange them on a baking tray.
instructions.10: Place the tray in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes.
instructions.11: Sprinkle nigella seeds on top before placing in the oven.
instructions.12: In a bowl, mix Roma sauce, ketchup, onion powder, garlic powder, and oregano.
instructions.13: Brush the tortillas with the mixture and add ground beef or turkey and mozzarella cheese.
instructions.14: Roll up the tortillas and cut them into slices.
instructions.15: Serve the meals in lunch boxes.

title: Vegetable and Cheese Feta Muffins
culturalNotes: You can add any other ingredients you prefer to make the muffins more varied and nutritious. This recipe is perfect for breakfast or a light snack.

instructions.1: Cut the Fino bread into small cubes.
instructions.2: Add 1/2 cup of yogurt, 1 tablespoon of butter, 2 tablespoons of cream cheese, salt, black pepper, and 1 tablespoon of oregano. Mix ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the cubed bread to the mixture.
instructions.4: Add your favorite vegetables (bell peppers, parsley, olives), meats (pastirma, Turkish chicken pieces), and grated cheese. Mix well.
instructions.5: Fill muffin molds with the mixture. You can also use a single baking pan lined with butter or ghee and flour.
instructions.6: Place the molds in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius.
instructions.7: Bake the muffins for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
instructions.8: Serve the muffins warm with your favorite drink.

title: Savory Muffins
culturalNotes: You can add different types of cheese such as feta or mozzarella according to preference. You can also use leftover cheese from the fridge to make use of it.

fah-445-i14.name: Chicken pieces or meat or meatballs

instructions.1: Mix the eggs with salt and black pepper in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the vinegar and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the oil and milk and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the baking powder and flour and stir until the mixture is well combined.
instructions.5: Add the tomatoes, olives, parsley, and cheese and stir well.
instructions.6: Add chicken pieces or meat or meatballs if desired.
instructions.7: Fill the muffin molds with the mixture.
instructions.8: Place the molds in the preheated oven at 170°C for 10-15 minutes.
instructions.9: Check the muffins' readiness with a toothpick.

title: Crispy Potatoes
culturalNotes: Crispy potatoes can be served with various dips such as ketchup or mayonnaise. They can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes in boiling water until tender.
instructions.2: Mash the potatoes while still hot.
instructions.3: Add the cornstarch and seasonings (turmeric, paprika, salt, pepper, chili) to the mashed potatoes and mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add an extra tablespoon of cornstarch if the dough feels sticky.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into small cylinders and cut into small pieces.
instructions.6: Use a fork to make marks on the surface of the pieces.
instructions.7: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.8: Fry the crisps until golden brown.
instructions.9: Place the crisps on paper towels to absorb excess oil.

title: Eggplant and Chicken Mujadara
culturalNotes: You can add boiled chickpeas for sweetness. You can also garnish the dish with toasted nuts for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Wash the chicken and cut it into small pieces.
instructions.3: Season the chicken with cinnamon, cloves, black pepper, mint, cumin, bay leaves, and mix well.
instructions.4: Add the chopped onion, tomatoes, carrots, sugar, salt, stock cube, and boiling water. Cover the chicken and simmer on low heat until cooked through.
instructions.5: In another bowl, peel the eggplant and potatoes and cut them into thick slices.
instructions.6: Sprinkle a pinch of salt over the eggplant and toss, then let it sit in a colander to drain excess water.
instructions.7: Fry the potatoes in hot oil over high heat until golden brown, then drain.
instructions.8: Fry the eggplant in hot oil until golden brown, then drain.
instructions.9: Drain the chicken from the broth and sauté it in a pan with 1 tablespoon of ghee.
instructions.10: Rinse the rice and soak it for 30 minutes, then drain. Season the rice with salt, black pepper, turmeric, curry powder, and cinnamon, and mix well.
instructions.11: Layer the pot starting with a layer of tomato and onion slices, then rice, then chicken, then eggplant, then potatoes, then rice again. Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used.
instructions.12: Add the boiling broth to the pot so that the liquid level is twice the amount of rice used.
instructions.13: Cover the pot and bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat and simmer until the rice is fully cooked.
instructions.14: When the rice is cooked, gently invert the pot onto a serving dish.
instructions.15: Serve hot with toasted nuts if desired.

title: Chicken Fajita Pasta
culturalNotes: You can add a chili pepper if you prefer a spicier dish. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Cut the chicken breasts into thin slices.
instructions.2: Marinate the chicken with 1 tablespoon of garlic, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, black pepper, salt, 1 teaspoon of onion powder, 1 teaspoon of garlic powder, and 2 tablespoons of vinegar. Mix well and let it sit for 30 minutes.
instructions.3: Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a pan over medium heat, then add the chicken pieces and stir-fry until fully cooked.
instructions.4: Slice the onion and colorful bell peppers into thin pieces.
instructions.5: In the same pan, add the sliced onion and bell peppers and stir-fry for 5 minutes until the onion turns golden.
instructions.6: Add the instant broth and 1 tablespoon of flour, and stir well.
instructions.7: Add 2 tablespoons of sauce and 1/2 liter of boiling water, and stir until the sauce thickens.
instructions.8: Return the chicken to the pan and mix with the vegetables and sauce.
instructions.9: Boil the pasta in salted boiling water until cooked through, then drain and add to the pan. Stir over medium heat for 2–3 minutes.
instructions.10: Serve hot, garnished with a sprinkle of fresh parsley.

title: Pasta with Cheese in the Microwave
culturalNotes: You can add black pepper to taste for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Mix the pasta with water and salt in a microwave-safe bowl.
instructions.2: Place the bowl in the microwave and heat for 2 minutes.
instructions.3: Remove from the microwave and add the yogurt and crumbled cheese, then mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Place the bowl back in the microwave and heat for 3 more minutes.

title: Spaghetti with Shrimp and White Sauce
culturalNotes: Serve hot with a green salad or fresh bread. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Put water in a pot, add salt and oil, then boil the spaghetti for 6 minutes.
instructions.2: Drain the spaghetti after boiling.
instructions.3: Chop celery, parsley, bell peppers, and green onions into small pieces.
instructions.4: In another pot, add shrimp and sauté with minced garlic, celery, and green onions.
instructions.5: Add flour and stir well until the mixture becomes dry.
instructions.6: Add the pasta cooking water, salt, and pepper, then stir until the mixture boils.
instructions.7: Add milk and stir until the consistency becomes smooth and even.
instructions.8: Add the spaghetti to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.9: Transfer the mixture into a baking dish, then sprinkle cheese on top.
instructions.10: Bake in the oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 10 minutes.

title: Spaghetti with Steak and Onion and a Dangerous Sauce
culturalNotes: You can add cream if you prefer a thicker sauce. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the oil and butter in a pan over high heat.
instructions.2: Add the steak and stir until it turns golden on all sides.
instructions.3: Add salt and black pepper and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the minced garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.5: Add the onion and stir until golden and soft.
instructions.6: Add the sugar and stir well.
instructions.7: Add the demiglace powder and stir well.
instructions.8: Add boiling water and let it boil.
instructions.9: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water for 10 minutes until half-done.
instructions.10: Add the spaghetti to the sauce and stir well.
instructions.11: Add the pasta cooking water to enhance the consistency.
instructions.12: Add the crushed pepper and stir well.
instructions.13: Serve hot.

title: Chicken Pasta
culturalNotes: You can add more spinach according to preference. You can also serve the dish with a green salad or fresh bread.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the pasta and sauté until golden brown.
instructions.3: Add the washed and drained chicken pieces and brown them until golden.
instructions.4: Add the chopped onion and minced garlic, and sauté until golden.
instructions.5: Add cumin, parsley, pepper, and salt, and stir well.
instructions.6: Add spinach and crushed tomatoes, and let the mixture simmer for 5 minutes.
instructions.7: Add tomato sauce and instant broth, cover the pot, and bring to a boil.
instructions.8: After boiling, add the pasta, cover the pot again, and let it boil for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Stir the pasta, cover the pot once more, and let it cook for another 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Add hot pepper to taste, and let the mixture cook for 5 more minutes.
instructions.11: Serve the dish hot.

title: Pasta with Liver
culturalNotes: You can add more spices according to preference. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Blend the red pepper, garlic, and tomatoes in a blender or food processor until smooth.
instructions.2: Heat a pan or pot on the stove. Add 1 spoon of ghee and 3 tablespoons of oil. Once hot, add 1 spoon of sauce and the chopped tomatoes.
instructions.3: Add salt, pepper, cumin, parsley, and instant stock. Let the ingredients simmer together and cover.
instructions.4: Add boiling water (from a packet of boiling water). Let the mixture boil, then add the desired amount of pasta.
instructions.5: Add salt if needed, then cover the pot and let it boil. Once boiling, stir the pasta once, then reduce heat and let it cook until done.
instructions.6: Slice the liver thinly. Mix 5 cloves of garlic with a pinch of salt and crush them well.
instructions.7: Heat a frying pan on the stove. Add 2–3 tablespoons of oil. Once hot, add the garlic and fry until golden.
instructions.8: Add the liver pieces and stir until the color changes. Add the green pepper and hot pepper and stir well.
instructions.9: Season the liver with salt and pepper and stir.
instructions.10: Add a pinch of sugar to the pasta sauce.
instructions.11: When the pasta is cooked, add the liver to the sauce and mix well.
instructions.12: Serve hot.

title: Pasta in One Pot
culturalNotes: You can increase the sauce quantity as desired. You can also add more boiling water if the pasta needs additional cooking time.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the onion, bell pepper, and chopped tomatoes, and stir for 1 minute.
instructions.3: Add the stock cube, salt, black pepper, cumin, and parsley, and stir well.
instructions.4: Pour in the boiling water, cover the pot, and simmer for 7–10 minutes on low heat.
instructions.5: Add the pasta, stir well, then let it simmer for 3–5 minutes until cooked through.
instructions.6: Remove the pot from the heat and serve hot.

title: Spaghetti with White Sauce and Shrimp
culturalNotes: You can add chopped green or red peppers to enhance flavor and color. Leftovers can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Boil water in a pot and add salt, then add spaghetti and cook until tender.
instructions.2: In a pan, add oil and butter and heat until hot.
instructions.3: Add onion and garlic and stir until the onion turns golden.
instructions.4: Add black pepper, chili powder, and cumin and stir well.
instructions.5: Add fish stock and let it boil.
instructions.6: Add shrimp and mushrooms and cook until done.
instructions.7: Add cooking cream and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the cooked spaghetti and mix until well combined with the sauce.
instructions.9: Add chopped parsley and stir well.
instructions.10: Serve hot.

title: Chicken Kofta with White Sauce Pasta
culturalNotes: Canned mushrooms can be used if fresh ones are not available. The dish can be served with a side salad.

instructions.1: Boil the pasta until al dente.
instructions.2: Chop the chicken breasts and mix with Knorr kofta mix.
instructions.3: Mix the chicken thoroughly with the kofta mix and shape into evenly sized balls.
instructions.4: Heat a pan on the stove and add oil and butter.
instructions.5: Fry the kofta until golden brown.
instructions.6: Add the chopped onion and sauté until soft and golden.
instructions.7: Add sliced mushrooms and stir the mixture.
instructions.8: Add the Knorr stock cube, salt, and pepper.
instructions.9: Add half of the milk and stir the mixture.
instructions.10: Add the remaining milk along with the Knorr béchamel mix and stir well.
instructions.11: Add the kofta to the mixture and simmer on medium heat for 5 minutes.
instructions.12: Add the pasta to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.13: Serve the dish garnished with parsley and tomatoes.

title: Mini Cheese Sandwiches
culturalNotes: You can use different types of cheese according to preference. If you can't find date molasses, you can use black honey as a substitute.

instructions.1: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the egg, butter, warm milk, and water, and knead until the dough becomes firm and elastic.
instructions.3: Add 1 spoon of oil and mix well.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for 7–10 minutes until smooth and firm.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rise until it doubles in size.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into 20 small balls.
instructions.7: Cover the balls and let them rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Fill each ball with cheese and seal tightly.
instructions.9: Dip each ball in date molasses, then in toasted sesame seeds.
instructions.10: Flatten them slightly and place on an oiled baking tray.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at high heat until golden brown.
instructions.12: Let them cool, then cover with a clean cloth.
instructions.13: Store in plastic bags in the freezer if you wish to keep them longer.

title: Crispy and Crunchy Nuggets
culturalNotes: Nuggets can be served with ketchup or mayonnaise. Nuggets can be stored in the freezer for up to one month.

instructions.1: Crush the crispy bits lightly.
instructions.2: Place the chicken breasts in the food processor and chop until small pieces form.
instructions.3: Add paprika, black pepper, chili powder, onion powder, garlic powder, chicken seasoning, instant broth, salt, and cornstarch. Mix ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add the boiled and cooled potatoes. Mix well.
instructions.5: Prepare a mixture of eggs, cornstarch, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
instructions.6: Shape the nuggets into pieces of about 30 grams each.
instructions.7: Dip each nugget in flour, then in the egg mixture, then in the crispy bits.
instructions.8: Fry the nuggets in oil until golden brown.
instructions.9: Store the nuggets in the freezer if you wish to keep them longer.
instructions.10: Bake the potatoes in the oven for 5 minutes at 180 degrees Celsius.
instructions.11: Bake the nuggets in the oven for 15 minutes at 180 degrees Celsius, then flip and bake for another 15 minutes.

title: Potatoes with Sausage
culturalNotes: This recipe can also be used for school lunch boxes.

instructions.1: Wash the potatoes well and cut each in half, then cut each half into three pieces.
instructions.2: Boil the potatoes in boiling water with a pinch of salt for 7 minutes.
instructions.3: Drain the potatoes and transfer them to a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.4: Sprinkle a pinch of pepper, a pinch of paprika, and a pinch of thyme over the potatoes.
instructions.5: Bake in the oven at the highest temperature until the potatoes are golden brown.
instructions.6: While the potatoes are browning, mix the Parmesan cheese with the yogurt, 1 tablespoon of thyme, and 2 large spoons of olive oil.
instructions.7: Serve the crispy potatoes with the delicious dip.

title: Easy and Quick Baghara
culturalNotes: You can use caramel sauce, chocolate, or powdered sugar to serve Baghara in different ways. Baghara can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Prepare the syrup: Mix sugar and water in a pot and stir well, then place on the stove.
instructions.2: Cook the mixture over medium heat for 5 minutes until it comes to a boil.
instructions.3: Add juice from half a lemon, 1 teaspoon of vanilla, and 2 tablespoons of white honey.
instructions.4: Let the syrup boil once, then turn off the heat and allow it to cool.
instructions.5: Prepare the dough: Mix flour, cornstarch, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.6: Add oil and vanilla, and mix well.
instructions.7: Gradually add eggs and water until the dough becomes firm and smooth.
instructions.8: Knead the dough for at least 5 minutes.
instructions.9: Divide the dough into 3 balls and let them rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Roll out the dough using cornstarch until it reaches about 3 mm thickness.
instructions.11: Cut the dough into small squares.
instructions.12: Fry the squares in hot oil over medium heat until golden brown.
instructions.13: Drain Baghara from oil and let it cool.
instructions.14: Add Baghara to the cooled syrup, or dust with powdered sugar, or drizzle with caramel sauce or chocolate as desired.

title: Nutella-Stuffed Donuts
culturalNotes: You can decorate the donuts with melted chocolate or any other topping of your choice. The dough doesn't absorb much oil, so it's relatively healthy.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast with 1 teaspoon of sugar in the warm water and let it sit for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: In another bowl, combine the flour with the remaining sugar, baking powder, and salt.
instructions.3: Add the yogurt and mayonnaise to the flour mixture and knead thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add the dissolved yeast and knead until you get a soft, elastic dough.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Roll out the dough on a floured surface and cut into circles the size of a lemon.
instructions.7: Cover the dough again and let it rest for 5 minutes.
instructions.8: Roll out each pair of circles to about 0.5 cm thick, then place a small amount of Nutella in the center.
instructions.9: Seal the edges well and cut them into donut shapes using a circular cutter.
instructions.10: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat, then fry the donuts until golden brown.
instructions.11: Sprinkle powdered sugar and cinnamon over the fried donuts.

title: Mudlaja
culturalNotes: Make sure the basbousa and kunafa are completely chilled before assembling the layers. You can use any type of basbousa available. You can serve mudlaja without nuts if you prefer.

instructions.1: Prepare the basbousa:
instructions.2: Heat the milk powder in a pan over medium heat until it turns golden brown.
instructions.3: Mix the semolina (basbousa flour) with dry ingredients: salt, baking powder, and coconut.
instructions.4: Add the butter-oil mixture to the dry mix and stir until it resembles damp sand.
instructions.5: Add the milk and white honey, and stir until the mixture is well combined.
instructions.6: Grease a 26 cm baking pan with butter and spread the basbousa mixture evenly.
instructions.7: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C until the basbousa is golden brown on both top and bottom.
instructions.8: Prepare the syrup by boiling sugar and water together until it boils.
instructions.9: Pour one-third of the syrup over the basbousa.
instructions.10: Prepare the kunafa:
instructions.11: Mix the kunafa with clarified butter, local butter, and powdered sugar.
instructions.12: Bake the kunafa in the oven until it turns golden brown.
instructions.13: Pour the remaining one-quarter of the syrup over the kunafa.
instructions.14: Prepare the cream:
instructions.15: Whip the raw chantilly cream with powdered sugar and frozen liquid milk for 5–7 minutes until it reaches the desired consistency.
instructions.16: Add the jam and mix thoroughly.
instructions.17: Assemble the mudlaja:
instructions.18: Lay a layer of kunafa in the mold.
instructions.20: Crush the basbousa and spread it over the cream.
instructions.21: Add a second layer of cream.
instructions.23: Sprinkle the nuts according to preference.
instructions.24: Refrigerate the mold for 5–6 hours until firm.

title: Light and Delicious Um Ali
culturalNotes: Non-fresh phyllo dough can be used in this recipe, as it works perfectly. The dish can be served warm or cold, according to preference.

instructions.1: Unroll two sheets of phyllo dough, cut them, and arrange them in a baking dish.
instructions.2: Spread butter over the phyllo dough in the dish.
instructions.3: Bake in the oven at 180°C for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.4: Mix milk with sugar and vanilla in a bowl, and stir well.
instructions.5: After removing the dish from the oven, pour the milk mixture over it.
instructions.6: Garnish the dish with dried fruits, raisins, cardamom, and caramel sauce.
instructions.7: Serve the dish warm.

title: Basbousa with Water
culturalNotes: You can sprinkle nuts on top before serving for decoration. You can also serve basbousa with ice cream or feta cheese for better taste.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix 1/2 cup sugar with 3 tablespoons water and 2 tablespoons white honey or glucose syrup over medium heat until the mixture turns golden brown.
instructions.2: Add 1/2 cup semolina and 1 cup water, and stir well until the sugar dissolves and the mixture is smooth.
instructions.3: Remove from heat and set aside.
instructions.4: Toast 2 tablespoons powdered milk over medium heat until golden brown, then remove from heat.
instructions.5: Add 2 cups semolina flour, 1/4 teaspoon baking powder, 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour, and 2 tablespoons dried coconut. Mix thoroughly.
instructions.6: Add the previously prepared mixture and stir until fully combined.
instructions.7: Pour the batter into a 28 cm greased baking pan, and spread evenly.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.9: In another bowl, mix 1 1/2 cups sugar with 1 1/2 cups water over low heat until boiling.
instructions.10: Add 1 tablespoon butter to the syrup and stir well.
instructions.11: Immediately pour the hot syrup over the basbousa right after removing it from the oven, and let it soak in completely.
instructions.12: Cut into pieces and serve warm or cold, as preferred.
instructions.13: You can sprinkle nuts on top before serving for decoration.

title: Caramelized Basbousa
culturalNotes: Use coarse or medium semolina for the right texture. Do not overmix; stir until flour disappears. Grease the pan with tahini and ghee for a rich flavor and appealing color. Make sure the oven is preheated before baking the basbousa. Pour the hot syrup onto the basbousa immediately after removing it from the oven.

instructions.1: Heat 1 cup of sugar in a pan over low heat, then add 2 tablespoons of water until sugar dissolves.
instructions.2: Stir the sugar with a wooden spoon until it turns golden.
instructions.3: Add 2 tablespoons of white honey and mix well.
instructions.4: Add 1 cup of ghee, 1.5 cups of boiling water, and a pinch of vanilla; mix all ingredients.
instructions.5: Add 4 cups of semolina flour, 3 tablespoons of coconut, 1/2 cup of powdered milk, 2 tablespoons of all-purpose flour, and 1/4 teaspoon of baking powder; mix thoroughly.
instructions.6: Grease a 40×50 cm baking pan with 1 tablespoon of ghee and 1 tablespoon of tahini.
instructions.7: Pour the mixture into the pan and smooth the surface with a spoon.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 30 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.9: Prepare the syrup by combining 3 cups of sugar and 3 cups of water in a pan over medium heat until sugar dissolves.
instructions.10: Add 1 tablespoon of ghee to the syrup and stir well.
instructions.11: Immediately pour the hot syrup over the basbousa right after removing it from the oven.
instructions.12: Let the basbousa cool for 2 to 3 hours at room temperature, or 1 hour in the refrigerator, before cutting.

title: Eid Biscuits
culturalNotes: You can add apricot or cherry jam on the rolled biscuits for decoration and extra flavor. The biscuits can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: Mix powdered sugar and butter in a bowl until the texture becomes light and creamy.
instructions.2: Add the eggs one at a time, continuing to beat until the mixture is well combined.
instructions.3: Add the vanilla and milk and mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix the flour, salt, and baking powder.
instructions.5: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, stirring gently until the dough is well blended.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
instructions.7: Shape the biscuits using a pastry bag or by hand.
instructions.8: Place the biscuits on a greased baking tray.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.10: Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
instructions.11: Let the biscuits cool before serving.

title: Orange and Anise Cookies
culturalNotes: Store the cookies in an airtight container away from moisture to keep them crisp and delicious. You can use a cloth bag or a rolling pin to shape the cookies as desired.

instructions.1: Add the ghee to the mixer and beat until creamy.
instructions.2: Add the powdered sugar and beat the mixture for 4–5 minutes until smooth and creamy.
instructions.3: Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
instructions.4: Add the orange vanilla, salt, and baking powder, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Add the milk along with the anise and mix well.
instructions.6: Add the combined flour and cornstarch, and mix until smooth and even.
instructions.7: Knead the dough with your hands until soft and pliable.
instructions.8: Grease the baking tray with oil and place the dough on it.
instructions.9: Bake the cookies in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Let the cookies cool completely before serving.

title: Eid Biscuits in the Blender
culturalNotes: Orange zest and orange juice can be used instead of milk for a citrus flavor. The biscuits can be shaped into any form you like. The biscuits can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: Mix the warm milk and oil in the blender.
instructions.2: Add the eggs and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the sugar, cornstarch, baking powder, vanilla, and vinegar, and mix for 5 minutes until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.4: Mix the flour, baking powder, cornstarch, and salt in a separate bowl.
instructions.5: Add the liquid mixture to the dry ingredients and knead until the dough is well combined.
instructions.6: Shape the dough into your desired form.
instructions.7: Place the biscuits on a greased baking tray.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius for 10 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Chocolate Cookies
culturalNotes: Make sure the shortening is very cold before starting to mix. Use flour specifically made for cookies and pastries for the best results. Bake the cookies on the middle rack of the oven for even browning. You can coat the cookies with chocolate for serving during Eid.

instructions.1: Mix the very cold shortening with the sifted powdered sugar in a bowl for 5 minutes until the mixture becomes creamy.
instructions.2: Gradually add the eggs while continuing to beat until fully combined.
instructions.3: Add the liquid vanilla and milk and mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: In a separate bowl, mix the pastry flour, cornstarch, baking powder, sodium bicarbonate, and salt.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour mixture to the shortening and sugar mixture, gently folding with your fingertips.
instructions.6: Mix half of the dough with the cocoa powder, oil, and milk to make the chocolate dough.
instructions.7: Lightly grease the baking tray with oil and shape the dough into circles, leaving space between each piece.
instructions.8: Bake the cookies in a preheated oven at 170°C for 17 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.9: Let the cookies cool completely before removing them from the tray.

title: Plain and Chocolate Cookies
culturalNotes: Make sure the shortening is very cold when starting to mix for best results. You can decorate the cookies with melted chocolate after removing them from the oven and letting them cool.

fah-470-i6.name: Pastry flour for cookies and cakes

instructions.1: Mix the very cold shortening with the sifted powdered sugar in a bowl using an electric mixer for 5 minutes, until the mixture becomes creamy and fluffy.
instructions.2: Gradually add the eggs while continuing to beat until fully combined.
instructions.3: Add the liquid vanilla and yogurt, and mix well.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, sodium bicarbonate, and salt.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour mixture to the shortening and sugar mixture, gently folding with your hands until the dough is well combined.
instructions.6: Take half of the dough and add the cocoa powder, oil, and yogurt; mix thoroughly.
instructions.7: Lightly grease the baking tray with oil and place the dough onto it, leaving space between the pieces.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius for 17 minutes, or until the cookies turn golden brown.
instructions.9: Let the cookies cool completely before removing them from the tray.

title: Kunafa with Phyllo and Chocolate-Drizzled Phyllo Fan
culturalNotes: You can use any type of crushed nuts according to preference. Kunafa can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Heat the fine ground pistachios in a pan over medium heat and stir until golden brown.
instructions.2: Remove from heat and transfer to a bowl.
instructions.3: Add the crushed nuts, 3 tablespoons of sugar, and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon. Mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Take two sheets of phyllo dough, brush them with butter, and spread the filling evenly over them.
instructions.5: Roll them up like a log or shape them into a spiral.
instructions.6: Repeat the previous steps until all phyllo sheets are used.
instructions.7: Place the shapes into a buttered baking dish and brush the tops with butter.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.9: Prepare the phyllo fan: Cut one sheet into halves, then into quarters. Brush each piece with butter and layer them.
instructions.10: Shape into a fan and brush with butter.
instructions.11: Place the fan into a buttered baking dish and brush the top with butter.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.13: Prepare the syrup: Mix 1 cup warm yogurt with 1 cup sweetened condensed milk and stir well.
instructions.14: Pour the syrup over the kunafa immediately after removing it from the oven.
instructions.15: Remove the fan from the oven and drizzle with honey while still hot.
instructions.16: Dip the tip of the fan into melted chocolate, then into crushed nuts.
instructions.17: Arrange on a serving platter.

title: Pistachio Kunafa
culturalNotes: The filling can be stored in airtight containers in the refrigerator and used later. Kunafa can be served with coffee or tea.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling: Place roasted peanuts in a food processor, add sugar, pistachios, butter, and green food coloring. Mix thoroughly until you get a uniform mixture.
instructions.2: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
instructions.3: Place the filling mixture in an aluminum baking pan and bake for 5 minutes until slightly browned.
instructions.4: Prepare the dough: Cut the phyllo dough to fit the baking pan size. Mix butter with baking powder.
instructions.5: Lay a layer of phyllo dough in the pan and brush it with the butter and baking powder mixture. Repeat this step until half of the phyllo dough is used.
instructions.6: Spread the filling evenly over the last layer of phyllo dough.
instructions.7: Complete the second layer of phyllo dough and brush each sheet with the butter and baking powder mixture.
instructions.8: Cut the kunafa into your preferred shapes (squares or rectangles).
instructions.9: Bake in the oven at 180 degrees Celsius until golden brown on both top and bottom.
instructions.10: Prepare the syrup: Combine 1 cup sugar and 1.5 cups water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Add lemon juice and boil for 2–3 minutes. Add 2 tablespoons of white honey and let the syrup cool.
instructions.11: After removing the kunafa from the oven, immediately pour the cold syrup over it.

title: Kunafa with Cream
culturalNotes: You can use different types of nuts such as almonds or pistachios according to preference. To preserve kunafa, store it in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix 3 cups of milk with 3 tablespoons of cornstarch.
instructions.2: Cook the mixture over medium heat, stirring constantly until thickened.
instructions.3: Add the can of cream and stir well.
instructions.4: Let the mixture cool, then refrigerate it.
instructions.5: Cut the phyllo dough sheets in half and brush them with butter.
instructions.6: Place one tablespoon of filling in the center of each sheet and spread it evenly.
instructions.7: Fold the edges of the sheet over the filling and begin rolling it into a log.
instructions.8: Place the rolls in a buttered baking dish.
instructions.9: Repeat the previous steps until all the dough sheets are used.
instructions.10: Lightly brush the rolls with butter.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.12: After removing kunafa from the oven, drizzle with honey or kunafa syrup as desired.

title: Kunafa with Kunafa
culturalNotes: Different types of nuts can be used according to preference. Kunafa can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix kunafa with melted butter and powdered sugar thoroughly.
instructions.2: Cut the phyllo sheet in half lengthwise.
instructions.3: Take two phyllo sheets and place a small amount of kunafa and nuts on top.
instructions.4: Roll the kunafa and nuts into a cylindrical shape.
instructions.5: Twist the roll around itself to form a rose shape.
instructions.6: Arrange the roses in a greased baking tray.
instructions.7: Brush the roses lightly with melted butter.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 20 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.9: Sprinkle 1 cup of yogurt over the kunafa right after removing from the oven.
instructions.10: Drizzle with honey or cold syrup.

title: Kunafa with Nuts
culturalNotes: You can use different types of nuts according to preference. You can also increase the sugar in the syrup if you prefer a sweeter dessert.

instructions.1: Cut the kunafa into small pieces using scissors or freeze it first, then break it into small pieces.
instructions.2: Mix 1/4 cup of butter into the kunafa and mix thoroughly until the kunafa absorbs all the butter.
instructions.3: Spread the kunafa in a baking pan and stir it occasionally while baking until golden brown and nicely colored.
instructions.4: Transfer the baked kunafa to a serving bowl.
instructions.5: Add the nuts and raisins to the baked kunafa and mix well.
instructions.6: Prepare the phyllo dough and cut it into two sheets.
instructions.7: Brush half of the phyllo sheet with butter, then fold the other half over it.
instructions.8: Place the filling in the center of the phyllo and roll it tightly.
instructions.9: Repeat the previous steps until all the filling is used.
instructions.10: Place the rolls in a buttered baking pan, leaving space between them.
instructions.11: Cut the phyllo rolls into small pieces using a heated knife.
instructions.12: Sprinkle the remaining butter over the top of the kunafa.
instructions.13: Bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius until golden brown and nicely colored.
instructions.14: Remove the kunafa from the oven and pour 1 cup of syrup over it.

title: Turkish Baklava with Pistachios
culturalNotes: Any type of nut can be used instead of pistachios. Baklava can be stored in an airtight container for up to 5 days.

instructions.1: Prepare the syrup: Combine 2 cups of sugar and 1.5 cups of water in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir until sugar dissolves.
instructions.2: Add juice from half a lemon to the syrup and simmer on low heat for 7 minutes until it reaches a medium consistency.
instructions.3: Remove syrup from heat and let it cool.
instructions.4: Boil the pistachios: Bring water to a boil in a pot, add pistachios, and boil for 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.5: Peel pistachios immediately after boiling. Let them cool, then toast them on low heat until crisp.
instructions.6: Chop the toasted pistachios finely.
instructions.7: Prepare the baklava: Cut the phyllo dough into circular pieces. Brush each piece with butter.
instructions.8: Place a spoonful of pistachio filling in the center of each piece and roll into a spiral. Pinch the ends together.
instructions.9: Arrange baklava in a greased baking dish. Cut each piece in half.
instructions.10: Brush the top of the baklava with butter.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 180-200°C for 15-20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.12: Remove baklava from oven and pour the cooled syrup over it.
instructions.13: Let baklava cool slightly before serving.

title: Kunafa and Basbousa
culturalNotes: You can use lemon juice instead of syrup if desired. Kunafa and basbousa can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix semolina flour with coconut thoroughly.
instructions.2: Set the mixture aside.
instructions.3: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
instructions.4: Grease the baking tray with ghee or butter.
instructions.5: Take two phyllo sheets and brush them with ghee.
instructions.6: Sprinkle the semolina and coconut mixture over the sheets.
instructions.7: Fold the sheets into the desired shape.
instructions.8: Repeat the previous steps until all the mixture is used.
instructions.9: Sprinkle sugar and butter or ghee on top.
instructions.10: Mix milk, sugar, egg, vanilla, and cream cheese together and stir well.
instructions.11: Pour the liquid mixture over the kunafa.
instructions.12: Bake in the middle rack of the oven until golden and cooked through.
instructions.13: Remove from oven and pour syrup over the top.
instructions.14: Cut into pieces and serve.

title: Quick Nutty Kunafa
culturalNotes: Kunafa can be served without syrup if preferred, but syrup adds a special and unique flavor. Kunafa can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
instructions.2: In a bowl, place the kunafa and melt the butter or ghee, then mix thoroughly until the kunafa fully absorbs the fat.
instructions.3: Add the powdered sugar and mix again until evenly distributed.
instructions.4: Cover the kunafa with butter and sugar, then place it into a coffee cup, making a hollow in the center.
instructions.5: Fill the hollow with nuts and raisins, then cover with another portion of kunafa.
instructions.6: Place the kunafa balls into a greased baking pan with butter or oil.
instructions.7: Bake in the oven for 10 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.8: In another bowl, mix the powdered sugar, dried milk powder, butter, and kiri cube.
instructions.9: Gradually add the warm water and stir until the syrup becomes smooth and homogeneous.
instructions.10: Pour the syrup into a glass and refrigerate until cooled.
instructions.11: Serve the kunafa warm with the cold syrup.

title: Nut-Stuffed Kunafa Balls
culturalNotes: Kunafa can be served without syrup if preferred, but the syrup adds a special and unique flavor.

instructions.1: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
instructions.2: In a bowl, combine the butter or clarified butter with the kunafa and mix thoroughly until all the kunafa is well coated.
instructions.3: Add the powdered sugar and mix well.
instructions.4: Shape the kunafa into a coffee cup form, create a hollow in the center, and fill it with nuts and raisins.
instructions.5: Close the cup with another piece of kunafa.
instructions.6: Place the kunafa balls into a greased baking pan with butter or oil.
instructions.7: Bake in the oven until golden and cooked through.
instructions.8: In another bowl, mix the powdered sugar, dried milk powder, butter, and kiri cube.
instructions.9: Gradually add the warm water and stir until the syrup is smooth and well blended.
instructions.10: Pour the syrup into a cup and refrigerate until cooled.
instructions.11: After the kunafa is baked, remove from the oven and serve warm with the chilled syrup.

title: Kunafa with Banana and Caramel
culturalNotes: You can use kunafa syrup instead of white honey. You can also decorate the dessert with chopped pistachios or almonds.

instructions.1: Fry the kunafa in 1/4 cup of ghee on the stove or in the oven.
instructions.2: Mix the whipped cream, cottage cheese, caramel cream, chantilly cream, dried milk powder, powdered sugar, and boiling water in a bowl.
instructions.3: Beat the mixture well with an electric mixer for 3 minutes until smooth and creamy.
instructions.4: Transfer the cream into a pastry bag or sandwich bag.
instructions.5: Place a layer of kunafa in serving molds.
instructions.6: Add a layer of cream on top of the kunafa.
instructions.7: Place banana slices on top of the cream.
instructions.8: Add another layer of cream.
instructions.9: Pour a layer of caramel sauce on top of the cream.
instructions.10: Garnish the dessert as desired.

title: Luxury Butter Biscuits
culturalNotes: Make sure the butter is very soft, and the kitchen is at a moderate temperature. Mix the sugar with the butter thoroughly to achieve a fluffy texture. Bake the biscuits at 170 degrees Celsius on the middle oven rack. You can store the biscuits in an airtight container in the refrigerator to keep them fresh for as long as possible.

instructions.1: Mix the butter and powdered sugar in a bowl using an electric wire whisk until the texture becomes creamy (about 5 minutes).
instructions.2: Add the eggs one at a time, stirring well after each addition.
instructions.3: Add the vanilla and salt, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Sift the flour, and gradually add it to the mixture, stirring gently until the dough is well combined.
instructions.5: Use a piping bag to shape the biscuits, and place them on a buttered baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.6: Place the tray in the preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius, and bake for 15 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.7: Remove from the oven and let cool.
instructions.8: To make chocolate-filled biscuits, mix the butter with the sifted cocoa powder, and shape them as you did with the regular biscuits.
instructions.9: Place a small amount of apricot jam in the center of each biscuit, and press the pieces together.
instructions.10: Dip the biscuits into white or dark chocolate, and sprinkle with crushed peanuts.
instructions.11: Let the biscuits cool completely, then store in an airtight container in the refrigerator to preserve them.

title: Fruit Cake
culturalNotes: You can use any type of favorite fruit for decoration. Chopped nuts can also be added for garnish. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix flour, cocoa, sugar, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Separate the eggs into yolks and whites. Whip the whites with vinegar and vanilla until stiff.
instructions.3: Whip the yolks with sugar until creamy.
instructions.4: Gradually add oil to the yolk mixture and beat well.
instructions.5: Gradually add flour to the yolk mixture while stirring continuously.
instructions.6: Gently fold the egg white mixture into the flour mixture until well combined.
instructions.7: Pour the batter into greased and floured cake pans.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool.
instructions.10: Cut the cake in half using a toothpick.
instructions.11: Brush the cake with pineapple jam or sugar dissolved in water.
instructions.12: Mix chantilly cream, whipping cream, and powdered sugar and beat well.
instructions.13: Spread a layer of cream on one half of the cake, then add chopped fruit.
instructions.14: Place the other half of the cake on top, then spread cream over the top and sides.
instructions.15: Garnish the cake with chopped fruit and grated chocolate.
instructions.16: Cover the cake with cream and distribute fruit and chocolate on top.
instructions.17: Glaze the fruit with glossing jelly.
instructions.18: Let the cake chill in the refrigerator for one hour before serving.

title: Economic Gâteau
culturalNotes: Serve the gâteau with a cup of coffee for a delicious taste. You can also use different types of nuts according to preference.

instructions.1: Crush the tea biscuits well or grind them in a food processor without fully pulverizing them.
instructions.2: Add the cocoa and powdered sugar, and mix thoroughly with the biscuits.
instructions.3: Add the crushed peanuts, butter, and vanilla, and mix well.
instructions.4: Add the milk and mix until the mixture becomes moldable.
instructions.5: Shape the mixture into a cylinder, wrap it in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 3-4 hours until firm.
instructions.6: Cut the cylinder into slices about 1 cm thick.
instructions.7: Dip the slices into melted chocolate (white or dark) and sprinkle with dates or chopped peanuts.
instructions.8: Refrigerate the gâteau for 15 minutes before serving.

title: Chocolate Cake
culturalNotes: You can use any type of dried fruit or nuts for garnish according to preference. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar with two cups of hot yogurt in a bowl and beat thoroughly until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.2: Add the cocoa powder and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the oil and mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add the eggs one at a time, continuing to beat.
instructions.5: Add the flour, baking powder, vanilla, and salt, and mix well.
instructions.6: Sift the flour and baking powder and fold them into the mixture.
instructions.7: Pour the batter into a greased and floured rectangular baking pan.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: After baking, remove the cake and let it cool completely.
instructions.10: Cut the cake in half and spread a layer of chantilly cream between the two halves.
instructions.11: Brush the cake with a mixture of yogurt, sugar, and cocoa.
instructions.12: Garnish with nuts, cherries, and shredded chocolate.
instructions.13: Serve the chocolate cake chilled.

title: Sweet Glaash with Custard and Jam
culturalNotes: You can sprinkle powdered sugar or crushed custard on top before serving for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Take two sheets of glaash, cut them into the desired shape, and roll them to form roses.
instructions.2: Arrange the roses in a greased baking dish.
instructions.3: Prepare the custard mixture: Mix custard or cornstarch with yogurt, milk, vanilla, melted butter, and powdered sugar.
instructions.4: Stir the mixture well until smooth and well combined.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture over the roses in the baking dish.
instructions.6: Spread the mixture evenly over the roses.
instructions.7: Place one teaspoon of strawberry jam on top of each rose.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.9: Serve the sweet glaash warm or cold, according to preference.

title: Kunafa Filling with Cream
culturalNotes: Make sure the cream is cold before placing it inside the phyllo dough to prevent leakage. You can add saffron to the cream or sprinkle it on top of the kunafa as desired.

instructions.1: Mix 3 cups of yogurt with 3 large tablespoons of cornstarch and stir them together while cold.
instructions.2: Cook the mixture over medium heat until thickened.
instructions.3: Add 1 large tablespoon of saffron or 1/2 cup of labneh cream and mix well.
instructions.4: Remove from heat and let cool completely.
