instructions.5: Prepare the phyllo dough and cut it into squares.
instructions.6: Place a spoonful of cream in the center of each square and fold the phyllo tightly to seal.
instructions.7: Brush the hot butter over the phyllo and let it sit for 10 minutes to absorb the butter.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 10 minutes until golden and crisp.
instructions.9: Drizzle the kunafa with white honey or cold simple syrup.
instructions.10: Garnish the kunafa with crushed pistachios, dried rose petals, and saffron as desired.

title: Mawlid Sweet (Molabban, Dumblia, and Rope)
culturalNotes: Orange blossom water can be used instead of vanilla, as desired. Make sure to grease the griddle well with oil to prevent the molabban from sticking.

instructions.1: Place 1.5 kg of sugar in a pot over heat, add half the water (about 750 ml), and stir well.
instructions.2: Add 200 grams of glucose syrup and stir until dissolved.
instructions.3: In another bowl, mix 280 grams of cornstarch with the remaining water (about 750 ml) and stir well.
instructions.4: Mix 1/4 teaspoon of lemon salt with 2 teaspoons of water and stir well.
instructions.5: Dissolve 50 grams of gelatin in half a cup of water and stir well.
instructions.6: After the sugar and glucose syrup have boiled, add the cornstarch mixture and stir well.
instructions.7: Continue stirring over medium heat for 2 hours until the consistency becomes thick and transparent.
instructions.8: Add 1/4 teaspoon of vanilla and stir well.
instructions.9: Pour half of the molabban into a greased griddle and sprinkle nuts on top.
instructions.10: Pour the remaining molabban into the griddle, add the red food coloring, and stir well.
instructions.11: Let the molabban cool for at least 6 hours or overnight.
instructions.12: Cut the molabban into desired shapes and serve.
instructions.13: To make the rope, dip a camel’s eye (a wooden skewer) into the hot molabban and hang it on a stick until cooled.
instructions.14: Dip the rope in cornstarch to prevent sticking.
instructions.15: Serve the rope, molabban, and dumblia together on a serving platter.

title: Tahini Sweet
culturalNotes: Make sure the sesame and flour turn a light golden color before adding them to the mixture. Proper pressing of the sweet is essential for achieving the perfect shape. Nuts can be added as desired for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Toast the sesame in a dry pan over low heat until it turns a light golden color
instructions.2: Add the flour to the same pan and stir until it also turns a light golden color
instructions.3: Blend the toasted sesame with oil and salt in a blender until smooth
instructions.4: Add the toasted flour to the mixture and blend well to form the tahini paste
instructions.5: Mix the powdered milk and powdered sugar together and sift them
instructions.6: Add the tahini and vanilla to the mixture and blend thoroughly
instructions.7: Take a small portion of the dough and make sure it holds together
instructions.8: Add nuts as desired
instructions.9: Bake the sweet in a tray and press it firmly
instructions.10: Add cocoa to one-third of the mixture to prepare the chocolate version
instructions.11: Refrigerate the sweet overnight
instructions.12: Cut the sweet into small pieces before serving

title: Sweet Potato Cream Caramel Dessert
culturalNotes: The dessert can be served cold or warm, according to preference. You can also sprinkle a little ground pistachio on top for garnish.

instructions.1: Peel the sweet potatoes, wash them, then grate them.
instructions.2: Put 1 spoon of butter or ghee into a baking dish and spread it evenly.
instructions.3: Add 2 spoons of semolina or fine wheat flour to the butter.
instructions.4: Add the grated sweet potatoes, sprinkle with cinnamon and 1/4 cup of sugar, then mix well.
instructions.5: Bake in the oven at the middle rack for 15 minutes.
instructions.6: Meanwhile, take 3 cups of milk and add 2 packets of Dreem Cream Caramel, then stir and cook over medium heat until boiling.
instructions.7: After the sweet potatoes are cooked, remove the dish from the oven and pour the cream caramel over them.
instructions.8: Let the dessert cool, then refrigerate until set.
instructions.9: Once set, cut the dessert and garnish with Tahfet caramel.

title: Hummusiyeh
culturalNotes: Any type of nuts can be used according to preference, such as almonds, walnuts, or carob. Make sure to warm the nuts before adding the syrup to prevent moisture formation. Cut the hummusiyeh while still warm to avoid difficulty in cutting.

instructions.1: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the sugar and 1 cup of water. Stir well until dissolved.
instructions.2: Let the mixture boil, then add the lemon juice, salt, and vanilla. Stir thoroughly.
instructions.3: Let the mixture simmer until it begins to thicken and foam forms on the surface.
instructions.4: Add the white honey or corn syrup and stir until the mixture turns a light golden color.
instructions.5: Add the sodium bicarbonate and stir rapidly, then turn off the heat.
instructions.6: Heat the chickpeas in a frying pan over medium heat or in a baking tray in the oven until warmed through, then transfer to a bowl greased with oil.
instructions.7: Add 1 cup of the syrup to the chickpeas and stir quickly. Pour into an oiled baking tray and spread evenly to the desired thickness.
instructions.8: Let the hummusiyeh cool slightly, then cut into desired sizes.
instructions.9: Repeat the same steps with the peanuts and sesame seeds.

title: Date Pops (Stuffed Dates with Nuts and Covered in Chocolate)
culturalNotes: Different types of nuts can be used according to preference. Date Pops can be stored in the freezer for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Wash the dates thoroughly and let them dry.
instructions.2: Cut the dates in half and carefully remove the pits.
instructions.3: Fill the pits with roasted and salted nuts to your preference.
instructions.4: Close the dates carefully so they look as if they were never opened.
instructions.5: Melt the chocolate in a heatproof bowl over a double boiler until smooth and creamy.
instructions.6: Dip each date piece into the melted chocolate and let excess drip off.
instructions.7: Place the pieces on a tray lined with parchment paper and a wire rack to allow excess chocolate to drain.
instructions.8: Put the tray in the freezer for 10 minutes until the chocolate hardens.
instructions.9: Serve the Date Pops cold and fully coated in chocolate.

title: Kunafa Rice with Roz bel Laban
culturalNotes: The dish can be served in a large bowl or in small cups for an elegant presentation. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Wash the rice and soak it for 10 minutes, then drain.
instructions.2: Add the rice to the milk in a pot over heat and stir well for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Cover the pot and let it simmer on low heat for 1 hour.
instructions.4: After one hour, return the pot to the heat and add the clotted cream, half a cup of sugar, and stir well.
instructions.5: Add one teaspoon of vanilla and stir well.
instructions.6: In another bowl, mix one cup of cold yogurt with one teaspoon of cornstarch and two tablespoons of Chantilly cream.
instructions.7: Add the cornstarch and Chantilly cream mixture to the rice and milk, and stir well over low heat for 5 minutes.
instructions.8: In a small pan, combine one cup of sugar with a small cup of water and cook over heat until the color turns golden.
instructions.9: Add the clotted cream and butter to the caramelized sugar and stir until well blended.
instructions.10: Prepare the kunafa by baking it in the oven with three tablespoons of ghee, then add 2-3 tablespoons of honey or date syrup and stir well.
instructions.11: In a large bowl, layer kunafa, then rice with milk, then more kunafa, and continue alternating until all ingredients are used.
instructions.12: Drizzle the caramel sauce over the final layer.
instructions.13: Garnish the dish with pieces of lotus biscuits.
instructions.14: Let the dish cool before serving.

title: Rafaello
culturalNotes: Make sure the coconut is fresh for the best flavor. You can use different types of chocolate according to preference. Rafaello can be stored in the refrigerator for up to one week.

instructions.1: Mix the fine shredded coconut with condensed milk in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add 3 large tablespoons of white chocolate and mix thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Cover the mixture with plastic wrap and shape into small balls, stuffing some with almonds.
instructions.4: Dip the balls in white or dark chocolate, then let them dry on parchment paper.
instructions.5: You can decorate them with sprinkles or coconut as desired.
instructions.6: Place in the refrigerator for 10 minutes until firm.
instructions.7: Cut the flat dough with a knife, cover with chocolate, then place on parchment paper until set.

title: Apple Roll Cake
culturalNotes: A light sprinkle of sugar or caramel sauce can be added to the roll when serving for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling
instructions.2: Peel the green apples and slice them thinly.
instructions.3: Add the apples to a pan with 1 cup of sugar, 1 teaspoon of cinnamon, and 2 tablespoons of butter.
instructions.4: Cook the apples over medium heat until soft and caramelized.
instructions.5: Remove the filling from the heat and let it cool.
instructions.6: Prepare the cake
instructions.7: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and vanilla in a bowl.
instructions.8: Add the eggs and milk, and mix thoroughly until the batter is smooth.
instructions.9: Bake the cake
instructions.10: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.11: Pour the batter into a greased and floured rectangular baking tray.
instructions.12: Place the tray in the oven and bake for 10-15 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.13: Shape the roll
instructions.14: Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool slightly.
instructions.15: Flip the cake onto a clean piece of parchment paper and peel off the parchment from the bottom.
instructions.16: Spread the filling evenly over the cake surface.
instructions.17: Gently roll the cake using the parchment paper to help maintain the roll shape.
instructions.18: Place the roll in the refrigerator for 3-4 hours until completely cooled and firm.
instructions.20: Slice the roll and serve with coffee or tea.

title: Kanafa Spice Mix
culturalNotes: You can use one teaspoon of this spice mix per kilogram of dough when making kanafa. This spice blend can be stored in the freezer for a long time.

instructions.1: Measure out all the spices, using 5 grams of each.
instructions.2: Place the spices in a grinder and grind them thoroughly until finely powdered.
instructions.3: Add 3 tablespoons of toasted sesame seeds to the ground spices.
instructions.4: Mix all ingredients well until fully combined.
instructions.5: Store the spice mix in an airtight container in the freezer.

title: Sablé with Ganache
culturalNotes: Sablé can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week. You can also experiment with different fillings such as cream or dried fruits.

instructions.1: Mix flour and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add butter and powdered sugar, and mix well until the texture becomes creamy.
instructions.3: Add eggs and vanilla, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Gradually add flour and mix until the dough is well combined.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into two parts, and fill one half with cocoa powder, mixing well.
instructions.6: Roll out the dough between two sheets of parchment paper and cut into various shapes.
instructions.7: Place the pieces on a baking tray and bake in a preheated oven at 160°C for 20 minutes.
instructions.8: Prepare the ganache: Heat the yogurt on the stove until boiling, then add the grated chocolate and stir until melted.
instructions.9: Cover the sablé with ganache and let it cool.
instructions.10: Garnish the sablé with powdered sugar, nuts, jam, and chocolate as desired.

title: Sesamiya
culturalNotes: Any type of nuts can be used according to preference, such as almonds, walnuts, or pistachios. Make sure to toast the nuts well before using them to enhance texture and flavor. Sesamiya can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the sugar and 1 cup of water. Stir well until dissolved.
instructions.2: Let the mixture boil, then add lemon juice, salt, and vanilla. Stir thoroughly.
instructions.3: Continue cooking until the mixture begins to thicken and foam forms on the surface.
instructions.4: Add white honey or corn syrup and stir until the mixture turns a light golden color.
instructions.5: Add sodium bicarbonate and stir quickly, then remove from heat.
instructions.6: Pour the mixture into a greased metal tray and spread evenly to the desired thickness.
instructions.7: Let it cool slightly, then cut into desired shapes.
instructions.8: Repeat the steps with the chickpeas and peanuts after toasting and mixing them with the syrup.

title: Eastern Dessert Syrup
culturalNotes: Make sure to use fine, white sugar for the best results. Do not stir the syrup on the heat after adding honey to prevent sugar crystallization.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar and water in a bowl at room temperature until the sugar dissolves completely.
instructions.2: Place the bowl on medium heat and let it boil.
instructions.3: Reduce the heat and let the syrup simmer for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Add the lemon juice and white honey or glucose honey, and let the mixture boil for 2 more minutes.
instructions.5: Turn off the heat and let the syrup cool.
instructions.6: Pour the syrup into clean bottles and store in the refrigerator.

title: Mango Charlotte
culturalNotes: Any type of mango can be used according to preference. The cake can be decorated with a satin ribbon for special occasions.

instructions.1: Prepare the cream: In a bowl, mix cream cheese with whipping cream, chantilly cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla. Whip the ingredients thoroughly for 7 minutes until a smooth, creamy consistency is achieved.
instructions.2: Prepare the mold: Line the bottom of a 26 cm cheesecake mold with a layer of savoy cookies. Press down firmly to secure.
instructions.3: Add the cream: Spread a layer of cream over the cookies, then add a layer of small mango cubes.
instructions.4: Add the sponge cake: Place a layer of sponge cake on top of the filling, followed by another layer of cream.
instructions.5: Repeat layers: Continue alternating layers of sponge cake, cream, and mango until all ingredients are used, pressing down firmly on each layer.
instructions.6: Apply the gel: Evenly spread the glossing gel over the top layer of mango to preserve its color and shape.
instructions.7: Chill: Refrigerate the cake for 3–4 hours until set.
instructions.8: Serve: Cut the cake and serve with fresh or preserved cherries as desired.

title: Chocolate-Filled Biscuit and Nut Cookies
culturalNotes: You can use any type of biscuit and nuts according to preference. You can also sprinkle gold dust on the cookies for an attractive appearance.

instructions.1: Mix 2 tablespoons of tahini paste with 1 cup of crushed tea biscuits.
instructions.2: Add roasted, unsalted nuts to the biscuit and tahini mixture.
instructions.3: Fill the cookies with the mixture and close them.
instructions.4: Melt the chocolate and dip the filled cookies into it.
instructions.5: Add a pinch of salt to the chocolate for extra flavor.
instructions.6: Arrange the cookies on a tray lined with parchment paper.
instructions.7: Serve them during Eid and all special occasions.

title: Orange Sauce
culturalNotes: You can use the sauce with cake or any other dessert you prefer. The sauce can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix 1 cup orange juice with 1 teaspoon tang.
instructions.2: Add 2 tablespoons sugar, 1 tablespoon cornstarch, and 2 tablespoons orange zest, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Transfer the mixture to a saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until it comes to a boil.
instructions.4: After boiling, add 1 tablespoon butter and stir until fully melted.
instructions.5: Continue cooking for 5 more minutes until the sauce thickens.
instructions.6: Remove from heat and let the sauce cool before serving.

title: Local Thickened Milk Sauce
culturalNotes: You can use this sauce to garnish cakes and pastries or add it to beverages.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar and powdered milk in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the hot water and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the butter and stir again.
instructions.4: Cover the bowl and blend for one minute.
instructions.5: Mix the ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.6: Add more water if you prefer a thinner consistency.
instructions.7: Cover the bowl and let it cool.
instructions.8: Stir in 2 tablespoons of cream cheese after the sauce has cooled.

title: Pistachio Shortbread
culturalNotes: Make sure the ghee is at room temperature before starting to beat. Mix the flour and sugar thoroughly to achieve a smooth and firm dough. Let the dough rest in the refrigerator for 30 minutes before shaping. Bake the shortbread at a low temperature to prevent drying out and cracking.

instructions.1: Take the ghee out of the refrigerator and let it sit until it reaches room temperature.
instructions.2: Beat the ghee for about 1 minute until smooth and creamy.
instructions.3: Add the siftered powdered sugar and beat the ingredients together for 4–5 minutes until the mixture becomes white and creamy.
instructions.4: Add the vanilla and beat again.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour while stirring until the dough comes together evenly.
instructions.6: Add a pinch of salt and mix thoroughly.
instructions.7: Knead the dough with your hands until it becomes firm and soft.
instructions.8: Divide the dough into three parts: one for traditional shortbread, one for chocolate shortbread, and one for pistachio shortbread.
instructions.9: Add the cocoa powder and ghee to the chocolate dough portion and mix well.
instructions.10: Add the ground pistachios to the pistachio dough portion and mix well.
instructions.11: Place all dough portions in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
instructions.12: Remove the dough from the refrigerator and shape it into small balls, about 10 grams each.
instructions.13: Arrange the balls on an oiled baking tray, leaving space between them.
instructions.14: Bake the shortbread in a preheated oven at 150°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.15: Let the shortbread cool completely before transferring.

title: Foulie
culturalNotes: Any type of nuts can be used according to preference, such as almonds, walnuts, or carob. Make sure to roast the nuts well before using them to enhance texture and flavor. Foulie can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the sugar and 1 cup of water. Stir well until dissolved.
instructions.2: Let the mixture boil, then add lemon juice, salt, and vanilla. Stir well.
instructions.3: Continue cooking until the mixture begins to thicken and foam forms on the surface.
instructions.4: Add white honey or corn syrup and stir until the mixture turns a light golden color.
instructions.5: Add sodium bicarbonate and stir quickly, then turn off the heat.
instructions.6: Pour the mixture into a greased metal tray and spread it to the desired thickness.
instructions.7: Let it cool slightly, then cut into the desired shapes.
instructions.8: Repeat the steps with roasted chickpeas, peanuts, and sesame, after roasting and mixing them with the syrup.

title: Honey Squash with Nuts
culturalNotes: Any type of nuts can be used according to preference. Serve the dish with ice cream and caramel sauce for a richer flavor.

instructions.1: Selecting the honey squash: Choose a bright orange squash, free of white spots and green veins, and with a uniform shape.
instructions.2: Peeling and cutting the squash: Cut the squash in half, then into long slices, and remove the inner part containing the seeds. Cut the squash into large cubes and place in a microwave-safe dish. Microwave for 4 minutes.
instructions.3: Peeling the squash: After removing the squash from the microwave, peel off the dry skin easily.
instructions.4: Cutting the squash: Cut the squash into smaller cubes.
instructions.5: Boiling the squash: Place the squash in a pot with 1 cup of sugar. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat and simmer until tender. Remove the lid to let any remaining water evaporate.
instructions.6: Adding butter: Add 2 tablespoons of butter and stir well.
instructions.7: Preparing the cream: In another pot, melt 4 tablespoons of butter and stir in 4 tablespoons of flour. Cook over medium heat until the raw flour taste disappears. Gradually add the milk while stirring continuously. Add 1/2 cup of sugar, 1 teaspoon of vanilla, and 1 cup of cooking cream or 3 tablespoons of Ishbal on Wesh el Lebanon.
instructions.8: Assembling the dish: Grease a baking dish with shortening and sprinkle with crushed breadcrumbs. Layer the honey squash, then spread a layer of cream. Sprinkle nuts on top.
instructions.9: Baking the dish: Place the dish in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20–25 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.10: Serving the dish: Let the dish cool slightly before serving. Serve with ice cream and caramel sauce.

title: Kazan Kebab Sauce
culturalNotes: The sauce can be stored in the refrigerator for 3-4 days. The leftover whey from straining the yogurt can be used in the dough for better results.

instructions.1: Boil 0.5 kg of milk in a pot, then add 1/2 cup of cream and 4 large tablespoons of powdered milk. Stir well until fully mixed.
instructions.2: Once the mixture starts boiling, mix 3 large tablespoons of cornstarch with a little water, then pour it into the milk and cream mixture. Stir well until the consistency becomes creamy.
instructions.3: Boil the remaining 1 kg of milk in another pot, then add 1/4 cup of vinegar. Stir until the milk separates and becomes thickened.
instructions.4: Strain the solid parts of the milk using a fine sieve, then transfer them to a bowl and mix with a little cream. Mash the mixture well until smooth and creamy.
instructions.5: Cover the sauce and let it cool before using it to fill desserts or serving it with white honey.

title: Crispy and Sweet Kunafa
culturalNotes: Make sure the dough rests well before pouring, and cover the kunafa after cooking to prevent drying out. You can use different types of cheese and nuts according to preference.

fah-507-i8.name: Feta or Parmesan or Double Cream cheese

instructions.1: Mix 2.5 cups all-purpose flour, 0.5 cup semolina, 2 large tablespoons sugar, 1 small tablespoon baking powder, 1 small tablespoon yeast, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add 3 cups warm water and mix thoroughly using a mixer for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Let the dough rest for 10–15 minutes.
instructions.4: Pour the dough into a funnel or piping bag and cover with a conical lid.
instructions.5: Pour the dough into a frying pan over medium heat until golden on both sides.
instructions.6: Flip the kunafa onto a clean cloth and cover it.
instructions.7: Prepare the fillings: mix feta or Parmesan or double cream cheese with parsley, and mix nuts with dried apricots, pistachios, sugar, and cinnamon.
instructions.8: Fill the kunafa with the mixtures and seal tightly.
instructions.9: Fry the kunafa in hot oil until golden brown.
instructions.10: Drain the kunafa and serve with honey, syrop, or thyme as desired.

title: Lotus Cake
culturalNotes: You can use ghee only or butter only instead of using both together. The cake can be served plain without any pattern or with a plain crust.

instructions.1: Mix the ghee and cold butter thoroughly until smooth and creamy.
instructions.2: Add the flour, yeast, baking powder, lotus flavoring, and salt; mix well.
instructions.3: Add the crushed lotus cookies and milk powder; mix into the flour.
instructions.4: Mix the yeast and sugar into warm water and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the yeast mixture to the dough and mix thoroughly until fully combined.
instructions.6: Shape the cake by forming a ball of dough and filling it with a ball of filling, then seal it tightly.
instructions.7: Arrange the cakes in an oiled baking tray and let them rest for 10 minutes to rise.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 175 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes.
instructions.9: Let the cakes cool completely, then dust with powdered sugar.

title: Cream Chantilly Cake
culturalNotes: You can store the cake in an airtight container for up to two weeks. You can also dust the cake with powdered sugar just before serving to keep its beautiful appearance.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and sugar in half a cup of warm water and let it sit for 10 minutes until it becomes frothy.
instructions.2: In a large bowl, mix the flour, cake aroma powder, chantilly cream powder, and salt.
instructions.3: Heat the ghee on the stove until melted, then add it to the flour and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the roasted sesame to the melted ghee and stir until well combined.
instructions.5: Gradually add the yeast and warm water mixture to the flour while continuing to stir.
instructions.6: Knead the dough well until it becomes soft and sticky.
instructions.7: Cover the dough with a plastic bag and let it rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Shape the cake as preferred (using a mold, flat, or with a stamp).
instructions.9: Let the shaped cakes rise for 1 hour until puffed and light.
instructions.10: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius, then bake the cakes on the middle rack until golden brown.
instructions.11: Let the cakes cool completely, then dust with powdered sugar just before serving.

title: Stuffed Koughka with Semolina, Date Paste, and Labneh
culturalNotes: Make sure not to overfill the koughka with filling, or it may crack and spill. You can shape the fillings in advance to make stuffing easier.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix 3 tablespoons of semolina with 3 tablespoons of flour.
instructions.2: Stir the mixture over medium heat until it turns golden brown.
instructions.3: Add 1 teaspoon of koughka essence and continue stirring.
instructions.4: Add 3 tablespoons of toasted sesame seeds and 1 cup of roasted nuts.
instructions.5: Add 1 cup minus 2 tablespoons of white honey and continue stirring until the mixture boils.
instructions.6: Let the mixture simmer on low heat for just 2 minutes.
instructions.7: Remove the semolina filling from the heat and transfer it to a plate to cool.
instructions.8: To prepare the date paste filling, place 1/2 kilogram of date paste and 2 tablespoons of butter in a bowl and let it soften.
instructions.9: To prepare the labneh filling, place 1/2 kilogram of labneh and 2 tablespoons of butter in a bowl and mix thoroughly.
instructions.10: You may add roasted nuts or peanuts to the labneh filling as desired.
instructions.11: Shape the fillings before using them in the koughka.
instructions.12: Store the fillings in the refrigerator before using to make them firmer and easier to handle.

title: Kunafa with Pineapple and Caramel Sauce
culturalNotes: Kunafa can be served chilled after refrigerating for one hour. It can also be cut into small pieces for serving.

instructions.1: Prepare the custard cream:
instructions.2: Heat the milk in a saucepan over medium heat.
instructions.3: In another bowl, mix egg yolks with sugar and liquid vanilla.
instructions.4: Add cornstarch and stir well.
instructions.5: Gradually pour the egg mixture into the hot milk while stirring continuously.
instructions.6: Return the mixture to the stove and stir until thickened.
instructions.7: Add butter and stir until fully melted.
instructions.8: Transfer the custard cream to a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let it cool.
instructions.9: Prepare the kunafa:
instructions.10: Mix the syrop into the baked kunafa and stir well.
instructions.11: Lay a layer of kunafa in the serving dish.
instructions.12: Add a layer of custard cream and whipped cream.
instructions.13: Garnish the top with pineapple pieces.
instructions.14: Drizzle caramel sauce over the top.
instructions.15: Garnish with nuts as desired.

title: Kunafa with Cream
culturalNotes: Kunafa can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days. It can be served cold or warm, according to preference.

instructions.1: Mix the milk and cornstarch in a saucepan and stir well.
instructions.2: Place the saucepan on the stove and continue stirring until the mixture becomes creamy and smooth.
instructions.3: Add the cream and stir until fully combined.
instructions.4: Remove the mixture from the heat.
instructions.5: Place the kunafa in a bowl and add 1 cup of ghee, stirring until the kunafa fully absorbs the ghee.
instructions.6: Add the powdered sugar and stir until evenly distributed.
instructions.7: Place half of the kunafa in a baking dish and spread it evenly.
instructions.8: Pour the cream mixture over the kunafa.
instructions.9: Cover the cream layer with another layer of kunafa.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 10–15 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.11: Prepare the syrup by mixing the sugar and water, boiling for 5 minutes, then add lemon juice and white honey, stirring until well combined.
instructions.12: Pour the cold syrup over the kunafa from all sides.
instructions.13: Garnish the kunafa with crushed pistachios.
instructions.14: Let it cool slightly before serving.

title: Kunafa with Crème Brûlée
culturalNotes: The dish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours. It can be served cold or warm, according to preference.

instructions.1: Preparation of the Crème Brûlée:
instructions.2: Whisk egg yolks with half a cup of sugar, vanilla, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
instructions.3: Add two cups of dessert cream and mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Transfer the mixture to a saucepan and cook over low heat until it begins to simmer.
instructions.5: Remove from heat and gradually add one tablespoon of the mixture to the beaten egg yolks while stirring continuously.
instructions.6: Return the mixture to the saucepan and stir until well heated.
instructions.7: Pour the mixture into a 24 cm Pyrex dish and place it in a water bath in a preheated oven at 180°C for 40 minutes.
instructions.8: Preparation of the Kunafa:
instructions.9: Chop the kunafa using a food processor.
instructions.10: Place the kunafa in a frying pan and add two tablespoons of smena, stirring over medium heat until golden brown.
instructions.11: Add two tablespoons of white honey or thick syrup to the hot kunafa and mix well.
instructions.12: Assembly and Serving:
instructions.13: Spread the golden kunafa over the crème brûlée.
instructions.14: Garnish the dish with lotus cookies and lotus butter.
instructions.15: Chill the dish in the refrigerator before serving.

title: Chocolate Mousse Kunafa
culturalNotes: Chocolate mousse kunafa can be served in small cups or one large serving dish. Additional ingredients such as walnuts or almonds can be added according to preference.

instructions.1: Heat the milk in a saucepan over the stove.
instructions.2: Add the cocoa powder and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the powdered milk and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the broken plain chocolate and stir until fully melted.
instructions.5: Add the Chantilly cream and caramel cream, and stir well.
instructions.6: Mix the dissolved cornstarch in half a cup of milk, then add to the mixture and stir quickly until smooth.
instructions.7: Let the mixture cool slightly.
instructions.8: In a serving dish, place a layer of caramelized kunafa.
instructions.9: Add a layer of strawberries.
instructions.10: Add a layer of chocolate mousse.
instructions.11: Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used up.
instructions.12: Add a final layer of kunafa.
instructions.13: Add a final layer of chocolate mousse.
instructions.14: Garnish with nuts as desired.
instructions.15: Refrigerate for at least one hour before serving.

title: Lotus Cream Cheese Kunafa
culturalNotes: You can use pre-baked kunafa as an additional topping. Make sure the kunafa is completely cooled before refrigerating to ensure proper layering.

instructions.1: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
instructions.2: Mix the ghee with the kunafa and knead thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the powdered sugar and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.4: Place the kunafa in a baking dish, press it firmly, and knead well.
instructions.5: Bake in the oven until golden brown.
instructions.6: Mix the cream cheese with the Chantilly cream, dessert cream, and powdered sugar using an electric mixer until smooth and creamy.
instructions.7: Add the lotus cream and mix thoroughly.
instructions.8: Remove the kunafa from the oven and pour the syrop over it.
instructions.9: Spread the cream mixture evenly over the kunafa and smooth it well.
instructions.10: Microwave the lotus cream for 10 seconds, then spread it over the kunafa.
instructions.11: Garnish the kunafa with dates and cookies to taste.
instructions.12: Let the kunafa cool completely, then refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Fruit Jelly Kunafa
culturalNotes: Make sure all ingredients are completely cold before assembling the dish. You can serve kunafa in small cups for an elegant presentation.

fah-516-i8.name: Mixed fruits (kiwi, strawberry, grapes, banana, apple)

instructions.1: Preheat the oven and prepare the baking tray.
instructions.2: Melt the ghee in a bowl, then add the kunafa and mix thoroughly until fully coated with ghee.
instructions.3: Transfer the kunafa to the baking tray and bake until golden brown.
instructions.4: Remove kunafa from oven, pour 1/2 cup of syrop over it, and mix well.
instructions.5: Return kunafa to oven for a few minutes to cool slightly.
instructions.6: Mix Chantilly cream with frozen milk and whip for 5–7 minutes until thick and fluffy.
instructions.7: Pipe the cream over the kunafa.
instructions.8: Return kunafa to the refrigerator until completely chilled.
instructions.9: Prepare the mango jelly by mixing 2 packs of jelly with 2 cups of hot water, then add 2 cups of cold water and stir until fully dissolved.
instructions.10: Pour the jelly over the kunafa and cream.
instructions.11: Refrigerate the dish for 4–5 hours until completely set and chilled.
instructions.12: Serve kunafa cut into small pieces.

title: Stuffed Kunafa with Dates and Dried Apricots
culturalNotes: You can grind the dates in a food processor or mortar for a smoother texture. You may increase the amount of syrup according to preference.

instructions.1: Mix two tablespoons of butter with the kunafa and stir well.
instructions.2: Add a quarter cup of powdered sugar and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Put a portion of the butter at the bottom of the baking dish and spread half of the kunafa evenly.
instructions.4: Press the kunafa firmly to form a solid layer.
instructions.5: Prepare the filling by mixing the dates, dried apricots, cinnamon, and two large tablespoons of butter.
instructions.6: Spread the filling evenly in the dish and cover it with the remaining kunafa.
instructions.7: Pour the remaining butter over the kunafa.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.9: Pour the cold, medium-thick syrup over the kunafa from both sides.
instructions.10: Serve warm or cold, according to preference.

title: Stuffed Kunafa with Cream, Strawberries, and Chocolate
culturalNotes: Kunafa can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days. It can be served cold or warm, according to preference.

instructions.1: Cut the kunafa and break it into pieces.
instructions.2: Pour one cup of hot butter over the kunafa and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Place the kunafa in a baking tray and bake in the oven at the highest temperature until golden brown and crispy.
instructions.4: Flip the kunafa occasionally in the oven to ensure even browning.
instructions.5: Add white honey to the baked kunafa and mix well.
instructions.6: Put one kilogram of milk in a pot and add two tablespoons of caramel cream, one tablespoon of chantilly cream, and a quarter cup of sugar. Mix well.
instructions.7: Add half a cup of heavy cream or two large spoons of available thickening agent and mix well.
instructions.8: Mix one large spoon of cornstarch with a quarter cup of water, then add to the mixture on the stove and stir until thickened.
instructions.9: Place a layer of baked and crumbled kunafa into a baking dish and spread a layer of cream on top.
instructions.10: Let the dish cool slightly until a crust forms.
instructions.11: For the second filling, add a quarter cup of raw cocoa powder and two pieces of chocolate to the cream mixture and mix well.
instructions.12: Place a layer of kunafa in another baking dish and spread strawberries and chocolate sauce over it.
instructions.13: Garnish the dish with baked kunafa and strawberries.

title: Nablus Kunafa
culturalNotes: Make sure the syrup is cold and of medium consistency when pouring over the kunafa. Kunafa can be served hot or cold, depending on preference.

instructions.1: Soak the cheese in water for at least 3 hours to remove saltiness, changing the water every two hours.
instructions.2: Cut and grate the cheese.
instructions.3: Place the kunafa in the freezer for one or two days to make it easier to crumble.
instructions.4: Mix the clarified butter into the kunafa and stir until the kunafa fully absorbs it.
instructions.5: Add powdered sugar and saffron powder, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.6: Place a layer of kunafa into the baking pan and spread it evenly.
instructions.7: Form a border around the edge of the pan to prevent the cheese from leaking out.
instructions.8: Layer the akawi and mozzarella cheeses over the kunafa.
instructions.9: Cover the cheese with another layer of kunafa.
instructions.10: Drizzle the remaining clarified butter over the top.
instructions.11: Bake on both sides on the stovetop until golden brown.
instructions.12: Place the kunafa in the oven on the bottom rack until the sides turn golden.
instructions.13: Put the kunafa under the broiler until the top is golden.
instructions.14: Prepare the syrup by mixing one cup of sugar with one cup of water and boiling for 5 minutes.
instructions.15: Pour the cold, medium-consistency syrup over the kunafa from both sides.

title: Nablus Kunafa with Mozzarella
culturalNotes: Make sure the oven is very hot before placing the kunafa inside to ensure proper cooking. Serve the kunafa hot for the best flavor.

instructions.1: Place the kunafa in the freezer overnight to dry it out.
instructions.2: Remove the kunafa from the freezer and gently fluff it.
instructions.3: Melt the mozzarella cheese to make sure it's not salty.
instructions.4: Melt the clarified butter over low heat.
instructions.5: Spread the melted butter over the kunafa and coat it thoroughly.
instructions.6: Cover the baklava pan with two tablespoons of butter.
instructions.7: Spread half a kilogram of kunafa into the pan and press it firmly.
instructions.8: Add the mozzarella cheese on top of the kunafa.
instructions.9: Cover the cheese with another layer of kunafa and press it firmly.
instructions.10: Place the pan into the preheated oven at 200 degrees for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.11: Remove the kunafa from the oven and pour the cold, medium-consistency syrup over it.
instructions.12: Garnish the kunafa with crushed pistachios and caramel.
instructions.13: Serve the kunafa hot with vanilla ice cream.

title: Nablus Kunafa on Charcoal
culturalNotes: Kunafa can be served with coffee or tea. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

fah-521-i6.name: Syrop
fah-521-i6.amount: one and a half cups sugar and one cup water

instructions.1: Prepare the kunafa and cut it into small pieces.
instructions.2: Add the clarified butter to the kunafa and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the powdered sugar and mix the kunafa well.
instructions.4: Put two or three tablespoons of clarified butter at the bottom of the baking dish.
instructions.5: Spread a layer of kunafa in the dish and press it firmly.
instructions.6: Add the mozzarella and akawi cheese (after soaking in water for 8 hours to reduce saltiness).
instructions.7: Cover with another layer of kunafa and press firmly.
instructions.8: Place the dish on hot charcoal and cook until the first side is golden brown.
instructions.9: Flip the dish and cook until the other side is golden brown.
instructions.10: Prepare the syrop by mixing sugar, water, and lemon juice, then simmer on low heat for 7 minutes.
instructions.11: Pour the hot syrop over the kunafa immediately after removing it from the charcoal.
instructions.12: Let the kunafa cool slightly before serving.

title: Phyllo Cake
culturalNotes: Any type of phyllo dough can be used, even if it's broken or not fresh. You can also use ghee or oil instead of melted butter.

instructions.1: Prepare the syrup: In a saucepan, combine sugar, water, and juice from half a lemon. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes until the syrup is ready.
instructions.2: Prepare the batter: In a bowl, mix melted butter, yogurt, sugar, eggs, vanilla, whipping cream, and baking powder. Blend all ingredients well using a mixer until smooth.
instructions.3: Prepare the pan: Line the bottom of the cheesecake pan with aluminum foil on the outside to prevent leakage.
instructions.4: Prepare the phyllo: Grease the pan with ghee, then begin layering phyllo sheets inside. Fold and crimp the sheets to create an attractive shape.
instructions.5: Pour the batter: Pour the batter over the phyllo layers in the pan.
instructions.6: Bake the cake
instructions.7: Bake in the oven at 170°C for 30 minutes, or until the cake turns golden brown.
instructions.8: Pour syrup over the cake: Immediately pour the cold syrup over the cake right after removing it from the oven.
instructions.9: Let the cake cool: Allow the cake to cool completely so it can fully absorb the syrup.
instructions.10: Serve the cake: Remove the pan, cut the cake into pieces, and serve.

title: Mango Milk Cake (The Glazed Version)
culturalNotes: You can use regular whipping cream instead of crème chantilly if crème chantilly is unavailable. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs with sugar and vanilla in a bowl until the texture becomes foamy.
instructions.2: Add the oil and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Sift the flour, salt, and baking powder into another bowl, then gradually add them to the egg mixture while continuing to mix.
instructions.4: Pour the batter into a greased and floured baking pan.
instructions.5: Bake in a preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius for 45 minutes.
instructions.6: After removing the cake from the oven, poke it with a spoon or knife to help it absorb the milk.
instructions.7: Prepare the milk and pastry cream mixture, then pour it over the cake.
instructions.8: Mix the crème chantilly with condensed milk, then transfer to a pastry bag and pipe it over the cake.
instructions.9: Arrange cubed mango on top of the cream.
instructions.10: Add a layer of glossy gel if desired.
instructions.11: Refrigerate the cake for at least two hours before serving.

title: Rouani Cake
culturalNotes: The cake can be served with coffee or tea. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Prepare a 26 cm cake pan by greasing it with butter and lightly dusting it with flour.
instructions.2: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.3: Mix the all-purpose flour, semolina flour, coconut, powdered milk, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.4: Add the sugar, buttermilk, vanilla, salt, and oil to a mixer and blend thoroughly.
instructions.5: Pour the liquid mixture into the dry ingredients and mix well until fully combined.
instructions.6: Pour the batter into the prepared pan.
instructions.7: Bake in the oven for 40-50 minutes.
instructions.8: Check the cake after 40 minutes to ensure it is fully cooked.
instructions.9: Prepare the syrup by mixing 2 cups of sugar with 2 cups of water and boiling for 4 minutes.
instructions.10: Remove the syrup from heat and let it cool.
instructions.11: Remove the cake from the oven and poke holes in it with a toothpick.
instructions.12: Pour half of the syrup over the cake, then flip it and pour the remaining syrup on the other side.
instructions.13: Let the cake cool completely before serving.

title: Semolina Cake (Rouani)
culturalNotes: Make sure the syrup is completely cold when pouring it over the cake to ensure better absorption. You can decorate the cake with nuts or shredded coconut as desired.

instructions.1: Prepare the syrup: In a saucepan, combine water and sugar, and stir well until sugar dissolves.
instructions.2: Bring the syrup to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 4 minutes after boiling.
instructions.3: Add lemon juice, bring to a single boil, then remove from heat and let cool completely.
instructions.4: Prepare the cake batter: In a large bowl, beat eggs, vanilla, 1 tablespoon vinegar, and a pinch of salt for 2 minutes until fluffy and creamy.
instructions.5: Add half a cup of sugar and beat for 1 minute until smooth and creamy.
instructions.6: Stir in yogurt until well combined.
instructions.7: Gradually add flour, shredded coconut, and baking powder while continuously stirring until the mixture is smooth and even.
instructions.8: Grease a baking pan with butter and lightly dust with flour. Pour in the batter and spread evenly.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 30-40 minutes.
instructions.10: Remove from oven and test for doneness using a wooden skewer.
instructions.11: Pour the cold syrup over the hot cake.
instructions.12: Let the cake cool slightly, then invert onto a serving plate.
instructions.13: Garnish with shredded coconut and nuts as desired.

title: Mango Cake
culturalNotes: You can use any cake type you prefer, whether vanilla cake or a ready-made cake. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Prepare the cream: Place the cream cheese in a bowl and beat it with an electric mixer until smooth.
instructions.2: Add the Chantilly cream, whipped cream, 1 teaspoon of vanilla, 1 cup of sweetened condensed milk, and 1/2 cup of yogurt. Mix the ingredients thoroughly for at least 7 minutes until you achieve a creamy consistency.
instructions.3: Prepare the mango sauce: Blend 1.5 kg of mango with 2 tablespoons of honey and 1/2 cup of water in a blender. Reserve some cubed mango pieces for use in the final dish.
instructions.4: Cut the cake in half.
instructions.5: Assemble the cake: Place a layer of cake in the serving dish, then add a layer of mango sauce, followed by a layer of cream.
instructions.6: Repeat the previous step until all ingredients are used up.
instructions.7: Add the final touches: Place the reserved cubed mango pieces on top of the finished dish.
instructions.8: Cover the cake and refrigerate for at least 6 hours so all ingredients can absorb properly.
instructions.9: Serve the cake chilled and enjoy its delicious taste.

title: Orange Cake with Candied Oranges
culturalNotes: The cake can be served with any preferred beverage. It can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Slice the local oranges into thin slices.
instructions.2: In a saucepan, combine half a cup of sugar and a quarter cup of water, and bring to a boil.
instructions.3: Add the orange slices and cook until caramelized.
instructions.4: In a blender, combine 1 cup of sugar, 4 eggs, 1 tablespoon of orange zest, half a cup of yogurt, half a cup of orange juice, a pinch of salt, and 1 teaspoon of vanilla.
instructions.5: Add 1 cup of butter and oil blend, and blend until the sugar is completely dissolved.
instructions.6: In a bowl, mix 2 and a half cups of flour and 1 packet of baking powder.
instructions.7: Add the blender mixture to the flour and stir well until all ingredients are combined and no flour lumps remain.
instructions.8: Grease a 24 cm baking pan with oil and line it with a buttered parchment paper.
instructions.9: Place the candied orange slices at the bottom of the pan.
instructions.10: Pour the cake batter over the candied orange slices.
instructions.11: Place the pan in a preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.12: Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until fully cooked.
instructions.13: Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.

title: Seven-Cup Cake
culturalNotes: You can use an electric mixer or hand mixer to combine the ingredients. Make sure the oven is preheated before placing the cake inside. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix powdered milk, sugar, all-purpose flour, semolina, coconut, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add eggs, vanilla, and salt and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add vinegar and oil and mix well.
instructions.4: Add liquid milk and mix until smooth.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture into a greased and floured cake pan.
instructions.6: Place the pan into the preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.7: Bake for 40-45 minutes until fully cooked.
instructions.8: Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool slightly.
instructions.9: Prepare the syrup by mixing sugar and water and boiling for 5 minutes, then let the syrup cool completely.
instructions.10: Pour the cold syrup over the cake immediately after removing it from the oven, using a knife to make small holes to help the syrup penetrate.
instructions.11: Let the cake rest for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Orange Semolina Cake
culturalNotes: You can store the cake in an airtight container for up to 3 days. You can also serve it with coffee or tea for a better taste.

instructions.1: Wash the oranges well, peel them, then slice them thinly and blend them to make concentrated juice.
instructions.2: In a bowl, beat the eggs with sugar and vanilla until the mixture changes color and becomes creamy.
instructions.3: Gradually add the oil and beat well, then add the orange juice and beat again.
instructions.4: Sift the flour with baking powder and salt, then add to the mixture and stir well until combined.
instructions.5: Add the vinegar and gently mix in one direction until the batter is smooth and even.
instructions.6: Grease the baking pan with butter and dust with flour, then pour the batter into it.
instructions.7: Place the pan in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius and bake for 50 minutes.
instructions.8: Remove the cake from the oven and test for doneness with a wooden skewer. If it comes out clean, the cake is ready.
instructions.9: Let the cake cool slightly, then serve it dusted with a light sprinkle of sugar.

title: Caramel Cream Cake
culturalNotes: You can store the cake in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. You can also serve the cake with a cup of tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Prepare the caramel: Put half cup of sugar in an aluminum pan over heat with ¼ cup water. Stir the mixture while moving the pan until it turns dark golden. Pour the caramel into the mold.
instructions.2: Prepare the cream: Mix half kilogram of yogurt, 4 eggs, 3 tablespoons of dried yogurt, half cup of sugar, and a small spoon of vanilla in a blender until smooth. Pour the cream over the caramel in the mold.
instructions.3: Prepare the cake: Beat 2 eggs with a small spoon of vanilla and ¼ cup of sugar until creamy. Add half cup of oil and half cup of yogurt and mix well. Add cocoa, baking powder, salt, and sifted flour. Mix thoroughly until combined. Pour the cake batter over the cream.
instructions.4: Bake the cake: Place the mold in a large baking tray and fill the tray with boiling water and ¼ cup of vinegar. Put the tray in a preheated oven at 180°C. Bake for 1 hour.
instructions.5: Serving: Let the cake cool, then gently invert it onto a serving plate. Serve with caramel sauce.

title: Coconut Jam
culturalNotes: Make sure the coconut is fresh, with a sweet smell, fresh taste, and white color for the best results. The jam can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Add 600 grams of sugar and 1/2 cup of water to a saucepan and place on medium heat.
instructions.2: Let the mixture boil gently.
instructions.3: Add 200 grams of glucose syrup and stir well.
instructions.4: When the mixture comes to a boil, remove the saucepan from the heat.
instructions.5: Add 350 grams of coconut and stir thoroughly.
instructions.6: Pour the mixture into a greased and plastic-wrapped tray.
instructions.7: Spread the mixture evenly across the tray.
instructions.8: Sprinkle 100 grams of raisins on top.
instructions.9: Cover the tray with plastic and let it sit for 6 hours or overnight until firm.
instructions.10: Cut the jam into squares or rectangles using an oiled knife.

title: Crispy Glaash
culturalNotes: Can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Can be served warm or cold, as preferred.

instructions.1: Prepare the crumbled glaash and spread it in the baking dish.
instructions.2: Add ghee to the dish and mix the glaash thoroughly with it.
instructions.3: Crisp the glaash and arrange it evenly in the dish.
instructions.4: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.5: Prepare the yogurt mixture by combining sugar and vanilla, stirring until sugar dissolves.
instructions.6: Add cream to the yogurt mixture and stir well.
instructions.7: Pour the yogurt mixture over the baked glaash.
instructions.8: Return the dish to the oven for 5 more minutes.
instructions.9: Serve the glaash with raisins, coconut, and nuts.
instructions.10: Serve the glaash with vanilla ice cream.

title: Molokhia
culturalNotes: Molokhia is best served hot for the best flavor. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Place 1 liter of milk on the stove.
instructions.2: Add 1/2 cup of sugar, vanilla, and stir well.
instructions.3: Let the mixture boil.
instructions.4: When it boils, pour the mixture into the baking dish.
instructions.5: Spread the molokhia in the dish and stir well.
instructions.6: Add raisins and cinnamon to taste.
instructions.7: Add 1 tablespoon of cream to enhance the flavor of the molokhia.
instructions.8: Place the dish in the preheated oven at 180°C for 20 minutes.
instructions.9: Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool slightly.

title: String and Doll Mlabban
culturalNotes: Make sure to stir continuously to prevent the mlabban from sticking to the bottom of the pot. You can use orange blossom water instead of vanilla, according to preference.

instructions.1: In a pot, mix half of the water with sugar and stir well.
instructions.2: Add glucose syrup and stir until dissolved.
instructions.3: In another pot, mix cornstarch with the remaining water and stir until smooth.
instructions.4: Gradually add the cornstarch mixture to the sugar mixture on the stove, stirring continuously.
instructions.5: Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and becomes clear (about 1.5 hours).
instructions.6: Add lemon salt and vanilla, and stir well.
instructions.7: Dip a stick into the hot mlabban and hang it on a surface to dry (about 6 hours or overnight).
instructions.8: Grease a tray or baking pan with oil. Spread half of the mlabban onto the tray and sprinkle nuts on top.
instructions.9: Add red food coloring to the remaining mlabban and stir well.
instructions.10: Pour the rest of the mlabban into the tray and smooth the surface with an oiled spatula.
instructions.11: Let the mlabban cool and dry completely (about 6 hours or overnight).
instructions.12: Cut the mlabban into desired shapes and serve.

title: Mini Koughka
culturalNotes: Store koughka in an airtight metal container to maintain its quality and crispiness. You can use powdered milk instead of water, but water gives better results.

instructions.1: Mix the cold shortening with the sifted powdered sugar until the texture becomes creamy.
instructions.2: Add the koughka and biscuit-specific flour, baking powder, koughka essence, and salt. Sift them thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the Chantilly cream and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.4: Gradually add the warm water and knead the dough until it becomes smooth and soft.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into small pieces and decorate them using your preferred method.
instructions.6: Place the koughka on a baking tray and let it rest for 30 minutes before baking.
instructions.7: Preheat the oven to 160°C for plain koughka and 180°C for stuffed koughka.
instructions.8: Bake the koughka for 30 minutes or until golden brown.
instructions.9: Let the koughka cool completely before adding the powdered sugar.

title: Eclair
culturalNotes: Make sure the dough becomes a single mass when adding flour, and let it cool slightly before adding eggs. Bake the eclairs in the oven for 40 minutes, then leave them to cool in the oven for an additional 30 minutes for best results.

instructions.1: Heat water and milk in a saucepan over heat, add butter, salt, and sugar. Stir ingredients well until butter melts.
instructions.2: When the liquid boils, add flour all at once and stir quickly until the dough comes together into a single mass.
instructions.3: Cook the dough on heat for one minute while stirring continuously, then remove from heat and let it cool slightly.
instructions.4: Add eggs one at a time, stirring continuously until the dough is well blended.
instructions.5: Bake the dough on a greased tray, or one lined with parchment paper or silicone, at 180 degrees for 40 minutes.
instructions.6: After baking, leave the eclairs to cool in the oven for 30 minutes with a small crack open.
instructions.7: Prepare the cream filling: heat milk in a saucepan. In another bowl, mix egg yolks, vanilla, cornstarch, and sugar. Add half of the milk to the egg mixture and stir well.
instructions.8: Pour the mixture back into the remaining milk in the saucepan and stir over low heat until thickened.
instructions.9: Add butter and stir until melted. Let the cream cool, then cover with plastic wrap pressed directly onto the surface to prevent a dry skin from forming.
instructions.10: Fill the eclairs with cream using a thin piping tip and pastry bag.
instructions.11: Melt chocolate in a double boiler, then dip the tip of each eclair into the chocolate and let it dry.

title: Homemade Fresh Mozzarella
culturalNotes: The leftover liquid from making this cheese can be used in pizza or pancake dough for excellent results.

instructions.1: Heat the milk in a pot over the stove, stirring continuously until it reaches a warm temperature but not boiling.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of white vinegar and stir in one direction for a short while, then switch to stirring in the opposite direction.
instructions.3: Let the milk sit until it starts to clump and turn into curds.
instructions.4: Remove the pot from the heat and strain the curds through a colander, squeezing out the excess liquid.
instructions.5: Add one large spoon of salt to the curds and return them to the pot over low heat.
instructions.6: Submerge the curds in the hot liquid and cover them with a wooden spoon until they begin to stretch and firm up.
instructions.7: Remove the curds and shape them into balls, then place them in cold water for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Cover the cheese with plastic wrap and refrigerate for two hours until cooled and firm.
instructions.9: This cheese can be used in sandwiches, pizza, or Naples-style Kunafa.

title: Quick Brownies
culturalNotes: Make sure the oven is preheated for the best results. You can add chocolate or vanilla sauce when serving for better flavor.

instructions.1: Take a bowl and add the oil and water.
instructions.2: Mix the ingredients well.
instructions.3: Open the brownie mix box and add its contents to the mixture.
instructions.4: Stir the ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.5: Take a baking dish and line its base with parchment paper.
instructions.6: Grease the dish with oil or ghee.
instructions.7: Pour the brownie mixture into the dish.
instructions.8: Place the dish in the preheated oven at 170°C for 20 minutes.
instructions.9: Remove the brownies from the oven and cut them into your preferred shape.
instructions.10: Serve the brownies with chocolate sauce.

title: Mango Trifle
culturalNotes: You can chill the trifle in the refrigerator for 2-3 hours before serving for best flavor. You can also add other fruit pieces like strawberries or blueberries as desired.

instructions.1: Cut the cake into thin slices and set aside.
instructions.2: Mix Chantilly cream with 1 cup of frozen milk and use an electric mixer to whip the mixture for 7 minutes until the texture becomes creamy and firm.
instructions.3: Place a layer of cake at the bottom of the container.
instructions.4: Pour diluted mango juice mixed with honey over the cake.
instructions.5: Add a layer of the whipped cream.
instructions.6: Add a layer of sliced mango.
instructions.7: Repeat steps 3 to 5 until all ingredients are used up.
instructions.8: Add a final layer of cream and decorate the trifle with Chantilly cream rosettes.

title: Oreo Cheesecake
culturalNotes: Cheesecake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. You can also decorate the cheesecake with fresh fruits or sauce.

instructions.1: Prepare the base: Crush the cookies finely in a food processor until smooth.
instructions.2: Add the softened butter to the crushed cookies and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Pour the cookie mixture into the bottom of a cheesecake pan and press firmly until compact.
instructions.4: Place the pan in the refrigerator.
instructions.5: Prepare the filling: Beat the cream cheese with powdered sugar and vanilla in a bowl using an electric mixer until smooth.
instructions.6: Add the raw chantilly cream, cold milk, and liquid dessert cream. Mix until the mixture becomes thick.
instructions.7: You can add 4 tablespoons of crushed cookies to the filling for extra flavor.
instructions.8: Remove the pan from the refrigerator and pour the filling over the base.
instructions.9: Spread the filling evenly in the pan and tap the pan lightly to smooth the surface.
instructions.10: Place the pan back in the refrigerator for at least 6 hours.
instructions.11: After the time has passed, remove the pan from the refrigerator and slice the cheesecake.
instructions.12: You can decorate the cheesecake with crushed cookies or melted chocolate as desired.

title: Strawberry Cheesecake
culturalNotes: Chocolate or caramel sauce can be added as desired. The cheesecake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Grind the graham crackers until finely crushed
instructions.2: Add butter and sugar to the ground crackers and mix thoroughly
instructions.3: Press the mixture into the bottom of the pan and preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius
instructions.4: Bake the crust for 10 minutes
instructions.5: Mix cream cheese with powdered sugar, vanilla, heavy cream, and whipping cream
instructions.6: Pour the mixture over the baked crust and smooth it evenly
instructions.7: Place the pan in the refrigerator for at least 6 hours
instructions.8: Prepare the strawberry sauce by mixing strawberries with sugar and cornstarch dissolved in water
instructions.9: Pour the sauce over the cheesecake after it has chilled
instructions.10: Serve the cheesecake after it has chilled thoroughly

title: Ice Cream and Sponge Cake Tort
culturalNotes: Any type of frozen fruit can be used to make the sauce. The tort can be stored in the freezer for up to 3 days. Serve the tort with coffee or tea.

instructions.1: Prepare the sponge cake: Mix the contents of the cake pack with 6 eggs and 1/2 cup water using an electric mixer for 2 minutes on low speed, then 6 minutes on high speed.
instructions.2: Pour the mixture into a greased baking pan and bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees for 20-25 minutes.
instructions.3: Prepare the ice cream: Mix the contents of the ice cream pack with 200 ml of liquid milk using an electric mixer for 3-4 minutes until the texture becomes creamy.
instructions.4: Pour the ice cream into a bowl and place it in the freezer for 5-6 hours until fully frozen.
instructions.5: Prepare the strawberry sauce: Boil frozen strawberries with 1/2 cup water and 1 cup sugar until the strawberries break down, then blend until smooth. Add 1 tablespoon lemon juice and simmer until thickened.
instructions.6: Assemble the tort: Cut the cake into thin slices, layer with strawberry ice cream, then vanilla ice cream. Place in the freezer until firm.
instructions.7: Garnish the tort: Pour the strawberry sauce over the top of the tort and decorate with fresh strawberries or berries.

title: Blender Economy Cake
culturalNotes: The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. It can be served with coffee or tea.

instructions.1: Prepare the ingredients and preheat the oven to 170 degrees.
instructions.2: Put a drop of oil in the baking pan and spread it well, then place the parchment paper.
instructions.3: Mix the eggs, sugar, oil, vanilla, and salt in the blender until well combined.
instructions.4: Gradually add the sifted flour and baking powder to the liquid mixture, stirring in one direction until no lumps remain.
instructions.5: Pour the batter into the pan and bake in the oven for 12 minutes.
instructions.6: Prepare the cream by mixing crème chantilly, laban cream, powdered sugar, vanilla, and cold milk using an electric mixer.
instructions.7: Place the cream in the refrigerator to chill.
instructions.8: Prepare the syrup by mixing warm water and white honey, or boil ¼ cup sugar with ½ cup water on the stove.
instructions.9: Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool, then cut it into 3 layers.
instructions.10: Place a layer of cream at the bottom of the dish, then add a cake layer, sprinkle the syrup on it, followed by another layer of cream and strawberry pieces.
instructions.11: Repeat the previous step to build the remaining layers.
instructions.12: Spread the cream over the top of the cake, smooth it, then refrigerate for 10 minutes.
instructions.13: Melt the white chocolate and break it into pieces, then use it to decorate the cake and place strawberries on top.

title: Celebration Cake for 2 Million Subscribers
culturalNotes: You can add dried fruits or walnuts to the cake mixture for extra flavor. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: In a large bowl, mix the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
instructions.2: Add the butter, milk, eggs, vanilla, and cocoa, and mix thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Pour the cake batter into a buttered and floured baking pan.
instructions.4: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 30 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.5: After removing the cake from the oven, let it cool completely.
instructions.6: In another bowl, whip the whipped cream with powdered sugar until thick.
instructions.7: Spread the whipped cream over the cake surface and decorate with chopped chocolate.
instructions.8: Serve the cake with melted chocolate on top.

title: Celebration Cake with a Million Subscribers
culturalNotes: You can add dried fruits or walnuts to the cake mixture for extra flavor. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: In a large bowl, mix the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
instructions.2: Add the milk, eggs, butter, and vanilla, and mix all ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Pour the cake batter into a buttered and floured baking pan.
instructions.4: Place the pan in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius and bake for 45 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.5: After removing the cake from the oven, let it cool completely.
instructions.6: In another bowl, whip the whipping cream until thick.
instructions.7: Spread the whipped cream over the cake surface and decorate with chopped chocolate.
instructions.8: Serve the celebration cake with a cup of tea or coffee.

title: Kunafa
culturalNotes: You can store the kunafa in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Serve it with a cup of tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs with sugar, oil, yogurt, vanilla, and salt in a blender until the mixture is well combined.
instructions.2: Add the flour, cocoa, baking powder, and instant coffee, and mix thoroughly until the batter is smooth and even.
instructions.3: Pour the batter into a greased and floured baking pan.
instructions.4: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Prepare the sauce by mixing yogurt, sugar, cocoa, and oil in a bowl and stirring well.
instructions.6: Pour the sauce over the cake after it has cooled slightly.
instructions.7: Prepare the ganache by gently heating cream and grated chocolate in a bowl until the chocolate melts completely.
instructions.8: Pour the ganache over the cake and let it cool completely before serving.

title: Easy and Quick Chocolate Cake
culturalNotes: You can use any type of chocolate for the topping, whether milk chocolate or dark chocolate. You can also add any other fresh fruits for garnish.

instructions.1: Prepare the cake batter: Mix the contents of the sponge cake box with 5.5 cups of water and 5 eggs in a bowl or mixer. Beat the mixture for 3 minutes on low speed, then 7 minutes on high speed until the consistency becomes thick and firm.
instructions.2: Pour the batter into a greased and floured cake pan. Bake in a preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius for 30 minutes or until fully cooked.
instructions.3: Prepare the cream: Mix 2 boxes of Dreem chocolate shimmies cream with 1 cup of frozen yogurt in a bowl. Beat thoroughly until smooth and creamy. Add 0.5 cup of grated chocolate and beat again.
instructions.4: Prepare the syrup: Mix half a cup of water with 1 cup of sugar and 3 tablespoons of white honey over medium heat until the sugar dissolves. Let the syrup cool.
instructions.5: Cut the cake into 3 layers. Brush each layer with syrup and spread a layer of cream between each layer. Add dates on top of the cream.
instructions.6: Cover the cake with cream and spread dates and strawberries on top. Refrigerate for 30 minutes until set.
instructions.7: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler and pour over the top of the cake. Sprinkle cookies and strawberries on top.
instructions.8: Let the cake chill in the refrigerator until completely cooled before serving.

title: Mirror Chocolate Cake
culturalNotes: Make sure the cake is completely cooled before pouring the mirror chocolate glaze to ensure a smooth, shiny finish. You can decorate the cake with strawberries and grated chocolate as desired.

instructions.1: Prepare the filling: Mix the chopped strawberries, sugar, lemon juice, and water in a saucepan over low heat until the mixture thickens. Mash some of the strawberries with a spoon and let the mixture cool.
instructions.2: Prepare the cake: Cut the ready-made cake in half. Brush the bottom half with a sugar-water mixture. Mix half a kilogram of chantilly cream and spread it over the bottom cake layer. Add the cooled strawberry filling. Place the top half of the cake on top and spread the remaining chantilly cream evenly over the surface.
instructions.3: Prepare the mirror chocolate glaze: Dissolve the gelatin in 50 grams of water. In a saucepan, combine the sweetened condensed milk, unsweetened chocolate, sugar, and water. Heat over low heat until boiling. Add the dissolved gelatin and stir well. Mix in the raw cocoa powder and stir until fully blended. Blend the mixture with a hand blender to ensure no lumps remain. Strain the mixture.
instructions.4: Pour the mirror chocolate glaze over the chilled cake and refrigerate for 3 hours. Make sure the cake is very cold before pouring the glaze.
instructions.5: Decorate the cake with fresh strawberries and grated chocolate as desired.

title: Restaurant-Style Cake with One Cup of Flour
culturalNotes: Choose good-quality butter for better flavor. You can use Seven Up, Sprite, or fruit juice instead of syrup to moisten the cake.

instructions.1: Prepare the pans: Grease rectangular pans measuring 25×30 with butter and lightly dust with flour.
instructions.2: Prepare the cake batter: Beat the eggs with sugar, vanilla, and salt in a bowl until the mixture becomes light and fluffy.
instructions.3: Gradually add the oil while continuing to beat.
instructions.4: Mix the flour, cocoa, and baking powder together, then gently fold into the batter to maintain airiness.
instructions.5: Pour the batter evenly into the prepared pans.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius for 15-20 minutes.
instructions.7: Prepare the frosting: Combine powdered sugar, cocoa, butter, boiling water, chocolate, and salt in a bowl and beat thoroughly.
instructions.8: Prepare the syrup: Boil 1 cup of water with 1 cup of sugar until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.9: Cut the cake into 4 layers and brush each layer with syrup.
instructions.10: Fill the cake: Place a layer of frosting between each cake layer.
instructions.11: Cover the entire cake with frosting and refrigerate until set.
instructions.12: Serve the cake: Cut into pieces using a knife dipped in hot water, wiping it clean between each cut.
instructions.13: Decorate the cake: You can decorate with whipped cream, grated chocolate, strawberries, or cherries as desired.

title: Luxury Chocolate Cake on a Budget
culturalNotes: Make sure the cream is very thick when filling the cake to prevent leakage. You can use different types of chocolate to achieve varied flavors.

instructions.1: Mix 1 cup whipping cream with 1/2 cup frozen milk and beat well until the cream becomes thick, then refrigerate.
instructions.2: In another bowl, beat 5 eggs with 1 teaspoon vanilla and 1 cup and 1/4 sugar until fluffy.
instructions.3: Add 1 cup flour, 1/2 teaspoon baking powder, 1/4 cup cocoa powder, and a pinch of salt; mix thoroughly until smooth.
instructions.4: Pour the batter into a greased and floured 40 by 50 cm baking tray.
instructions.5: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
instructions.6: Let the cake cool, then cut it into pieces.
instructions.7: Fill each piece with the previously prepared cream, then coat with melted chocolate.
instructions.8: Slice the strawberries and place them on top of the cake.
instructions.9: Refrigerate the cake for 10 minutes until the chocolate sets.

title: Chocolate Ganache
culturalNotes: Ganache can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. It can be used to decorate cakes or other desserts.

instructions.1: Warm the cream in a saucepan over medium heat until warm, but do not let it boil.
instructions.2: Add the chopped chocolate to the warm cream and stir until the chocolate is completely melted.
instructions.3: If the chocolate needs more melting, microwave the mixture for an additional 10 seconds.
instructions.4: Let the ganache cool slightly, then spread it over the cake.
instructions.5: Garnish the cake with ganache and serve.

title: Rocky Road with Marshmallows
culturalNotes: You can reduce the quantities if you wish to make a smaller batch. You can also use any type of plain biscuit instead of Digestive biscuits.

instructions.1: Chop the small marshmallows if they are large, to make them smaller.
instructions.2: Mix 100 grams of crushed dates.
instructions.3: Mix 500 grams of biscuits and 500 grams of grated dark chocolate.
instructions.4: In a bowl, combine the can of cream with 1/2 cup of milk and place on the stove.
instructions.5: Add 1 large tablespoon of butter and let the mixture heat up well without boiling.
instructions.6: Pour the hot mixture over the grated chocolate and stir until the chocolate melts and blends smoothly.
instructions.7: Add the crumbled biscuits, marshmallows, and crushed dates. Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.8: Prepare a rectangular baking pan and line it with parchment paper or plastic wrap.
instructions.9: Pour the mixture into the pan and smooth the surface with a spatula to achieve an even layer.
instructions.10: Cover the pan with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
instructions.11: After the time has passed, remove the pan and invert it onto a cutting surface.
instructions.12: Cut the rocky road into cubes, both in width and length.
instructions.13: Serve the rocky road with a cup of coffee, or store it in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

title: Oreo Souffle
culturalNotes: This dessert can be served warm or cold, according to preference. It can also be decorated with chocolate pieces or fruits.

instructions.1: Mix the cookie pieces with 1 cup of milk, 1/2 cup of Chantilly cream, and 1 can of whipped cream in the blender until well combined.
instructions.2: Wash the silicone molds and fill them with the cookie mixture.
instructions.3: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius.
instructions.4: Place the molds in the oven tray and bake for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: Remove from the oven and decorate with powdered sugar or cookie pieces.

title: Chocolate Swiss Roll
culturalNotes: You can use any fruit you prefer in the filling, such as cherries or berries. The Swiss roll can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs with sugar and vanilla in a bowl and beat well until the mixture turns from yellow to a creamy white.
instructions.2: Add the oil and stir thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the salt and stir.
instructions.4: Mix the flour, cocoa powder, and baking powder together and sift them, then add to the egg mixture and gently fold until fully combined.
instructions.5: Preheat the oven to 170°C (338°F). Grease a rectangular baking pan with butter and lightly dust with flour and cocoa powder.
instructions.6: Pour the cake batter into the pan and spread it evenly.
instructions.7: Bake in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the cake is firm and no longer jiggly.
instructions.8: Prepare the cream: Beat the Chantilly cream with powdered sugar and frozen yogurt for 7 minutes until light and fluffy.
instructions.9: Add the chocolate sauce and mix well.
instructions.10: Refrigerate the cream for a few minutes.
instructions.11: Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool slightly. Then flip it onto a parchment paper and roll it while still warm.
instructions.12: Layer strawberries, chocolate chips, and maraschino cherries on the cake as desired.
instructions.13: Gently roll the cake again and refrigerate for 3–4 hours.
instructions.14: Remove from the fridge and dust with cocoa powder and decorate with garnishes.
instructions.15: Serve the chocolate Swiss roll chilled.

title: Cinnamon Roll Creamy Sauce
culturalNotes: You can add a little vanilla to the sauce to enhance its flavor. The sauce can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the cream cheese and sweetened condensed milk in a bowl.
instructions.2: Stir the ingredients well until fully combined.
instructions.3: Pour the sauce into a small bowl and serve with cinnamon roll.

title: Japanese Pancake with Strawberries
culturalNotes: You can use homemade strawberry jam for a better taste. You can also serve the pancake with white honey.

instructions.1: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
