title: Homemade Yogurt
culturalNotes: Make sure to use high-quality milk and boil it thoroughly to ensure cleanliness. Yogurt can be served with fruits or honey as desired.

instructions.1: Boil 2 kilograms of milk over heat, stirring continuously to prevent dry skin formation.
instructions.2: Turn off the heat, cover the milk, and let it cool slightly until warm.
instructions.3: Add 2 jars of yogurt to the warm milk and stir well until fully mixed.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into serving dishes or bowls and cover them.
instructions.5: Place the dishes into a preheated oven (around 100 degrees Celsius) and bake for 4 hours.
instructions.6: After 4 hours, place the dishes in the refrigerator for 4 hours or overnight to stop bacterial activity.

title: Lotus Butter
culturalNotes: Butter can be stored in the jar for over a month in the refrigerator. Serve with sandwiches or as a spread.

instructions.1: Blend the cookies in the blender.
instructions.2: Add the cinnamon.
instructions.3: Add the caramel sauce.
instructions.4: Mix the ingredients thoroughly until you achieve a uniform consistency.
instructions.5: Transfer the mixture to a clean and dry jar.

title: Clotted Cream Butter and Taameya Bread
culturalNotes: Taameya bread can be stored in sealed bags in the freezer and used as needed. Serve the bread with cheese, honey, and clotted cream.

instructions.1: Take the clotted cream from the freezer and let it sit at room temperature.
instructions.2: Blend the clotted cream in a mixer until it turns into butter and oil separates.
instructions.3: Strain the oil and store the butter in a bowl.
instructions.4: Mix flour, salt, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.5: Add the remaining clotted cream (the curd) to the flour and knead until the dough becomes firm.
instructions.6: Let the dough rest for one minute.
instructions.7: Heat a taameya griddle on high heat.
instructions.8: Place the dough onto the hot griddle and flip it once.
instructions.9: Cover the bread after removing it from the griddle to keep it soft.

title: Sabliya
culturalNotes: You can shape sabliya into any form you like. You can also add cocoa to half of the dough to make chocolate sabliya. Sabliya can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: Sift the flour twice.
instructions.2: Add the butter and powdered sugar and beat well until the mixture becomes light and creamy.
instructions.3: Add the egg and vanilla and mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add the salt and mix.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour and mix until all ingredients are well combined.
instructions.6: Knead the dough lightly, but do not overwork it.
instructions.7: Cover the dough and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
instructions.8: Clean and grease your work surface, then roll out the dough between two plastic bags to a thickness of less than half a centimeter.
instructions.9: Use different shaped cutters to cut the dough.
instructions.10: Place the pieces onto a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 12-15 minutes.
instructions.12: Remove from the oven and let cool.
instructions.13: You can decorate sabliya with caramel, jam, or chocolate as desired.

title: Melted Chocolate
culturalNotes: Make sure the water is warm, not too hot, to prevent chocolate from seizing. This method can be used to melt any type of chocolate easily and quickly.

instructions.1: Chop the white and dark chocolate into small pieces or grate them.
instructions.2: Add 100 grams of white chocolate to a plastic bag with one tablespoon of oil.
instructions.3: Spread the oil over the chocolate inside the bag.
instructions.4: Squeeze out the air from the bag and tie it tightly.
instructions.5: Add 100 grams of dark chocolate to another plastic bag with one tablespoon of oil.
instructions.6: Spread the oil over the chocolate inside the bag.
instructions.7: Squeeze out the air from the bag and tie it tightly.
instructions.8: Submerge both bags in warm water for 5 minutes.
instructions.9: Make sure the chocolate has completely melted.
instructions.10: Open the bag from the side to avoid water getting in.
instructions.11: Pour the melted chocolate into a bowl and use it for decorating.

title: Toffee Sauce
culturalNotes: The sauce can be used to garnish cakes, cinnamon rolls, and donuts. It can be stored in the refrigerator for a long time.

instructions.1: Place the cup of sugar and quarter cup of water in a saucepan over heat.
instructions.2: Gently shake the saucepan until the sugar dissolves and turns golden.
instructions.3: Once it turns golden, add the can of whipping cream and stir until well combined.
instructions.4: Gradually add half cup of yogurt according to desired consistency.
instructions.5: Simmer the sauce on low heat until it reaches the desired thickness.
instructions.6: Once cooled, transfer the sauce to a bowl, cover it, and refrigerate.

title: Kunafa
culturalNotes: You can add nuts, cream, or caramel sauce on top of kunafa before serving for extra flavor. Kunafa can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Boil the macaroni in hot water without oil or salt until cooked.
instructions.2: Add milk and sugar to the blender and mix well.
instructions.3: Mix cornstarch and Chantilly cream in a cup of milk.
instructions.4: Add the boiled macaroni to the milk and sugar mixture in the blender and blend together.
instructions.5: Transfer the mixture to a pot and cook over medium heat. Add egg yolks, vanilla, Chantilly cream, and cornstarch. Stir continuously until it boils and thickens.
instructions.6: Pour the mixture into a buttered baking dish and spread evenly.
instructions.7: Let it cool completely for 2 hours.
instructions.8: Bake in the oven at 180°C for 30 minutes or until the top turns golden brown.
instructions.9: Let the kunafa cool completely before cutting.
instructions.10: Add nuts, cream, or caramel sauce on top as desired.

title: Making Labneh from Milk and Yogurt
culturalNotes: Labneh can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for 3-4 days. The liquid drained from labneh can be used in dough for pastries, sambosas, and pizza.

instructions.1: Place milk in a pot over heat and stir continuously until it boils.
instructions.2: Remove milk from heat and let it cool slightly until warm.
instructions.3: Add yogurt to the warm milk and stir well until fully combined.
instructions.4: Place the mixture in a closed, warm oven for 4 hours.
instructions.5: After 4 hours, transfer the mixture to the refrigerator for another 4 hours.
instructions.6: Strain the mixture through a clean cloth and let it drain completely; you can place a heavy plate on top of the cloth to speed up the straining process.
instructions.7: Add salt to the labneh after straining and mix well.
instructions.8: Serve labneh with thyme or tomatoes and olives as desired.

title: French Toast with Pudding
culturalNotes: Brown sugar can be used instead of white sugar, and one tablespoon of black honey can be added for flavor. The dish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

fah-634-i1.name: Toast or croissant or French bread

instructions.1: Spread half the butter (1/4 cup) in the baking dish and sprinkle 1/2 cup of sugar on the bottom.
instructions.2: Arrange slices of toast, croissant, or French bread in the baking dish.
instructions.3: In a blender, mix the eggs with the milk, remaining sugar (1/4 cup), remaining butter (1/4 cup), vanilla, and salt until well combined.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture over the bread slices in the dish.
instructions.5: Preheat the oven to 220°C and place the dish in the middle rack until golden and set (about 30 minutes).
instructions.6: Garnish the dish after removing from the oven with vanilla ice cream, strawberries, chopped nuts, and caramel sauce to taste.

title: Qishra
culturalNotes: Fresh yogurt can be used instead of dried yogurt for similar results. Qishra remains usable for up to two weeks if stored in the refrigerator.

instructions.1: Boil the yogurt in a pot over low heat until it simmers.
instructions.2: Cover the pot and leave it in a warm oven for 24 hours.
instructions.3: Strain the dried yogurt through a sieve and sprinkle 1 teaspoon of salt over it.
instructions.4: Let the strained yogurt (cottage cheese) sit in the sieve to dry for 24 hours.
instructions.5: Mix the red pepper and ground cumin with the dried yogurt in a blender.
instructions.6: Add the cottage cheese to the blended mixture.
instructions.7: Serve the qishra with honey to taste.

title: Raisin and Nut Cupcakes
culturalNotes: You can use regular milk instead of thick yogurt. When preparing the chantilly cream, make sure not to add too much liquid so the cream stays firm.

instructions.1: Mix sugar, eggs, and vanilla in a large bowl and beat with an electric mixer until the mixture turns pale and creamy.
instructions.2: Add butter and oil and mix well.
instructions.3: Add yogurt and mix again.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix flour with salt and baking powder.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour mixture to the egg and oil mixture, stirring slowly until ingredients are well combined.
instructions.6: Mix raisins and nuts with one teaspoon of flour, then fold into the batter gently.
instructions.7: Fill cupcake molds with two-thirds of the batter.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Reduce temperature to 160°C and continue baking for 10 more minutes.
instructions.10: Remove cupcakes from the oven and let them cool.
instructions.11: Garnish cupcakes with chantilly cream as desired.

title: Oat Cookies with Raisins
culturalNotes: You can reduce the sugar amount according to preference. You can use different types of nuts depending on availability and personal taste. This recipe is very beneficial for both children and adults.

instructions.1: Mix sugar and butter in a bowl until the mixture becomes creamy.
instructions.2: Add eggs and vanilla and mix well.
instructions.3: Add black honey and mix again.
instructions.4: Add cinnamon, baking powder, and salt and mix ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.5: Add sifted flour and mix until the dough is well combined.
instructions.6: Add oats and mix gently.
instructions.7: Add raisins and nuts and mix until evenly distributed.
instructions.8: Preheat oven to 160 degrees Celsius.
instructions.9: Shape cookies onto a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.10: Bake cookies for 12-15 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.11: Let cookies cool slightly before serving.

title: Coconut Cookies
culturalNotes: Cookies can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week. Serve with tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Cream the butter and powdered sugar in a bowl using an electric mixer until light and fluffy.
instructions.2: Add the eggs and vanilla, and mix well until fully combined.
instructions.3: In a separate bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, and coconut.
instructions.4: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture and mix until a uniform dough forms.
instructions.5: Dust your work surface with flour and roll out the dough to about 1/2 cm thickness.
instructions.6: Use a cookie cutter to shape the dough.
instructions.7: Place the cookies on a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.8: Sprinkle granulated sugar on top of each cookie.
instructions.9: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.10: Let the cookies cool slightly before serving.

title: Fruit Jelly Cake
culturalNotes: Make sure the chantilly cream is well-set before spreading it on the cake to prevent the jelly from sinking. You can use any type of fruit according to preference.

instructions.1: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
instructions.2: Mix flour, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.3: In another bowl, beat eggs with vanilla and sugar until the mixture turns white.
instructions.4: Add oil and yogurt and mix well.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour mixture and mix until smooth.
instructions.6: Pour the batter into a greased and floured baking pan.
instructions.7: Bake in the oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown.
instructions.8: In a bowl, boil 2 cups of water and add two packets of jelly, stirring until dissolved.
instructions.9: Add 1 cup of cold water and mix well, then let the mixture cool.
instructions.10: Whip the chantilly cream and spread it over the cake.
instructions.11: Place chopped fruits on top of the chantilly cream.
instructions.12: Pour the cooled jelly over the fruits.
instructions.13: Refrigerate the cake for 4-5 hours until set.

title: Hot Milk Cake
culturalNotes: You can add dried fruits as desired. The cake can be served warm or cold.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and baking powder thoroughly.
instructions.2: In another bowl, mix the oil, butter, and sugar for two minutes.
instructions.3: Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
instructions.4: Add the vanilla, salt, and vinegar, and mix well.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour mixture while continuing to mix.
instructions.6: Add the hot milk and mix until the batter is smooth and well combined.
instructions.7: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.8: Wash a 26 cm baking pan, grease it with butter, and lightly dust with flour.
instructions.9: Pour the batter into the pan, making sure it does not exceed half the pan.
instructions.10: Place the pan in the middle rack of the oven and bake for 45 minutes.
instructions.11: Insert a wooden skewer into the center of the cake; if it comes out clean, the cake is done.

title: Quick Chocolate Cake in the Microwave
culturalNotes: The cake can be served with a glass of milk or tea.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the yogurt and oil, and mix the ingredients well.
instructions.3: Add the baking powder and cocoa powder, and mix again.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into a microwave-safe bowl.
instructions.5: Dollop the center of the mixture with 1 large tablespoon of melted chocolate.
instructions.6: Place the bowl in the microwave and cook for 2 minutes.
instructions.7: Remove from the microwave and serve with a spoonful of chocolate.

title: Ten-Minute Cake
culturalNotes: Serve the cake with tea or coffee. Make sure the cake is completely cooled before slicing to avoid crumbling.

instructions.1: Make sure all ingredients are at room temperature.
instructions.2: Mix the eggs, yogurt, oil, vanilla, and salt in the blender.
instructions.3: Add the sugar and mix the ingredients thoroughly for 1 or 2 minutes.
instructions.4: Sift the flour with baking powder and gradually add it to the liquid mixture. Mix using a hand mixer in one direction.
instructions.5: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius and grease a 26 cm cake pan.
instructions.6: Pour the batter into the pan and reserve two large spoonfuls of batter.
instructions.7: Mix the two large spoonfuls of batter with 1 tablespoon of raw cocoa powder. Add 2 tablespoons of milk if the mixture is too thick.
instructions.8: Transfer the mixture to a piping bag and pipe vertical and horizontal lines onto the cake surface.
instructions.9: Bake the cake in the middle rack of the oven for 45 minutes.
instructions.10: Check the cake after 35 minutes using a toothpick. If it comes out clean, the cake is ready.
instructions.11: Let the cake cool completely before slicing.

title: Cold Crème Caramel Cake
culturalNotes: You can use any type of biscuit you prefer. You can also add a little vanilla for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Crush the biscuits into large pieces.
instructions.2: Take 1 kilogram of cold milk and pour the crème caramel pack into it.
instructions.3: Add 2 tablespoons of instant coffee, 2 tablespoons of raw cocoa, 2 tablespoons of cornstarch, and 2 tablespoons of sugar.
instructions.4: Stir the ingredients well into the cold milk.
instructions.5: Place the mixture on the stove and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and continue stirring until the consistency becomes thick.
instructions.6: Remove from heat and pour the mixture over the crushed biscuits in a glass dish.
instructions.7: Cover the dish and place it in the refrigerator until chilled.
instructions.8: Once chilled, invert the cake onto a serving plate and sprinkle raw cocoa on top.
instructions.9: Serve the cake cold.

title: No-Oven Cake
culturalNotes: You can serve the cake as is, or decorate it with chocolate sauce or any other sauce of your choice. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix the eggs with vanilla and sugar thoroughly.
instructions.2: Add the oil and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.3: Add the yogurt and mix well until smooth.
instructions.4: Add the flour, baking powder, cocoa powder, and salt. Mix dry ingredients with wet ingredients until fully combined.
instructions.5: Lightly grease the cake pan with oil. If using an aluminum pan, grease it with butter and lightly dust with flour.
instructions.6: Pour the cake batter into the pan, making sure it does not exceed half the pan's height.
instructions.7: Place the pan inside a larger pot filled with boiling water, ensuring the water level does not exceed one-third of the pan.
instructions.8: Cover the pot with a kitchen towel, then close with the lid. Cook over medium heat for 40 minutes.
instructions.9: After 40 minutes, check the cake's doneness by inserting a wooden skewer into the center. If it comes out clean, the cake is fully baked.
instructions.10: Remove the cake from the pot and let it cool slightly, then invert it onto a flat surface.
instructions.11: Serve the cake warm or cold, and decorate with chocolate sauce or any other sauce of your choice.

title: Marbled Mousse Cake Without Oven
culturalNotes: You can use different types of biscuits according to preference. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix milk, sugar, raw cocoa, cornstarch, caramel cream dream, raw chocolate, and instant coffee in a bowl.
instructions.2: Stir the ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Cook the mixture over medium heat until it starts boiling, stirring constantly.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into cake molds and place pieces of plain tea biscuits inside.
instructions.5: Cover the molds and refrigerate for 5-6 hours until set.
instructions.6: After setting, remove the molds and invert them onto a bowl of hot water to help release the cake easily.
instructions.7: Serve the cake chilled.

title: Chocolate Oat Cake for Diet
culturalNotes: Vegetable oil can be used instead of coconut oil. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix cocoa powder with oat flour, baking soda, baking powder, and Sweetal sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add low-fat yogurt, vinegar, and coconut oil to the dry ingredients and stir well.
instructions.3: Pour the mixture into muffin cups until half full.
instructions.4: Place the muffin cups in a pot with boiling water, ensuring the water level does not exceed one-third of the muffin cups' height.
instructions.5: Cover the pot with a clean cloth, then with the lid.
instructions.6: Let the cake bake for 3 hours.
instructions.7: After 3 hours, check the cake's doneness with a wooden skewer.
instructions.8: Prepare the chocolate sauce by mixing 1 cup dark chocolate with ½ cup low-fat warm milk.
instructions.9: Pour the sauce over the baked cake.
instructions.10: Garnish the cake with sliced strawberries and kiwi as desired.

title: Quick Biscuit Cake Without Oven
culturalNotes: You can add chocolate chips or dried fruits as desired for extra flavor.

instructions.1: Crush the biscuits until finely ground.
instructions.2: Bring out the milk.
instructions.3: Add the flour to the crushed biscuit mixture.
instructions.4: Add the cocoa, sugar, and baking powder.
instructions.5: Mix the ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.6: Transfer the mixture into a microwave-safe bowl.
instructions.7: Heat the mixture in the microwave for exactly 1 minute.
instructions.8: Remove the cake from the microwave and serve warm.

title: Mango Jelly Cake
culturalNotes: The cake can be served with a little fresh mango or other fruits as desired. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Beat the eggs with vanilla and sugar until the mixture becomes creamy.
instructions.2: Add the flour, baking powder, and salt, and stir until the flour is completely incorporated.
instructions.3: Pour the cake batter into the prepared pan and bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 30 minutes, or until fully cooked.
instructions.4: Meanwhile, beat the Chantilly cream with powdered sugar, yogurt, and Mango Dream Jelly until smooth and creamy.
instructions.5: Mix the mango jelly in a bowl and stir well, then let it cool.
instructions.6: Pour the syrup or honey-water mixture over the cooled cake.
instructions.7: Spread the Chantilly cream layer over the cake.
instructions.8: Place mango pieces on top of the cream.
instructions.9: Pour the chilled jelly layer over the cake.
instructions.10: Refrigerate the cake for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: 10-Minute Cake Without Oven
culturalNotes: Make sure the water does not boil vigorously so it doesn't enter the molds. You can serve the cake warm or cold, according to preference.

instructions.1: Mix the egg with vanilla and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the sugar and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the oil and milk and stir until the mixture is well combined.
instructions.4: Sift the flour and cocoa powder over the mixture and stir until the consistency is even.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture into cake molds (small containers) until halfway full.
instructions.6: Place chocolate pieces in the center of each mold.
instructions.7: Put the molds into a baking tray and fill the tray with hot water until halfway up the molds.
instructions.8: Cover the tray with a towel, then with a lid, and place it on medium heat.
instructions.9: Let the cake cook for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Remove the lid and towel, and let the cake cool slightly.
instructions.11: Garnish the cake with powdered sugar and cherries if desired.

title: Light and Delicious Cornstarch Cake
culturalNotes: Make sure the oven is preheated to 170 degrees Celsius before starting. This cake can be served with a cup of tea or milk tea.

instructions.1: Mix flour, cornstarch, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add sugar, eggs, oil, vanilla, hot milk, vinegar, and salt to a mixer and blend thoroughly until sugar is completely dissolved.
instructions.3: Gradually pour the liquid mixture into the dry ingredients and mix until well combined.
instructions.4: Pour the batter into a 26 cm greased baking pan, dusted with flour or butter.
instructions.5: Place the pan into the preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.6: Bake for 40-50 minutes or until fully cooked.
instructions.7: Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool before slicing.

title: Quick Pomegranate Cake
culturalNotes: You can use other fruits such as apple or orange instead of pomegranate. You can also add a little cinnamon for flavor.

instructions.1: Remove the seeds from the pomegranate and slice them thinly.
instructions.2: Place the pomegranate slices in an 18 cm non-stick baking dish.
instructions.3: Add 2 tablespoons of sugar to the pomegranate and distribute evenly.
instructions.4: In a bowl, mix 2 tablespoons of sugar, 2 tablespoons of oil, 3/4 cup of flour, and 1/3 cup of yogurt.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture over the pomegranate in the baking dish.
instructions.6: Sprinkle the nuts on top of the mixture.
instructions.7: Preheat the oven to medium heat and place the dish inside.
instructions.8: Cover the dish and bake until golden brown.
instructions.9: Serve warm or cold, according to preference.

title: No-Oven, No-Egg Summer Cake
culturalNotes: Leftover cake can be used instead of cookies in the first layer. Serve the cake chilled and decorated with fresh fruits.

instructions.1: Take a pot and pour 1 liter of milk into it.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of sugar, 3 tablespoons of unsweetened cocoa powder, and 3 tablespoons of cornstarch.
instructions.3: Stir the ingredients well with the cold milk until completely dissolved.
instructions.4: Place the pot on the stove and continuously stir until the mixture boils and thickens.
instructions.5: Add 1 can of condensed milk (Nescafé or Bok), 1 tablespoon of butter, and 1 small spoon of vanilla.
instructions.6: Continue stirring until the chocolate and butter are fully melted.
instructions.7: Take a cheesecake mold and line the bottom with a layer of cookies.
instructions.8: Pour a layer of hot mousse over the cookies.
instructions.9: Repeat the previous steps until all ingredients are used, making sure the final layer is mousse.
instructions.10: Cover the mold and refrigerate for at least 5 hours or overnight.
instructions.11: Before serving, decorate with grated unsweetened chocolate and fresh strawberries or cherries as desired.

title: One-Egg Cake
culturalNotes: You can add an additional 1/4 cup of sugar if you are not using caramel cream. The cake can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Beat the egg in the mixer.
instructions.2: Add the oil, vanilla, yogurt, sugar, and vinegar. Mix well for 3-4 minutes.
instructions.3: In a separate bowl, mix the flour, cornstarch, cake mix, caramel cream (optional), and salt.
instructions.4: Add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients and mix thoroughly until the dough is well combined.
instructions.5: Grease the baking pan with butter and lightly dust with flour.
instructions.6: Pour the batter into the pan and spread evenly.
instructions.7: Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 40 minutes.
instructions.8: Remove the cake from the oven after 40 minutes and check for doneness.
instructions.9: Let the cake cool before serving.

title: Light, Delicious, and Moist Cake
culturalNotes: The cake can be served with a cup of mint tea or Nescafé. It can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.2: Prepare a 30×40 cm baking pan and line it with parchment paper.
instructions.3: In a blender, mix the eggs, oil, vanilla, dry yogurt or yogurt, sugar, and salt.
instructions.4: Add the flour, baking powder, and coconut, and mix thoroughly until the batter is smooth and well combined.
instructions.5: Pour the batter into the prepared pan.
instructions.6: Place the pan in the oven and bake for 20–25 minutes.
instructions.7: After removing the cake from the oven, brush it with cold milk.
instructions.8: Let it cool completely, then cut it into cubes.

title: Yogurt
culturalNotes: Yogurt can be used in doughs and pastries or eaten as a light snack with honey. It is best stored in the refrigerator after preparation.

instructions.1: Boil the yogurt in a pot over low heat.
instructions.2: After boiling, pour the yogurt into a clean baking dish and cover it.
instructions.3: Place the dish in a warm oven and leave it undisturbed for 24 hours.
instructions.4: After 24 hours, remove the dish from the oven and let it cool.
instructions.5: Strain the yogurt through a wire sieve and add one teaspoon of salt.
instructions.6: Leave the yogurt in the sieve for another day to drain excess water.
instructions.7: Yogurt can be eaten as is with honey or used in doughs and pastries.

title: Homemade Marshmallows
culturalNotes: Various shapes can be used for cutting marshmallows, such as circles, stars, and hearts. Marshmallows can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix 1/2 cup water with 2 cups granulated sugar and 1/4 cup glucose syrup.
instructions.2: Add 1 drop of lemon juice and stir the ingredients well.
instructions.3: Place the mixture over medium heat until it boils, then let it simmer for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix 1/4 cup gelatin with 1/2 cup boiling water and stir quickly.
instructions.5: Pour the gelatin mixture into the sugar mixture and stir thoroughly.
instructions.6: Pour the mixture into a square baking pan lined with plastic wrap and greased with oil.
instructions.7: Spread the mixture evenly and let it cool for 10 minutes.
instructions.8: Add half of the mixture to the pan and color the remaining half with your preferred color.
instructions.9: Let the mixture cool completely in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
instructions.10: Dust the pan generously with cornstarch, then cut the marshmallows into small cubes.
instructions.11: Roll each cube in cornstarch and shake off the excess in a strainer.

title: Green Apple Jam
culturalNotes: You can slice the apples into thin strips or small cubes, depending on preference. Gelatin helps set the jam when refrigerated.

instructions.1: Cut the green apples into thin strips or small cubes, according to preference.
instructions.2: Add the apples to a pot and mix with half a kilogram of centrifugal sugar, half a cup of water, and a large spoonful of lemon juice.
instructions.3: Stir the ingredients well, cover the pot, and place it over medium heat until it starts boiling.
instructions.4: After boiling, let the jam simmer on low heat until it begins to thicken and the syrup starts to reduce.
instructions.5: Dissolve the gelatin powder in half a cup of water, then set it aside.
instructions.6: After about half the cooking time, add half a cup of raisins and a small spoonful of cinnamon, and stir well.
instructions.7: Continue cooking the jam on low heat until it is completely thickened.
instructions.8: Add the dissolved gelatin and stir the jam just once over the heat.
instructions.9: Remove the jam from the heat when it is fully ready.
instructions.10: Store the jam in sterilized and clean jars, seal tightly, and refrigerate.

title: Carrot Preserves with Apricot and Orange
culturalNotes: The preserve can be stored in jars for a long time if kept in a cool, dry place. When using the preserve, always use a clean, dry spoon to avoid contamination.

instructions.1: Wash the orange and cut it in half.
instructions.2: Use a food processor to juice the orange and strain out the seeds and peel.
instructions.3: Wash the carrots and slice them thinly.
instructions.4: Use a food processor to grate the carrots.
instructions.5: Add the grated carrots and orange juice to a pot.
instructions.6: Add sugar, cloves, and dried apricot to the mixture.
instructions.7: Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and stir occasionally until thickened.
instructions.8: Once the preserve thickens, remove it from the heat.
instructions.9: Store the preserve in clean, dry jars and keep in a cool, dry place.

title: Strawberry Jam
culturalNotes: Make sure to use ripe strawberries free of green parts to achieve a delicious taste and beautiful color. The jam can be stored in sterilized jars or freezer bags for a long time.

instructions.1: Wash the strawberries thoroughly and chop them into small pieces, or blend some of them in a blender.
instructions.2: Add sugar to the strawberries and mix well, then cover and refrigerate overnight.
instructions.3: The next day, open the jar and you'll see that the strawberries have released a lot of liquid.
instructions.4: Transfer the strawberries to a heavy-bottomed pot and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.5: After some boiling, you'll notice foam forming on the surface—skim it off with a spoon.
instructions.6: Continue boiling until the mixture becomes thick.
instructions.7: Add lemon juice and stir well.
instructions.8: Scoop a spoonful of jam and place it on a plate. Let it cool slightly, then draw a line through the middle—if the jam doesn’t mix back together, it’s ready.
instructions.9: Let the jam cool completely, then transfer it to sterilized and dry jars.
instructions.10: Seal the jars tightly and store in a cool, dry place or in the refrigerator.

title: Mahlabiyah with Filo
culturalNotes: Any available nuts can be used, such as peanuts or almonds. Syrup can also be used instead of honey.

instructions.1: Cut the filo into small pieces and arrange them in a baking dish.
instructions.2: Melt the ghee or butter and pour it over the filo.
instructions.3: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius and bake the dish on the middle rack until the filo turns golden brown.
instructions.4: In a pot, place 1 kilogram of milk and heat it on medium flame.
instructions.5: Crush the cardamom pods and add them to the milk.
instructions.6: Add half a cup of sugar to the milk and stir.
instructions.7: In another bowl, mix 4 tablespoons of cornstarch with half a cup of liquid milk.
instructions.8: Pour the cornstarch mixture into the milk on the stove and stir continuously until the mixture thickens.
instructions.9: Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla and 1 tablespoon of cream, and stir well.
instructions.10: Remove the filo from the oven and break it into pieces.
instructions.11: Add the toasted nuts and a little honey or syrup, then mix all ingredients together.
instructions.12: In serving dishes, layer the baked filo, then the mahlabiyah, then another layer of baked filo.
instructions.13: You may sprinkle additional nuts on top if desired.
instructions.14: Let the dessert cool in the refrigerator before serving.

title: Chocolate Sauce Muffins
culturalNotes: Molto can be served warm or cold. It can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days.

instructions.1: Mix flour, yeast, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add egg, vinegar, and warm water, then knead until the dough is well combined.
instructions.3: Add melted butter and knead for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover the dough with a cloth and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Lightly oil the work surface and roll out the dough into a round shape.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into small squares.
instructions.7: Shape each square into a croissant using the method shown in the video.
instructions.8: Place the croissants on an oiled baking tray and let them rise for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Brush the croissants with egg and milk mixture, then bake in a preheated oven at 220°C for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: In a bowl, mix yogurt, sugar, and cornstarch. Cook over low heat until thickened.
instructions.11: Add crushed chocolate and butter, stirring until the chocolate is fully melted.
instructions.12: Let the sauce cool slightly, then refrigerate for a few minutes.
instructions.13: Dip the croissants into the sauce or fill them with chocolate using a pastry bag.

title: Milk Shake
culturalNotes: Fresh bananas can be used instead of frozen, but frozen bananas give a thicker and colder texture.

instructions.1: Place the frozen bananas into the blender.
instructions.2: Add the milk, vanilla, and sugar.
instructions.3: Add the ice cream.
instructions.4: Blend all ingredients together until smooth.
instructions.5: Pour the milk shake into cups.
instructions.6: Drizzle caramel sauce on top to taste.

title: Nati
culturalNotes: Any type of jam can be used according to preference. Nati can be served with a cup of tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs with vanilla and sugar in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the oil while continuing to beat.
instructions.3: Add the yogurt and continue beating until the mixture is well combined.
instructions.4: Add the flour, baking powder, and salt, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture into a buttered baking pan or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C for 15 minutes.
instructions.7: Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool slightly.
instructions.8: Cut the cake in half and spread the jam on the bottom half.
instructions.9: Cover the bottom half with the top half and gently press down.
instructions.10: Cut the cake into small pieces.
instructions.11: Garnish the pieces with melted chocolate.

title: Nutella Homemade
culturalNotes: Nutella can be stored in the jar for over a month in the refrigerator. It can be used as a spread for sandwiches or as a sauce for desserts.

instructions.1: Roast the peanuts in the oven at 170 degrees for 10 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.2: Grind the peanuts in the blender until smooth.
instructions.3: Add the chopped raw chocolate to the blender.
instructions.4: Add the powdered sugar, powdered milk, and raw cocoa to the blender.
instructions.5: Gradually pour the boiling water into the mixture.
instructions.6: Mix all ingredients thoroughly until the consistency is smooth and creamy.
instructions.7: Pour the mixture into a clean and dry jar.

title: Kunafa with Cream
culturalNotes: You can add crushed pistachios or peanuts to the cream before filling for extra flavor. Kunafa can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

fah-665-i4.name: Cream
fah-665-i4.amount: 1 can or 1/2 cup dessert cream or 2 tablespoons cream mixed with yogurt

instructions.1: Add 2 cups cold milk to a saucepan and place on the stove.
instructions.2: Add 2 tablespoons cornstarch and stir the mixture well until blended.
instructions.3: Continue stirring until the mixture boils and thickens.
instructions.4: Add the cream and stir until it melts and blends completely with the ingredients.
instructions.5: Remove the saucepan from the heat and let the cream cool.
instructions.6: Lightly grease a baking pan and evenly spread the phyllo pastry inside.
instructions.7: Brush the kunafa with milk.
instructions.8: Bake the kunafa in a preheated oven at 180°C for 10-12 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.9: Let the kunafa cool slightly, then cut each piece in half.
instructions.10: Fill the kunafa with the cream using a pastry bag or spoon.
instructions.11: Serve the kunafa warm or cold, according to preference.

title: Syrian Baraziq
culturalNotes: Make sure to thoroughly coat the dough with sesame and pistachios for an attractive appearance. Peanut can be used instead of pistachio if pistachio is unavailable. Be sure to remove the baraziq from the tray immediately after taking them out of the oven while still hot to prevent sticking to the tray.

instructions.1: Mix the butter with powdered sugar and vanilla in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg and oil, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the sifter flour, baking powder, powdered milk, and salt, and mix until the dough is well combined.
instructions.4: If the dough feels dry, add water as needed.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rest in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees.
instructions.7: Prepare a tray and grease it with oil.
instructions.8: Toast the sesame in the oven until lightly golden.
instructions.9: Mix the tahini syrup with the toasted sesame and stir well.
instructions.10: Crush the pistachios and chop them into small pieces.
instructions.11: Take a piece of dough, shape it into a ball, then dip it into the crushed pistachios.
instructions.12: Place a spoonful of the tahini-sesame mixture on top.
instructions.13: Place the baraziq on the tray and lightly grease the surface with oil.
instructions.14: Bake in the oven for 10 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.15: Remove the baraziq from the tray immediately after taking them out of the oven while still hot.

title: Mahjooga the Old Way
culturalNotes: Tehweeja is a blend of spices such as cumin, fennel, and anise, and can be purchased from a spice merchant. Mahjooga becomes crispy and flaky when cut immediately after coming out of the oven.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the tehweeja and coconut, and stir the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the sifted powdered sugar and stir again.
instructions.4: Heat the oil and ghee in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.5: Add the white sesame and nigella seeds, and fry until golden brown.
instructions.6: Remove the pan from the heat and pour the contents into the flour mixture. Stir well.
instructions.7: Continue stirring until the mixture cools slightly.
instructions.8: Add the black honey and mix until the mixture is well combined.
instructions.9: Transfer the mixture into a 30×40 cm greased square baking tray.
instructions.10: Spread the mixture with your hands or a spatula to an even thickness.
instructions.11: Cut the mixture into squares before placing it in the oven.
instructions.12: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.13: Place the tray in the middle rack of the oven and bake for 30-40 minutes.
instructions.14: Remove the tray from the oven and let it cool slightly.
instructions.15: Cut the mahjooga again along the same lines.
instructions.16: Serve with a cup of warm tea.

title: Papa Roati
culturalNotes: Make sure the butter is frozen when using it in the pastries to prevent melting. The pastries can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, dry milk powder, sugar, yeast, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg, butter, and vanilla, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Gradually add the warm milk until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.4: Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
instructions.5: Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap and a clean towel. Let it rise for 1 hour.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into lemon-sized balls (about 40 grams each).
instructions.7: Cover the balls and let them rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Roll out each ball, place a cube of frozen butter in the center, fold the edges over, and seal.
instructions.9: Place the pastries in an oiled baking tray or one lined with parchment paper, leaving space between them.
instructions.10: Prepare the topping: Mix the butter, sugar, vanilla, Nescafe, hot water, and sifted flour.
instructions.11: Transfer the topping to a pastry bag and pipe it over the pastries.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 10-12 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.13: Serve warm with chocolate or caramel sauce.

title: Cheese Pancake
culturalNotes: You can add parsley to taste. Serve the pancakes warm with honey or powdered sugar.

instructions.1: Whisk the egg and milk together in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add black pepper, salt, sugar, flour, and baking powder; mix well.
instructions.3: Add cottage cheese and bell peppers; mix thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add oats if desired.
instructions.5: Heat the pan over medium heat and grease it with oil.
instructions.6: Pour the mixture into the pan, using about 1 tablespoon per pancake.
instructions.7: Flip the pancake when the bottom side turns golden.
instructions.8: Repeat until all the mixture is used up.

title: Sweet and Savory Pancakes
culturalNotes: You can use any available fruit to serve the sweet pancakes. You can also use different types of cheese for the savory pancakes.

instructions.1: Mix whole wheat flour, vinegar, salt, sugar, and milk in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Stir ingredients thoroughly until well combined and no lumps remain.
instructions.3: Add baking powder and softened butter, and mix well.
instructions.4: Pour the batter into a squeeze bottle or a piping bag with a nozzle.
instructions.5: Lightly grease the pan with oil and wipe with a cloth.
instructions.6: Heat the pan and pour batter into circular shapes.
instructions.7: After ten seconds, place a spoonful of water on each pancake and cover the pan.
instructions.8: Cook until golden and crispy on both sides.
instructions.9: To make savory pancakes, place a small amount of batter in the center, add a piece of ricotta cheese, then cover with more batter.
instructions.10: After ten seconds, add a spoonful of water and flip the pancake.
instructions.11: Repeat until all batter is used.
instructions.12: Serve sweet pancakes with fruit and honey, and savory pancakes with cheese.

title: Cheese Biscuits
culturalNotes: These biscuits can be served as a light snack for children at school, and adding some fruit or vegetables can increase their nutritional value.

instructions.1: Mix the flour and butter until the mixture resembles damp sand.
instructions.2: Add the grated Romano cheese, salt, and baking powder, and mix the dry ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the egg and half a cup of yogurt, and knead until a firm dough forms.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Remove the dough from the fridge and roll it out using a rolling pin until about half a centimeter thick.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into various shapes using cookie cutters.
instructions.7: Place the pieces on a greased baking tray.
instructions.8: Whisk the egg yolk with a tablespoon of yogurt and a pinch of sugar, then brush the mixture onto the tops of the biscuits.
instructions.9: Sprinkle a little grated cheese on top of each biscuit.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at 160°C for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.11: Remove from the oven and let cool completely.
instructions.12: Serve the biscuits in an airtight container or freeze for storage.

title: Chocolate Swirl Cookies
culturalNotes: Store the cookies in an airtight container to keep them fresh and crisp for longer.

instructions.1: Mix powdered sugar, butter, and vanilla in a bowl using an electric mixer until the texture is creamy and the color is light.
instructions.2: Add the egg and mix for 2 to 3 minutes.
instructions.3: Add the sifter flour and salt, then mix with your hands until the dough comes together.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into two equal parts. Add sweetened cocoa powder and unsweetened cocoa powder to the second half, then mix with your hands.
instructions.5: Shape both doughs into small rolls and alternate placing them on an oiled baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated oven at 160°C for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.7: Let the cookies cool before serving.

title: Lancashire Biscuits
culturalNotes: You can use any type of jam you prefer, such as strawberry or apricot jam. You can also decorate the biscuits with melted chocolate or chopped nuts.

instructions.1: Mix the sugar and shortening thoroughly using a hand or electric mixer.
instructions.2: Add the eggs and vanilla, and mix all ingredients together.
instructions.3: In a separate bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and salt.
instructions.4: Sift the flour mixture over the sugar and shortening mixture, and mix well.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
instructions.6: Preheat the oven to 160 degrees Celsius.
instructions.7: Form small balls from the dough and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
instructions.8: Bake in the oven for 15 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.9: Remove the biscuits from the oven and let them cool.
instructions.10: Decorate the biscuits with chopped walnuts, sprinkles, jam, pistachios, chocolate, or any other topping you prefer.

title: Banana Cookies
culturalNotes: These cookies can be served with a cup of tea or milk, and are suitable for breakfast or evening snack. They can also be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: Cream the date paste with cold butter until soft and forms thin, long fingers.
instructions.2: Mix the sifted flour, baking powder, salt, and powdered sugar in a bowl.
instructions.3: Add the shortening to the flour mixture and mix well until the flour absorbs it.
instructions.4: Add the egg and vanilla and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Gradually add water until the dough becomes soft and easy to shape.
instructions.6: Form small balls from the dough, each about the size of a lemon.
instructions.7: Roll each ball on a floured surface until very thin and translucent.
instructions.8: Place a piece of date paste in the center of each dough circle and roll it up like a scroll.
instructions.9: Shape the scroll into a banana-like form and place it on an oiled baking tray.
instructions.10: Brush the tops of the cookies with beaten egg mixed with 1 teaspoon of vanilla.
instructions.11: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius and bake the cookies for 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: Anise Cookies
culturalNotes: These cookies can be served with tea or coffee. They can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: Mix the eggs with vanilla, vinegar, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the butter, oil, and sugar, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the flour and baking powder, and mix until the dough is well combined.
instructions.4: Divide the dough in half. Add the anise to one half and mix well.
instructions.5: Add the cinnamon and dried apricots (if using) to the other half, and mix well.
instructions.6: Grease a small baking tray with butter and lightly dust with flour.
instructions.7: Roll out the dough and place it in a preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes.
instructions.8: Remove from the oven and let cool completely.
instructions.9: Cut the cookies into thin pieces and arrange them on an aluminum baking tray.
instructions.10: Bake again in the oven at 150 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.11: Let cool completely before serving.

title: Crusty Whole Wheat Biscuits
culturalNotes: These biscuits can be served with labneh or cheese, drizzled with olive oil and poppy seeds. They are perfect for breakfast or as a snack.

instructions.1: Mix the whole wheat flour, sesame seeds, poppy seeds, thyme, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of oil and one cup of shortening or butter, and mix until the texture resembles damp sand.
instructions.3: Add half a cup of warm water with one teaspoon of yeast and one tablespoon of tomato sauce, and mix until the dough is well combined.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30 minutes.
instructions.5: After 30 minutes, roll out half the dough into a thin sheet, about 0.5 cm thick, and sprinkle with basil as desired.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into circles using a cutter or a cup.
instructions.7: Place the circles onto an oiled baking tray.
instructions.8: Preheat the oven for 15 minutes at 180 degrees Celsius.
instructions.9: Bake in the oven until the biscuits turn golden brown.
instructions.10: Remove from the oven and let cool slightly before serving.

title: Makroun Cookies
culturalNotes: These cookies can be served with a cup of tea or coffee. They can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, ground anise, baking powder, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the butter and oil, and mix thoroughly until the flour absorbs the fats.
instructions.3: Add the vinegar and yogurt, and gently mix until combined.
instructions.4: Take small portions of the dough and shape them into rolls.
instructions.5: Place the rolls onto an oiled baking tray.
instructions.6: Brush the tops of the cookies with beaten egg and sprinkle with nigella seeds.
instructions.7: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.8: Bake in the middle rack for 15-20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.9: Remove from the oven and let cool slightly before serving.

title: Hedouta Biscuits
culturalNotes: These biscuits can be stored in an airtight metal container for a long time. They can be served with cheese or tea for a light and delicious breakfast.

instructions.1: Mix the oil and ghee in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the sugar, salt, baking powder, egg yolk, and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the vinegar and continue stirring.
instructions.4: Gradually add the flour while continuously stirring until the dough is well combined.
instructions.5: Slowly add the yogurt until you get a soft and easy-to-shape dough.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and let it rest for 10 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll out the dough on a surface dusted with cornstarch to about half a centimeter thick.
instructions.8: Cut the dough into rectangular shapes about 2 centimeters wide.
instructions.9: Dip the top side of each biscuit into the egg white, then sprinkle with sesame and poppy seeds.
instructions.10: Place the biscuits on an oiled baking tray.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 160 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.12: Remove from the oven and let cool before serving.

title: Digestive Biscuits Without Eggs or Milk
culturalNotes: These biscuits can be served with various dips such as hummus, labneh cheese, and cherry tomatoes. The biscuits can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and butter and mix the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Gradually add the water until the dough becomes firm and easy to shape.
instructions.4: Cover the dough bowl with a plastic bag lightly greased with oil.
instructions.5: Take a piece of dough and roll it between two chilled rolling pins until it reaches a thickness of about half a centimeter.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into equal circles.
instructions.7: Place the circles onto an oiled baking tray and prick each with a fork.
instructions.8: Bake in a preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.9: Remove from the oven and let cool.

title: Sesame and Black Seed Savory Biscuits
culturalNotes: The biscuits can be enjoyed with cheese or any dip of your choice. They can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: Preheat the oven to 170 degrees Celsius.
instructions.2: In a pan over heat, toast the sesame and nigella seeds thoroughly until their aroma is released.
instructions.3: Add half a cup of melted butter, half a cup of corn oil, and half a cup of milk to the pan.
instructions.4: Add one teaspoon of salt, one tablespoon of sugar, one tablespoon of fine semolina, and one teaspoon of baking powder.
instructions.5: Mix the ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.6: Add 2 and a half cups of fine flour and stir until all ingredients are well combined.
instructions.7: Roll out the dough on a pastry bag to a thickness of about half a centimeter.
instructions.8: Cut the dough into small pieces and shape them using a knife.
instructions.9: Arrange the pieces on an oiled baking tray.
instructions.10: Bake in the oven until the biscuits are golden brown on both sides.
instructions.11: Remove the biscuits from the oven and let them cool completely.
instructions.12: Serve the biscuits with tea or coffee.

title: Stuffed Date Yogurt Biscuits
culturalNotes: These biscuits can be served with tea or any other beverage. They can also be used as a light snack for students at school.

fah-681-i12.name: Milk or cream or clotted cream

instructions.1: Mix the yogurt with sugar and stir until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.2: Add the shortening and oil mixture and stir well.
instructions.3: Add the salt and vanilla and stir.
instructions.4: Add the flour and baking powder and mix by hand until the dough is well combined.
instructions.5: Shape the dough into a thin layer in a rectangular baking pan lined with plastic wrap.
instructions.6: Prepare the date paste and mix in the butter and desired additions (such as sesame or cardamom).
instructions.7: Spread the date paste evenly over the first layer of dough.
instructions.8: Lightly grease the pan with oil and add half of the remaining dough, spreading it out.
instructions.9: Add another layer of date paste and cover it with the remaining dough.
instructions.10: Brush the biscuits with milk or cream or clotted cream and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.
instructions.11: Cut the biscuits into squares.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated medium oven until golden brown.

title: Eggless and dairy-free cookies with 3 dips
culturalNotes: The cookies can be served with the different dips to enjoy a variety of flavors. The cookies can be stored in an airtight container for up to one week.

instructions.1: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the oil and butter and mix thoroughly.
instructions.3: Gradually add the water until the dough becomes easy to shape.
instructions.4: Cover the bowl with a piece of plastic wrap greased with oil.
instructions.5: Take a piece of dough and roll it between two chilled rolling pins until it reaches a thickness of about half a centimeter.
instructions.6: Cut the dough into equal circles.
instructions.7: Place the circles onto an oiled baking tray.
instructions.8: Bake the cookies in a preheated oven at 170 degrees Celsius for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.9: Prepare the dips:
instructions.10: Blend chickpeas, lemon juice, tahini, cumin, coriander, paprika, chopped tomatoes, and cold water in a blender until smooth.
instructions.11: Mix yogurt, feta cheese, olive oil, salt, and thyme in a bowl.
instructions.12: Mix cubed cheese, cherry tomatoes, chili, and olives in a bowl.

title: Chocolate Buns
culturalNotes: The dough can be used for sweet and savory pastries. Dust the buns with powdered sugar after baking for a more attractive appearance. This dough enhancer can be used with any dough to give it a crisp texture and sweet flavor.

instructions.1: Mix the bread enhancer ingredients: yogurt, flour, baking powder, and vinegar. Stir well until combined and frothy.
instructions.2: In another bowl, mix the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt. Add the warm water and egg white, then knead thoroughly.
instructions.3: Add the bread enhancer to the dough and knead for 10 minutes until the dough becomes soft and elastic.
instructions.4: Grease the proofing pan with oil and place the dough inside. Cover with plastic wrap and a clean towel, then let it rise until doubled in size.
instructions.5: After rising, roll out the dough and spread the soft butter, sugar, and chocolate chips on top. Fold the dough and cut into pieces.
instructions.6: Brush the buns with the mixture of egg yolk, milk, and vanilla. Sprinkle with nuts to taste.
instructions.7: Bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Turkish Baklava
culturalNotes: You can add other types of cheese according to preference. The baklava can be frozen after baking and reheated for 30 seconds in the microwave before serving. It can be served as a snack or at breakfast.

instructions.1: Mix the yogurt with the butter until smooth and creamy.
instructions.2: Add 4–5 tablespoons of melted butter and mix well.
instructions.3: Grease the baking dish with a mixture of butter and oil.
instructions.4: Brush a phyllo sheet with the yogurt-butter mixture.
instructions.5: Spread the cream cheese over the phyllo sheet.
instructions.6: Add the cheese and pastirma mixture on top of the phyllo.
instructions.7: Roll the sheets together with the filling and place them in the baking dish.
instructions.8: Repeat the steps until all ingredients are used up.
instructions.9: Cut the baklava into pieces.
instructions.10: Brush the top of the baklava with the butter-oil mixture.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 15 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Turkish Meat Phyllo Pie
culturalNotes: You can store the phyllo pie in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours before baking. You can also serve it with tomato sauce or red sauce.

instructions.1: Grate the raw potatoes.
instructions.2: Add black pepper, paprika, and salt to the grated potatoes and mix well.
instructions.3: Add the ground meat to the mixture and stir until well combined.
instructions.4: Take one sheet of phyllo dough and brush it with water, then with butter and oil.
instructions.5: Repeat the process with 3 sheets of phyllo dough.
instructions.6: Place the mixture on the last sheet in a long line and carefully roll it up.
instructions.7: Repeat the process until all sheets are used.
instructions.8: Place the phyllo pie into a greased baking pan.
instructions.9: Brush the top of the pie with a mixture of egg yolk and yogurt.
instructions.10: Sprinkle sesame seeds and nigella seeds on top of the pie.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.12: Remove the pie from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.

title: Potato Pizza
culturalNotes: Serve the pizza with a green salad or tomato sauce.

instructions.1: Heat a pan on the stove and add 1 large spoon of butter.
instructions.2: Add the boiled and mashed potatoes and stir well with the butter.
instructions.3: Season the mixture with salt and pepper.
instructions.4: Transfer the mixture into an oiled baking dish.
instructions.5: Sprinkle 2 large spoons of grated cheese over the top.
instructions.6: Arrange tomato slices, bell pepper slices, and olive slices on top.
instructions.7: Bake in a preheated oven at low heat for 15 minutes, until the top turns golden.
instructions.8: Serve the pizza hot.

title: Fatteer Pizza
culturalNotes: You can use any type of cheese according to preference. The fatayer can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer storage.

instructions.1: Mix the warm water with sugar and yeast, and stir well.
instructions.2: Let the mixture sit for 4 minutes until it rises.
instructions.3: Add the flour, oil, and salt, and stir well with a spoon until the dough is well combined.
instructions.4: Let the dough rest for 10 minutes until it rises and doubles in size.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into equal-sized balls.
instructions.6: Lightly grease a baking tray or pan with oil and roll out the dough balls.
instructions.7: Add the filling (cheese and pepper) onto each dough piece.
instructions.8: Bake the fatayer in a preheated hot oven for 10 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.9: Serve hot.

title: Griddle Pizza with Cheese Sauce
culturalNotes: You can add any other ingredients you prefer to the pizza. The dough can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours before use.

instructions.1: Mix flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and yeast in a large bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add warm water while kneading until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.3: Add oil and continue kneading for 3-4 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise for 15 minutes.
instructions.5: In another bowl, melt butter over low heat and add flour, stirring well.
instructions.6: Gradually add milk while continuously stirring until the sauce becomes smooth.
instructions.7: Add mozzarella cheese and continue stirring until the cheese melts completely.
instructions.8: Remove the sauce from heat and set aside.
instructions.9: In a separate bowl, mix tomato sauce, ketchup, onion powder, garlic powder, and oregano.
instructions.10: Lightly grease the griddle with oil and sprinkle semolina.
instructions.11: Spread the dough onto the griddle and shape it as desired.
instructions.12: Spread the pizza sauce evenly over the dough.
instructions.13: Spread the cheese sauce evenly over the dough.
instructions.14: Add cheddar cheese, mozzarella, salami, onion, green pepper, olives, and hot pepper according to preference.
instructions.15: Place the pizza in a preheated oven at 220°C (428°F) and bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.16: Remove the pizza from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.

title: Soft and Delicious Toast
culturalNotes: Make sure the dough is smooth and silky before letting it rise. You can add powdered milk to the flour for better flavor. Bake the toast in a preheated oven for best results.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and sugar in 0.25 cup of warm water and let it sit for 10 minutes to test the yeast.
instructions.2: Mix the baking powder, bread improver, and salt with the flour.
instructions.3: Add the yeast mixture, warm milk, yogurt, and oil to the flour and knead all ingredients together.
instructions.4: Gradually add warm water as needed until the dough becomes firm and cohesive.
instructions.5: Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and silky.
instructions.6: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes or until it doubles in size.
instructions.7: Divide the dough into small portions and shape them into balls.
instructions.8: Roll each ball into the desired shape and place them on an oiled baking tray.
instructions.9: Let the dough rise again for 10-15 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush the dough with a mixture of powdered milk, Nescafé, water, and sugar.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 20-30 minutes or until golden brown.
instructions.12: Remove the toast from the oven and cover it with a clean kitchen towel to keep it soft and make cutting easier.

title: Four-Flavor Phyllo Rolls
culturalNotes: Phyllo can be frozen and used as needed. Phyllo rolls can be served warm or in a toaster.

instructions.1: Prepare apple filling: Chop the apple into small pieces, then place in a pan with butter, cinnamon, and sugar. Remove from heat and stir until well combined and liquid has evaporated.
instructions.2: Prepare the fat mixture: Mix yogurt, semolina, and baking powder in a bowl to form the fat mixture.
instructions.3: Prepare potato filling: Mash the boiled potatoes, then add cheese, parsley, and cream cheese. Mix until well combined.
instructions.4: Prepare cheese filling: Mix mozzarella, pepper, Romano, and cream cheese. Stir until well combined.
instructions.5: Prepare cheesecake filling: Place jam in a pastry bag, and cream cheese in another bag.
instructions.6: Prepare phyllo: Roll out a phyllo sheet and brush with the fat mixture. Fold in half, then brush again. Place filling in the center, fold the edges closed, and roll up the sheet.
instructions.7: Cook the phyllo: Heat a small drop of shortening or oil in a pan, then fry the phyllo rolls until golden brown on all sides.

title: Dnash
culturalNotes: You can sprinkle sesame on top of the Dnash before placing it in the oven for a more appealing appearance. Dnash can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast with warm water and sugar, and let it sit aside until frothy.
instructions.2: In another bowl, combine the flour, dry milk powder, baking powder, and salt.
instructions.3: Add the yeast mixture to the flour and knead thoroughly.
instructions.4: Gradually add the oil and knead until the dough becomes soft and smooth.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30 minutes until doubled in size.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into small pieces and shape them into balls.
instructions.7: Roll each piece with a rolling pin until very thin.
instructions.8: Brush the dough with butter and roll it tightly on itself.
instructions.9: Place the Dnash in a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.10: Let the Dnash rise again for 15 minutes.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 15–20 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.12: After removing from the oven, brush the Dnash with honey and jam, and place cherries on top.

title: Oil-Free Baked Donuts
culturalNotes: You can add grated unsweetened chocolate to the glaze for a stronger flavor. You can also shape the donuts differently according to preference.

instructions.1: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add egg, vinegar, and warm water, and knead the ingredients well for 5 minutes.
instructions.3: Add melted butter and mix it into the dough for an additional 5 minutes.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size.
instructions.5: Mix milk, sugar, cornstarch, and cocoa powder in a saucepan and stir over medium heat until the mixture boils and thickens.
instructions.6: Add butter and stir until melted, then remove the glaze from heat and let it cool.
instructions.7: Divide the dough into equal portions and roll them into balls. Place them on a greased baking tray.
instructions.8: Cover the dough and let it rise again for 15 minutes.
instructions.9: Preheat the oven to high and let it heat for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: Brush the donuts with beaten egg yolk mixed with 1 tablespoon of milk.
instructions.11: Bake the donuts in the oven for 10–12 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.12: Let the donuts cool, then glaze them with the chocolate glaze.
instructions.13: Serve the donuts warm or cold, according to preference.

title: Sambosa Crisps
culturalNotes: The filling can be customized as desired, such as vegetarian or cheese fillings. Sambosas can be frozen for up to one month.

instructions.1: Mix 3 cups of flour with 1 teaspoon of salt and 3 teaspoons of oil.
instructions.2: Gradually add water and knead until the dough reaches a medium consistency.
instructions.3: Cover the dough with a plastic bag and let it rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into 14 small balls.
instructions.5: Dust the balls with flour and roll them out with a rolling pin until thin.
instructions.6: Prepare the filling: fry the onion in ghee until browned, add minced meat, spices, and parsley, and stir well.
instructions.7: Place filling in the center of each dough piece and seal tightly.
instructions.8: Cut the sambosas into the desired shape.
instructions.9: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat, add the sambosas, and fry until golden and crispy.

title: Cheese Rolls
culturalNotes: The rolls can be frozen after cooling, stored in airtight bags, and used as needed.

instructions.1: Mix sugar and yeast in warm water and let sit for 10 minutes until they begin to react.
instructions.2: Add sifted flour, baking powder, and yogurt; mix well.
instructions.3: Knead the dough for 5 minutes, then add oil and knead again for 5 minutes until you get a smooth dough.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rest in a warm place for 30 minutes until it rises and doubles in size.
instructions.5: Chop red and green peppers into small pieces; add Bramley cheese and cream cheese, then mix well.
instructions.6: Sprinkle flour on the work surface and roll out the dough to about 0.5 cm thickness.
instructions.7: Spread the filling over the dough and cut into 2 cm pieces.
instructions.8: Roll each piece and place them in an oiled baking tray.
instructions.9: Let the rolls rest again for 30 minutes to rise.
instructions.10: Brush the tops of the rolls with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame and nigella seeds.
instructions.11: Bake in a preheated hot oven for 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: School Sandwiches, Crispy and Soft
culturalNotes: Sandwiches can be frozen and used as needed. Can be served with a cup of tea.

instructions.1: Mix flour, powdered milk, salt, yeast, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add yogurt, oil, and warm water, and mix ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.3: Knead the dough for at least 10 minutes until it becomes firm and smooth.
instructions.4: Cover the dough with plastic wrap and a clean cloth, and let it rest in a warm place for 1 hour until risen.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into equal portions and shape into balls.
instructions.6: Cover the balls with plastic wrap and cloth again, and let them rest for 15 minutes.
instructions.7: Roll each ball into a thin rectangle.
instructions.8: Place sausage in the center of the dough and roll it up like a log.
instructions.9: Cut each log in half to make mini sandwiches.
instructions.10: Place the sandwiches in an oiled baking tray and let them rise for 10 minutes.
instructions.11: Brush the tops of the sandwiches with egg wash and sprinkle sesame seeds on top.
instructions.12: Bake in a preheated oven at high temperature for 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: Stuffed Cheese Sandwiches
culturalNotes: You can add any other fillings according to preference. The sandwiches can be stored in the refrigerator for up to two days or frozen for longer. They can be served warm or cold.

instructions.1: Mix the baking flour, yeast, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the egg white, vinegar, and warm water, and knead the ingredients for 10 minutes until the dough becomes soft and firm.
instructions.3: Cover the dough and let it rise for 30 minutes in a warm place.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape them into balls.
instructions.5: Roll out each ball and fill with your favorite filling (mixed cheese, olives, bulgarian sausage, parmesan cheese, pepper, feta cheese).
instructions.6: Seal the filling well and shape each into a roll.
instructions.7: Place the sandwiches into baking molds.
instructions.8: Brush the sandwiches with a mixture of egg yolk and yogurt, then sprinkle with breadcrumbs.
instructions.9: Brush the sandwiches with a mixture of butter, thyme, garlic powder, and sesame seeds.
instructions.10: Bake the sandwiches in a preheated oven at high temperature for 20 minutes until golden brown and crispy.

title: Bavarian Sambosa
culturalNotes: Unfried sambosas can be stored in the freezer for up to one month. When ready to fry, remove from the freezer and let thaw slightly before frying.

instructions.1: Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, sugar, salt, and dried milk powder in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add ghee or oil and mix ingredients until they resemble sand grains.
instructions.3: Gradually add warm water and mix until the dough becomes soft and not sticky.
instructions.4: Cover the dough and let it rest for 30 minutes to one hour.
instructions.5: Divide the dough into 3 balls and cover them.
instructions.6: Lightly dust the work surface with cornstarch and roll out the dough to about 1/2 cm thickness.
instructions.7: Cut the dough into circles using a cookie cutter.
instructions.8: Place your preferred filling in the center of each circle and close them using your preferred method.
instructions.9: Place the sambosas on a greased baking tray or one lightly dusted with cornstarch.
instructions.10: Heat oil in a pan and fry the sambosas until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.11: Fry until golden brown and serve on paper towels to absorb excess oil.

title: Cinnamon Sambosa
culturalNotes: You can serve the sambosa with caramel sauce or chocolate sauce to enhance the flavor. You can also store the sambosa in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Mix powdered sugar with cocoa and cinnamon in a bowl.
instructions.2: Prepare the sambosa sheets and fill them with cream or cottage cheese.
instructions.3: Seal the sheets tightly to form a crescent shape.
instructions.4: Put oil in a pan over heat until hot, then reduce to low heat.
instructions.5: Fry the sambosa until golden brown on both sides.
instructions.6: Drain the sambosa from excess oil using paper towel.
instructions.7: Dip the sambosa into the sugar, cocoa, and cinnamon mixture until fully coated on all sides.
instructions.8: Serve the sambosa warm with caramel sauce or chocolate sauce.

title: Sambosa with Multiple Fillings (Vegetarian)
culturalNotes: Sambosas can be frozen and used as needed. They can be served with various sauces such as red sauce or white sauce.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat.
instructions.2: Add the garlic and sauté until lightly golden.
instructions.3: Add the boiled potatoes and mash them well.
instructions.4: Add cumin, parsley, black pepper, salt, green onion, red pepper, smoked paprika, potato spices, and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: In another pan, heat oil and add the chopped onion. Sauté until soft and fragrant.
instructions.6: Add curry and black pepper. Stir well.
instructions.7: Add eggplant, boiled carrots, and instant broth. Mix well.
instructions.8: Add salt and stir again.
instructions.9: Mix cottage cheese with a pinch of seeds, olive oil, cream, parsley, pepper, and black olives.
instructions.10: Mix cheddar, mozzarella, feta, cream cheese, red chili, and mixed bell peppers.
instructions.11: Mix tomato, olives, basterma, remaining cheese, ketchup, and thyme.
instructions.12: Mix flour with water to make a sealing paste.
instructions.13: Bake the dough and cut it into circles.
instructions.14: Fill the dough with the mixtures and roll them neatly.
instructions.15: Apply the sealing paste around the edges to prevent opening during frying.
instructions.16: Fry the sambosas in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Crispy Anise Sesame Cake
culturalNotes: Shaboura can be served with a cup of hot tea. Nigella seeds and anise are beneficial ingredients for health.

instructions.1: Place the eggs in the blender.
instructions.2: Add the oil, sugar, vinegar, 0.5 cup of milk, 1 small spoon of vanilla, and a pinch of saffron powder.
instructions.3: Blend the ingredients thoroughly until the sugar dissolves.
instructions.4: Add the salt, nigella seeds, and baking powder, and mix well.
instructions.5: Gradually add the flour and mix until the dough is well combined.
instructions.6: Grease a rectangular baking pan and spread the dough evenly.
instructions.7: Sprinkle sesame seeds and nigella seeds over the dough surface.
instructions.8: Place the pan in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius.
instructions.9: Bake for 40–45 minutes until fully cooked.
instructions.10: Remove the shaboura from the oven and let it cool slightly.
instructions.11: Cut into slices and bake again in the oven at 140 degrees Celsius until lightly toasted.

title: Cream-filled Phyllo Fingers
culturalNotes: Phyllo fingers can be served warm or cold. Different types of nuts can be used according to preference. The fingers can be stored in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Unroll the phyllo dough and cut it into 10 cm × 10 cm squares.
instructions.2: Prepare the cream: either use ready-made cream from a can, or mix 1 cup of milk with 1 tablespoon of cornstarch and stir over medium heat until thickened.
instructions.3: Take two phyllo squares and place a spoonful of cream in the center, being careful not to let the cream touch the edges.
instructions.4: Fold the squares into phyllo finger shapes and place them in a buttered baking tray.
instructions.5: Lightly brush each finger with melted butter.
instructions.6: Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C for 10 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.7: Immediately drizzle white honey over the fingers after removing them from the oven.

title: Brioche Braids
culturalNotes: Make sure to use high-quality yeast and knead the dough thoroughly to ensure a light and crispy result. These braids can be served with colored hard-boiled eggs during Easter celebrations.

instructions.1: Mix the yeast and sugar in warm milk and stir well.
instructions.2: Add salt to the flour and stir.
instructions.3: Add the yeast and milk mixture to the flour and knead thoroughly.
instructions.4: Add butter and knead until the dough is smooth.
instructions.5: Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
instructions.6: Divide the dough into small balls and roll each into a long strip.
instructions.7: Braid three strips together and arrange the braids in a greased baking tray or one lined with parchment paper.
instructions.8: Let the braids rise again for 30 minutes.
instructions.9: Brush the braids with a mixture of egg yolk, milk, and Nescafé.
instructions.10: Bake in a preheated oven at 200 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
instructions.11: Serve the braids warm with tea or coffee.

title: Sandwich Dough
