instructions.8: Preheat the waffle maker and lightly grease it with oil.
instructions.9: Pour the batter into the waffle maker and cook for 7 to 10 minutes until golden and cooked through.
instructions.10: If you don't have a waffle maker, you can use a greased skillet on medium heat.
instructions.11: Pour the batter to make pancakes.
instructions.12: Serve waffles and pancakes with chocolate syrup, strawberries, bananas, caramel sauce, and ice cream as desired.

title: Very Crispy Date Flowers for Breakfast and Evening Snacks
culturalNotes: Make sure the date paste is cold when filling to prevent melting. You can serve the flowers with different beverages such as tea or coffee.

instructions.1: Mix the flour with yeast, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Gradually add the oil, milk, and warm water, and knead until the dough becomes soft and not sticky.
instructions.3: Let the dough rest for at least 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Divide the dough into balls the size of an egg.
instructions.5: Roll each ball flat with a rolling pin and fill with date paste.
instructions.6: Divide the rolled dough into sections and cut with a knife to form the flower shape.
instructions.7: Lightly brush some oil on the baking tray and place the flowers on it.
instructions.8: Let the flowers rise again for 10 minutes.
instructions.9: Prepare the coating mixture using milk powder, coffee, sugar, and water, then brush it over the flowers.
instructions.10: Sprinkle sesame seeds on the flowers as desired.
instructions.11: Place the tray in a preheated oven at 220 degrees Celsius.
instructions.12: Bake the flowers for 10 minutes until golden brown.
instructions.13: Serve hot with tea, Nescafé, or cappuccino.

title: Milk-Caramel Macchiato
culturalNotes: Coffee grounds can be used instead of an espresso machine if unavailable. Brown sugar can also be used to make homemade caramel syrup.

instructions.1: Prepare espresso: Make 2 shots of espresso using an espresso machine, or mix 1 tablespoon of coffee grounds with half a cup of hot water as a substitute.
instructions.2: Prepare whipped cream: Add 1 tablespoon of whipped cream to the cup.
instructions.3: Add syrup: Pour 1 tablespoon of caramel syrup into the cup.
instructions.4: Mix ingredients: Stir the espresso, whipped cream, and caramel syrup together thoroughly.
instructions.5: Add ice: Add ice to taste into the cup.
instructions.6: Add milk: Pour in milk to taste.
instructions.7: Add cream: Top with cream for the final touch.
instructions.8: Serve: Serve the drink immediately, chilled.

title: Cactus Pear Ice Cream
culturalNotes: You can try adding small pieces of fresh cactus pear for a stronger flavor. The ice cream can be stored in the freezer for up to one week.

instructions.1: Add 3 cups of cactus pear juice to a bowl.
instructions.2: Add 1 cup of heavy cream.
instructions.3: Add 1/2 cup of powdered sugar.
instructions.4: Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla.
instructions.5: Add 1 small drop of yellow food coloring.
instructions.6: Stir the ingredients well until fully combined.
instructions.7: Place the mixture in a container and cover it.
instructions.8: Put the container in the freezer for at least 4 hours.
instructions.9: After 4 hours, remove the container and make sure the consistency has become thick.

title: Umm Ali Ice Cream
culturalNotes: You can add other flavors like strawberry or vanilla to the basic ice cream mixture. The ice cream can be stored in the freezer for up to one week.

instructions.1: In a bowl, beat the whipping cream well until thick.
instructions.2: Add the sweetened condensed milk and beat the ingredients together until well combined.
instructions.3: Fry the Umm Ali in a pan over low heat with the semolina until golden brown.
instructions.4: Add the honey, raisins, and dried apricots and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Fold the toasted Umm Ali into the ice cream mixture and mix well.
instructions.6: Pour the mixture into a container and freeze for at least 6 hours.
instructions.7: Before serving, dip the spoon in hot water to make it easier to scoop the ice cream.

title: Fruit Ice Cream (Kiwi, Chocolate Banana, Strawberry)
culturalNotes: You can use any type of fruit you prefer. You can also add other flavors like vanilla or almond as desired.

instructions.1: Peel the fruit and cut it into small pieces.
instructions.2: Place the fruit in bags and freeze them.
instructions.3: Choose your favorite type of fruit (kiwi, chocolate banana, strawberry).
instructions.4: Blend the fruit with yogurt and cream chantilly in a blender.
instructions.5: Add honey if you want to increase sweetness.
instructions.6: Add cocoa if you want a chocolate flavor.
instructions.7: Blend the ingredients thoroughly until smooth.
instructions.8: Pour the mixture into a container and freeze for 2 to 3 hours.
instructions.9: Stir the mixture once or twice during freezing to achieve a smooth texture.
instructions.10: Serve the ice cream immediately after freezing.

title: Affordable Fruit Ice Cream
culturalNotes: Various frozen fruits such as strawberries, mango, and bananas can be used. Alternatively, Middle Eastern sweet syrup can be used instead of honey if honey is unavailable.

instructions.1: Blend frozen fruit, Chantilly cream, yogurt, lemon juice, and sour milk in a blender.
instructions.2: Add honey to taste and blend for 5 minutes until ingredients are well combined.
instructions.3: Add food coloring if you wish to enhance the color.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into clean, dry containers and cover them.
instructions.5: Place containers in the freezer for at least 8 hours.
instructions.6: After freezing, serve the ice cream in cups and decorate as desired.

title: Cantaloupe Ice Cream
culturalNotes: You can use any fruit of your choice to make this ice cream. The ice cream can be stored in the freezer for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Peel the cantaloupe and cut it into small pieces.
instructions.2: Place the pieces in a bag and freeze until solid.
instructions.3: In a mixing bowl, add the frozen cantaloupe, yogurt, and white honey.
instructions.4: Add the dissolved pineapple gelatin pack and mix all ingredients thoroughly.
instructions.5: If desired, add a pinch of natural flavoring color and mix well to achieve an attractive color.
instructions.6: Cover the mixture and freeze for at least 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Before serving, mix the mixture again to achieve a smooth texture.
instructions.8: Serve the ice cream in small cups or bowls.

title: Kunafa Ice Cream
culturalNotes: You can use any type of frozen fruit instead of mango according to preference. The ice cream can be stored in the freezer for up to one week.

instructions.1: Blend the frozen mango, liquid milk, and Chantilly cream in a blender until smooth.
instructions.2: Pour the mixture into a bowl and place in the freezer for 3 hours.
instructions.3: Remove the kunafa from the freezer and chop it into small pieces.
instructions.4: Add half a cup of ghee to the kunafa and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Preheat the oven to the highest temperature and bake the kunafa until crispy.
instructions.6: Add two tablespoons of honey to the baked kunafa and stir well.
instructions.7: Remove the mango ice cream from the freezer and place the crispy kunafa on top.
instructions.8: Return the ice cream to the freezer for an additional two hours.
instructions.9: Serve the ice cream in cups and enjoy the delicious taste.

title: Lotus Ice Cream
culturalNotes: You can add other flavors such as strawberry or vanilla according to preference. For best results, make sure the cream and sweetened condensed milk are cold before mixing.

instructions.1: In a bowl, add the whipping cream and beat it well.
instructions.2: Add the sweetened condensed milk and mix thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Add 4 tablespoons of raw shmytik cream and mix into the previous mixture.
instructions.4: Add 3 tablespoons of lotus cream and mix well.
instructions.5: Transfer the mixture into a container and sprinkle crushed lotus cookies on top.
instructions.6: Cover the container and freeze for at least 6 hours.
instructions.7: Before serving, dip a spoon into hot water to make it easier to scoop the ice cream.

title: Oreo Ice Cream
culturalNotes: The ice cream can be served in regular cups or coated with melted chocolate to create a crunchy outer layer. Alternatively, a spoon can be used to eat the ice cream if you don't want to use sticks.

fah-780-i3.name: Dessert cream
fah-780-i3.amount: one and a half cups (or a container of clotted cream with half a cup of milk)

instructions.1: Crush the six Oreo packs into small pieces.
instructions.2: Beat the cream in a bowl for two minutes.
instructions.3: Add the sweetened condensed milk and beat the mixture for another two minutes.
instructions.4: Fold in the crushed Oreo pieces and mix thoroughly.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture into ice cream cups.
instructions.6: Place the cups in the freezer for at least 6 hours until the ice cream is fully frozen.
instructions.7: Serve the ice cream as is or coat it with melted chocolate.

title: Ice Cream Without Eggs or Machine
culturalNotes: You can add other ingredients such as packaged fruits or nuts according to preference. The ice cream can be stored in the freezer for a long time.

instructions.1: Mix 1 cup of heavy cream with 2.5 cups of frozen milk in a bowl and beat for 5 minutes until the consistency becomes thick.
instructions.2: Add 1 can of whipping cream and beat for 1 minute.
instructions.3: Add 1 cup of sweetened condensed milk and beat for another minute until the mixture is well combined.
instructions.4: Divide the mixture into 4 airtight containers.
instructions.5: Add 3 tablespoons of caramel sauce to one container and stir well.
instructions.6: Add 1/2 teaspoon of liquid vanilla to another container and stir well.
instructions.7: Add 1 packet of Nescafé Fil Black to a third container and stir well.
instructions.8: Add 3 tablespoons of chocolate syrup and 1 tablespoon of raw cocoa powder to the last container and stir well.
instructions.9: Place the containers in the freezer for at least 8 hours.
instructions.10: After 8 hours, remove the containers from the freezer and serve the ice cream in cups or bowls.
instructions.11: You can decorate the ice cream with caramel sauce and nuts according to preference.

title: Healthy and Economical Strawberry Ice Cream
culturalNotes: You can add a little natural strawberry juice for a stronger flavor. The ice cream can be stored in the freezer for up to one week.

instructions.1: Mix the chopped strawberries with sugar, milk, and whipping cream in a bowl.
instructions.2: Place the mixture in the freezer for one hour.
instructions.3: Remove from the freezer and transfer to a blender, then blend thoroughly.
instructions.4: Return the mixture to the freezer for another 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Remove again and blend once more.
instructions.6: Serve in small cups or bowls.

title: Homemade Ice Cream with Three Flavors: Vanilla, Caramel, and Chocolate
culturalNotes: You can use any type of crushed biscuit according to preference. You can also add other ingredients such as dried fruits or walnuts to enhance the flavor.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix the milk, sugar, and cornstarch thoroughly.
instructions.2: Place the mixture over medium heat and stir until it begins to boil and thickens.
instructions.3: Add the butter and continue stirring until it melts.
instructions.4: Remove from heat and let it cool slightly.
instructions.5: Add 3 packets of dried cream, 1 tablespoon of vanilla, and 1 cup of frozen milk. Mix thoroughly for 7 minutes.
instructions.6: Transfer the mixture to a container and refrigerate for 2 hours until completely chilled.
instructions.7: After chilling, divide the mixture into three equal parts.
instructions.8: For vanilla flavor: Mix one portion thoroughly.
instructions.9: For caramel flavor: Add 3 tablespoons of caramel and 1/2 cup of crushed biscuit. Mix thoroughly.
instructions.10: For chocolate flavor: Add 2 tablespoons of cocoa, 2 tablespoons of chocolate chips, and 3 tablespoons of melted chocolate. Mix thoroughly.
instructions.11: Pour the flavors into trays and freeze for 4–6 hours until fully frozen.
instructions.12: Before serving, let the ice cream sit out to slightly soften for 10 minutes, then serve.

title: Ice Cream Cake
culturalNotes: You can use different types of ice cream according to preference. The cake can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Prepare the cake: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add eggs and vanilla, and mix ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Pour cake batter into a buttered and floured baking pan.
instructions.4: Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
instructions.5: Remove cake from oven and let it cool.
instructions.6: Prepare vanilla ice cream: Mix vanilla ice cream with frozen milk in a bowl and beat for 7 minutes.
instructions.7: Prepare chocolate ice cream: Mix chocolate ice cream with frozen milk in a bowl and beat for 7 minutes.
instructions.8: Pour a light layer of syrup onto the cooled cake.
instructions.9: Place chocolate ice cream on the cake and spread evenly.
instructions.10: Place vanilla ice cream on top of the chocolate ice cream and spread evenly.
instructions.11: Gently shake the mold to smooth the ice cream.
instructions.12: Place the cake in the refrigerator for 5-6 hours until fully frozen.
instructions.13: Remove the cake from the refrigerator and decorate with ice cream balls and chocolate sauce.

title: 3 Healthy and Delicious Drinks
culturalNotes: Chocolate syrup can be used instead of caramel syrup in the Oreo milkshake. The amount of honey can be reduced or increased to taste in the spinach and strawberry drink. A personal blender can be used to serve the juice anywhere.

instructions.1: Prepare Oreo milkshake
instructions.2: Add ice to the blender jar
instructions.3: Add 1 cup of vanilla ice cream
instructions.4: Add 1 cup of milk
instructions.5: Add 2 packs of chocolate cookies
instructions.6: Blend ingredients for 30 seconds
instructions.7: Pour the drink into glasses
instructions.8: Add caramel syrup to taste
instructions.9: Prepare spinach and strawberry drink
instructions.10: Add 1 cup of spinach leaves
instructions.11: Add 1 cup of strawberries
instructions.12: Add 1 large piece of beetroot or 2 small pieces
instructions.13: Add 1 cup of orange juice
instructions.14: Add 2 tablespoons of white honey
instructions.15: Add 1 cup of water
instructions.16: Blend ingredients thoroughly
instructions.17: Pour the drink into glasses

title: 4 Easy and Quick Winter Drinks
culturalNotes: Store sahlab powder and hot chocolate mix in clean, dry, airtight containers. You can sprinkle nuts on top of sahlab for a crunchy texture.

instructions.1: Prepare hot cider: Mix apple juice, cinnamon sticks, star anise, and orange slices in a pot. Bring to a boil and simmer until flavors are well blended.
instructions.2: Prepare sahlab powder: In a large bowl, combine rice flour, powdered sugar, milk powder, finely ground nuts, cornstarch, toasted sesame seeds, raisins, and vanilla powder. Store the mixture in an airtight container.
instructions.3: Prepare sahlab: Mix 1 cup of milk with 1 tablespoon of sahlab powder at room temperature. Heat the mixture over medium heat and stir until it boils. Pour into cups and serve.
instructions.4: Prepare hot chocolate mix: In a bowl, combine powdered sugar, cocoa powder, milk powder, cornstarch, and chocolate chips. Store the mixture in an airtight container.
instructions.5: Prepare hot chocolate: Mix 1 cup of milk with 1 tablespoon of hot chocolate mix at room temperature. Heat over medium heat and stir until it boils. Pour into cups and serve with marshmallows.
instructions.6: Prepare custard: Mix 1 cup of milk with 1 tablespoon of custard powder, 1 teaspoon of sugar, and 2 cloves in a pot. Heat over medium heat and stir until it boils and thickens. Pour into cups and garnish with ginger powder.

title: Iced Coffee
culturalNotes: You can add a little caramel syrup for a stronger and sweeter taste.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix half a cup of instant coffee with a quarter cup of sugar and one tablespoon of vanilla ice cream powder.
instructions.2: Add two tablespoons of frozen water and beat the mixture well with an electric mixer until thick and frothy.
instructions.3: Add ice to two cups, then pour the frothy coffee over the ice.
instructions.4: Stir well and serve the iced coffee cold.

title: Spanish Latte
culturalNotes: You can add a little caramel sugar for a sweeter taste and richer flavor.

instructions.1: Dissolve the instant coffee in hot water.
instructions.2: Add the sweetened condensed milk to the cup.
instructions.3: Add ice to taste.
instructions.4: Pour the dissolved coffee.
instructions.5: Complete the cup with cold liquid milk.
instructions.6: Stir the ingredients well.
instructions.7: Serve the drink cold, enjoy!

title: Espresso and Foul White
culturalNotes: Espresso and foul white can be served hot or cold according to preference. A little cinnamon or ground cocoa can be sprinkled on top for garnish.

instructions.1: Prepare espresso using an espresso machine.
instructions.2: Pour the espresso into the cup.
instructions.3: Steam the milk to create a foamy texture using the steam wand.
instructions.4: Pour the foamy milk over the espresso.
instructions.5: Add sugar to taste.

title: Nubian Tea
culturalNotes: You can adjust the sugar quantity to taste. You can also add some cucumber and olives when serving.

instructions.1: Add 1 cup of water and 1 cup of milk to a pot.
instructions.2: Add 2 tea packets and 1 teaspoon of sugar.
instructions.3: Let the mixture simmer on low heat for 5 minutes.
instructions.4: In another bowl, mix 1/2 cup of flour with 1/4 cup of water, a pinch of salt, and a pinch of sugar.
instructions.5: Add the egg and 1 teaspoon of oil, and mix thoroughly until no lumps remain.
instructions.6: Heat a pan on the stove and add a small amount of oil, spreading it evenly.
instructions.7: Add a small amount of the flour mixture and stir in the pan until it forms a soft dough.
instructions.8: Fry the dough until lightly golden.
instructions.9: Add the ricotta cheese and flip the sandwich from side to side until the cheese is melted and warm.
instructions.10: Serve the sandwich with a cup of milk tea.

title: Fresh Pineapple, Apple, and Orange Juice
culturalNotes: You can add water or sugar as desired to adjust the juice's taste. The juice can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Prepare the pineapple: Remove the skin and eyes from the pineapple and cut it into large pieces.
instructions.2: Put the pineapple in the juicer: Place the pineapple pieces into the juicer and use the appropriate speed to extract the juice.
instructions.3: Prepare the apple: Wash the apple and cut it into large pieces without removing the skin.
instructions.4: Put the apple in the juicer: Place the apple pieces into the juicer and use the appropriate speed to extract the juice.
instructions.5: Prepare the orange: Wash the orange and cut it in half.
instructions.6: Put the orange in the juicer: Place the orange halves into the juicer and use the appropriate speed to extract the juice.
instructions.7: Strain the juice: Use the filter to strain the juice and remove pulp and seeds.
instructions.8: Serve the juice: Pour the juice into glasses and serve chilled.

title: Black Mulberry Juice
culturalNotes: You can taste the juice and add more sugar or water according to preference. Boiled mulberries can also be served to children as a light snack.

instructions.1: Wash the black mulberries thoroughly.
instructions.2: Add a quarter cup of water to the sugar and place it on the stove, stirring gently until it turns a dark golden color.
instructions.3: Gradually add water to the caramel.
instructions.4: Add about two liters of water to the washed mulberries and let it boil.
instructions.5: Cover the pot, reduce the heat, and let it simmer for half an hour.
instructions.6: Strain the mixture through a fine sieve.
instructions.7: Add two liters of cold water to the juice.
instructions.8: Let the juice cool down.
instructions.9: Pour the juice into bags and store in the freezer.

title: Ramadan Dried Plum Juice
culturalNotes: You can sweeten the juice with honey instead of sugar for a healthier taste. The juice can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.

instructions.1: Add half a cup of ground dried plums to a bowl.
instructions.2: Add half a cup of sugar.
instructions.3: Add two cups of milk.
instructions.4: Add two cups of boiling water.
instructions.5: Add one cup of ice.
instructions.6: Add nuts to taste.
instructions.7: Blend all ingredients in a blender until smooth.
instructions.8: Strain the juice into cups.
instructions.9: Serve the juice chilled.

title: Strawberry, Banana, Watermelon, and Mint Lemon Juice
culturalNotes: You can use different types of lemons such as local lemon or qatli lemon. You can also garnish the cups with fruit slices or fresh herbs.

fah-794-i6.name: Simple syrup or honey or sugar

instructions.1: Wash the strawberries and cut them into small pieces
instructions.2: Add the strawberries to the blender with milk, Chantilly cream, ice cream, ice cubes, and simple syrup or honey or sugar to taste
instructions.3: Blend the ingredients thoroughly until smooth
instructions.4: Pour the juice into cups and garnish with mint
instructions.5: Cut the banana into small pieces and add ice cubes, milk, honey or simple syrup or sugar, and vanilla
instructions.6: Blend the ingredients thoroughly until smooth
instructions.7: Pour the juice into cups and garnish with banana slices
instructions.8: Cut the watermelon into cubes and add sugar, milk, and ice cubes
instructions.9: Blend the ingredients thoroughly until smooth
instructions.10: Pour the juice into cups and garnish with watermelon pieces
instructions.11: Squeeze the lemon and remove the seeds
instructions.12: Add sugar and water and mix well
instructions.13: Strain the juice to remove the peel
instructions.14: Add mint leaves and ice cubes and mix again
instructions.15: Pour the juice into cups and garnish with lemon slices and mint

title: White Chocolate Iced Coffee (Iced White Mocha)
culturalNotes: You can add sugar, honey, or caramel syrup to taste for sweetness.

instructions.1: Melt the white chocolate in the microwave for 30 seconds.
instructions.2: Mix the melted chocolate with the dissolved coffee (espresso or instant coffee) in water.
instructions.3: Add the liquid vanilla to the mixture.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into the glass.
instructions.5: Fill the glass with ice until full.
instructions.6: Pour the milk over the mixture.
instructions.7: You can add Chantilly cream and caramel syrup to taste.

title: Cappuccino
culturalNotes: Keep the foam in the freezer in an airtight container to extend its shelf life.

instructions.1: Mix the Nescafe, sugar, and water in a cup.
instructions.2: Use an electric mixer to whip the ingredients for 5 minutes, starting on low speed then gradually increasing.
instructions.3: Continue whipping until you achieve a thick, white foam.
instructions.4: Pour the foam into a clean, dry container with a tight-fitting lid.
instructions.5: Add the foam to a cup of hot milk, and stir in a spoonful of sugar if desired.
instructions.6: Garnish the cappuccino with a light sprinkle of powdered cocoa on top.

title: Cup of Nescafe with Foam
culturalNotes: The cup can be served with a small piece of chocolate or a small biscuit for garnish.

instructions.1: Add one teaspoon of Nescafe, one teaspoon of sugar, and one teaspoon of water to a cup.
instructions.2: Stir the mixture as described until well combined.
instructions.3: Gradually add hot milk to the mixture.
instructions.4: Stir vigorously to create foam.
instructions.5: Sprinkle a pinch of cocoa on top for garnish.

title: Machiato
culturalNotes: You can garnish the drink with whipped cream or chocolate pieces as desired. Machiato can also be served with biscuits or small pastries.

instructions.1: Bring the milk to room temperature or let it sit out of the refrigerator for a few minutes.
instructions.2: Use a steam machine to heat the milk and create foam. If unavailable, use an electric mixer or hand whisk to beat the milk until frothy.
instructions.3: Place the coarse ground coffee into a small cup.
instructions.4: Pour the milk foam over the coffee in the cup.
instructions.5: Add sugar to taste.
instructions.6: Serve the drink hot.

title: Delicious Dried Dates Drink
culturalNotes: Date drink is soothing and beneficial for health, helps regulate blood pressure and cleanse the liver, kidneys, and spleen. Can be served cold on hot days.

instructions.1: Wash the dates thoroughly to remove any impurities or dirt.
instructions.2: Place sugar in a pot over heat and stir with dates until sugar dissolves slightly, without browning.
instructions.3: Add 2 liters of water and let the mixture warm on the stove without boiling.
instructions.4: Cover the pot, remove from heat, and let it steep in the refrigerator overnight.
instructions.5: Strain the drink well the next day.
instructions.6: You can store the drink in bags in the freezer and use as needed.

title: Lemon, Ginger, and Honey Immunity-Boosting Drink
servings: Kept for up to one week
culturalNotes: You can consume one teaspoon of the mixture daily to boost immunity and improve skin radiance. You can also add hot water to the mixture before consuming.

instructions.1: Peel the ginger as if peeling potatoes.
instructions.2: Wash the ginger and lemon thoroughly, then dry them.
instructions.3: Cut the ginger and lemon into thin slices.
instructions.4: Mix the ginger and lemon in a bowl.
instructions.5: Transfer the mixture into a jar.
instructions.6: Pour honey over the mixture.
instructions.7: Cover the jar and store it in the refrigerator for two hours before use.
instructions.8: The mixture can be stored in the refrigerator for up to one week.

title: Detox Drink (Spinach, Beetroot, and Strawberry)
culturalNotes: This drink is rich in vitamins and minerals, improves skin health, and strengthens hair. You can adjust the honey quantity to taste.

instructions.1: Add spinach leaves to the blender.
instructions.2: Add strawberries.
instructions.3: Add chopped beetroot into small pieces.
instructions.4: Add orange juice.
instructions.5: Add white honey.
instructions.6: Add water.
instructions.7: Blend all ingredients together until smooth.

title: Strawberry Mojito
culturalNotes: Any other fruit can be used as desired, such as blueberries or orange.

instructions.1: Wash the strawberries and chop them into small pieces.
instructions.2: Add the strawberries to the glass with sugar and lemon juice.
instructions.3: Add hot water and stir well until sugar dissolves.
instructions.4: Add ice to taste and stir again.
instructions.5: Serve the drink cold in glasses.

title: Cactus Pear Milkshake
culturalNotes: You can use fresh or canned cactus pear to make the drink. You can also add a little sugar if you prefer a sweeter milkshake.

instructions.1: Wash the cactus pears thoroughly and peel them.
instructions.2: Cut the cactus pears into small pieces and add them to the blender with 1 cup of water.
instructions.3: Add the chopped cactus pears and water to the blender and blend well.
instructions.4: Strain the mixture to remove the seeds.
instructions.5: Keep about 1.5 liters of the juice.
instructions.6: In the blender bowl, add 3 cups of cactus pear juice, 1 cup of vanilla ice cream, 1 packet of Chantilly cream, and a little ice.
instructions.7: Blend the ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.8: Pour the milkshake into glasses and serve cold.

title: Coffee Milkshake
culturalNotes: Any type of plain biscuit can be used if coffee biscuits are unavailable. Sugar can also be added if you prefer the drink sweeter.

instructions.1: Add milk, Nescafe, coffee biscuits, 1 cup of vanilla ice cream, and crushed ice to the blender.
instructions.2: Blend all ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.3: Pour the mixture into serving glasses.
instructions.4: Garnish the glasses with caramel sauce, fresh chantilly cream, or additional vanilla ice cream.
instructions.5: Top each glass with a piece of coffee biscuit or any plain biscuit.

title: Mango Milkshake
culturalNotes: You can adjust the consistency by adding more ice or cold water as desired. You can also decorate the cups with other fruits such as berries or strawberries.

instructions.1: Add the mango to the blender.
instructions.2: Add the ice cubes.
instructions.3: Add the vanilla ice cream.
instructions.4: Add the Chantilly cream.
instructions.5: Add the sugar.
instructions.6: Blend the ingredients well in the blender until smooth.
instructions.7: If the consistency is too thick, add cold water or extra ice until you reach the desired texture.
instructions.8: Pour the milkshake into the cups.
instructions.9: Garnish the cups with a scoop of ice cream, mint leaves, mango cubes, and a cherry.

title: Oreo Milkshake
culturalNotes: No additional sugar is needed because ice cream and Oreo cookies already contain sugar. You can use chocolate syrup or any other syrup to enhance flavor and appearance.

instructions.1: Grab the blender and add the ice cubes.
instructions.2: Add the vanilla ice cream.
instructions.3: Add 2 cups of frozen milk.
instructions.4: Add the contents of the 2 Oreo cookie packages.
instructions.5: Blend all ingredients thoroughly until well combined.
instructions.6: Add whipped chantilly cream or ice cream topping as desired.
instructions.7: Garnish the glass with an Oreo cookie piece or chocolate syrup.

title: Nescafe with Cappuccino Foam
culturalNotes: Keep the foam in a clean, tightly sealed container in the freezer to keep it fresh longer.

instructions.1: Mix Nescafe, sugar, and water in a cup.
instructions.2: Use an electric mixer to whip the ingredients for 5 minutes, starting on low speed then gradually increasing.
instructions.3: Continue whipping until you achieve a thick, white foam.
instructions.4: Store the foam in a clean, tightly sealed container in the freezer.
instructions.5: To serve, add the foam to a cup of hot water or hot milk, and stir in one spoon of sugar to taste.
instructions.6: Garnish the cup with a light sprinkle of ground cocoa on top.

title: Hot Chocolate with Marshmallows
culturalNotes: You can serve this drink hot or cold, according to preference. You can also top the drink with marshmallows for an appealing appearance.

instructions.1: Heat the milk and pour 2 cups into a pot.
instructions.2: Add 2 squares of chocolate.
instructions.3: Stir the ingredients until the chocolate melts completely.
instructions.4: Add 3 tablespoons of sugar to taste.
instructions.5: Let the mixture boil and thicken to desired consistency.
instructions.6: Pour into cups and serve topped with marshmallows.
